H3159: Feminine of יִזְרְעֵאלִי; a Jezreelitess. In the KJV it is rendered: Jezreelitess.
H3160: From חָבָה; hidden; Jechubbah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jehubbah.
H3161: A primitive root; to be (or become) one. In the KJV it is rendered: join, unite.
H3162: From יָחַד; properly, a unit, i.e. (adverb) unitedly. In the KJV it is rendered: alike, at all (once), both, likewise, only, (al-)together, withal.
H3163: From יָ֫חַד with pronominal suffix; his unity, i.e. (adverb) together; Jachdo, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jahdo.
H3164: From יָ֫חַד and אֵל; unity of God; Jachdiel, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jahdiel.
H3165: From יָ֫חַד and יָהּ; unity of Jah; Jechdijah, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Jehdeiah.
H3166: From חָזָה and אֵל; beheld of God; Jachaziel, the name of five Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Jahaziel, Jahziel.
H3167: From חָזָה and יָהּ; Jah will behold; Jachzejah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jahaziah.
H3168: From חָזַק and אֵל; God will strengthen; Jechezkel, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Ezekiel, Jehezekel.
H3169: Or Ychizqiyahuw; from יְרוּשָׁה and יָהּ; strengthened of Jah; Jechizkijah, the name of five Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Hezekiah, Jehizkiah.
H3170: From the same as חֲזִיר; perhaps protection; Jachzerah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jahzerah.
H3171: Or (2 Chron. 29:14) Ychavrel; from חָיָה and אֵל; God will live; Jechiel (or Jechavel), the name of eight Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Jehiel.
H3172: Patronymically from יְחִיאֵל; a Jechielite or descendant of Jechiel. In the KJV it is rendered: Jehieli.
H3173: From יָחַד; properly, united, i.e. sole; by implication, beloved; also lonely; (feminine) the life (as not to be replaced). In the KJV it is rendered: darling, desolate, only (child, son), solitary.
H3174: From חָיָה and יָהּ; Jah will live; Jechijah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jehiah.
H3175: From יָחַל; expectant. In the KJV it is rendered: should hope.
H3176: A primitive root; to wait; by implication, to be patient, hope. In the KJV it is rendered: (cause to, have, make to) hope, be pained, stay, tarry, trust, wait.
H3177: From יָחַל and אֵל; expectant of God; Jachleel, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jahleel.
H3178: Patronymically from יַחְלְאֵל; a Jachleelite or descendant of Jachleel. In the KJV it is rendered: Jahleelites.
H3179: A primitive root; probably to be hot; figuratively, to conceive. In the KJV it is rendered: get heat, be hot, conceive, be warm.
H3180: From חָמַר; a kind of deer (from the color; compare חֲמוֹר). In the KJV it is rendered: fallow deer.
H3181: Probably from יָחַם; hot; Jachmai, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jahmai.
H3182: From an unused root meaning to take off the shoes; unsandalled. In the KJV it is rendered: barefoot, being unshod.
H3183: From חָצָה and אֵל; God will allot; Jachtseel, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jahzeel.
H3184: Patronymically from יַחְצְאֵל; a Jachtseelite (collectively) or descendants of Jachtseel. In the KJV it is rendered: Jahzeelites.
H3185: From חָצָה and אֵל; allotted of God; Jachtsiel, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jahziel.
H3186: A primitive root; to delay. In the KJV it is rendered: tarry longer.
H3187: A primitive root; to sprout; used only as denominative from יַ֫חַשׂ; to enroll by pedigree. In the KJV it is rendered: (number after, number throughout the) genealogy (to be reckoned), be reckoned by genealogies.
H3188: From יָחַשׂ; a pedigree or family list (as growing spontaneously). In the KJV it is rendered: genealogy.
H3189: From יָחַד; unity; Jachath, the name of four Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Jahath.
H3190: A primitive root; to be (causative) make well, literally (sound, beautiful) or figuratively (happy, successful, right). In the KJV it is rendered: be accepted, amend, use aright, benefit, be (make) better, seem best, make cheerful, be comely, + be content, diligent(-ly), dress, earnestly, find favour, give, be glad, do (be, make) good((-ness)), be (make) merry, please (+ well), shew more (kindness), skilfully, X very small, surely, make sweet, thoroughly, tire, trim, very, be (can, deal, entreat, go, have) well (said, seen).
H3191: (Aramaic) corresponding to יָטַב. In the KJV it is rendered: seem good.
H3192: From יָטַב; pleasantness; Jotbah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Jotbah.
H3193: From יָטְבָה; Jotbathah, a place in the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Jotbath, Jotbathah.
H3194: Or Yuwtah; from נָטָה; extended; Juttah (or Jutah), a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Juttah.
H3195: Probably from the same as טוּר; encircled (i.e. inclosed); Jetur, a son of Ishmael. In the KJV it is rendered: Jetur.
H3196: From an unused root meaning to effervesce; wine (as fermented); by implication, intoxication. In the KJV it is rendered: banqueting, wine, wine(-bibber).
H3197: By erroneous transcription for יָד; a hand or side. In the KJV it is rendered: (way-)side.
H3198: A primitive root; to be right (i.e. correct); reciprocal, to argue; causatively, to decide, justify or convict. In the KJV it is rendered: appoint, argue, chasten, convince, correct(-ion), daysman, dispute, judge, maintain, plead, reason (together), rebuke, reprove(-r), surely, in any wise.
H3199: From כּוּן; he (or it) will establish; Jakin, the name of three Israelites and of a temple pillar. In the KJV it is rendered: Jachin.
H3200: Patronymically from יָכִין; a Jakinite (collectively) or descendants of Jakin. In the KJV it is rendered: Jachinites.
H3201: Or (fuller) yakowl; a primitive root; to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might). In the KJV it is rendered: be able, any at all (ways), attain, can (away with, (-not)), could, endure, might, overcome, have power, prevail, still, suffer.
H3202: (Aramaic) or ykiyl (Aramaic); to יָכֹל. In the KJV it is rendered: be able, can, couldest, prevail.
H3203: And Ykolyahuw; or (2 Chronicles 26:3) Ykiylyah; from יָכֹל and יָהּ; Jah will enable; Jekoljah or Jekiljah, an Israelitess. In the KJV it is rendered: Jecholiah, Jecoliah.
H3204: And Ykonyahuw; or (Jereremiah 27:20) Ykownyah; from כּוּן and יָהּ; Jah will establish; Jekonjah, a Jewish king. In the KJV it is rendered: Jeconiah.
H3205: A primitive root; to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage. In the KJV it is rendered: bear, beget, birth((-day)), born, (make to) bring forth (children, young), bring up, calve, child, come, be delivered (of a child), time of delivery, gender, hatch, labour, (do the office of a) midwife, declare pedigrees, be the son of, (woman in, woman that) travail(-eth, -ing woman).
H3206: From יָלַד; something born, i.e. a lad or offspring. In the KJV it is rendered: boy, child, fruit, son, young man (one).
H3207: Feminine of יָ֫לֶד; a lass. In the KJV it is rendered: damsel, girl.
H3208: Abstractly from יָ֫לֶד; boyhood (or girlhood). In the KJV it is rendered: childhood, youth.
H3209: Passive from יָלַד; born. In the KJV it is rendered: born.
H3210: From לוּן; lodging; Jalon, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jalon.
H3211: From יָלַד; born. In the KJV it is rendered: ((home-))born, child, son.
H3212: A primitive root (compare הָלַך); to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses). In the KJV it is rendered: X again, away, bear, bring, carry (away), come (away), depart, flow, + follow(-ing), get (away, hence, him), (cause to, made) go (away, -ing, -ne, one's way, out), grow, lead (forth), let down, march, prosper, + pursue, cause to run, spread, take away ((-journey)), vanish, (cause to) walk(-ing), wax, X be weak.
H3213: A primitive root; to howl (with a wailing tone) or yell (with a boisterous one). In the KJV it is rendered: (make to) howl, be howling.
H3216: A primitive root; to blurt or utter inconsiderately. In the KJV it is rendered: devour.
H3217: From an unused root apparently meaning to stick or scrape; scurf or tetter. In the KJV it is rendered: scabbed.
H3218: From an unused root meaning to lick up; a devourer; specifically, the young locust. In the KJV it is rendered: cankerworm, caterpillar.
H3219: From לָקַט; a travelling pouch (as if for gleanings):-scrip.
H3220: From an unused root meaning to roar; a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south. In the KJV it is rendered: sea (X -faring man, (-shore)), south, west (-ern, side, -ward).
H3221: (Aramaic) corresponding to יָם. In the KJV it is rendered: sea.
H3222: From the same as יוֹם; a warm spring. In the KJV it is rendered: mule.
H3223: From יוֹם and אֵל; day of God; Jemuel, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jemuel.
H3224: Perhaps from the same as יוֹם; properly, warm, i.e. affectionate; hence, dove (compare יוֹנִים); Jemimah, one of Job's daughters. In the KJV it is rendered: Jemimah.
H3225: From יָמַן; the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south. In the KJV it is rendered: + left-handed, right (hand, side), south.
H3226: The same as יָמִין; Jamin, the name of three Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Jamin.
H3227: For יָמִין; right. In the KJV it is rendered: (on the) right (hand).
H3228: Patronymically from יָמִין; a Jeminite (collectively) or descendants of Jamin. In the KJV it is rendered: Jaminites.
H3229: Or Yimlah; from מָלֵא; full; Jimla or Jimlah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Imla, Imlah.
H3230: From מָלַך; he will make king; Jamlek, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jamlech.
H3231: A primitive root; to be (physically) right (i.e. firm); but used only as denominative from יָמִין and transitive, to be right-handed or take the right-hand side. In the KJV it is rendered: go (turn) to (on, use) the right hand.
H3232: From יָמַן; prosperity (as betokened by the right hand); Jimnah, the name of two Israelites; also (with the article) of the posterity of one of them. In the KJV it is rendered: Imna, Imnah, Jimnah, Jimnites.
H3233: From יָמַן; right (i.e. at the right hand): -(on the) right (hand).
H3234: From מָנַע; he will restrain; Jimna, an Israelite: -Imna.
H3235: A primitive root; to exchange; by implication, to change places. In the KJV it is rendered: boast selves, change.
H3236: Probably from יָמַר; interchange; Jimrah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Imrah.
H3237: A primitive root; to touch. In the KJV it is rendered: feel.
H3238: A primitive root; to rage or be violent: by implication, to suppress, to maltreat. In the KJV it is rendered: destroy, (thrust out by) oppress(-ing, -ion, -or), proud, vex, do violence.
H3239: Or (with enclitic) Yanowchah from יָנַח; quiet; Janoach or Janochah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Janoah, Janohah.
H3240: A primitive root; to deposit; by implication, to allow to stay. In the KJV it is rendered: bestow, cast down, lay (down, up), leave (off), let alone (remain), pacify, place, put, set (down), suffer, withdraw, withhold.
H3241: From נוּם; asleep; Janim, a place in Palestine: -Janum (from the margin).
H3242: From יָנַק; a sucker or sapling. In the KJV it is rendered: young twig.
H3243: A primitive root; to suck; causatively, to give milk. In the KJV it is rendered: milch, nurse(-ing mother), (give, make to) suck(-ing child, -ling).
H3244: Or yanshowph; apparently from נָשַׁף; an unclean (acquatic) bird; probably the heron (perhaps from its blowing cry, or because the night-heron is meant (compare נֶ֫שֶׁף))). In the KJV it is rendered: (great) owl.
H3245: A primitive root; to set (literally or figuratively); intensively, to found; reflexively, to sit down together, i.e. settle, consult. In the KJV it is rendered: appoint, take counsel, establish, (lay the, lay for a) found(-ation), instruct, lay, ordain, set, X sure.
H3246: From יָסַד; a foundation (figuratively, i.e. beginning). In the KJV it is rendered: X began.
H3247: From יָסַד; a foundation (literally or figuratively):--bottom, foundation, repairing.
H3248: Feminine of יְסֻד; a foundation. In the KJV it is rendered: foundation.
H3250: From יָסַר; a reprover. In the KJV it is rendered: instruct.
H3251: A primitive root; to pour (intransitive). In the KJV it is rendered: be poured.
H3252: From an unused root meaning to watch; observant; Jiskah, sister of Lot. In the KJV it is rendered: Iscah.
H3253: From סָמַך and יָהּ; Jah will sustain; Jismakjah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Ismachiah.
H3254: A primitive root; to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing). In the KJV it is rendered: add, X again, X any more, X cease, X come more, + conceive again, continue, exceed, X further, X gather together, get more, give more-over, X henceforth, increase (more and more), join, X longer (bring, do, make, much, put), X (the, much, yet) more (and more), proceed (further), prolong, put, be (strong-) er, X yet, yield.
H3255: (Aramaic) corresponding to יָסַף. In the KJV it is rendered: add.
H3256: A primitive root; to chastise, literally (with blows) or figuratively (with words); hence, to instruct. In the KJV it is rendered: bind, chasten, chastise, correct, instruct, punish, reform, reprove, sore, teach.
H3257: From יָעָה; a shovel. In the KJV it is rendered: shovel.
H3258: From an unused root probably meaning to grieve; sorrowful; Jabets, the name of an Israelite, and also of a place in Palestine: -Jabez.
H3259: A primitive root; to fix upon (by agreement or appointment); by implication, to meet (at a stated time), to summon (to trial), to direct (in a certain quarter or position), to engage (for marriage): -agree,(maxke an) appoint(-ment,a time), assemble (selves), betroth, gather (selves, together), meet (together), set (a time).
H3260: From יָעַד; appointed; Jedi, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Iddo (from the margin) See Yiddow.
H3261: A primitive root; apparently to brush aside. In the KJV it is rendered: sweep away.
H3262: From יָעָה and אֵל; carried away of God; Jeuel, the name of four Israelites; -Jehiel, Jeiel, Jeuel. Compare יְעִיאֵל.
H3263: From עוּץ; counsellor; Jeuts, an Israelite: -Jeuz.(gl.
H3264: A variation of יַעֲרֶשְׁיָה; a forest. In the KJV it is rendered: wood.
H3265: Apparently the passive participle of the same as יָ֫עַר; wooded; Jaur, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jair(from the margin).
H3266: From עוּשׁ; hasty; Jeush, the name of an Edomite and of four Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Jehush, Jeush.
H3267: A primitive root; to be bold or obstinate: d-fierce.
H3268: From יָעַז and אֵל; emboldened of God; Jaaziel, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jaaziel.
H3269: From יָעַז and יָהּ; emboldened of Jah; Jaazijah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jaaziah.
H3270: Or Yazer; from עָזַר; helpful; Jaazer or Jazer, a place East of the Jordan. In the KJV it is rendered: Jaazer, Jazer.
H3271: A primitive root; to clothe. In the KJV it is rendered: cover.
H3272: (Aramaic) corresponding to יָעַץ; to counsel; reflexively, to consult. In the KJV it is rendered: counsellor, consult together.
H3273: From יָעָה and אֵל; carried away of God; Jeiel, the name of six Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Jeiel, Jehiel.
H3274: From עוּשׁ; hasty; Jeish, the name of an Edomite and of a an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jeush (from the margin).
H3275: From the same as עָכָן; troublesome; Jakan, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jachan.
H3276: A primitive root; properly, to ascend; figuratively, to be valuable (objectively: useful, subjectively: benefited). In the KJV it is rendered: X at all, set forward, can do good, (be, have) profit, (able).
H3277: From יָעַל; an ibex (as climbing). In the KJV it is rendered: wild goat.
H3278: The same as יָעֵל; Jael, a Canaanite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jael.
H3279: Or Yaaalah; the same as יַעֲלַת or direct from יָעַל; Jaala or Jaalah, one of the Nethinim. In the KJV it is rendered: Jaala, Jaalah.
H3280: Feminine of יָעֵל. In the KJV it is rendered: roe.
H3281: From עָלַם; occult; Jalam, an Edomite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jalam.
H3282: From an unused root meaning to pay attention; properly, heed; by implication, purpose (sake or account); used adverbially to indicate the reason or cause. In the KJV it is rendered: because (that), forasmuch (+ as), seeing then, + that, + wheras, + why.
H3283: From the same as יַ֫עַן; the ostrich (probably from its answering cry. In the KJV it is rendered: ostrich.
H3284: Feminine of יְעֵנִים, and meaning the same. In the KJV it is rendered: + owl.
H3285: From the same as יְעֵנִים; responsive; Jaanai, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jaanai.
H3286: A primitive root; to tire (as if from wearisome flight). In the KJV it is rendered: faint, cause to fly, (be) weary (self).
H3287: From יָעַף; fatigued; figuratively, exhausted. In the KJV it is rendered: faint, weary.
H3289: A primitive root; to advise; reflexively, to deliberate or resolve. In the KJV it is rendered: advertise, take advise, advise (well), consult, (give, take) counsel(-lor), determine, devise, guide, purpose.
H3290: From עָקַב; heel-catcher (i.e. supplanter); Jaakob, the Israelitish patriarch. In the KJV it is rendered: Jacob.
H3292: From the same as עֲקָן; Jaakan, an Idumaean: -Jaakan. Compare בְּנֵי יַעֲקָן.
H3293: From an unused root probably meaning to thicken with verdure; a copse of bushes; hence, a forest; hence, honey in the comb (as hived in trees). In the KJV it is rendered: (honey-)comb, forest, wood.
H3294: A form of יַעְרַת; Jarah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jarah.
H3295: Feminine of יָ֫עַר, and meaning the same. In the KJV it is rendered: (honey-) comb, forest.
H3296: From the plural of יָ֫עַר and the masculine plural active participle of אָרַג; woods of weavers; Jaare-Oregim, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jaare-oregim.
H3297: Plural of יָ֫עַר; forests; Jearim, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Jearim.
H3298: From an unused root of uncertain signification and יָהּ; Jaareshjah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jaresiah.
H3299: From עָשָׂה; they will do; Jaasu, an Israelite: -Jaasau.
H3300: From עָשָׂה and אֵל; made of God; Jaasiel, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jaasiel, Jasiel.
H3301: From פָּדָה and יָהּ; Jah will liberate; Jiphdejah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Iphedeiah.
H3302: A primitive root; properly, to be bright, i.e. (by implication) beautiful. In the KJV it is rendered: be beautiful, be (make self) fair(-r), deck.
H3303: From יָפָה; beautiful (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: + beautiful, beauty, comely, fair(-est, one), + goodly, pleasant, well.
H3304: From יָפָה by reduplication; very beautiful. In the KJV it is rendered: very fair.
H3305: Or Yaphow (Ezra 3:7); from יָפָה; beautiful; Japho, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Japha, Joppa.
H3306: A primitive root; properly, to breathe hard, i.e. (by implication) to sigh. In the KJV it is rendered: bewail self.
H3307: From יָפַח; properly, puffing, i.e. (figuratively) meditating. In the KJV it is rendered: such as breathe out.
H3308: From יָפָה; beauty. In the KJV it is rendered: beauty.
H3309: From יָפַע; bright; Japhia, the name of a Canaanite, an Israelite, and a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Japhia.

H3311: Patronymically from יַפְלֵט; a Japhletite or descendant of Japhlet. In the KJV it is rendered: Japhleti.
H3312: From פָּנָה; he will be prepared; Jephunneh, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Jephunneh.

H3315: From פָּתָה; expansion; Jepheth, a son of Noah; also his posterity. In the KJV it is rendered: Japheth.

H3320: A primitive root; to place (any thing so as to stay); reflexively, to station, offer, continue. In the KJV it is rendered: present selves, remaining, resort, set (selves), (be able to, can, with-) stand (fast, forth, -ing, still, up).
H3321: (Aramaic) corresponding to יָצַב; to be firm; hence, to speak surely. In the KJV it is rendered: truth.
H3322: A primitive root; to place permanently. In the KJV it is rendered: establish, leave, make, present, put, set, stay.
H3323: From צָהַר; oil (as producing light); figuratively, anointing. In the KJV it is rendered: + anointed oil.
H3324: The same as יִצְהָר; Jitshar, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Izhar.
H3325: Patronymically from יִצְהָר; a Jitsharite or descendant of Jitshar. In the KJV it is rendered: Izeharites, Izharites.
H3326: Passive participle of יָצַע; spread, i.e. a bed; (architecture) an extension, i.e. wing or lean-to (a single story or collectively): -bed, chamber, couch.
H3327: From צָחַק; laughter (i.e. mochery); Jitschak (or Isaac), son of Abraham. In the KJV it is rendered: Isaac.
H3328: From the same as צָ֫חַר; he will shine; Jitschar, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: and Zehoar (from the margin).
H3329: From יָצָא; issue, i.e. offspring. In the KJV it is rendered: those that came forth.
H3330: (Aramaic) from יְצֵב; fixed, sure; concretely, certainty. In the KJV it is rendered: certain(-ty), true, truth.
H3331: A primitive root; to strew as a surface. In the KJV it is rendered: make (one's) bed, X lie, spread.
H3332: A primitive root; properly, to pour out (transitive or intransitive); by implication, to melt or cast as metal; by extension, to place firmly, to stiffen or grow hard. H3333: Passive participle feminine of יָצַק; poured out, i.e. run into a mould. In the KJV it is rendered: when it was cast.
H3334: A primitive root; to press (intransitive), i.e. be narrow; figuratively, be in distress. In the KJV it is rendered: be distressed, be narrow, be straitened (in straits), be vexed.

H3336: From יָצַר; a form; figuratively, conception (i.e. purpose). In the KJV it is rendered: frame, thing framed, imagination, mind, work.
H3337: The same as יֵ֫צֶר; Jetser, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jezer.
H3338: Passive participle of יָצַר; structure, i.e. limb or part. In the KJV it is rendered: member.
H3339: From יָצַר; formative; Jitsri, an Israelite: -Isri.
H3340: : patronymically from יֵ֫צֶר; a Jitsrite (collectively) or descendants of Jetser. In the KJV it is rendered: Jezerites.
H3341: A primitive root; to burn or set on fire; figuratively, to desolate. In the KJV it is rendered: burn (up), be desolate, set (on) fire ((fire)), kindle.
H3342: From an unused root meaning to excavate; a trough (as dug out); specifically, a wine-vat (whether the lower one, into which the juice drains; or the upper, in which the grapes are crushed). In the KJV it is rendered: fats, presses, press-fat, wine(-press).
H3343: From קָבַץ and אֵל; God will gather; Jekabtseel, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Jekabzeel.
H3344: A primitive root; to burn. In the KJV it is rendered: (be) burn(-ing), X from the hearth, kindle.
H3345: (Aramaic) corresponding to יָקַד. In the KJV it is rendered: burning.
H3347: From יָקַד and עָם; burning of (the) people; Jokdeam, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Jokdeam.
H3348: From an unused root probably meaning to obey; obedient; Jakeh, a symbolical name (for Solomon). In the KJV it is rendered: Jakeh.
H3349: From the same as יָקֶה; obedience: -gathering, to obey.
H3350: From יָקַד; a burning. In the KJV it is rendered: burning.
H3351: From קוּם; properly, standing (extant), i.e. by implication, a living thing. In the KJV it is rendered: (living) substance.
H3352: From יָקֹשׁ; properly, entangling; hence, a snarer: -fowler.
H3353: Passive participle of יָקֹשׁ; properly, entangled, i.e. by implication (intransitively) a snare, or (transitive) a snarer. In the KJV it is rendered: fowler, snare.
H3354: From the same as יָקֶה and אֵל; obedience of God; Jekuthiel, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jekuthiel.
H3355: From קָטַן; he will be made little; Joktan, an Arabian patriarch. In the KJV it is rendered: Joktan.
H3356: From קוּם; he will raise; Jakim, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Jakim.
H3357: From יָקַר; precious. In the KJV it is rendered: dear.
H3358: (Aramaic) corresponding to יַקִּיר. In the KJV it is rendered: noble, rare.
H3359: From קוּם and יָהּ; Jah will rise; Jekamjah, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Jekamiah.
H3360: From קוּם and עָם; (the) people will rise; Jekamam, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jekameam.
H3361: From קוּם and עָם; (the) people will be raised; Jokmeam, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Jokmeam.
H3362: From קוּן and עָם; (the) people will be lamented; Jokneam, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Jokneam.
H3363: A primitive root; properly, to sever oneself, i.e. (by implication) to be dislocated; figuratively, to abandon; causatively, to impale (and thus allow to drop to pieces by rotting). In the KJV it is rendered: be alienated, depart, hang (up), be out of joint.
H3364: A primitive root; to awake (intransitive). In the KJV it is rendered: (be) awake(-d).
H3365: A primitive root; properly, apparently, to be heavy, i.e. (figuratively) valuable; causatively, to make rare (figuratively, to inhibit). In the KJV it is rendered: be (make) precious, be prized, be set by, withdraw.
H3366: From יָקַר; value, i.e. (concretely) wealth; abstractly, costliness, dignity. In the KJV it is rendered: honour, precious (things), price.
H3367: (Aramaic) corresponding to יְקָר. In the KJV it is rendered: glory, honour.
H3368: From יָקַר; valuable (obj. or subj.): -brightness, clear, costly, excellent, fat, honourable women, precious, reputation.
H3369: A primitive root; to ensnare (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: fowler (lay a) snare.
H3370: From יָקֹשׁ; insidious; Jokshan, an Arabian patriarch. In the KJV it is rendered: Jokshan.
H3371: Probably from the same as יָקֶה and אֵל; veneration of God (compare יְקוּתִיאֵל); Joktheel, the name of a place in Palestine, and of one in Idumaea. In the KJV it is rendered: Joktheel.
H3372: A primitive root; to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten. In the KJV it is rendered: affright, be (make) afraid, dread(-ful), (put in) fear(-ful, -fully, -ing), (be had in) reverence(-end), X see, terrible (act, -ness, thing).
H3373: From יָרֵא; fearing; morally, reverent. In the KJV it is rendered: afraid, fear (-ful).
H3374: Feminine of יָרֵא; fear (also used as infinitive); morally, reverence. In the KJV it is rendered: X dreadful, X exceedingly, fear(-fulness).
H3375: From יָרֵא; fearfulness; Jiron, a place in Pal: -Iron.
H3376: From יָרֵא and יָהּ; fearful of Jah; Jirijah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Irijah.

H3378: From רִיב and בַּ֫עַל; Baal will contend; Jerubbaal, a symbol. name of Gideon. In the KJV it is rendered: Jerubbaal.
H3379: From רִיב and עָם; (the) people will contend; Jarobam, the name of two Israelite kings. In the KJV it is rendered: Jeroboam.
H3380: From רִיב and בֹּ֫שֶׁת; shame (i.e. the idol) will contend; Jerubbesheth, a symbol. name for Gideon: -Jerubbesheth.

H3383: From יָרַד; a descender; Jarden, the principal river of Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Jordan.

H3385: From יָרָה and אֵל; founded of God; Jeruel, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Jeruel.
H3386: Perhaps denominative from יָרֵ֫חַ; (born at the) new moon; Jaroach, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jaroah.
H3387: From יָרַק; green, i.e. an herb. In the KJV it is rendered: green thing.
H3388: Or Yaruwshah feminine passive participle of יָרַשׁ; possessed; Jerusha or Jerushah, as Israelitess. In the KJV it is rendered: Jerusha, Jerushah.
H3389: Rarely Yruwshalayim; a dual (in allusion to its two main hills (the true pointing, at least of the former reading, seems to be that of יְרוּשְׁלֶם)); probably from (the passive participle of) יָרָה and שָׁלַם; founded peaceful; Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine. H3391: From a unused root of uncertain signification; a lunation, i.e. month. In the KJV it is rendered: month, moon.
H3392: The same as יֶ֫רַח; Jerach, an Arabian patriarch. In the KJV it is rendered: Jerah.
H3393: (Aramaic) corresponding to יֶ֫רַח; a month. In the KJV it is rendered: month.
H3394: From the same as יֶ֫רַח; the moon. In the KJV it is rendered: moon.
H3395: From רָחַם; compassionate; Jerocham, the name of seven or eight Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Jeroham.
H3396: From רָחַם and אֵל; God will compassionate; Jerachmeel, the name of three Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Jerahmeel.
H3397: Patronymically from יְרַחְמְאֵל; a Jerachmeelite or descendant of Jerachmeel. In the KJV it is rendered: Jerahmeelites.
H3398: Probably of Egyptian origin; Jarcha, an Egyptian. In the KJV it is rendered: Jarha.
H3399: A primitive root; to precipitate or hurl (rush) headlong; (intransitively) to be rash. In the KJV it is rendered: be perverse, turn over.
H3400: From יָרָה and אֵל; thrown of God; Jeriel, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jeriel.
H3401: From רִיב; literally, he will contend; properly, adjective, contentious; used as noun, an adversary. In the KJV it is rendered: that content(-eth), that strive.
H3402: The same as יָרִיב; Jarib, the name of three Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Jarib.
H3403: From יָרִיב; contentious; Jeribai, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jeribai.
H3404: Or Yriyahuw; from יָרָה and יָהּ; Jah will throw; Jerijah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jeriah, Jerijah.
H3405: Or Yrechow; or variation (1 Kings 16:34) Yriychoh; perhaps from יָרֵ֫חַ; its month; or else from ר֫וּחַ; fragrant; Jericho or Jerecho, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Jericho.

H3407: From יָרַע; a hanging (as tremulous). In the KJV it is rendered: curtain.
H3408: Plural of יְרִיעָה; curtains; Jerioth, an Israelitess. In the KJV it is rendered: Jerioth.

H3412: From רוּם; elevation; Jarmuth, the name of two places in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Jarmuth.
H3413: From רוּם; elevated; Jeremai, an Israelite: -Jeremai.
H3414: Or Yirmyahuw; from רוּם and יָהּ; Jah will rise; Jirmejah, the name of eight or nine Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Jeremiah.

H3417: A primitive root; to spit. In the KJV it is rendered: X but, spit.
H3418: From יָרַק (in the sense of vacuity of color); properly, pallor, i.e. hence, the yellowish green of young and sickly vegetation; concretely, verdure, i.e. grass or vegetation. In the KJV it is rendered: grass, green (thing).
H3419: From the same as יֶ֫רֶק; properly, green; concretely, a vegetable. In the KJV it is rendered: green, herbs.
H3420: From יֶ֫רֶק; paleness, whether of persons (from fright), or of plants (from drought). In the KJV it is rendered: greenish, yellow.
H3421: From רִיק and עָם; people will be poured forth; Jorkeam, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Jorkeam.
H3422: From the same as יֶ֫רֶק; yellowishness: -greenish, yellow.

H3432: Patronymically from יָשׁוּב; a Jashubite, or descendant of Jashub. In the KJV it is rendered: Jashubites.

H3439: From the same as יֶ֫שַׁח and יָהּ; Jah will empty; Jeshochajah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jeshoaiah.
H3440: From שָׁוָה; level; Jishvi, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Ishuai, Ishvi, Isui, Jesui.

H3450: From שׂוּם and אֵל; God will place; Jesimael, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Jesimael.
