H4082: From דִּין; properly, a judgeship, i.e. jurisdiction; by implication, a district (as ruled by a judge); generally, a region. In the KJV it is rendered: (X every) province.
H4083: (Aramaic) corresponding to מְדִינָה. In the KJV it is rendered: province.
H4084: Patronymical or patrial from מִדְיָן; a Midjanite or descend. (native) of Midjan. In the KJV it is rendered: Midianite.
H4085: From דּוּך; a mortar. In the KJV it is rendered: mortar.
H4086: From the same as דֹּ֫מֶן; dunghill; Madmen, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Madmen.
H4087: Feminine from the same as דֹּ֫מֶן; a dunghill. In the KJV it is rendered: dunghill.
H4088: The same as מַדְמֵנָה; Madmenah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Madmenah.
H4089: A variation for מַדְמֵנָה; Madmannah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Madmannah.
H4090: A form of מָדוֹן. In the KJV it is rendered: discord, strife.
H4091: The same as מְדָנִים; Medan, a son of Abraham. In the KJV it is rendered: Medan.
H4092: A variation of מִדְיָנִי. In the KJV it is rendered: Midianite.

H4094: From דָּקַר; a wound. In the KJV it is rendered: piercing.

H4100: Or mah; or ma; or ma; also meh; a primitive particle; properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! H4112: From הָלַם; a blow. In the KJV it is rendered: stripe, stroke.

H4115: From הָפַך; a wrench, i.e. the stocks. In the KJV it is rendered: prison, stocks.

H4280: From the same as חַרְאֵי; a sink. In the KJV it is rendered: draught house.
H4281: From חָרַשׁ; probably a pick-axe. In the KJV it is rendered: mattock.
H4282: From חָרַשׁ; probably a hoe. In the KJV it is rendered: share.
H4283: Or mochoratham (1 Sam. 30:17); feminine from the same as מָחָר; the morrow or (adverbially) tomorrow. In the KJV it is rendered: morrow, next day.
H4284: Or machashebeth; from חָשַׁב; a contrivance, i.e. (concretely) a texture, machine, or (abstractly) intention, plan (whether bad, a plot; or good, advice). In the KJV it is rendered: cunning (work), curious work, device(-sed), imagination, invented, means, purpose, thought.
H4285: From חָשַׁך; darkness; concretely, a dark place. In the KJV it is rendered: dark(-ness, place).
H4286: From חָשַׂף; a peeling. In the KJV it is rendered: made appear.
H4287: Probably from מָחָה; erasure; Machath, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Mahath.
H4288: From חָתָה; properly, a dissolution; concretely, a ruin, or (abstractly) consternation. In the KJV it is rendered: destruction, dismaying, ruin, terror.
H4289: The same as מְחִתָּה in the sense of removal; a pan for live coals. In the KJV it is rendered: censer, firepan, snuffdish.
H4290: From חָתַר; a burglary; figuratively, unexpected examination. In the KJV it is rendered: breaking up, secret search.
H4291: (Aramaic) or mtah (Aramaic); apparently corresponding to מָצָא in the intransitive sense of being found present; to arrive, extend or happen. In the KJV it is rendered: come, reach.
H4292: Apparently a denominative from טִיט; a broom (as removing dirt (compare Engl. "to dust", i.e. remove dust)). In the KJV it is rendered: besom.
H4293: From טָבַח; slaughter. In the KJV it is rendered: slaughter.
H4294: Or (feminine) mattah; from נָטָה; a branch (as extending); figuratively, a tribe; also a rod, whether for chastising (figuratively, correction), ruling (a sceptre), throwing (a lance), or walking (a staff; figuratively, a support of life, e.g. bread). In the KJV it is rendered: rod, staff, tribe.
H4295: From עָוַר with directive enclitic appended; downward, below or beneath; often adverbially with or without prefixes. In the KJV it is rendered: beneath, down(-ward), less, very low, under(-neath).
H4296: From נָטָה; a bed (as extended) for sleeping or eating; by analogy, a sofa, litter or bier. In the KJV it is rendered: bed((-chamber)), bier.
H4297: From נָטָה; a stretching, i.e. distortion (figuratively, iniquity). In the KJV it is rendered: perverseness.
H4298: From נָטָה; expansion. In the KJV it is rendered: stretching out.
H4299: From טָוָה; something spun. In the KJV it is rendered: spun.
H4300: From טוּל in the sense of hammering out; an iron bar (as forged). In the KJV it is rendered: bar.
H4301: Or matmon; or matmun; from טָמַן; a secret storehouse; hence, a secreted valuable (buried); generally money. In the KJV it is rendered: hidden riches, (hid) treasure(-s).
H4302: From נָטַע; something planted, i.e. the place (a garden or vineyard), or the thing (a plant, figuratively or men); by implication, the act, planting. In the KJV it is rendered: plant(-ation, -ing).
H4303: Or (feminine) matiammah; from טָעַם; a delicacy. In the KJV it is rendered: dainty (meat), savoury meat.
H4304: From טָפַח; a wide cloak (for a woman). In the KJV it is rendered: vail, wimple.
H4305: A primitive root; to rain. In the KJV it is rendered: (cause to) rain (upon).
H4306: From מָטַר; rain. In the KJV it is rendered: rain.
H4307: Or mattarah; from נָטַר; a jail (as a guard-house); also an aim (as being closely watched). In the KJV it is rendered: mark, prison.
H4308: From טָרַד; propulsive; Matred, an Edomitess. In the KJV it is rendered: Matred.
H4309: From מָטַר; rainy; Matri, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Matri.
H4310: An interrogative pronoun of persons, as מָה is of things, who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix. In the KJV it is rendered: any (man), X he, X him, + O that! what, which, who(-m, -se, -soever), + would to God.
H4311: From מָ֫יִם and דֹּ֫בֶא; water of quiet; Medeba, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Medeba.
H4312: From יָדַד in the sense of loving; affectionate; Medad, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Medad.
H4313: From מָ֫יִם and יֵרָקוֹן with the art. interposed; water of the yellowness; Me-haj-Jarkon, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Me-jarkon.
H4314: From מָ֫יִם and זָהָב, water of gold; Me-Zahab, an Edomite. In the KJV it is rendered: Mezahab.
H4315: From יָטַב; the best part. In the KJV it is rendered: best.
H4316: A variation for מִיכָה; Mica, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Micha.
H4317: From מִי and (the prefix derivative from) כִּי and אֵל; who (is) like God?; Mikael, the name of an archangel and of nine Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Michael.
H4318: An abbrev. of מִיכָיָה; Micah, the name of seven Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Micah, Micaiah, Michah.
H4319: A contr. for מִיכָיְהוּ; Mikehu, an Israelite prophet. In the KJV it is rendered: Micaiah (2 Chronicles 18:8).
H4320: From מִי and (the prefix derivative from) כִּי and יָהּ; who (is) like Jah?; Micajah, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Micah, Michaiah.
H4321: Or Mikayhuw (Jeremiah 36:11); abbrev. for מִיכָיָ֫הוּ; Mikajah, the name of three Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Micah, Micaiah, Michaiah.
H4322: For מִיכָיָה; Mikajah, the name of an Israelite and an Israelitess. In the KJV it is rendered: Michaiah.
H4323: From יָכֹל; properly, a container, i.e. a streamlet. In the KJV it is rendered: brook.
H4324: Apparently the same as מִיכַל הַמָּ֫יִם; revulet; Mikal, Saul's daughter. In the KJV it is rendered: Michal.
H4325: Dual of a primitive noun (but used in a singular sense); water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen. In the KJV it is rendered: + piss, wasting, water(-ing, (-course, -flood, -spring)).
H4326: A form for מִנְיָמִין; Mijamin, the name of three Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Miamin, Mijamin.
H4327: From an unused root meaning to portion out; a sort, i.e. species. In the KJV it is rendered: kind.
H4328: Properly, feminine passive participle of יָסַד; something founded, i.e. a foundation. In the KJV it is rendered: foundation.
H4329: From סָכַך; a portico (as covered). In the KJV it is rendered: covert.
H4330: From מִיץ; pressure. In the KJV it is rendered: churning, forcing, wringing.
H4331: From מוּשׁ; departure; Mesha, a place in Arabia; also an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Mesha.
H4332: From מִי and אֵל with the abbrev. insep. relatively (see אֲשֶׁר) interposed; who (is) what God (is)?; Mishael, the name of three Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Mishael.
H4333: (Aramaic) corresponding to מִישָׁאֵל; Mishael, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Mishael.
H4334: Or miyshor; from יָשַׁר; a level, i.e. a plain (often used (with the article prefix) as a properly, name of certain districts); figuratively, concord; also straightness, i.e. (figuratively) justice (sometimes adverbially, justly). In the KJV it is rendered: equity, even place, plain, right(-eously), (made) straight, uprightness.
H4335: Borrowed from מֵישַׁך; Meshak, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Meshak.
H4336: (Aramaic) of foreign origin and doubtful significance; Meshak, the Babylonian name of מִישָׁאֵל. In the KJV it is rendered: Meshak.
H4337: From יָשַׁע; safety; Mesha, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Mesha.
H4338: A variation for מֵישָׁע; safety; Mesha, a Moabite. In the KJV it is rendered: Mesha.
H4339: From יָשַׁר; evenness, i.e. (figuratively) prosperity or concord; also straightness, i.e. (figuratively) rectitude (only in plural with singular sense; often adverbially). In the KJV it is rendered: agreement, aright, that are equal, equity, (things that are) right(-eously, things), sweetly, upright(-ly, -ness).
H4340: From יָתַר; a cord (of a tent) (compare יֶ֫תֶר) or the string (of a bow). In the KJV it is rendered: cord, string.
H4341: Sometimes makcowb; also (feminine Isaiah 53:3) makfobah; from כָּאַב; anguish or (figuratively) affliction. In the KJV it is rendered: grief, pain, sorrow.
H4342: Transitive participle of כָּבַר; plenty. In the KJV it is rendered: abundance.
H4343: From the same as כַּבּוֹן; knoll; Macbena, a place in Palestine settled by him. In the KJV it is rendered: Machbenah.
H4344: Patrial from מַכְבֵּנָה; a Macbannite or native of Macbena. In the KJV it is rendered: Machbanai.
H4345: From כָּבַר in the sense of covering (compare כְּבָרָה); a grate. In the KJV it is rendered: grate.
H4346: From כָּבַר in the sense of covering; a cloth (as netted (compare מִכְבָּר)). In the KJV it is rendered: thick cloth.
H4347: Or (masculine) makkeh; (plural only) from נָכָה; a blow (in 2 Chronicles 2:10, of the flail); by implication, a wound; figuratively, carnage, also pestilence. In the KJV it is rendered: beaten, blow, plague, slaughter, smote, X sore, stripe, stroke, wound((-ed)).
H4348: From כָּוָה; a burn. In the KJV it is rendered: that burneth, burning.
H4349: From כּוּן; properly, a fixture, i.e. a basis; generally a place, especially as an abode. In the KJV it is rendered: foundation, habitation, (dwelling-, settled) place.
H4350: Or mkonah; feminine of מָכוֹן; a pedestal, also a spot. In the KJV it is rendered: base.
H4351: Or mkorah; from the same as כּוּר in the sense of dipping; origin (as if a mine). In the KJV it is rendered: birth, habitation, nativity.
H4352: Probably from מוּך; pining; Maki, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Machi.
H4353: From מָכַר; salesman; Makir, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Machir.
H4354: Patronymical from מָכִיר; a Makirite or descend. of Makir. In the KJV it is rendered: of Machir.
H4355: A primitive root; to tumble (in ruins); figuratively, to perish. In the KJV it is rendered: be brought low, decay.
H4356: Or miklah; from כָּלָא; a pen (for flocks). In the KJV it is rendered: ((sheep-))fold.
H4357: From כָּלָה; completion (in plural concrete adverbial, wholly). In the KJV it is rendered: perfect.
H4358: From כָּלַל; perfection (i.e. concrete adverbial, splendidly). In the KJV it is rendered: most gorgeously, all sorts.
H4359: From כָּלַל; perfection (of beauty). In the KJV it is rendered: perfection.
H4360: From כָּלַל; something perfect, i.e. a splendid garment. In the KJV it is rendered: all sorts.
H4361: From אָכַל; nourishment. In the KJV it is rendered: food.
H4362: From the same as כַּמֹּן in the sense of hiding; treasure (as hidden). In the KJV it is rendered: treasure.
H4363: (Ezra 2:2 or Mikmash; or Mikmash (Neh. 11:31); from כָּמַס; hidden; Mikmas or Mikmash, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Mikmas, Mikmash.
H4364: Or mikmor; from כָּמַר in the sense of blackening by heat; a (hunter's) net (as dark from concealment). In the KJV it is rendered: net.
H4365: Or mikmoreth; feminine of מַכְמֹרִים; a (fisher's) net. In the KJV it is rendered: drag, net.
H4366: Apparently from an unused root meaning to hide; concealment; Mikmethath, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Michmethath.
H4367: From מָה and נָדַב with a particle interposed; what (is) like (a) liberal (man)?; Maknadbai, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Machnadebai.
H4368: The same as מְכוֹנָה; a base; Mekonah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Mekonah.
H4369: The same as מְכוֹנָה; a spot. In the KJV it is rendered: base.
H4370: From כָּמַס in the sense of hiding; (only in dual) drawers (from concealing the private parts). In the KJV it is rendered: breeches.
H4371: Probably from an unused root meaning to enumerate; an assessment (as based upon a census). In the KJV it is rendered: tribute.
H4372: From כָּסָה; a covering, i.e. weather-boarding. In the KJV it is rendered: covering.
H4373: Feminine of מֶ֫כֶס; an enumeration; by implication, a valuation. In the KJV it is rendered: number, worth.
H4374: From כָּסָה; a covering, i.e. garment; specifically, a coverlet (for a bed), an awning (from the sun); also the omentum (as covering the intestines). In the KJV it is rendered: clothing, to cover, that which covereth.
H4375: From כָּפַל; a fold; Makpelah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Machpelah.
H4376: A primitive root; to sell, literally (as merchandise, a daughter in marriage, into slavery), or figuratively (to surrender). In the KJV it is rendered: X at all, sell (away, -er, self).
H4377: From מָכַר; merchandise; also value. In the KJV it is rendered: pay, price, ware.
H4378: From נָכַר; an acquaintance. In the KJV it is rendered: acquaintance.
H4379: From כָּרָה; a pit (for salt). In the KJV it is rendered: (salt-)pit.
H4380: Probably from the same as כּוּר in the sense of stabbing; a sword. In the KJV it is rendered: habitation.
H4381: From מָכַר; salesman; Mikri, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Michri.
H4382: Patrial from an unused name (the same as מְכֵרוֹת) of a place in Palestine: a Mekerathite, or inhabitant of Mekerah. In the KJV it is rendered: Mecherathite.
H4383: Or mikshol; masculine from כָּשַׁל; a stumbling-block, literally or figuratively (obstacle, enticement (specifically an idol), scruple). In the KJV it is rendered: caused to fall, offence, X (no-)thing offered, ruin, stumbling-block.
H4384: Feminine from כָּשַׁל; a stumbling-block, but only figuratively (fall, enticement (idol)). In the KJV it is rendered: ruin, stumbling-block.
H4385: From כָּתַב; a thing written, the characters, or a document (letter, copy, edict, poem). In the KJV it is rendered: writing.
H4386: From כָּתַת; a fracture. In the KJV it is rendered: bursting.
H4387: From כָּתַם; an engraving, i.e. (techn.) a poem. In the KJV it is rendered: Michtam.
H4388: From כָּתַשׁ; a mortar; by analogy, a socket (of a tooth). In the KJV it is rendered: hollow place, mortar.
H4389: The same as מַכְתֵּשׁ; dell; the Maktesh, a place in Jerusalem. In the KJV it is rendered: Maktesh.
H4390: Or malae (Esth. 7:5); a primitive root, to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: accomplish, confirm, + consecrate, be at an end, be expired, be fenced, fill, fulfil, (be, become, X draw, give in, go) full(-ly, -ly set, tale), (over-)flow, fulness, furnish, gather (selves, together), presume, replenish, satisfy, set, space, take a (hand-)full, + have wholly.
H4391: (Aramaic) corresponding to מָלֵא; to fill. In the KJV it is rendered: fill, be full.
H4392: From מָלֵא; full (literally or figuratively) or filling (literally); also (concretely) fulness; adverbially, fully. In the KJV it is rendered: X she that was with child, fill(-ed, -ed with), full(-ly), multitude, as is worth.
H4393: Rarely mlowf; or mlow (Ezekiel 41:8); from מָלֵא; fulness (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: X all along, X all that is (there-)in, fill, (X that whereof.
H4394: From מָלֵא; a fulfilling (only in plural), i.e. (literally) a setting (of gems), or (technically) consecration (also concretely, a dedicatory sacrifice). In the KJV it is rendered: consecration, be set.
H4395: Feminine of מָלֵא; something fulfilled, i.e. abundance (of produce). In the KJV it is rendered: (first of ripe) fruit, fulness.
H4396: Feminine of מִלֻּאּים; a filling, i.e. setting (of gems). In the KJV it is rendered: inclosing, setting.
H4397: From an unused root meaning to despatch as a deputy; a messenger; specifically, of God, i.e. an angel (also a prophet, priest or teacher). In the KJV it is rendered: ambassador, angel, king, messenger.
H4398: (Aramaic) corresponding to מַלְאָך; an angel. In the KJV it is rendered: angel.
H4399: From the same as מַלְאָך; properly, deputyship, i.e. ministry; generally, employment (never servile) or work (abstractly or concretely); also property (as the result of labor). In the KJV it is rendered: business, + cattle, + industrious, occupation, (+ -pied), + officer, thing (made), use, (manner of) work((-man), -manship).
H4400: From the same as מַלְאָך; a message. In the KJV it is rendered: message.
H4401: From the same as מַלְאָך; ministrative; Malaki, a prophet. In the KJV it is rendered: Malachi.
H4402: From מָלֵא; fulness, i.e. (concretely) a plump socket (of the eye). In the KJV it is rendered: X fitly.
H4403: Or malbush; from לָבַשׁ; a garment, or (collectively) clothing. In the KJV it is rendered: apparel, raiment, vestment.
H4404: From לָבַן (denominative); a brick-kiln. In the KJV it is rendered: brickkiln.
H4405: From מָלַל (plural masculine as if from milleh; a word; collectively, a discourse; figuratively, a topic. In the KJV it is rendered: + answer, by-word, matter, any thing (what) to say, to speak(-ing), speak, talking, word.
H4406: (Aramaic) corresponding to מִלִּים; a word, command, discourse, or subject. In the KJV it is rendered: commandment, matter, thing.
H4407: Or mil-loe (2 Kings 12:20); from מָלֵא; a rampart (as filled in), i.e. the citadel. In the KJV it is rendered: Millo.
H4408: From מָלַח; sea-purslain (from its saltness). In the KJV it is rendered: mallows.
H4409: Or Malluwkiy (Neh. 12:14); from מָלַך; remnant; Malluk, the name of five Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Malluch, Melichu (from the margin).
H4410: Feminine passive participle of מָלַך; something ruled, i.e. a realm. In the KJV it is rendered: kingsom, king's, X royal.
H4411: From לוּן; a lodgment, i.e. caravanserai or encampment. In the KJV it is rendered: inn, place where.
H4412: Feminine from לוּן; a hut, a hammock. In the KJV it is rendered: cottage, lodge.
H4413: Apparently from מָלַל; I have talked (i.e. loquacious). In the KJV it is rendered: Mallothi, an Israelite:--Mallothi.
H4414: A primitive root; properly, to rub to pieces or pulverize; intransitively, to disappear as dust; also (as denominative from מֶ֫לַח) to salt whether internally (to season with salt) or externally (to rub with salt). In the KJV it is rendered: X at all, salt, season, temper together, vanish away.
H4415: (Aramaic) corresponding to מָלַח; to eat salt, i.e. (generally) subsist. In the KJV it is rendered: + have maintenance.
H4416: (Aramaic) from מְלַח; salt. In the KJV it is rendered: + maintenance, salt.
H4417: From מָלַח; properly, powder, i.e. (specifically) salt (as easily pulverized and dissolved. In the KJV it is rendered: salt((-pit)).
H4418: From מָלַח in its original sense; a rag or old garment. In the KJV it is rendered: rotten rag.
H4419: From מָלַח in its second. sense; a sailor (as following "the salt"). In the KJV it is rendered: mariner.
H4420: From מָלַח (in its denominative sense); properly, salted (i.e. land (אָ֫רֶץ being understood)), i.e. a desert. In the KJV it is rendered: barren land(-ness), salt (land).
H4421: From לָחַם (in the sense of fighting); a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. warfare). In the KJV it is rendered: battle, fight(-ing), war((-rior)).
H4422: A primitive root; properly, to be smooth, i.e. (by implication) to escape (as if by slipperiness); causatively, to release or rescue; specifically, to bring forth young, emit sparks. In the KJV it is rendered: deliver (self), escape, lay, leap out, let alone, let go, preserve, save, X speedily, X surely.
H4423: From מָלַט, cement (from its plastic smoothness). In the KJV it is rendered: clay.
H4424: From מֶ֫לֶט and יָהּ; (whom) Jah has delivered; Melatjah, a Gibeonite. In the KJV it is rendered: Melatiah.
H4425: From מְלַל (in the sense of cropping (compare מוּל)); a head of grain (as cut off). In the KJV it is rendered: ear.
H4426: From לִיץ; an aphorism; also a satire. In the KJV it is rendered: interpretation, taunting.
H4427: A primitive root; to reign; inceptively, to ascend the throne; causatively, to induct into royalty; hence (by implication) to take counsel. In the KJV it is rendered: consult, X indeed, be (make, set a, set up) king, be (make) queen, (begin to, make to) reign(-ing), rule, X surely.
H4428: From מָלַך; a king. In the KJV it is rendered: king, royal.
H4429: The same as מֶ֫לֶך; king; Melek, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Melech, Hammelech (by including the article).
H4430: (Aramaic) corresponding to מֶ֫לֶך; a king. In the KJV it is rendered: king, royal.
H4431: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to מָלַך in the sense of consultation: advice. In the KJV it is rendered: counsel.
H4432: From מָלַך; Molek (i.e. king), the chief deity of the Ammonites. In the KJV it is rendered: Molech.
H4433: (Aramaic) corresponding to מַלְכָּה; a queen. In the KJV it is rendered: queen.
H4434: From לָכַד; a snare. In the KJV it is rendered: trap.
H4435: A form of מַלְכָּה; queen; Milcah, the name of a Hebrewess and of an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Milcah.
H4436: Feminine of מֶ֫לֶך; a queen. In the KJV it is rendered: queen.
H4437: (Aramaic) corresponding to מַלְכוּת; dominion (abstractly or concretely). In the KJV it is rendered: kingdom, kingly, realm, reign.
H4438: Or malkuth; or (in plural) malkuyah; from מָלַך; a rule; concretely, a dominion. In the KJV it is rendered: empire, kingdom, realm, reign, royal.
H4439: From מֶ֫לֶך and אֵל; king of (i.e. appointed by) God; Malkiel, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Malchiel.
H4440: Patronymical from מַלְכִּיאֵל; a Malkielite or descendant of Malkiel. In the KJV it is rendered: Malchielite.
H4441: Or Malkiyahuw (Jer. 38:6); from מֶ֫לֶך and יָהּ; king of (i.e. appointed by) Jah; Malkijah, the name of ten Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Malchiah, Malchijah.
H4442: From מֶ֫לֶך and צֶ֫דֶק; king of right; Malki-Tsedek, an early king in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Melchizedek.
H4443: From מֶ֫לֶך and רוּם; king of a high one (i.e. of exaltation); Malkiram, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Malchiram.
H4444: From מֶ֫לֶך and שׁ֫וּעַ; king of wealth; Malkishua, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Malchishua.
H4445: Or Milkowm; from מֶ֫לֶך for מֹ֫לֶך; Malcam or Milcom, the national idol of the Ammonites. In the KJV it is rendered: Malcham, Milcom.
H4446: From מָלַך; a queen. In the KJV it is rendered: queen.
H4447: Feminine active participle of מָלַך; queen; Moleketh, an Israelitess. In the KJV it is rendered: Hammoleketh (including the article).
H4448: A primitive root; to speak (mostly poetical) or say. In the KJV it is rendered: say, speak, utter.
H4449: (Aramaic) corresponding to מָלַל; to speak. In the KJV it is rendered: say, speak(-ing).
H4450: From מָלַל; talkative; Milalai, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Milalai.
H4451: From לָמַד; a goad for oxen. In the KJV it is rendered: goad.
H4452: A primitive root; to be smooth, i.e. (figuratively) pleasant. In the KJV it is rendered: be sweet.
H4453: Of Persian derivation; the butler or other officer in the Babylonian court. In the KJV it is rendered: Melzar.
H4454: A primitive root; to crack a joint; by implication, to wring the neck of a fowl (without separating it). In the KJV it is rendered: wring off.
H4455: From לָקַח; transitively (in dual) the jaws (as taking food); intransitively, spoil (and captives) (as taken). In the KJV it is rendered: booty, jaws, prey.
H4456: From לָקַשׁ; the spring rain (compare לָ֫קֶשׁ); figuratively, eloquence. In the KJV it is rendered: latter rain.
H4457: Or malqach; from לָקַח; (only in dual) tweezers. In the KJV it is rendered: snuffers, tongs.
H4458: From an unused root meaning to spread out; a wardrobe (i.e. room where clothing is spread). In the KJV it is rendered: vestry.
H4459: Transp. for מְתַלְּעוֹת; a grinder, i.e. back tooth. In the KJV it is rendered: great tooth.
H4460: From מָגַר (in the sense of depositing); a granary. In the KJV it is rendered: barn.
H4461: From מָדַד; a measure. In the KJV it is rendered: measure.
H4462: Or (transp.) Mowmukan (Esth. 1:16); of Persian derivation; Memucan or Momucan, a Persian satrap. In the KJV it is rendered: Memucan.
H4463: From מוּת; a mortal disease; concretely, a corpse. In the KJV it is rendered: death.
H4464: From an unused root meaning to alienate; a mongrel, i.e. born of a Jewish father and a heathen mother. In the KJV it is rendered: bastard.
H4465: From מָכַר; merchandise; abstractly, a selling. In the KJV it is rendered: X ought, (that which cometh of) sale, that which.
H4466: Feminine of מִמְכָּר; a sale. In the KJV it is rendered: + sold as.
H4467: From מָלַך; dominion, i.e. (abstractly) the estate (rule) or (concretely) the country (realm). In the KJV it is rendered: kingdom, king's, reign, royal.
H4468: A form of מַמְלָכָה and equiv. to it. In the KJV it is rendered: kingdom, reign.
H4469: From מָסַך; mixture, i.e. (specifically) wine mixed (with water or spices). In the KJV it is rendered: drink-offering, mixed wine.
H4470: From an unused root meaning to grieve; sorrow. In the KJV it is rendered: bitterness.
H4471: From מָרָא(in the sense of vigor); lusty; Mamre, an Amorite. In the KJV it is rendered: Mamre.
H4472: From מָרַר; a bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) calamity. In the KJV it is rendered: bitterness.
H4473: From מָשַׁח, in the sense of expansion; outspread (i.e. with outstretched wings). In the KJV it is rendered: anointed.
H4474: From מָשַׁל; a ruler or (abstractly) rule. In the KJV it is rendered: dominion, that ruled.
H4475: Feminine of מִמְשָׁל; rule; also (concretely in plural) a realm or a ruler. In the KJV it is rendered: dominion, government, power, to rule.
H4476: From the same as מֶ֫שֶׁק; a possession. In the KJV it is rendered: breeding.
H4477: From מָתַק; something sweet (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: (most) sweet.
H4478: From מָה; literally, a whatness (so to speak), i.e. manna (so called from the question about it). In the KJV it is rendered: manna.
H4479: (Aramaic) from מָה; who or what (properly, interrogatively, hence, also indefinitely and relatively). In the KJV it is rendered: what, who(-msoever, + -so).
H4480: Or minniy; or minney (constructive plural); (Isaiah 30:11); for מִנִּים; properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses (as follows). H4481: (Aramaic) corresponding to מִן. In the KJV it is rendered: according, after, + because, + before, by, for, from, X him, X more than, (out) of, part, since, X these, to, upon, + when.
H4482: From an unused root meaning to apportion; a part; hence, a musical chord (as parted into strings). In the KJV it is rendered: in (the same) (Psalm 68:23), stringed instrument (Psalm 150:4), whereby (Psalm 45:8 (defective plural)).
H4483: (Aramaic) or mnah (Aramaic); corresponding to מָנָא; to count, appoint. In the KJV it is rendered: number, ordain, set.
H4484: (Aramaic) passive participle of מְנָא; numbered. In the KJV it is rendered: Mene.
H4485: From נָגַן; a satire. In the KJV it is rendered: music.
H4486: (Aramaic) corresponding to מַדָּע; wisdom or intelligence. In the KJV it is rendered: knowledge, reason, understanding.
H4487: A primitive root; properly, to weigh out; by implication, to allot or constitute officially; also to enumerate or enroll. In the KJV it is rendered: appoint, count, number, prepare, set, tell.
H4488: From מָנָא; properly, a fixed weight or measured amount, i.e. (techn.) a maneh or mina. In the KJV it is rendered: maneh, pound.
H4489: From מָנָא; properly, something weighed out, i.e. (figuratively) a portion of time, i.e. an instance. In the KJV it is rendered: time.
H4490: From מָנָא; properly, something weighed out, i.e. (generally) a division; specifically (of food) a ration; also a lot. In the KJV it is rendered: such things as belonged, part, portion.
H4491: From נָהַג; the driving (of a chariot). In the KJV it is rendered: driving.
H4492: From נָהַר; properly, a channel or fissure, i.e. (by implication) a cavern. In the KJV it is rendered: den.
H4493: From נוּד a nodding or toss (of the head in derision). In the KJV it is rendered: shaking.
H4494: From נ֫וּחַ; quiet, i.e. (concretely) a settled spot, or (figuratively) a home. In the KJV it is rendered: (place of) rest.
H4495: The same as מָנ֫וֹחַ; rest; Manoach, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Manoah.
H4496: Or mnuchah; feminine of מָנ֫וֹחַ; repose or (adverbially) peacefully; figuratively, consolation (specifically, matrimony); hence (concretely) an abode. In the KJV it is rendered: comfortable, ease, quiet, rest(-ing place), still.
H4497: From נוּן; a continuator, i.e. heir. In the KJV it is rendered: son.
H4498: From נוּס; a retreat (literally or figuratively); abstractly, a fleeing. In the KJV it is rendered: X apace, escape, way to flee, flight, refuge.
H4499: Or mnucah; feminine of מָנוֹס; retreat. In the KJV it is rendered: fleeing, flight.
H4500: From נִיר; a yoke (properly, for plowing), i.e. the frame of a loom. In the KJV it is rendered: beam.
H4501: Or mnorah; feminine of מָנוֹר (in the original sense of נֵר); a chandelier. In the KJV it is rendered: candlestick.
H4502: From נָזַר; a prince. In the KJV it is rendered: crowned.
H4503: From an unused root meaning to apportion, i.e. bestow; a donation; euphemistically, tribute; specifically a sacrificial offering (usually bloodless and voluntary). In the KJV it is rendered: gift, oblation, (meat) offering, present, sacrifice.
H4504: (Aramaic) corresponding to מִנְחָה; a sacrificial offering. In the KJV it is rendered: oblation, meat offering.
H4505: From נָחַם; comforter; Menachem, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Menahem.
H4506: From נ֫וּחַ; rest; Manachath, the name of an Edomite and of a place in Moab. In the KJV it is rendered: Manahath.
H4507: From מָנָא; the Apportioner, i.e. Fate (as an idol). In the KJV it is rendered: number.
H4508: Of foreign derivation; Minni, an Armenian province. In the KJV it is rendered: Minni.
H4509: From מִן and יָמִין; from (the) right hand; Minjamin, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Miniamin.
H4510: (Aramaic) from מְנָא; enumeration. In the KJV it is rendered: number.
H4511: From the same as מִנִּים; enumeration; Minnith, a place East of the Jordan. In the KJV it is rendered: Minnith.
H4512: From נָלָה; completion, i.e. (in produce) wealth. In the KJV it is rendered: perfection.
H4513: A primitive root; to debar (negatively or positively) from benefit or injury. In the KJV it is rendered: deny, keep (back), refrain, restrain, withhold.
H4514: Or maniul; from נָעַל; a bolt. In the KJV it is rendered: lock.
H4515: From נָעַל; a bolt. In the KJV it is rendered: shoe.
H4516: From נָעֵם; a delicacy. In the KJV it is rendered: dainty.
H4517: From נ֫וּעַ; a sistrum (so called from its rattling sound). In the KJV it is rendered: cornet.
H4518: From נָקָה; a sacrificial basin (for holding blood). In the KJV it is rendered: bowl.
H4519: From נָשָׁה; causing to forget; Menashsheh, a grandson of Jacob, also the tribe descended from him, and its territory. In the KJV it is rendered: Manasseh.
H4520: From מְנַשֶּׁה; a Menashshite or descendant of Menashsheh. In the KJV it is rendered: of Manasseh, Manassites.
H4521: From מָנָא; an allotment (by courtesy, law or providence). In the KJV it is rendered: portion.
H4522: Or mic; from מָסַס; properly, a burden (as causing to faint), i.e. a tax in the form of forced labor. In the KJV it is rendered: discomfited, levy, task(-master), tribute(-tary).
H4523: From מָסַס; fainting, i.e. (figuratively) disconsolate. In the KJV it is rendered: is afflicted.
H4524: Plural masculine mcibbiym; or feminine mcibbowth; from סָבַב; a divan (as enclosing the room); abstractly (adverbial) around. In the KJV it is rendered: that compass about, (place) round about, at table.
H4525: From סָגַר; a fastener, i.e. (of a person) a smith, (of a thing) a prison. In the KJV it is rendered: prison, smith.
H4526: From סָגַר; something enclosing, i.e. a margin (of a region, of a panel); concretely, a stronghold. In the KJV it is rendered: border, close place, hole.
H4527: From יָסַד; a foundation. In the KJV it is rendered: foundation.
H4528: From the same as סְדָרִים; a colonnade or internal portico (from its rows of pillars). In the KJV it is rendered: porch.
H4529: A primitive root; to dissolve. In the KJV it is rendered: make to consume away, (make to) melt, water.
H4530: From מָסַס (in the sense of flowing); abundance, i.e. (adverbially) liberally: tribute.
H4531: From נָסָה; a testing, of men (judicial) or of God (querulous). In the KJV it is rendered: temptation, trial.
H4532: The same as מַסָּה; Massah, a place in the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Massah.
H4533: Apparently from an unused root meaning to cover; a veil. In the KJV it is rendered: vail.
H4534: For מְשׂוּכָה; a hedge. In the KJV it is rendered: thorn hedge.
H4535: From נָסַח in the sense of staving off; a cordon, (adverbially) or (as a) military barrier. In the KJV it is rendered: broken down.
H4536: From סָחַר; trade. In the KJV it is rendered: traffic.
H4537: A primitive root; to mix, especially wine (with spices). In the KJV it is rendered: mingle.
H4538: From מָסַך; a mixture, i.e. of wine with spices. In the KJV it is rendered: mixture.
H4539: From סָכַך; a cover, i.e. veil. In the KJV it is rendered: covering, curtain, hanging.
H4540: From סָכַך; a covering, i.e. garniture. In the KJV it is rendered: covering.
H4541: From נָסַך; properly, a pouring over, i.e. fusion of metal (especially a cast image); by implication, a libation, i.e. league; concretely a coverlet (as if poured out). In the KJV it is rendered: covering, molten (image), vail.
H4542: From סִכְלוּת; indigent. In the KJV it is rendered: poor (man).
H4543: By transp. from כָּנַס; a magazine. In the KJV it is rendered: store(-house), treasure.
H4544: From מִסְכֵּן; indigence. In the KJV it is rendered: scarceness.
H4545: From נָסַך in the sense of spreading out; something expanded, i.e. the warp in a loom (as stretched out to receive the woof). In the KJV it is rendered: web.
H4546: From סָלַל; a thoroughfare (as turnpiked), literally or figuratively; specifically a viaduct, a staircase. In the KJV it is rendered: causeway, course, highway, path, terrace.
H4547: From סָלַל; a thoroughfare (as turnpiked). In the KJV it is rendered: highway.
H4548: Or micmer; also (feminine) macmrah; or micmrah; or even masmrah (Eccles. 12:11); from סָמַר; a peg (as bristling from the surface). In the KJV it is rendered: nail.
H4549: A primitive root; to liquefy; figuratively, to waste (with disease), to faint (with fatigue, fear or grief). In the KJV it is rendered: discourage, faint, be loosed, melt (away), refuse, X utterly.
H4550: From נָסַע; a departure (from striking the tents), i.e. march (not necessarily a single day's travel); by implication, a station (or point of departure). In the KJV it is rendered: journey(-ing).
H4551: From נָסַע in the sense of projecting; a missile (spear or arrow); also a quarry (whence stones are, as it were, ejected). In the KJV it is rendered: before it was brought, dart.
H4552: ' from סָעַד; a balustrade (for stairs). In the KJV it is rendered: pillar.
H4553: From סָפַד; a lamentation. In the KJV it is rendered: lamentation, one mourneth, mourning, wailing.
H4554: From an unused root meaning to collect; fodder. In the KJV it is rendered: provender.
H4555: From סָפַח; a veil (as spread out). In the KJV it is rendered: kerchief.
H4556: From סָפַח; scruf (as spreading over the surface). In the KJV it is rendered: scab.
H4557: From סָפַר; a number, definite (arithmetical) or indefinite (large, innumerable; small, a few); also (abstractly) narration. In the KJV it is rendered: + abundance, account, X all, X few, (in-)finite, (certain) number(-ed), tale, telling, + time.
H4558: The same as מֶלְקָחַ֫יִם; number; Mispar, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Mizpar.
H4559: Feminine of מַלְכוּ; enumeration; Mispereth, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Mispereth.
H4560: A primitive root; to sunder, i.e. (transitively) set apart, or (reflex.) apostatize. In the KJV it is rendered: commit, deliver.
H4561: From יָסַר; admonition. In the KJV it is rendered: instruction.
H4562: From אָסַר; a band. In the KJV it is rendered: bond.
H4563: From סָתַר; a refuge. In the KJV it is rendered: covert.
H4564: From סָתַר; properly, a hider, i.e. (abstractly) a hiding, i.e. aversion. In the KJV it is rendered: hid.
H4565: From סָתַר; properly, a concealer, i.e. a covert. In the KJV it is rendered: secret(-ly, place).
H4566: From עָבַד; an act. In the KJV it is rendered: work.
H4567: (Aramaic) corresponding to מַעְבָּדִים; an act. In the KJV it is rendered: work.
H4568: From עָבָה; properly, compact (part of soil), i.e. loam. In the KJV it is rendered: clay.
H4569: Or feminine mapabarah; from עָבַר; a crossing-place (of a river, a ford; of a mountain, a pass); abstractly, a transit, i.e. (figuratively) overwhelming. In the KJV it is rendered: ford, place where.
H4570: Or feminine mapgalah; from the same as עָגֹל; a track (literally or figuratively); also a rampart (as circular). In the KJV it is rendered: going, path, trench, way((-side)).
H4571: A primitive root; to waver. In the KJV it is rendered: make to shake, slide, slip.
H4572: From עָדָה; ornamental; Maadai, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Maadai.
H4573: From עָדָה and יָהּ; ornament of Jah; Maadjah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Maadiah.
H4574: Or (feminine) maadannah; from עָדַן; a delicacy or (abstractly) pleasure (adverbially, cheerfully). In the KJV it is rendered: dainty, delicately, delight.
H4575: By transitive from עָנַד; a bond, i.e. group. In the KJV it is rendered: influence.
H4576: From עָדַר; a (weeding) hoe. In the KJV it is rendered: mattock.
H4577: (Aramaic) or m(ae (Aramaic); corresponding to מְעֵי; only in plural the bowels. In the KJV it is rendered: belly.
H4578: From an unused root probably meaning to be soft; used only in plural the intestines, or (collectively) the abdomen, figuratively, sympathy; by implication, a vest; by extens. the stomach, the uterus (or of men, the seat of generation), the heart (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: belly, bowels, X heart, womb.
H4579: Feminine of מְעֵי; the belly, i.e. (figuratively) interior. In the KJV it is rendered: gravel.
H4580: From עוּג; a cake of bread (with לַעֲגֵי a table- buffoon, i.e. parasite). In the KJV it is rendered: cake, feast.
H4581: (also mauwz); or mahoz (also ma,uz; from עָזַז; a fortified place; figuratively, a defence. In the KJV it is rendered: force, fort(-ress), rock, strength(-en), (X most) strong (hold).
H4582: From מָעַך; oppressed; Maok, a Philistine. In the KJV it is rendered: Maoch.
H4583: Or maiyn (1 Chronicles 4:41); from the same as עֹנַת; an abode, of God (the Tabernacle or the Temple), men (their home) or animals (their lair); hence, a retreat (asylum). In the KJV it is rendered: den, dwelling((-)place), habitation.
H4584: The same as מָעוֹן; a residence; Maon, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Maon, Maonites.
H4585: Or msonah; feminine of מָעוֹן, and meaning the same. In the KJV it is rendered: den, habitation, (dwelling) place, refuge.
H4586: Or Msiyniy; probably patrial from מָעוֹן; a Meunite, or inhabitant of Maon (only in plural). In the KJV it is rendered: Mehunim(-s), Meunim.
H4587: Plural of מְעוֹנַת; habitative; Meonothai, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Meonothai.
H4588: From עוּף in the sense of covering with shade (compare מוּעָף); darkness. In the KJV it is rendered: dimness.
H4589: From עוּר; nakedness, i.e. (in plural) the pudenda. In the KJV it is rendered: nakedness.
H4590: Or Ma.azyahuw; probably from עוּז (in the sense of protection) and יָהּ; rescue of Jah; Maazjah, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Maaziah.
H4591: A primitive root; properly, to pare off, i.e. lessen; intransitively, to be (or causatively, to make) small or few (or figuratively, ineffective). H4592: Or miat; from מָעַט; a little or few (often adverbial or compar.). In the KJV it is rendered: almost (some, very) few(-er, -est), lightly, little (while), (very) small (matter, thing), some, soon, X very.
H4593: Passive adjective of מָעַט; thinned (as to the edge), i.e. sharp. In the KJV it is rendered: wrapped up.
H4594: From עָטָה; a vestment. In the KJV it is rendered: garment.
H4595: From עָטַף; a cloak. In the KJV it is rendered: mantle.
H4596: From עָוָה; a pile of rubbish (as contorted), i.e. a ruin (compare עִי). In the KJV it is rendered: heap.
H4597: Probably from מְעֵי; sympathetic; Maai, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Maai.
H4598: From מָעַל in the sense of covering; a robe (i.e. upper and outer garment). In the KJV it is rendered: cloke, coat, mantle, robe.
H4599: Or ma ynow (Psa. 114:8); or (feminine) ma yanah; from עַ֫יִן (as a denominative in the sense of a spring); a fountain (also collectively), figuratively, a source (of satisfaction). In the KJV it is rendered: fountain, spring, well.
H4600: A primitive root; to press, i.e. to pierce, emasculate, handle. In the KJV it is rendered: bruised, stuck, be pressed.

H4602: Patrial from מַעֲכָה; a Maakathite, or inhabitant of Maakah. In the KJV it is rendered: Maachathite.
H4603: A primitive root; properly, to cover up; used only figuratively, to act covertly, i.e. treacherously. In the KJV it is rendered: transgress, (commit, do a) trespass(-ing).
H4604: From מָעַל; treachery, i.e. sin. In the KJV it is rendered: falsehood, grievously, sore, transgression, trespass, X very.
H4605: From עָלָה; properly, the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward, above, overhead, from the top, etc. In the KJV it is rendered: above, exceeding(-ly), forward, on (X very) high, over, up(-on, -ward), very.
H4606: (Aramaic) from עֲלַל; (only in plural as singular) the setting (of the sun). In the KJV it is rendered: going down.
H4607: From עָלָה; a raising (of the hands). In the KJV it is rendered: lifting up.
H4608: From עָלָה; an elevation, i.e. (concretely) acclivity or platform; abstractly (the relation or state) a rise or (figuratively) priority. In the KJV it is rendered: ascent, before, chiefest, cliff, that goeth up, going up, hill, mounting up, stairs.
H4609: Feminine of מַעֲלֶה; elevation, i.e. the act (literally, a journey to a higher place, figuratively, a thought arising), or (concretely) the condition (literally, a step or grade-mark, figuratively, a superiority of station); specifically a climactic progression (in certain Psalms). In the KJV it is rendered: things that come up, (high) degree, deal, go up, stair, step, story.
H4610: From מַעֲלֶה and (the plural of) עַקְרָב; Steep of Scorpions, a place in the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Maaleh- accrabim, the ascent (going up) of Akrabbim.
H4611: From עָלַל; an act (good or bad). In the KJV it is rendered: doing, endeavour, invention, work.
H4612: From עָמַד; (figuratively) a position. In the KJV it is rendered: attendance, office, place, state.
H4613: From עָמַד; literally, a foothold. In the KJV it is rendered: standing.
H4614: From עָמַס; burdensomeness. In the KJV it is rendered: burdensome.
H4615: From עָמַק; a deep. In the KJV it is rendered: deep, depth.
H4616: From עָנָה; properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that. In the KJV it is rendered: because of, to the end (intent) that, for (to,.
H4617: From עָנָה; a reply (favorable or contradictory). In the KJV it is rendered: answer, X himself.
H4618: From עָנָה, in the sense of depression or tilling; a furrow. In the KJV it is rendered: + acre, furrow.
H4619: From עָצָה; closure; Maats, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Maaz.
H4620: From עָצַב; anguish. In the KJV it is rendered: sorrow.
H4621: From an usused root meaning to hew; an axe. In the KJV it is rendered: ax, tongs.
H4622: From עָצַר; objectively, a hindrance. In the KJV it is rendered: restraint.
H4623: From עָצַר; subjectively, control. In the KJV it is rendered: rule.
H4624: From an unused root meaning to repress; a parapet. In the KJV it is rendered: battlement.
H4625: From עָקַשׁ; a crook (in a road). In the KJV it is rendered: crooked thing.
H4626: From עָרָה; a nude place, i.e. (literally) the pudenda, or (figuratively) a vacant space. In the KJV it is rendered: nakedness, proportion.
H4627: From עָרַב, in the sense of trading; traffic; by implication, mercantile goods. In the KJV it is rendered: market, merchandise.
H4628: Or (feminine) maearabah; from עָרַב, in the sense of shading; the west (as a region of the evening sun). In the KJV it is rendered: west.
H4629: From עָרָה; a nude place, i.e. a common. In the KJV it is rendered: meadows.
H4630: Feminine of מַעֲרֵה; an open spot. In the KJV it is rendered: army (from the margin).
H4631: From עוּר; a cavern (as dark). In the KJV it is rendered: cave, den, hole.
H4632: The same as מְעָרָה; cave; Mearah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Mearah.
H4633: From עָרַך; an arrangement, i.e. (figuratively) mental disposition. In the KJV it is rendered: preparation.
H4634: Feminine of מַעַרְכֵי; an arrangement; concretely, a pile; specifically a military array. In the KJV it is rendered: army, fight, be set in order, ordered place, rank, row.
H4635: From עָרַך; an arrangement, i.e. (concretely) a pile (of loaves). In the KJV it is rendered: row, shewbread.
H4636: From עָרֹם, in the sense of stripping; bare. In the KJV it is rendered: naked.
H4637: From עָרַץ; violence. In the KJV it is rendered: terror.
H4638: A form of מַעֲרוֹת; waste; Maarath, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Maarath.
H4639: From עָשָׂה; an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property. In the KJV it is rendered: act, art, + bakemeat, business, deed, do(-ing), labor, thing made, ware of making, occupation, thing offered, operation, possession, X well, ((handy-, needle-, net-))work(ing, - manship), wrought.
H4640: From עָשָׂה; operative; Maasai, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Maasiai.
H4641: Or Maaseyahuw; from מַעֲשֶׂה and יָהּ; work of Jah; Maasejah, the name of sixteen Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Maaseiah.
H4642: From עָשַׁק; oppression. In the KJV it is rendered: oppression, X oppressor.
H4643: Or maasar; and (in plural) feminine maasrah; from עָשָׂר; a tenth; especially a tithe. In the KJV it is rendered: tenth (part), tithe(-ing).
H4644: Of Egyptian origin: Moph, the capital of Lower Egypt. In the KJV it is rendered: Memphis.
H4645: From פָּגַע; an object of attack. In the KJV it is rendered: mark.
H4646: From נָפַח; a breathing out (of life), i.e. expiring. In the KJV it is rendered: giving up.
H4647: From נָפַח; the bellows (i.e. blower) of a forge. In the KJV it is rendered: bellows.
H4648: Or Mphibosheth; probably from פָּאָה and בֹּ֫שֶׁת; dispeller of shame (i.e. of Baal); Mephibosheth, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Mephibosheth.
H4649: A plural apparently from נוּף; wavings; Muppim, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Muppim.
H4650: From פּוּץ; a breaker, i.e. mallet. In the KJV it is rendered: maul.
H4651: From נָפַל; a falling off, i.e. chaff; also something pendulous, i.e. a flap. In the KJV it is rendered: flake, refuse.
H4652: From פָּלָא; a miracle. In the KJV it is rendered: wondrous work.
H4653: From פָּלַג; a classification. In the KJV it is rendered: division.
H4654: Or mappelah; from נָפַל; something fallen, i.e. a ruin. In the KJV it is rendered: ruin(-ous).
H4655: From פָּלַט; an escape. In the KJV it is rendered: escape.
H4656: From פָּלַץ; a terror, i.e. an idol. In the KJV it is rendered: idol.
H4657: From an unused root meaning to balance; a poising. In the KJV it is rendered: balancing.
H4658: From נָפַל; fall, i.e. decadence; concretely, a ruin; specifically a carcase. In the KJV it is rendered: carcase, fall, ruin.
H4659: Or (feminine) miph.alah; from פָּעַל; a performance. In the KJV it is rendered: work.
H4660: From נָפַץ; a smiting to pieces. In the KJV it is rendered: slaughter.
H4661: From נָפַץ; a smiter, i.e. a war club. In the KJV it is rendered: battle ax.
H4662: From פָּקַד; an appointment, i.e. mandate; concretely, a designated spot; specifically, a census. In the KJV it is rendered: appointed place, commandment, number.
H4663: The same as מִפְקָד; assignment; Miphkad, the name of a gate in Jerusalem. In the KJV it is rendered: Miphkad.
H4664: From פָּרַץ; a break (in the shore), i.e. a haven. In the KJV it is rendered: breach.
H4665: From פָּרַק; properly, a fracture, i.e. joint (vertebrae) of the neck. In the KJV it is rendered: neck.
H4666: From פָּרַשׂ; an expansion. In the KJV it is rendered: that which.
H4667: From פָּשַׂע; a stride, i.e. (by euphemism) the crotch. In the KJV it is rendered: buttocks.
H4668: From פָּתַח; an opener, i.e. a key. In the KJV it is rendered: key.
H4669: From פָּתַח; an aperture, i.e. (figuratively) utterance. In the KJV it is rendered: opening.
H4670: From the same as פָּ֫תֶן; a stretcher, i.e. a sill. In the KJV it is rendered: threshold.
H4671: Or mowts (Zephaniah 2:2); from מִיץ; chaff (as pressed out, i.e. winnowed or (rather) threshed loose). In the KJV it is rendered: chaff.
H4672: A primitive root; properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present. In the KJV it is rendered: + be able, befall, being, catch, X certainly, (cause to) come (on, to, to hand), deliver, be enough (cause to) find(-ing, occasion, out), get (hold upon), X have (here), be here, hit, be left, light (up-)on, meet (with), X occasion serve, (be) present, ready, speed, suffice, take hold on.
H4673: From נָצַב; a fixed spot; figuratively, an office, a military post. In the KJV it is rendered: garrison, station, place where.
H4674: From נָצַב; a station, i.e. military post. In the KJV it is rendered: mount.
H4675: Or mitstsabah; feminine of מַצָּב; a military guard. In the KJV it is rendered: army, garrison.
H4676: Feminine (causatively) participle of נָצַב; something stationed, i.e. a column or (memorial stone); by analogy, an idol. In the KJV it is rendered: garrison, (standing) image, pillar.
H4677: Apparently from מָצָא and יָהּ; found of Jah; Metsobajah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Mesobaite.
H4678: From נָצַב; something stationary, i.e. a monumental stone; also the stock of a tree. In the KJV it is rendered: pillar, substance.
H4679: Or mtsad; or (feminine) mtsadah; from צוּד; a fastness (as a covert of ambush). In the KJV it is rendered: castle, fort, (strong) hold, munition.
H4680: A primitive root; to suck out; by implication, to drain, to squeeze out. In the KJV it is rendered: suck, wring (out).
H4681: Active participle feminine of מָצָה; drained; Motsah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Mozah.
H4682: From מָצַץ in the sense of greedily devouring for sweetness; properly, sweetness; concretely, sweet (i.e. not soured or bittered with yeast); specifically, an unfermented cake or loaf, or (elliptically) the festival of Passover (because no leaven was then used). In the KJV it is rendered: unleaved (bread, cake), without leaven.
H4683: From נָצָה; a quarrel. In the KJV it is rendered: contention, debate, strife.
H4684: From צָהַל; a whinnying (through impatience for battle or lust). In the KJV it is rendered: neighing.
H4685: Or (feminine) mtsowdah; or mtsodah; from צוּד; a net (for capturing animals or fishes). In the KJV it is rendered: also (by interchange for mtsad) a fastness or (beseiging) tower:--bulwark, hold, munition, net, snare.
H4686: Or (feminine) mtsuwdah; or mtsudah; for מְצוֹד; a net, or (abstractly) capture; also a fastness; --castle, defense, fort(-ress), (strong) hold, be hunted, net, snare, strong place.
H4687: From צָוָה; a command, whether human or divine (collectively, the Law). In the KJV it is rendered: (which was) commanded(-ment), law, ordinance, precept.
H4688: Or mtsolah; also mtsuwlah; or mtsulah; from the same as צוּלָה; a deep place (of water or mud). In the KJV it is rendered: bottom, deep, depth.
H4689: From צוּק; a narrow place, i.e. (abstractly and figuratively) confinement or disability. In the KJV it is rendered: anguish, distress, straitness.
H4690: Or matsuq; from צוּק; something narrow, i.e. a column or hilltop. In the KJV it is rendered: pillar, situate.
H4691: Or mtsuqah; feminine of מָצוּק; narrowness, i.e. (figuratively) trouble. In the KJV it is rendered: anguish, distress.
H4692: Or matsuwr; from צוּר; something hemming in, i.e. (objectively) a mound (of besiegers), (abstractly) a siege, (figuratively) distress; or (subjectively) a fastness. In the KJV it is rendered: besieged, bulwark, defence, fenced, fortress, siege, strong (hold), tower.
H4693: The same as מָצוֹר in the sense of a limit; Egypt (as the border of Palestine). In the KJV it is rendered: besieged places, defense, fortified.
H4694: Or mtsurah; feminine of מָצוֹר; a hemming in, i.e. (objectively) a mound (of siege), or (subjectively) a rampart (of protection), (abstractly) fortification. In the KJV it is rendered: fenced (city, fort, munition, strong hold.
H4695: From נָצָה; a quarrel. In the KJV it is rendered: that contended.
H4696: From an unused root meaning to be clear, i.e. conspicuous; the forehead (as open and prominent). In the KJV it is rendered: brow, forehead, + impudent.
H4697: From the same as מֵ֫צַח; a shin-piece of armor (as prominent), only plural. In the KJV it is rendered: greaves.
H4698: From צָלַל; a tinkler, i.e. a bell. In the KJV it is rendered: bell.
H4699: From צָלַל; shade. In the KJV it is rendered: bottom.
H4700: From צָלַל; (only dual) double tinklers, i.e. cymbals. In the KJV it is rendered: cymbals.
H4701: From צָנַף; a tiara, i.e. official turban (of a king or high priest). In the KJV it is rendered: diadem, mitre.
H4702: From יָצַע; a couch. In the KJV it is rendered: bed.
H4703: From צָעַד; a step; figuratively, companionship. In the KJV it is rendered: going, step.
H4704: Feminine of מִצְעָר; properly, littleness; concretely, diminutive. In the KJV it is rendered: little.
H4705: From צָעַר; petty (in size or number); adverbially, a short (time). In the KJV it is rendered: little one (while), small.
H4706: The same as מִצְעָר; Mitsar, a peak of Lebanon. In the KJV it is rendered: Mizar.
H4707: From צָפָה; an observatory, especially for military purposes. In the KJV it is rendered: watch tower.
H4708: The same as מִצְפֶּה; Mitspeh, the name of five places in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Mizpeh, watch tower.
H4709: Feminine of מִצְפֶּה; Mitspah, the name of two places in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Mitspah.
H4710: From צָפַן; a secret (place or thing, perhaps, treasure). In the KJV it is rendered: hidden thing.
H4711: A primitive root; to suck. In the KJV it is rendered: milk.
H4712: From קֵבָה; something tight, i.e. (figuratively) trouble. In the KJV it is rendered: distress, pain, strait.
H4713: From מִצְרָ֫יִם; a Mitsrite, or inhabitant of Mitsrajim. In the KJV it is rendered: Egyptian, of Egypt.
H4714: Dual of מָצוֹר; Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt. In the KJV it is rendered: Egypt, Egyptians, Mizraim.
H4715: From צָרַף; a crucible. In the KJV it is rendered: fining pot.
H4716: From מָקַק; properly, a melting, i.e. putridity. In the KJV it is rendered: rottenness, stink.
H4717: From נָקַב; properly, a perforatrix, i.e. a hammer (as piercing). In the KJV it is rendered: hammer.
H4718: From נָקַב; properly, a perforator, i.e. a hammer (as piercing); also (intransitively) a perforation, i.e. a quarry. In the KJV it is rendered: hammer, hole.
H4719: From the same as נָקֹד in the denominative sense of herding (compare נֹקֵד); fold; Makkedah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Makkedah.
H4720: Or miqqdash (Exod. 15:17); from קָדַשׁ; a consecrated thing or place, especially, a palace, sanctuary (whether of Jehovah or of idols) or asylum. In the KJV it is rendered: chapel, hallowed part, holy place, sanctuary.
H4721: Or (feminine) maqhelah; from קָהַל; an assembly. In the KJV it is rendered: congregation.
H4722: Plural of מַקְהֵלִים (feminine); assemblies; Makheloth, a place in the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Makheloth.
H4723: Or miqveh (1 Kings 10:28); or miqvet (2 Chron. 1:16); from קָוָה; something waited for, i.e. confidence (objective or subjective); also a collection, i.e. (of water) a pond, or (of men and horses) a caravan or drove. In the KJV it is rendered: abiding, gathering together, hope, linen yarn, plenty (of water), pool.
H4724: Feminine of מִקְוֶה; a collection, i.e. (of water) a reservoir. In the KJV it is rendered: ditch.
H4725: Or maqom; also (feminine) mqowmah; or mqomah; from קוּם; properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind). In the KJV it is rendered: country, X home, X open, place, room, space, X whither(-soever).
H4726: Or maqor; from קוּר; properly, something dug, i.e. a (general) source (of water, even when naturally flowing; also of tears, blood (by euphemism, of the female pudenda); figuratively, of happiness, wisdom, progeny). In the KJV it is rendered: fountain, issue, spring, well(-spring).
H4727: From לָקַח; reception. In the KJV it is rendered: taking.
H4728: From לָקַח; something received, i.e. merchandise (purchased). In the KJV it is rendered: ware.
H4729: From קָטַר; something to fume (incense) on i.e. a hearth place. In the KJV it is rendered: to burn.
H4730: Feminine of מִקְטַר; something to fume (incense) in, i.e. a coal-pan. In the KJV it is rendered: censer.
H4731: Or (feminine) maqqlah; from an unused root meaning apparently to germinate; a shoot, i.e. stick (with leaves on, or for walking, striking, guiding, divining). In the KJV it is rendered: rod, ((hand-))staff.
H4732: (or perhaps mik-kel-ohth') plural of (feminine) מַקֵּל; rods; Mikloth, a place in the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Mikloth.
H4733: From קָלַט in the sense of taking in; an asylum (as a receptacle). In the KJV it is rendered: refuge.
H4734: From קָלַע; a sculpture (probably in bas-relief). In the KJV it is rendered: carved (figure), carving, graving.
H4735: From קָנָה; something bought, i.e. property, but only livestock; abstractly, acquisition. In the KJV it is rendered: cattle, flock, herd, possession, purchase, substance.
H4736: Feminine of מִקְנֶה; properly, a buying, i.e. acquisition; concretely, a piece of property (land or living); also the sum paid. In the KJV it is rendered: (he that is) bought, possession, piece, purchase.
H4737: From מִקְנֶה and יָהּ; possession of Jah; Miknejah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Mikneiah.
H4738: From קָסַם; an augury. In the KJV it is rendered: divination.
H4739: From קָצַץ; end; Makats, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Makaz.
H4740: Or maqtsoa; or (feminine) maqtso-ah; from קָצַע in the denominative sense of bending; an angle or recess. In the KJV it is rendered: corner, turning.
H4741: From קָצַע; a scraper, i.e. a carving chisel. In the KJV it is rendered: plane.
H4742: From קָצַע in the denominative sense of bending; an angle. In the KJV it is rendered: corner.
H4743: ' a primitive root; to melt; figuratively, to flow, dwindle, vanish. In the KJV it is rendered: consume away, be corrupt, dissolve, pine away.
H4744: From קָרָא; something called out, i.e. a public meeting (the act, the persons, or the place); also a rehearsal. In the KJV it is rendered: assembly, calling, convocation, reading.
H4745: From קָרָה; something met with, i.e. an accident or fortune. In the KJV it is rendered: something befallen, befalleth, chance, event, hap(-peneth).
H4746: From קָרָה; properly, something meeting, i.e. a frame (of timbers). In the KJV it is rendered: building.
H4747: From the same as קַר; a cooling off. In the KJV it is rendered: X summer.
H4748: From קָשָׁה in the sense of knotting up round and hard; something turned (rounded), i.e. a curl (of tresses). In the KJV it is rendered: X well (set) hair.
H4749: Feminine of מִקְשֶׁה; rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering (repousse). In the KJV it is rendered: beaten (out of one piece, work), upright, whole piece.
H4750: Denominative from קִשֻּׁאּים; literally, a cucumbered field, i.e. a cucumber patch. In the KJV it is rendered: garden of cucumbers.
H4751: Or (feminine) marah; from מָרַר; bitter (literally or figuratively); also (as noun) bitterness, or (adverbially) bitterly. In the KJV it is rendered: + angry, bitter(-ly, -ness), chafed, discontented, X great, heavy.
H4752: From מָרַר in its original sense of distillation; a drop. In the KJV it is rendered: drop.
H4753: Or mowr; from מָרַר; myrrh (as distilling in drops, and also as bitter). In the KJV it is rendered: myrrh.
H4754: A primitive root; to rebel; hence (through the idea of maltreating) to whip, i.e. lash (self with wings, as the ostrich in running). In the KJV it is rendered: be filthy, lift up self.
H4755: For מָר feminine; bitter; Mara, a symbolic name of Naomi. In the KJV it is rendered: Mara.
H4756: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to מָרָא in the sense of domineering; a master. In the KJV it is rendered: lord, Lord.
H4757: Of foreign derivation; Merodak-Baladan, a Babylonian king. In the KJV it is rendered: Merodach-baladan.
H4758: From רָאָה; a view (the act of seeing); also an appearance (the thing seen), whether (real) a shape (especially if handsome, comeliness; often plural the looks), or (mental) a vision. In the KJV it is rendered: X apparently, appearance(-reth), X as soon as beautiful(-ly), countenance, fair, favoured, form, goodly, to look (up) on (to), look(-eth), pattern, to see, seem, sight, visage, vision.
H4759: Feminine of מַרְאֶה; a vision; also (causatively) a mirror. In the KJV it is rendered: looking glass, vision.
H4760: Apparently feminine passive causative participle of רָאָה; something conspicuous, i.e. the craw of a bird (from its prominence). In the KJV it is rendered: crop.
H4761: Denominative from רֹאשׁ; properly, headship, i.e. (plural for collective) dominion. In the KJV it is rendered: principality.
H4762: Or Mareshah; formed like מַרְאֲשׁוֹת; summit; Mareshah, the name of two Israelites and of a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Mareshah.
H4763: Formed like מַרְאֲשׁוֹת; properly, a headpiece, i.e. (plural for adverbial) at (or as) the head-rest (or pillow). In the KJV it is rendered: bolster, head, pillow.
H4764: From רָבַב; increase; Merab, a daughter of Saul. In the KJV it is rendered: Merab.
H4765: From רָבַד; a coverlet. In the KJV it is rendered: covering of tapestry.
H4766: From רָבָה; properly, increasing; as noun, greatness, or (adverbially) greatly. In the KJV it is rendered: great, increase.
H4767: From רָבָה; abundance, i.e. a great quantity. In the KJV it is rendered: much.
H4768: From רָבָה; a multitude; also offspring; specifically interest (on capital). In the KJV it is rendered: greatest part, greatness, increase, multitude.
H4769: From רָבַץ; a reclining place, i.e. fold (for flocks). In the KJV it is rendered: couching place, place to lie down.
H4770: From an unused root meaning to tie up; a stall (for cattle). In the KJV it is rendered: X fat(-ted), stall.
H4771: From רָגַע; a resting place. In the KJV it is rendered: rest.
H4772: Denominative from רָ֫גֶל; (plural for collective) a footpiece, i.e. (adverbially) at the foot, or (direct.) the foot itself. In the KJV it is rendered: feet.
H4773: From רָגַם; a stone-heap. In the KJV it is rendered: sling.
H4774: From רָגַע; rest. In the KJV it is rendered: refreshing.
H4775: A primitive root; to rebel. In the KJV it is rendered: rebel(-lious).
H4776: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to מָרַד; rebellion. In the KJV it is rendered: rebellion.
H4777: From מָרַד; rebellion. In the KJV it is rendered: rebellion.
H4778: The same as מֶ֫רֶד; Mered, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Mered.
H4779: (Aramaic) from the same as מְרַד; rebellious. In the KJV it is rendered: rebellious.
H4780: From מָרַד; rebelliousness. In the KJV it is rendered: X rebellious.
H4781: Of foreign derivation; Merodak, a Babylonian idol. In the KJV it is rendered: Merodach.
H4782: Of foreign derivation; Mordecai, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Mordecai.
H4783: From רָדַף; persecuted. In the KJV it is rendered: persecuted.
H4784: A primitive root; to be (causatively, make) bitter (or unpleasant); (figuratively) to rebel (or resist; causatively, to provoke). In the KJV it is rendered: bitter, change, be disobedient, disobey, grievously, provocation, provoke(-ing), (be) rebel (against, -lious).
H4785: The same as מָר feminine; bitter; Marah, a place in the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Marah.
H4786: From מָרַר; bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) trouble. In the KJV it is rendered: grief.
H4787: A form of מֹרַת; trouble. In the KJV it is rendered: bitterness.
H4788: From רוּד in the sense of maltreatment; an outcast; (abstractly) destitution. In the KJV it is rendered: cast out, misery.
H4789: Of uncertain derivation; Meroz, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Meroz.
H4790: From מָרַח; bruised, i.e. emasculated. In the KJV it is rendered: broken.
H4791: From רוּם; altitude, i.e. concretely (an elevated place), abstractly (elevation, figuratively (elation), or adverbially (aloft). In the KJV it is rendered: (far) above, dignity, haughty, height, (most, on) high (one, place), loftily, upward.
H4792: Formed like מָרוֹם; height; Merom, a lake in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Merom.
H4793: From רוּץ; a run (the trial of speed). In the KJV it is rendered: race.
H4794: Or mrutsah; feminine of מֵרוֹץ; a race (the act), whether the manner or the progress. In the KJV it is rendered: course, running.
H4795: From מָרַק; properly, rubbed; but used abstractly, a rubbing (with perfumery). In the KJV it is rendered: purification.
H4796: Plural of מָר feminine; bitter springs; Maroth, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Maroth.
H4797: From an unused root meaning to scream; a cry, i.e. (of job), a revel. In the KJV it is rendered: banquet.
H4798: Formed like מִרְזַח; a cry, i.e. (of grief) a lamentation. In the KJV it is rendered: mourning.
H4799: A primitive root; properly, to soften by rubbing or pressure; hence (medicinally) to apply as an emollient. In the KJV it is rendered: lay for a plaister.
H4800: From רָחַב; enlargement, either literally (an open space, usually in a good sense), or figuratively (liberty). In the KJV it is rendered: breadth, large place (room).
H4801: : from רָחַק; remoteness, i.e. (concretely) a distant place; often (adverbially) from afar. In the KJV it is rendered: (a-, dwell in, very) far (country, off).
H4802: From רָחַשׁ; a stew-pan. In the KJV it is rendered: fryingpan.
H4803: A primitive root; to polish; by implication, to make bald (the head), to gall (the shoulder); also, to sharpen. In the KJV it is rendered: bright, furbish, (have his) hair (be) fallen off, peeled, pluck off (hair).
H4804: (Aramaic) corresponding to מָרַט; to pull off. In the KJV it is rendered: be plucked.
H4805: From מָרָה; bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) rebellion; concretely, bitter, or rebellious. In the KJV it is rendered: bitter, (most) rebel(-lion, -lious).
H4806: From מָרָא in the sense of grossness, through the idea of domineering (compare מָרֵא); stall-fed; often (as noun) a beeve. In the KJV it is rendered: fat (fed) beast (cattle, -ling).
H4807: From רִיב and בַּ֫עַל; quarreller of Baal, Merib-Baal, an epithet of Gideon. In the KJV it is rendered: Merib-baal.
H4808: From רִיב; quarrel. In the KJV it is rendered: provocation, strife.
H4809: The same as מְרִיבָה; Meribah, the name of two places in the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Meribah.
H4810: From מֶ֫רִי and בַּ֫עַל; rebellion of (i.e. against) Baal; Meri-Baal, an epithet of Gideon. In the KJV it is rendered: Meri-baal.
H4811: From מָרָה; rebellion; Merajah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Meraiah.
H4812: Plural of מְרָיָה; rebellious; Merajoth, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Meraioth.
H4813: From מֶ֫רִי; rebelliously; Mirjam, the name of two Israelitesses. In the KJV it is rendered: Miriam.
H4814: From מָרַר; bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) grief. In the KJV it is rendered: bitterness.
H4815: From מָרַר; bitter, i.e. poisonous. In the KJV it is rendered: bitter.
H4816: Perhaps from רָכַך; softness, i.e. (figuratively) fear. In the KJV it is rendered: faintness.
H4817: From רָכַב; a chariot; also a seat (in a vehicle). In the KJV it is rendered: chariot, covering, saddle.
H4818: Feminine of מֶרְכָּב; a chariot. In the KJV it is rendered: chariot.
H4819: From רָכַל; a mart. In the KJV it is rendered: merchandise.
H4820: From רָמָה in the sense of deceiving; fraud. In the KJV it is rendered: craft, deceit(-ful, -fully), false, feigned, guile, subtilly, treachery.
H4821: The same as מִרְמָה; Mirmah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Mirma.
H4822: Plural from רוּם; heights; Meremoth, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Meremoth.
H4823: From רָמַס; abasement (the act or the thing). In the KJV it is rendered: tread (down)-ing, (to be) trodden (down) under foot.
H4824: Patrial from an unused noun; a Meronothite, or inhabitant of some (otherwise unknown) Meronoth. In the KJV it is rendered: Meronothite.
H4825: Of foreign derivation; Meres, a Persian. In the KJV it is rendered: Meres.
H4826: Of foreign derivation; Marsena, a Persian. In the KJV it is rendered: Marsena.
H4827: From רָעַע; used as (abstract) noun, wickedness. In the KJV it is rendered: do mischief.
H4828: From רָעָה in the sense of companionship; a friend. In the KJV it is rendered: companion, friend.
H4829: From רָעָה in the sense of feeding; pasture (the place or the act); also the haunt of wild animals. In the KJV it is rendered: feeding place, pasture.
H4830: From רָעָה in the sense of feeding; pasturage; concretely, a flock. In the KJV it is rendered: flock, pasture.
H4831: From רָעַל; perhaps, earthquake; Maralah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Maralah.
H4832: From רָפָא; properly, curative, i.e. literally (concretely) a medicine, or (abstractly) a cure; figuratively (concretely) deliverance, or (abstractly) placidity. In the KJV it is rendered: ((in-))cure(-able), healing(-lth), remedy, sound, wholesome, yielding.
H4833: From רָפַשׂ; muddled water. In the KJV it is rendered: that which.
H4834: A primitive root; properly, to press, i.e. (figuratively) to be pungent or vehement; to irritate. In the KJV it is rendered: embolden, be forcible, grievous, sore.
H4835: From רָצַץ; oppression. In the KJV it is rendered: violence.
H4836: From רָצַע; an awl. In the KJV it is rendered: aul.
H4837: From רָצַף; a pavement. In the KJV it is rendered: pavement.
H4838: A primitive root; to polish; by implication, to sharpen; also to rinse. In the KJV it is rendered: bright, furbish, scour.
H4839: From מָרַק; soup (as if a rinsing). In the KJV it is rendered: broth.
H4840: From רָקַח; a spicy herb. In the KJV it is rendered: X sweet.
H4841: Feminine of מֶרְקָחִים; abstractly, a seasoning (with spicery); concretely, an unguent-kettle (for preparing spiced oil). In the KJV it is rendered: pot of ointment, X well.
H4842: From רָקַח; an aromatic unguent; also an unguent-pot. In the KJV it is rendered: prepared by the apothecaries' art, compound, ointment.
H4843: A primitive root; properly, to trickle (see מַר); but used only as a denominative from מָר; to be (causatively, make) bitter (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: (be, be in, deal, have, make) bitter(-ly, - ness), be moved with choler, (be, have sorely, it) grieved(-eth), provoke, vex.
H4844: Or mrowr; from מָרַר; a bitter herb. In the KJV it is rendered: bitter(-ness).
H4845: From מָרַר; bile (from its bitterness). In the KJV it is rendered: gall.
H4846: Or mrowrah; from מָרַר; properly, bitterness; concretely, a bitter thing; specifically bile; also venom (of a serpent). In the KJV it is rendered: bitter (thing), gall.
H4847: From מָרַר; bitter; Merari, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Merari.
H4848: From מְרָרִי; a Merarite (collectively), or decendants of Merari. In the KJV it is rendered: Merarites.
H4849: From רָשַׁע; a female wicked doer. In the KJV it is rendered: wicked woman.
H4850: Dual of מָר feminine; double bitterness; Merathajim, an epithet of Babylon. In the KJV it is rendered: Merathaim.
H4851: Of foreign derivation; Mash, a son of Aram, and the people descended from him. In the KJV it is rendered: Mash.
H4852: Of foreign derivation; Mesha, a place in Arabia. In the KJV it is rendered: Mesha.
H4853: From נָשָׂא; a burden; specifically, tribute, or (abstractly) porterage; figuratively, an utterance, chiefly a doom, especially singing; mental, desire. In the KJV it is rendered: burden, carry away, prophecy, X they set, song, tribute.
H4854: The same as מַשָּׂא; burden; Massa, a son of Ishmael. In the KJV it is rendered: Massa.
H4855: From נָשָׁה; a loan; by implication, interest on a debt. In the KJV it is rendered: exaction, usury.
H4856: From נָשָׂא; partiality (as a lifting up). In the KJV it is rendered: respect.
H4857: From שָׁאַב; a trough for cattle to drink from. In the KJV it is rendered: place of drawing water.
H4858: From נָשָׂא; a conflagration (from the rising of smoke). In the KJV it is rendered: burden.
H4859: Feminine of מַשָּׁא; a loan. In the KJV it is rendered: X any(- thing), debt.
H4860: From נָשָׁא; dissimulation. In the KJV it is rendered: deceit.
H4861: From שָׁאַל; request; Mishal, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Mishal, Misheal.
H4862: From שָׁאַל; a request. In the KJV it is rendered: desire, petition.
H4863: From שָׁאַר in the original sense of swelling; a kneading-trough (in which the dough rises). In the KJV it is rendered: kneading trough, store.
H4864: From נָשָׂא; properly, (abstractly) a raising (as of the hands in prayer), or rising (of flame); figuratively, an utterance; concretely, a beacon (as raised); a present (as taken), mess, or tribute; figuratively, a reproach (as a burden). In the KJV it is rendered: burden, collection, sign of fire, (great) flame, gift, lifting up, mess, oblation, reward.
H4865: From שָׁבַץ; a brocade; by analogy, a (reticulated) setting of a gem. In the KJV it is rendered: ouch, wrought.
H4866: From שָׁבַר; the orifice of the womb (from which the fetus breaks forth). In the KJV it is rendered: birth, breaking forth.
H4867: From שָׁבַר; a breaker (of the sea). In the KJV it is rendered: billow, wave.
H4868: From שָׁבַת; cessation, i.e. destruction. In the KJV it is rendered: sabbath.
H4869: From שָׂגַב; properly, a cliff (or other lofty or inaccessible place); abstractly, altitude; figuratively, a refuge. In the KJV it is rendered: defence, high fort (tower), refuge, Misgab, a place in Moab:--Misgab.
H4870: From שָׁגָה; an error. In the KJV it is rendered: oversight.
H4871: A primitive root; to pull out (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: draw(out).
H4872: From מָשָׁה; drawing out (of the water), i.e. rescued; Mosheh, the Israelite lawgiver. In the KJV it is rendered: Moses.
H4873: (Aramaic) corresponding to מֹשֶׁה. In the KJV it is rendered: Moses.
H4874: From נָשָׁה; a debt. In the KJV it is rendered: + creditor.
H4875: Or mshoah; from the same as שׁוֹאָה; (a) ruin, abstractly (the act) or concretely (the wreck). In the KJV it is rendered: desolation, waste.
H4876: Or mashshu ah; for מְשֹׁאָה; ruin. In the KJV it is rendered: desolation, destruction.
H4877: From שׁוּב; returned; Meshobab, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Meshobab.
H4878: Or mshubah; from שׁוּב; apostasy. In the KJV it is rendered: backsliding, turning away.
H4879: From an unused root meaning to stray; mistake. In the KJV it is rendered: error.
H4880: Or mishshowt; from שׁוּט; an oar. In the KJV it is rendered: oar.
H4881: Or msukah; from שׂוּך; a hedge. In the KJV it is rendered: hedge.
H4882: From an unused root meaning to plunder; spoilation. In the KJV it is rendered: spoil.
H4883: From an unused root meaning to rasp; a saw. In the KJV it is rendered: saw.
H4884: From an unused root meaning apparently to divide; a measure (for liquids). In the KJV it is rendered: measure.
H4885: From שׂוּשׂ; delight, concretely (the cause or object) or abstractly (the feeling). In the KJV it is rendered: joy, mirth, rejoice.
H4886: A primitive root; to rub with oil, i.e. to anoint; by implication, to consecrate; also to paint. In the KJV it is rendered: anoint, paint.
H4887: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to מָשַׁח; oil. In the KJV it is rendered: oil.
H4888: Or moshchah; from מָשַׁח; unction (the act); by implication, a consecratory gift. In the KJV it is rendered: (to be) anointed(-ing), ointment.
H4889: From שָׁחַת; destructive, i.e. (as noun) destruction, literally (specifically a snare) or figuratively (corruption). In the KJV it is rendered: corruption, (to) destroy(-ing), destruction, trap, X utterly.
H4890: From שַׁחֲצוֹם; a laughing-stock. In the KJV it is rendered: scorn.
H4891: From שָׁחַר in the sense of day breaking; dawn. In the KJV it is rendered: morning.
H4892: For מַשְׁחִית; destruction. In the KJV it is rendered: destroying.
H4893: Or moshchath; from שָׁחַת; disfigurement. In the KJV it is rendered: corruption, marred.
H4894: Or mishtach; from שָׁטַח; a spreading-place. In the KJV it is rendered: (to) spread (forth, -ing, upon).
H4895: From the same as שֹׁטֵט; enmity. In the KJV it is rendered: hatred.
H4896: From שֹׁטֵר; jurisdiction. In the KJV it is rendered: dominion.
H4897: From מָשָׁה; silk (as drawn from the cocoon). In the KJV it is rendered: silk.
H4898: From an equiv. to שְׁזַב and אֵל; delivered of God; Meshezabel, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Meshezabeel.
H4899: From מָשַׁח; anointed; usually a consecrated person (as a king, priest, or saint); specifically, the Messiah. In the KJV it is rendered: anointed, Messiah.
H4900: A primitive root; to draw, used in a great variety of applications (including to sow, to sound, to prolong, to develop, to march, to remove, to delay, to be tall, etc.). In the KJV it is rendered: draw (along, out), continue, defer, extend, forbear, X give, handle, make (pro-, sound)long, X sow, scatter, stretch out.
H4901: From מָשַׁך; a sowing; also a possession. In the KJV it is rendered: precious, price.
H4902: The same in form as מֶ֫שֶׁך, but probably of foreign derivation; Meshek, a son of Japheth, and the people descended from him. In the KJV it is rendered: Mesech, Meshech.
