H6698: The same as צוּר; rock; Tsur, the name of a Midianite and of an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Zur.
H6699: Feminine of צוּר; a rock (Job 28:10); also a form (as if pressed out). In the KJV it is rendered: form, rock.
H6700: From צוּר and אֵל; rock of God; Tsuriel, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Zuriel.
H6701: From צוּר and שַׁדָּי; rock of (the) Almighty; Tsurishaddai, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Zurishaddai.
H6702: A primitive root; to blaze. In the KJV it is rendered: burn.
H6703: From צָחַח; dazzling, i.e. sunny, bright, (figuratively) evident. In the KJV it is rendered: clear, dry, plainly, white.
H6704: From an unused root meaning to glow; parched. In the KJV it is rendered: dried up.
H6705: A primitive root; to glare, i.e. be dazzling white. In the KJV it is rendered: be whiter.
H6706: From צָחַח; glaring, i.e. exposed to the bright sun. In the KJV it is rendered: higher place, top.
H6707: Feminine of צְחִ֫יחַ; a parched region, i.e. the desert. In the KJV it is rendered: dry land.
H6708: From צְחִ֫יחַ; bare spot, i.e. in the glaring sun. In the KJV it is rendered: higher place.
H6709: From an unused root meaning to putrefy; stench. In the KJV it is rendered: ill savour.
H6710: From צָחַח; a dry place, i.e. desert. In the KJV it is rendered: drought.
H6711: A primitive root; to laugh outright (in merriment or scorn); by implication, to sport. In the KJV it is rendered: laugh, mock, play, make sport.
H6712: From צָחַק; laughter (in pleasure or derision). In the KJV it is rendered: laugh(-ed to scorn).
H6713: From an unused root meaning to dazzle; sheen, i.e. whiteness. In the KJV it is rendered: white.
H6714: From the same as צָ֫חַר; whiteness; Tsochar, the name of a Hittite and of an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Zohar.
H6715: From the same as צָ֫חַר; white. In the KJV it is rendered: white.
H6716: From צָוָה; a ship (as a fixture). In the KJV it is rendered: ship.
H6717: From the same as צוֹבָה; station; Tsiba, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Ziba.
H6718: From a form of צוּד and meaning the same; the chase; also game (thus taken); (generally) lunch (especially for a journey). In the KJV it is rendered: X catcheth, food, X hunter, (that which he took in) hunting, venison, victuals.
H6719: From the same as צָ֫יִד; a huntsman. In the KJV it is rendered: hunter.
H6720: Or tsedah; feminine of צָ֫יִד; food. In the KJV it is rendered: meat, provision, venison, victuals.
H6721: Or Tsiydon; from צוּד in the sense of catching fish; fishery; Tsidon, the name of a son of Canaan, and of a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Sidon, Zidon.
H6722: Patrial from צִידוֹן; a Tsidonian or inhabitant of Tsidon. In the KJV it is rendered: Sidonian, of Sidon, Zidonian.
H6723: From an unused root meaning to parch; aridity; concretely, a desert. In the KJV it is rendered: barren, drought, dry (land, place), solitary place, wilderness.
H6724: From the same as צִיָּה; a desert. In the KJV it is rendered: dry place.
H6725: From the same as צִיָּה in the sense of conspicuousness (compare נָצַח); a monumental or guiding pillar. In the KJV it is rendered: sign, title, waymark.
H6726: The same (regularly) as צִיּוּן; Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem. In the KJV it is rendered: Zion.
H6727: Or Tsicha(; as if feminine of צִחֵה; drought; Tsicha, the name of two Nethinim. In the KJV it is rendered: Ziha.
H6728: From the same as צִיָּה; a desert-dweller, i.e. nomad or wild beast. In the KJV it is rendered: wild beast of the desert, that dwell in (inhabiting) the wilderness.
H6729: From an unused root meaning to confine; the pillory. In the KJV it is rendered: stocks.
H6730: From צָעַר; small; Tsior, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Zior.
H6731: Or tsits; from צוּץ; properly, glistening, i.e. a burnished plate; also a flower (as bright-colored); a wing (as gleaming in the air). In the KJV it is rendered: blossom, flower, plate, wing.
H6732: The same as צִיץ; bloom; Tsits, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Ziz.
H6733: Feminine of צִיץ; a flower. In the KJV it is rendered: flower.
H6734: Feminine of צִיץ; a floral or wing-like projection, i.e. a forelock of hair, a tassel. In the KJV it is rendered: fringe, lock.
H6735: From צוּר; a hinge (as pressed in turning); also a throe (as a phys. or mental pressure); also a herald or errand-doer (as constrained by the principal). In the KJV it is rendered: ambassador, hinge, messenger, pain, pang, sorrow.
H6736: The same as צִיר; a form (of beauty; as if pressed out, i.e. carved); hence, an (idolatrous) image. In the KJV it is rendered: beauty, idol.
H6737: A denominative from צִיר in the sense of ambassador; to make an errand, i.e. betake oneself. In the KJV it is rendered: make as if.
H6738: From צָלַל; shade, whether literal or figurative. In the KJV it is rendered: defence, shade(-ow).
H6739: (Aramaic) probably corresponding to צָלַע in the sense of bowing; pray. In the KJV it is rendered: pray.
H6740: A primitive root; to roast. In the KJV it is rendered: roast.
H6741: Feminine of צֵל; Tsillah, an antediluvian woman. In the KJV it is rendered: Zillah.
H6742: From צָלַל in the sense of rolling; a (round or flattened) cake. In the KJV it is rendered: cake.
H6743: Or tsaleach; a primitive root; to push forward, in various senses (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive). In the KJV it is rendered: break out, come (mightily), go over, be good, be meet, be profitable, (cause to, effect, make to, send) prosper(-ity, -ous, - ously).
H6744: (Aramaic) corresponding to צָלַח; to advance (transitive or intransitive). In the KJV it is rendered: promote, prosper.
H6745: From צָלַח; something protracted or flattened out, i.e. a platter. In the KJV it is rendered: pan.
H6746: From צָלַח; something prolonged or tall, i.e. a vial or salt-cellar. In the KJV it is rendered: cruse.
H6747: From צָלַח; something advanced or deep, i.e. a bowl; figuratively, the bosom. In the KJV it is rendered: bosom, dish.
H6748: Passive participle of צָלָה; roasted. In the KJV it is rendered: roast.
H6749: A primitive root; properly, to tumble down, i.e. settle by a waving motion. In the KJV it is rendered: sink.
H6750: A primitive root (identical with צָלַל through the idea of vibration); to tinkle, i.e. rattle together (as the ears in reddening with shame, or the teeth in chattering with fear). In the KJV it is rendered: quiver, tingle.
H6751: A primitive root (identical with צָלַל through the idea of hovering over (compare צֶ֫לֶם)); to shade, as twilight or an opaque object. In the KJV it is rendered: begin to be dark, shadowing.
H6752: From צָלַל; shade. In the KJV it is rendered: shadow.
H6753: From צֵ֫לֶל and the active participle of פָּנָה; shade-facing; Tselelponi, an Israelitess. In the KJV it is rendered: Hazelelponi (including the article).
H6754: From an unused root meaning to shade; a phantom, i.e. (figuratively) illusion, resemblance; hence, a representative figure, especially an idol. In the KJV it is rendered: image, vain shew.
H6755: (Aramaic) or tslem (Aramaic); corresponding to צֶ֫לֶם; an idolatrous figure. In the KJV it is rendered: form, image.
H6756: From צֶ֫לֶם; shady; Tsalmon, the name of a place in Palestine and of an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Zalmon.
H6757: From צֵל and מָ֫וֶת; shade of death, i.e. the grave (figuratively, calamity). In the KJV it is rendered: shadow of death.
H6758: Feminine of צַלְמָ֫וֶת; shadiness; Tsalmonah, a place in the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Zalmonah.
H6759: From צֵל and מָנַע; shade has been denied; Tsalmunna, a Midianite. In the KJV it is rendered: Zalmunna.
H6760: A primitive root: probably to curve; used only as denominative from צְלָעֹת, to limp (as if one-sided). In the KJV it is rendered: halt.
H6761: From צָלַע; a limping or full (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: adversity, halt(-ing).
H6762: The same as צֶ֫לַע; Tsela, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Zelah.
H6763: Or (feminine) tsalTah; from צָלַע; a rib (as curved), literally (of the body) or figuratively (of a door, i.e. leaf); hence, a side, literally (of a person) or figuratively (of an object or the sky, i.e. quarter); architecturally, a (especially floor or ceiling) timber or plank (single or collective, i.e. a flooring). In the KJV it is rendered: beam, board, chamber, corner, leaf, plank, rib, side (chamber).
H6764: From an unused root of unknown meaning; Tsalaph, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Zalaph.
H6765: From the same as צָלָף and אֶחָד; Tselophchad, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Zelophehad.
H6766: From צֵל and צַח; clear shade; Tseltsach, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Zelzah.
H6767: From צָלַל reduplicated; a clatter, i.e. (abstractly) whirring (of wings); (concretely) a cricket; also a harpoon (as rattling), a cymbal (as clanging). In the KJV it is rendered: cymbal, locust, shadowing, spear.
H6768: From an unused root meaning to split; fissure; Tselek, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Zelek.
H6769: From the feminine of צֵל; shady; Tsillethai, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Zilthai.
H6770: A primitive root; to thirst (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: (be a-, suffer) thirst(-y).
H6771: From צָמֵא; thirsty (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: (that) thirst(-eth, -y).
H6772: From צָמֵא; thirst (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: thirst(-y).
H6773: Feminine of צָמָא; thirst (figuratively, of libidinousnes). In the KJV it is rendered: thirst.
H6774: From צָמֵא; a thirsty place, i.e. desert. In the KJV it is rendered: drought, dry ground, thirsty land.
H6775: A primitive root; to link, i.e. gird; figuratively, to serve, (mentally) contrive. In the KJV it is rendered: fasten, frame, join (self).
H6776: A yoke or team (i.e. pair); hence, an acre (i.e. day's task for a yoke of cattle to plough). In the KJV it is rendered: acre, couple, X together, two (donkeys), yoke (of oxen).
H6777: From an unused root meaning to fasten on; a veil. In the KJV it is rendered: locks.
H6778: From צָמַק; a cake of dried grapes. In the KJV it is rendered: bunch (cluster) of raisins.
H6779: A primitive root; to sprout (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative). In the KJV it is rendered: bear, bring forth, (cause to, make to) bud (forth), (cause to, make to) grow (again, up), (cause to) spring (forth, up).
H6780: From צָמַח; a sprout (usually concrete), literal or figurative. In the KJV it is rendered: branch, bud, that which (where) grew (upon), spring(-ing).
H6781: Or tsamid; from צָמַד; a bracelet or arm-clasp; generally, a lid. In the KJV it is rendered: bracelet, covering.
H6782: From the same as צַמַּת; a noose (as fastening); figuratively, destruction. In the KJV it is rendered: robber.
H6783: Or tsmithuth; from צָמַת; excision, i.e. destruction; used only (adverbially) with prepositional prefix to extinction, i.e. perpetually. In the KJV it is rendered: ever.
H6784: A primitive root; to dry up. In the KJV it is rendered: dry.
H6785: From an unused root probably meaning to be shaggy; wool. In the KJV it is rendered: wool(-len).
H6786: Patrial from an unused name of a place in Palestine; a Tsemarite or branch of the Canaanites. In the KJV it is rendered: Zemarite.
H6787: Dual of צָ֫מֶר; double fleece; Tsemarajim, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Zemaraim.
H6788: From the same as צָ֫מֶר; fleeciness, i.e. foliage. In the KJV it is rendered: highest branch, top.
H6789: A primitive root; to extirpate (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: consume, cut off, destroy, vanish.
H6790: From an unused root meaning to prick; a crag; Tsin, a part of the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Zin.
H6791: From an unused root meaning to be prickly; a thorn; hence, a cactus-hedge. In the KJV it is rendered: thorn.
H6792: Or tsoneh; for צֹאן; a flock. In the KJV it is rendered: sheep.
H6793: Feminine of צִנִּים; a hook (as pointed); also a (large) shield (as if guarding by prickliness); also cold (as piercing). In the KJV it is rendered: buckler, cold, hook, shield, target.
H6794: From an unused root perhaps meaning to be hollow; a culvert. In the KJV it is rendered: gutter, water-spout.
H6795: A primitive root; to alight; (transitive) to cause to descend, i.e. drive down. In the KJV it is rendered: fasten, light (from off).
H6796: Or tsanin; from the same as צִנִּים; a thorn. In the KJV it is rendered: thorn.
H6797: Or tsanowph; or (feminine) tsaniyphah; from צָנַף; a head-dress (i.e. piece of cloth wrapped around). In the KJV it is rendered: diadem, hood, mitre.
H6798: A primitive root; to blast or shrink. In the KJV it is rendered: withered.
H6799: Probably for צַאֲנָן; Tsenan, a place near Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Zenan.
H6800: A primitive root; to humiliate. In the KJV it is rendered: humbly, lowly.
H6801: A primitive root; to wrap, i.e. roll or dress. In the KJV it is rendered: be attired, X surely, violently turn.
H6802: From צָנַף; a ball. In the KJV it is rendered: X toss.
H6803: From the same as צִנִּים; a vase (probably a vial tapering at the top). In the KJV it is rendered: pot.
H6804: Probably from the same as צִנּוֹר; a tube. In the KJV it is rendered: pipe.
H6805: A primitive root; to pace, i.e. step regularly; (upward) to mount; (along) to march; (down and causatively) to hurl. In the KJV it is rendered: bring, go, march (through), run over.
H6806: From צַנְתְּרוֹת; a pace or regular step. In the KJV it is rendered: pace, step.
H6807: Feminine of צָ֫עַד; a march; (concretely) an (ornamental) ankle-chain. In the KJV it is rendered: going, ornament of the legs.
H6808: A primitive root; to tip over (for the purpose of spilling or pouring out), i.e. (figuratively) depopulate; by implication, to imprison or conquer; (reflexive) to lie down (for coitus). In the KJV it is rendered: captive exile, travelling, (cause to) wander(-er).
H6809: From an unused root meaning to wrap over; a veil. In the KJV it is rendered: vail.
H6810: Or tsanowr; from צָעַר; little; (in number) few; (in age) young, (in value) ignoble. In the KJV it is rendered: least, little (one), small (one), + young(-er, -est).
H6811: The same as צָעִיר; Tsair, a place in Idumaea. In the KJV it is rendered: Zair.
H6812: Feminine of צָעִיר; smallness (of age), i.e. juvenility. In the KJV it is rendered: youth.
H6813: A primitive root; to load up (beasts), i.e. to migrate. In the KJV it is rendered: be taken down.
H6814: Of Egyptian derivation; Tsoan, a place in Egypt. In the KJV it is rendered: Zoan.
H6815: Or (dual) Tsaeanayim; plural from צָעַן; removals; Tsaanannim or Tsaanajim, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Zaannannim, Zaanaim.
H6816: From an unused root meaning to bestrew with carvings; sculpture. In the KJV it is rendered: image (work).
H6817: A primitive root; to shriek; (by implication) to proclaim (an assembly). In the KJV it is rendered: X at all, call together, cry (out), gather (selves) (together).
H6818: From צָעַק; a shriek. In the KJV it is rendered: cry(-ing).
H6819: A primitive root; to be small, i.e. (figuratively) ignoble. In the KJV it is rendered: be brought low, little one, be small.
H6820: From צָעַר; little; Tsoar, a place East of the Jordan. In the KJV it is rendered: Zoar.
H6821: A primitive root; to adhere. In the KJV it is rendered: cleave.
H6822: A primitive root; properly, to lean forward, i.e. to peer into the distance; by implication, to observe, await. In the KJV it is rendered: behold, espy, look up (well), wait for, (keep the) watch(-man).
H6823: A primitive root (probably identical with צָפָה through the idea of expansion in outlook, transferring to action); to sheet over (especially with metal). In the KJV it is rendered: cover, overlay.
H6824: From צָפָה; an inundation (as covering). In the KJV it is rendered: X swimmest.
H6825: Or Tsphiy; from צָפָה; observant; Tsepho or Tsephi, an Idumaean. In the KJV it is rendered: Zephi, Zepho.
H6826: From צָפָה; encasement (with metal). In the KJV it is rendered: covering, overlaying.
H6827: Probably for צִפְיוֹן; Tsephon, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Zephon.
H6828: Or tsaphon; from צָפַן; properly, hidden, i.e. dark; used only of the north as a quarter (gloomy and unknown). In the KJV it is rendered: north(-ern, side, -ward, wind).
H6829: The same as צָפוֹן; boreal; Tsaphon, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Zaphon.
H6830: From צָפוֹן; northern. In the KJV it is rendered: northern.
H6831: Patronymically from צְפוֹן; a Tsephonite, or (collectively) descendants of Tsephon. In the KJV it is rendered: Zephonites.
H6832: From the same as צֶ֫פַע; excrement (as protruded). In the KJV it is rendered: dung.
H6833: Or tsippor; from צָפַר; a little bird (as hopping). In the KJV it is rendered: bird, fowl, sparrow.
H6834: The same as צִפּוֹר; Tsippor, a Moabite. In the KJV it is rendered: Zippor.
H6835: From an unused root meaning to expand; a saucer (as flat). In the KJV it is rendered: cruse.
H6836: From צָפָה; watchfulness. In the KJV it is rendered: watching.
H6837: From צָפָה; watch-tower; Tsiphjon, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Ziphion.
H6838: From the same as צַפַּ֫חַת; a flat thin cake. In the KJV it is rendered: wafer.
H6839: Plural of active participle of צָפָה; watchers; Tsophim, a place East of the Jordan. In the KJV it is rendered: Zophim.
H6840: From צָפַן; a treasure (as hidden). In the KJV it is rendered: hid.
H6841: (Aramaic) corresponding to צָפִיר; a he-goat. In the KJV it is rendered: he (goat).
H6842: From צָפַר; a male goat (as prancing). In the KJV it is rendered: (he) goat.
H6843: Feminine formed like צָפִיר; a crown (as encircling the head); also a turn of affairs (i.e. mishap). In the KJV it is rendered: diadem, morning.
H6844: From צָפָה; a sentry. In the KJV it is rendered: watchtower.
H6845: A primitive root; to hide (by covering over); by implication, to hoard or reserve; figuratively to deny; specifically (favorably) to protect, (unfavorably) to lurk. In the KJV it is rendered: esteem, hide(-den one, self), lay up, lurk (be set) privily, (keep) secret(-ly, place).
H6846: Or Tsphanyahuw; from צָפַן and יָהּ; Jah has secreted; Tsephanjah, the name of four Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Zephaniah.
H6847: Of Egyptian derivation; Tsophnath-Paneach, Joseph's Egyptian name. In the KJV it is rendered: Zaphnath-paaneah.
H6848: Or tsiph<oniy from an unused root meaning to extrude; a viper (as thrusting out the tongue, i.e. hissing). In the KJV it is rendered: adder, cockatrice.
H6849: Feminine from the same as צֶ֫פַע; an outcast thing. In the KJV it is rendered: issue.
H6850: A primitive root; to coo or chirp (as a bird). In the KJV it is rendered: chatter, peep, whisper.
H6851: From צוּף; a willow (as growing in overflowed places). In the KJV it is rendered: willow tree.
H6852: A primitive root; to skip about, i.e. return. In the KJV it is rendered: depart early.
H6853: (Aramaic) corresponding to צִפּוֹר; a bird. -- bird.
H6854: From צָפַר and a word elsewhere unused meaning a swamp; a marsh-leaper, i.e. frog. In the KJV it is rendered: frog.
H6855: Feminine of צִפּוֹר; bird; Tsipporah, Moses' wife. In the KJV it is rendered: Zipporah.
H6856: From צָפַר (in the denominative sense (from צִפּוֹר) of scratching); properly, a claw, i.e. (human) nail; also the point of a style (or pen, tipped with adamant). In the KJV it is rendered: nail, point.
H6857: From צָפָה; watch-tower; Tsephath, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Zephath.
H6858: From an unused root meaning to encircle; a capital of a column. In the KJV it is rendered: chapiter.
H6859: The same as צְפַת; Tsephathah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Zephathah.
H6860: Or Tsiyqlag (1 Chronicles 12:1,20); of uncertain derivation: Tsiklag or Tsikelag, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Ziklag.
H6861: From an unused root meaning to wind; a sack (as tied at the mouth). In the KJV it is rendered: husk.
H6862: Or tsar; from צָרַר; narrow; (as a noun) a tight place (usually figuratively, i.e. trouble); also a pebble (as in צֹר); (transitive) an opponent (as crowding). In the KJV it is rendered: adversary, afflicted(-tion), anguish, close, distress, enemy, flint, foe, narrow, small, sorrow, strait, tribulation, trouble.
H6863: From צָרַר; rock; Tser, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Zer.
H6864: From צוּר; a stone (as if pressed hard or to a point); (by implication, of use) a knife. In the KJV it is rendered: flint, sharp stone.
H6865: Or Tsowr; the same as צֹר; a rock; Tsor, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Tyre, Tyrus.
H6866: A primitive root; to burn. In the KJV it is rendered: burn.
H6867: From צוּעָר; conflagration (of fire or disease). In the KJV it is rendered: burning, inflammation.
H6868: Or Tsredathah; apparently from an unused root meaning to pierce; puncture; Tseredah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Zereda, Zeredathah.
H6869: Feminine of צָר; tightness (i.e. figuratively, trouble); transitively, a female rival. In the KJV it is rendered: adversary, adversity, affliction, anguish, distress, tribulation, trouble.
H6870: Feminine passive participle from the same as צֹ֫רִי; wounded; Tserujah, an Israelitess. In the KJV it is rendered: Zeruiah.
H6871: Feminine passive participle of צָרַע; leprous; Tseruah, an Israelitess. In the KJV it is rendered: Zeruah.
H6872: Or (shorter) tsror; from צָרַר; a parcel (as packed up); also a kernel or particle (as if a package). In the KJV it is rendered: bag, X bendeth, bundle, least grain, small stone.
H6873: A primitive root; to be clear (in tone, i.e. shrill), i.e. to whoop. In the KJV it is rendered: cry, roar.
H6874: The same as צֹ֫רִי; Tseri, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Zeri.
H6875: Or tsoriy; from an unused root meaning to crack (as by pressure), hence, to leak; distillation, i.e. balsam. In the KJV it is rendered: balm.
H6876: Patrial from צֹר; a Tsorite or inhabitant of Tsor (i.e. Syrian). In the KJV it is rendered: (man) of Tyre.
H6877: From צָרַח in the sense of clearness of vision; a citadel. In the KJV it is rendered: high place, hold.
H6878: From an unused root meaning to need; need. In the KJV it is rendered: need.
H6879: A primitive root; to scourge, i.e. (intransitive and figurative) to be stricken with leprosy. In the KJV it is rendered: leper, leprous.
H6880: From צָרַע; a wasp (as stinging). In the KJV it is rendered: hornet.
H6881: Apparently another form for צִרְעָה; Tsorah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Zareah, Zorah, Zoreah.
H6882: Or Tsortathiy; patrial from צָרְעָה; a Tsorite or Tsorathite, i.e. inhabitants of Tsorah. In the KJV it is rendered: Zorites, Zareathites, Zorathites.
H6883: From צָרַע; leprosy. In the KJV it is rendered: leprosy.
H6884: A primitive root; to fuse (metal), i.e. refine (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: cast, (re-)fine(-er), founder, goldsmith, melt, pure, purge away, try.
H6885: From צָרַף; refiner; Tsorephi (with the article), an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: goldsmith's.
H6886: From צָרַף; refinement; Tsarephath, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Zarephath.
H6887: A primitive root; to cramp, literally or figuratively, transitive or intransitive (as follows). In the KJV it is rendered: adversary, (be in) afflict(-ion), beseige, bind (up), (be in, bring) distress, enemy, narrower, oppress, pangs, shut up, be in a strait (trouble), vex.
H6888: Apparently by erroneous transcription for צְרֵדָה; Tsererah for Tseredah. In the KJV it is rendered: Zererath.
H6889: Perhaps from צָהַר; splendor; Tsereth, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Zereth.
H6890: From the same as צֶ֫רֶת and שָׁ֫חַר with the article interposed; splendor of the dawn; Tsereth-hash-Shachar, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Zareth-shahar.
H6891: Perhaps for צְרֵדָה; Tsarethan, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Zarthan.
H6892: Or qiys; from קוֹא; vomit. In the KJV it is rendered: vomit.
H6893: From קוֹא; probably the pelican (from vomiting). In the KJV it is rendered: cormorant.
H6894: From קָבַב; a hollow, i.e. vessel used as a (dry) measure. In the KJV it is rendered: cab.
H6895: A primitive root; to scoop out, i.e. (figuratively) to malign or execrate (i.e. stab with words). In the KJV it is rendered: X at all, curse.
H6896: From קָבַב; the paunch (as a cavity) or first stomach of ruminants. In the KJV it is rendered: maw.
H6897: From קָבַב; the abdomen (as a cavity). In the KJV it is rendered: belly.
H6898: From קָבַב; a pavilion (as a domed cavity). In the KJV it is rendered: tent.
H6899: From קָבַץ; a throng. In the KJV it is rendered: company.
H6900: Or qburah; feminine passive participle of קָבַר; sepulture; (concretely) a sepulchre. In the KJV it is rendered: burial, burying place, grave, sepulchre.
H6901: A primitive root; to admit, i.e. take (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: choose, (take) hold, receive, (under-)take.
H6902: (Aramaic) corresponding to קָבַל; to acquire. In the KJV it is rendered: receive, take.
H6903: (Aramaic) or qobel (Aramaic); (corresponding to קָבָלְ־; (adverbially) in front of; usually (with other particles) on account of, so as, since, hence. In the KJV it is rendered: + according to, + as, + because, before, + for this cause, + forasmuch as, + by this means, over against, by reason of, + that, + therefore, + though, + wherefore.
H6904: From קָבַל in the sense of confronting (as standing opposite in order to receive); a battering-ram. In the KJV it is rendered: war.
H6905: From קָבַל in the sense of opposite (see קֳבָלּוֹ); the presence, i.e. (adverbially) in front of. In the KJV it is rendered: before.
H6906: A primitive root; to cover, i.e. (figuratively) defraud. In the KJV it is rendered: rob, spoil.
H6907: From קָבַע; a goblet (as deep like a cover). In the KJV it is rendered: dregs.
H6908: A primitive root; to grasp, i.e. collect. In the KJV it is rendered: assemble (selves), gather (bring) (together, selves together, up), heap, resort, X surely, take up.
H6909: From קָבַץ and אֵל; God has gathered; Kabtseel, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kabzeel.
H6910: Feminine passive participle of קָבַץ; a hoard. In the KJV it is rendered: X gather.
H6911: Dual from קָבַץ; a double heap; Kibtsajim, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kibzaim.
H6912: A primitive root; to inter. In the KJV it is rendered: X in any wise, bury(-ier).
H6913: Or (feminine) qibrah; from קָבַר; a sepulchre. In the KJV it is rendered: burying place, grave, sepulchre.
H6914: From the feminine plural of קָ֫בֶר and תַּאֲוָה with the article interposed; graves of the longing; Kibroth-hat-Taavh, a place in the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Kibroth-hattaavah.
H6915: A primitive root; to shrivel up, i.e. contract or bend the body (or neck) in deference. In the KJV it is rendered: bow (down) (the) head, stoop.
H6916: From קָדַד; cassia bark (as in shrivelled rolls). In the KJV it is rendered: cassia.
H6917: Passive participle of קָדַם; a pristine hero. In the KJV it is rendered: ancient.
H6918: Or qadosh; from קָדַשׁ; sacred (ceremonially or morally); (as noun) God (by eminence), an angel, a saint, a sanctuary. In the KJV it is rendered: holy (One), saint.
H6919: A primitive root to inflame. In the KJV it is rendered: burn, kindle.
H6920: From קָדַח; inflammation, i.e. febrile disease. In the KJV it is rendered: burning ague, fever.
H6921: Or qadim; from קָדַם; the fore or front part; hence (by orientation) the East (often adverbially, eastward, for brevity the east wind). In the KJV it is rendered: east(-ward, wind).
H6923: A primitive root; to project (one self), i.e. precede; hence, to anticipate, hasten, meet (usually for help). In the KJV it is rendered: come (go, (flee)) before, + disappoint, meet, prevent.
H6924: Or qedmah; from קָדַם; the front, of place (absolutely, the fore part, relatively the East) or time (antiquity); often used adverbially (before, anciently, eastward). In the KJV it is rendered: aforetime, ancient (time), before, east (end, part, side, -ward), eternal, X ever(-lasting), forward, old, past.
H6925: (Aramaic) or qdam (Aramaic) (Daniel 7:13); corresponding to קֶ֫דֶם; before. In the KJV it is rendered: before, X from, X I (thought), X me, + of, X it pleased, presence.
H6926: Feminine of קֶ֫דֶם; the forward part (or relatively) East (often adverbially, on the east or in front). In the KJV it is rendered: east(-ward).
H6927: From קָדַם; priority (in time); also used adverbially (before). In the KJV it is rendered: afore, antiquity, former (old) estate.
H6928: (Aramaic) corresponding to קַדְמַת; former time. In the KJV it is rendered: afore(-time), ago.
H6929: From קָדַם; precedence; Kedemah, a son of Ishmael. In the KJV it is rendered: Kedemah.
H6930: From קָדַם; eastern. In the KJV it is rendered: east.
H6931: Or qadmoniy; from קַדְמוֹנָה; (of time) anterior or (of place) oriental. In the KJV it is rendered: ancient, they that went before, east, (thing of) old.
H6932: From קָדַם; beginnings; Kedemoth, a place in eastern Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kedemoth.
H6933: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to קָדַם; first. In the KJV it is rendered: first.
H6934: From קֶ֫דֶם and אֵל; presence of God; Kadmiel, the name of three Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Kadmiel.
H6935: The same as קַדְמוֹנִי; ancient, i.e. aboriginal; Kadmonite (collectively), the name of a tribe in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kadmonites.
H6936: From קָדַד; the crown of the head (as the part most bowed). In the KJV it is rendered: crown (of the head), pate, scalp, top of the head.
H6937: A primitive root; to be ashy, i.e. dark-colored; by implication, to mourn (in sackcloth or sordid garments). In the KJV it is rendered: be black(-ish), be (make) dark(-en), X heavily, (cause to) mourn.
H6938: From קָדַר; dusky (of the skin or the tent); Kedar, a son of Ishmael; also (collectively) Bedouin (as his descendants or representatives). In the KJV it is rendered: Kedar.
H6939: From קָדַר; dusky place; Kidron, a brook near Jerusalem. In the KJV it is rendered: Kidron.
H6940: From קָדַר; duskiness. In the KJV it is rendered: blackness.
H6941: Adverb from קָדַר; blackish ones (i.e. in sackcloth); used adverbially, in mourning weeds. In the KJV it is rendered: mournfully.
H6942: A primitive root; to be (causatively, make, pronounce or observe as) clean (ceremonially or morally). In the KJV it is rendered: appoint, bid, consecrate, dedicate, defile, hallow, (be, keep) holy(-er, place), keep, prepare, proclaim, purify, sanctify(-ied one, self), X wholly.
H6943: From קָדַשׁ; a sanctum; Kedesh, the name of four places in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kedesh.
H6944: From קָדַשׁ; a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity. In the KJV it is rendered: consecrated (thing), dedicated (thing), hallowed (thing), holiness, (X most) holy (X day, portion, thing), saint, sanctuary.
H6945: From קָדַשׁ; a (quasi) sacred person, i.e. (technically) a (male) devotee (by prostitution) to licentious idolatry. In the KJV it is rendered: sodomite, unclean.
H6946: The same as קָדֵשׁ; sanctuary; Kadesh, a place in the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Kadesh.
H6947: From the same as קָדֵשׁ and an otherwise unused word (apparently compounded of a correspondent to בָּרָא and a derivative of נ֫וּעַ) meaning desert of a fugitive; Kadesh of (the) Wilderness of Wandering; Kadesh-Barnea, a place in the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Kadesh-barnea.
H6948: Feminine of קָדֵשׁ; a female devotee (i.e. prostitute). In the KJV it is rendered: harlot, whore.
H6949: A primitive root; to be dull. In the KJV it is rendered: be set on edge, be blunt.
H6950: A primitive root; to convoke. In the KJV it is rendered: assemble (selves) (together), gather (selves) (together).
H6951: From קָהַל; assemblage (usually concretely). In the KJV it is rendered: assembly, company, congregation, multitude.
H6952: From קָהַל; an assemblage. In the KJV it is rendered: assembly, congregation.
H6953: Feminine of active participle from קָהַל; a (female) assembler (i.e. lecturer): abstractly, preaching (used as a "nom de plume", Koheleth). In the KJV it is rendered: preacher.
H6954: From קָהַל; convocation; Kehelathah, a place in the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Kehelathah.
H6955: From an unused root meaning to ally oneself; allied; Kehath, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Kohath.
H6956: Patronymically from קְהָת; a Kohathite (collectively) or descendants of Kehath. In the KJV it is rendered: Kohathites.
H6957: Or qav; from קָוָה (compare קָוה); a cord (as connecting), especially for measuring; figuratively, a rule; also a rim, a musical string or accord. In the KJV it is rendered: line.
H6958: Or qayah (Jer. 25:27); a primitive root; to vomit. In the KJV it is rendered: spue (out), vomit (out, up, up again).
H6959: A form collateral to כּוֹבָע; a helmet. In the KJV it is rendered: helmet.
H6960: A primitive root; to bind together (perhaps by twisting), i.e. collect; (figuratively) to expect. In the KJV it is rendered: gather (together), look, patiently, tarry, wait (for, on, upon).
H6961: From קָוָה; a (measuring) cord (as if for binding). In the KJV it is rendered: line.
H6962: A primitive root; properly, to cut off, i.e. (figuratively) detest. In the KJV it is rendered: begrieved, loathe self.
H6963: Or qol; from an unused root meaning to call aloud; a voice or sound. In the KJV it is rendered: + aloud, bleating, crackling, cry (+ out), fame, lightness, lowing, noise, + hold peace, (pro-)claim, proclamation, + sing, sound, + spark, thunder(-ing), voice, + yell.
H6964: From קוֹל and יָהּ; voice of Jah; Kolajah, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Kolaiah.
H6965: A primitive root; to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative). In the KJV it is rendered: abide, accomplish, X be clearer, confirm, continue, decree, X be dim, endure, X enemy, enjoin, get up, make good, help, hold, (help to) lift up (again), make, X but newly, ordain, perform, pitch, raise (up), rear (up), remain, (a-)rise (up) (again, against), rouse up, set (up), (e-)stablish, (make to) stand (up), stir up, strengthen, succeed, (as-, make) sure(-ly), (be) up(-hold, - rising).
H6966: (Aramaic) corresponding to קוּם. In the KJV it is rendered: appoint, establish, make, raise up self, (a-)rise (up), (make to) stand, set (up).
H6967: From קוּם; height. In the KJV it is rendered: X along, height, high, stature, tall.
H6968: From קוּם; elevation, i.e. (adverbially) erectly (figuratively): upright.
H6969: A primitive root; to strike a musical note, i.e. chant or wail (at a funeral). In the KJV it is rendered: lament, mourning woman.
H6970: Probably from קוּץ in the original sense of cutting off; curtailment; Koa, a region of Bab. In the KJV it is rendered: Koa.
H6971: Or qoph; probably of foreign origin; a monkey. In the KJV it is rendered: ape.
H6972: A primitive root; to clip off; used only as denominative from קָ֫יִץ; to spend the harvest season. In the KJV it is rendered: summer.
H6973: A primitive root (identical with קוּץ through the idea of severing oneself from (compare קוּט)); to be (causatively, make) disgusted or anxious. In the KJV it is rendered: abhor, be distressed, be grieved, loathe, vex, be weary.
H6974: A primitive root (identical with קוּץ through the idea of abruptness in starting up from sleep (compare יָקַץ)); to awake (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: arise, (be) (a-)wake, watch.
H6975: Or qots; from קוּץ (in the sense of pricking); a thorn. In the KJV it is rendered: thorn.
H6976: The same as קוֹץ; Kots, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Koz, Hakkoz (including the article).
H6977: Feminine passive participle of קוּץ in its original sense; a forelock (as shorn). In the KJV it is rendered: lock.
H6978: From קָו (in the sense of a fastening); stalwart. In the KJV it is rendered: X meted out.
H6979: A primitive root; to trench; by implication, to throw forth; also (denominative from קִיר) to wall up, whether literal (to build a wall) or figurative (to estop). In the KJV it is rendered: break down, cast out, destroy, dig.
H6980: From קוּר; (only plural) trenches, i.e. a web (as if so formed). In the KJV it is rendered: web.
H6981: Or Qore7 (1 Chronicles 26:1); active participle of קָרָא; crier; Kore, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Kore.
H6982: Or qorah; from קוּר; a rafter (forming trenches as it were); by implication, a roof. In the KJV it is rendered: beam, roof.
H6983: A primitive root; to bend; used only as denominative for יָקֹשׁ, to set a trap. In the KJV it is rendered: lay a snare.
H6984: From the passive participle of קוֹשׁ and יָהּ; entrapped of Jah; Kushajah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Kushaiah.
H6985: From קוּט in the sense of abbreviation; a little, i.e. (adverbially) merely. In the KJV it is rendered: very.
H6986: From an unused root meaning to cut off; ruin. In the KJV it is rendered: destroying, destruction.
H6987: From the same as קָ֫טֶב; extermination. In the KJV it is rendered: destruction.
H6988: From קָטַר; perfume. In the KJV it is rendered: incense.
H6989: Feminine passive participle of קָטַר; perfumed; Keturah, a wife of Abraham. In the KJV it is rendered: Keturah.
H6990: A primitive root; to clip off, i.e. (figuratively) destroy. In the KJV it is rendered: be cut off.
H6991: A primitive root; properly, to cut off, i.e. (figuratively) put to death. In the KJV it is rendered: kill, slay.
H6992: (Aramaic) corresponding to קָטַל; to kill. In the KJV it is rendered: slay.
H6993: From קָטַל; a violent death. In the KJV it is rendered: slaughter.
H6994: A primitive root (rather denominative from קָטָן); to diminish, i.e. be (causatively, make) diminutive or (figuratively) of no account. In the KJV it is rendered: be a (make) small (thing), be not worthy.
H6995: From קָטַן; a pettiness, i.e. the little finger. In the KJV it is rendered: little finger.
H6996: Or qaton; from קוּט; abbreviated, i.e. diminutive, literally (in quantity, size or number) or figuratively (in age or importance). In the KJV it is rendered: least, less(-er), little (one), small(-est, one, quantity, thing), young(-er, -est).
H6997: The same as קָטָן; small; Katan, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Hakkatan (including the article).
H6998: A primitive root; to strip off. In the KJV it is rendered: crop off, cut down (up), pluck.
H6999: A primitive root (identical with קְטֻרוֹת through the idea of fumigation in a close place and perhaps thus driving out the occupants); to smoke, i.e. turn into fragrance by fire (especially as an act of worship). In the KJV it is rendered: burn (incense, sacrifice) (upon), (altar for) incense, kindle, offer (incense, a sacrifice).
H7000: A primitive root; to inclose. In the KJV it is rendered: join.
H7001: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to קְטֻרוֹת; a knot (as tied up), i.e. (figuratively) a riddle; also a vertebra (as if a knot). In the KJV it is rendered: doubt, joint.
H7002: From קָטַר; perfume. In the KJV it is rendered: incense.
H7003: From קָטַר; fumigative; Kitron, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kitron.
H7004: From קָטַר; a fumigation. In the KJV it is rendered: (sweet) incense, perfume.
H7005: From קָטָן; littleness; Kattath, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kattath.
H7006: A primitive root; to vomit. In the KJV it is rendered: spue.
H7007: (Aramaic) corresponding to קָ֫יִץ; harvest. In the KJV it is rendered: summer.
H7008: Or qiytor; from קָטַר; a fume, i.e. cloud. In the KJV it is rendered: smoke, vapour.
H7009: From קוּם; an opponent (as rising against one), i.e. (collectively) enemies. In the KJV it is rendered: substance.
H7010: (Aramaic) from קוּם; an edict (as arising in law). In the KJV it is rendered: decree, statute.
H7011: (Aramaic) from קוּם; permanent (as rising firmly). In the KJV it is rendered: stedfast, sure.
H7012: From קוּם; an arising. In the KJV it is rendered: rising up.
H7013: From קוּן in the original sense of fixity; a lance (as striking fast). In the KJV it is rendered: spear.
H7014: The same as קֵין (with a play upon the affinity to קָנָה); Kajin, the name of the first child, also of a place in Palestine, and of an Oriental tribe. In the KJV it is rendered: Cain, Kenite(-s).
H7015: From קוּן; a dirge (as accompanied by beating the breasts or on instruments). In the KJV it is rendered: lamentation.
H7016: The same as קִינִים; Kinah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kinah.
H7017: Or Qiyniy (1 Chron. 2:55); patronymic from קָ֫יִן; a Kenite or member of the tribe of Kajin. In the KJV it is rendered: Kenite.
H7018: From the same as קֵן; fixed; Kenan, an antediluvian. In the KJV it is rendered: Cainan, Kenan.
H7019: From קוּץ; harvest (as the crop), whether the product (grain or fruit) or the (dry) season. In the KJV it is rendered: summer (fruit, house).
H7020: From קוּץ; terminal. In the KJV it is rendered: out- (utter-)most.
H7021: Perhaps from קָיָה; the gourd (as nauseous). In the KJV it is rendered: gourd.
H7022: From קָלוֹן; intense disgrace. In the KJV it is rendered: shameful spewing.
H7023: Or qir (Isa. 22:5); or (feminine) qiyrah; from קוּר; a wall (as built in a trench). In the KJV it is rendered: + mason, side, town, X very, wall.
H7024: The same as קִיר; fortress; Kir, a place in Assyrian; also one in Moab. In the KJV it is rendered: Kir.
H7025: Or (feminine of the latter word) Qiyr Chareseth; from קִיר and חָ֫רֶשׂ; fortress of earthenware; Kir-Cheres or Kir-Chareseth, a place in Moab. In the KJV it is rendered: Kir-haraseth, Kir-hareseth, Kir-haresh, Kir-heres.
H7026: Or Qeroc; from the same as קַרְסֹל; ankled; Keros, one of the Nethinim. In the KJV it is rendered: Keros.
H7027: From קוֹשׁ; a bow; Kish, the name of five Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Kish.
H7028: From קוֹשׁ; winding; Kishon, a river of Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kishon, Kison.
H7029: From קוֹשׁ; bowed; Kishi, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Kishi.
H7030: (Aramaic) of Greek origin; a lyre. In the KJV it is rendered: harp.
H7031: Contracted from קָלַל; light; (by implication) rapid (also adverbial). In the KJV it is rendered: light, swift(-ly).
H7032: (Aramaic) corresponding to קוֹל. In the KJV it is rendered: sound, voice.
H7033: A primitive root (rather identical with קָלָה through the idea of shrinkage by heat); to toast, i.e. scorch partially or slowly. In the KJV it is rendered: dried, loathsome, parch, roast.
H7034: A primitive root; to be light (as implied in rapid motion), but figuratively, only (be (causatively, hold) in contempt). In the KJV it is rendered: base, contemn, despise, lightly esteem, set light, seem vile.
H7035: For קָהַל; to assemble. In the KJV it is rendered: gather together.
H7036: From קָלָה; disgrace; (by implication) the pudenda. In the KJV it is rendered: confusion, dishonour, ignominy, reproach, shame.
H7037: Apparently but a form for צַלָּ֫חַת; a kettle. In the KJV it is rendered: caldron.
H7038: A primitive root; to maim. In the KJV it is rendered: lacking in his parts.
H7039: Or qaliyi; from קָלָה; roasted ears of grain. In the KJV it is rendered: parched corn.
H7040: From קָלַל; frivolous; Kallai, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Kallai.
H7041: From קָלָה; insignificance; Kelajah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Kelaiah.
H7042: From קָלַט; maiming; Kelita, the name of three Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Kelita.
H7043: A primitive root; to be (causatively, make) light, literally (swift, small, sharp, etc.) or figuratively (easy, trifling, vile, etc.). In the KJV it is rendered: abate, make bright, bring into contempt, (ac-)curse, despise, (be) ease(-y, -ier), (be a, make, make somewhat, move, seem a, set) light(-en, -er, -ly, -ly afflict, -ly esteem, thing), X slight(-ly), be swift(-er), (be, be more, make, re-)vile, whet.
H7044: From קָלַל; brightened (as if sharpened). In the KJV it is rendered: burnished, polished.
H7045: From קָלַל; vilification. In the KJV it is rendered: (ac-)curse(-d, - ing).
H7046: A primitive root; to disparage, i.e. ridicule. In the KJV it is rendered: mock, scoff, scorn.
H7047: From קָלַס; a laughing-stock. In the KJV it is rendered: derision.
H7048: Intensive from קָלַס; ridicule. In the KJV it is rendered: mocking.
H7049: A primitive root: to sling: also to carve (as if a circular motion, or into light forms). In the KJV it is rendered: carve, sling (out).
H7050: From קָלַע; a sling; also a (door) screen (as if slung across), or the valve (of the door) itself. In the KJV it is rendered: hanging, leaf, sling.
H7051: Intensive from קָלַע; a slinger. In the KJV it is rendered: slinger.
H7052: From קָלַל; insubstantial. In the KJV it is rendered: light.
H7053: From an unused root meaning to prick; a prong, i.e. hay-fork. In the KJV it is rendered: fork.
H7054: Feminine of active participle of קוּם; something that rises, i.e. a stalk of grain. In the KJV it is rendered: (standing) corn, grown up, stalk.
H7055: From קוּם and אֵל; raised of God; Kemuel, the name of a relative of Abraham, and of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Kemuel.
H7056: From קוּם; an elevation; Kamon, a place East of the Jordan. In the KJV it is rendered: Camon.
H7057: Or qiymowsh; from an unused root meaning to sting; a prickly plant. In the KJV it is rendered: nettle.
H7058: From an unused root probably meaning to grind; flour. In the KJV it is rendered: flour, meal.
H7059: A primitive root; to pluck, i.e. destroy. In the KJV it is rendered: cut down, fill with wrinkles.
H7060: A primitive root; to wither. In the KJV it is rendered: hew down, wither.
H7061: A primitive root; to grasp with the hand. In the KJV it is rendered: take an handful.
H7062: From קָמַץ; a grasp, i.e. handful. In the KJV it is rendered: handful.
H7063: From the same as קִמּוֹשׂ; a prickly plant. In the KJV it is rendered: thorn.
H7064: Contracted from קָנַן; a nest (as fixed), sometimes including the nestlings; figuratively, a chamber or dwelling. In the KJV it is rendered: nest, room.
H7065: A primitive root; to be (causatively, make) zealous, i.e. (in a bad sense) jealous or envious. In the KJV it is rendered: (be) envy(-ious), be (move to, provoke to) jealous(-y), X very, (be) zeal(-ous).
H7066: (Aramaic) corresponding to קָנָה; to purchase. In the KJV it is rendered: buy.
H7067: From קָנָא; jealous. In the KJV it is rendered: jealous.
H7068: From קָנָא; jealousy or envy. In the KJV it is rendered: envy(-ied), jealousy, X sake, zeal.
H7069: A primitive root; to erect, i.e. create; by extension, to procure, especially by purchase (causatively, sell); by implication to own. In the KJV it is rendered: attain, buy(-er), teach to keep cattle, get, provoke to jealousy, possess(-or), purchase, recover, redeem, X surely, X verily.
H7070: From קָנָה; a reed (as erect); by resemblance a rod (especially for measuring), shaft, tube, stem, the radius (of the arm), beam (of a steelyard). In the KJV it is rendered: balance, bone, branch, calamus, cane, reed, X spearman, stalk.
H7071: Feminine of קָנֶה; reediness; Kanah, the name of a stream and of a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kanah.
H7072: For קַנָּא; jealous or angry. In the KJV it is rendered: jealous.
H7073: Probably from an unused root meaning to hunt; hunter; Kenaz, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Kenaz.
H7074: Patronymic from קְנַז, a Kenizzite or descendant of Kenaz. In the KJV it is rendered: Kenezite, Kenizzites.
H7075: From קָנָה; creation, i.e. (concretely) creatures; also acquisition, purchase, wealth. In the KJV it is rendered: getting, goods, X with money, riches, substance.
H7076: From an unused root (meaning to erect); cinnamon bark (as in upright rolls). In the KJV it is rendered: cinnamon.
H7077: A primitive root; to erect; but used only as denominative from קֵן; to nestle, i.e. build or occupy as a nest. In the KJV it is rendered: make.
H7078: From an unused root probably meaning to wrench; perversion. In the KJV it is rendered: end.
H7079: From קָנָה; possession; Kenath, a place East of the Jordan. In the KJV it is rendered: Kenath.
H7080: A primitive root; properly, to distribute, i.e. determine by lot or magical scroll; by implication, to divine. In the KJV it is rendered: divine(-r, -ation), prudent, soothsayer, use (divination).
H7081: From קָסַם; a lot: also divination (including its fee), oracle. In the KJV it is rendered: (reward of) divination, divine sentence, witchcraft.
H7082: A primitive root; to lop off. In the KJV it is rendered: cut off.
H7083: From the same as כּוֹס (or as קָשָׁה); properly, a cup, i.e. an ink-stand. In the KJV it is rendered: inkhorn.
H7084: Perhaps from קָלַע in the sense of inclosing; citadel; Keilah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Keilah.
H7085: From the same as ק֫וֹעַ; an incision or gash. In the KJV it is rendered: + mark.
H7086: Probably from קָרַע; a bowl (as cut out hollow). In the KJV it is rendered: charger, dish.
H7087: A primitive root; to shrink, i.e. thicken (as unracked wine, curdled milk, clouded sky, frozen water). In the KJV it is rendered: congeal, curdle, dark, settle.
H7088: A primitive root; to contract, i.e. roll together. In the KJV it is rendered: cut off.
H7089: From קָפַד; shrinking, i.e., terror. In the KJV it is rendered: destruction.
H7090: Or qippod; from קָפַד; a species of bird, perhaps the bittern (from its contracted form). In the KJV it is rendered: bittern.
H7091: From an unused root meaning to contract, i.e. spring forward; an arrow-snake (as darting on its prey). In the KJV it is rendered: great owl.
H7092: A primitive root; to draw together, i.e. close; by implication, to leap (by contracting the limbs); specifically, to die (from gathering up the feet). In the KJV it is rendered: shut (up), skip, stop, take out of the way.
H7093: Contracted from קָצַץ; an extremity; adverbially (with prepositional prefix) after. In the KJV it is rendered: + after, (utmost) border, end, (in-)finite, X process.
H7094: A primitive root; to clip, or (generally) chop. In the KJV it is rendered: cut down, shorn.
H7095: From קָצַב; shape (as if cut out); base (as if there cut off). In the KJV it is rendered: bottom, size.
H7096: A primitive root; to cut off; (figuratively) to destroy; (partially) to scrape off. In the KJV it is rendered: cut off, cut short, scrape (off).
H7097: Or (negative only) qetseh; from קָצָה; an extremity (used in a great variety of applications and idioms; compare קֵץ). In the KJV it is rendered: X after, border, brim, brink, edge, end, (in-)finite, frontier, outmost coast, quarter, shore, (out-)side, X some, ut(-ter-)most (part).
H7098: Feminine of קָצֶה; a termination (used like קָצֶה):--coast, corner, (selv-)edge, lowest, (uttermost) participle.
H7099: And (feminine) qitsvah; from קָצָה; a limit (used like קָצֶה, but with less variety):--end, edge, uttermost participle.
H7100: From an unused root apparently meaning to incise; fennelflower (from its pungency). In the KJV it is rendered: fitches.
H7101: From קָצָה in the sense of determining; a magistrate (as deciding) or other leader. In the KJV it is rendered: captain, guide, prince, ruler.
H7102: From קָצַע; cassia (as peeled; plural the bark). In the KJV it is rendered: cassia.
H7103: The same as קְצִיעוֹת; Ketsiah, a daughter of Job. In the KJV it is rendered: Kezia.
H7104: From קָצַץ; abrupt; Keziz, a valley in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Keziz.
H7105: From קָצַר; severed, i.e. harvest (as reaped), the crop, the time, the reaper, or figuratively; also a limb (of a tree, or simply foliage). In the KJV it is rendered: bough, branch, harvest (man).
H7106: A primitive root; to strip off, i.e. (partially) scrape; by implication, to segregate (as an angle). In the KJV it is rendered: cause to scrape, corner.
H7107: A primitive root; to crack off, i.e. (figuratively) burst out in rage. In the KJV it is rendered: (be) anger(-ry), displease, fret self, (provoke to) wrath (come), be wroth.
H7108: (Aramaic) corresponding to קָצַף; to become enraged. In the KJV it is rendered: be furious.
H7109: (Aramaic) from קְצַף; rage. In the KJV it is rendered: wrath.
H7110: From קָצַף; a splinter (as chipped off); figuratively, rage or strife. In the KJV it is rendered: foam, indignation, X sore, wrath.
H7111: From קָצַף; a fragment. In the KJV it is rendered: bark(-ed).
H7112: A primitive root; to chop off (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: cut (asunder, in pieces, in sunder, off), X utmost.
H7113: (Aramaic) corresponding to קָצַץ. In the KJV it is rendered: cut off.
H7114: A primitive root; to dock off, i.e. curtail (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative); especially to harvest (grass or grain). In the KJV it is rendered: X at all, cut down, much discouraged, grieve, harvestman, lothe, mourn, reap(-er), (be, wax) short(-en, -er), straiten, trouble, vex.
H7115: From קָצַר; shortness (of spirit), i.e. impatience. In the KJV it is rendered: anguish.
H7116: From קָצַר; short (whether in size, number, life, strength or temper). In the KJV it is rendered: few, hasty, small, soon.
H7117: From קָצָה; a termination (literally or figuratively); also (by implication) a portion; adverbially (with prepositional prefix) after. In the KJV it is rendered: end, part, X some.
H7118: (Aramaic) corresponding to קְצָת. In the KJV it is rendered: end, partly.
H7119: Contracted from an unused root meaning to chill; cool; figuratively, quiet. In the KJV it is rendered: cold, excellent (from the margin).
H7120: From the same as קַר; cold. In the KJV it is rendered: cold.
H7121: A primitive root (rather identical with קָרָא through the idea of accosting a person met); to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications). In the KJV it is rendered: bewray (self), that are bidden, call (for, forth, self, upon), cry (unto), (be) famous, guest, invite, mention, (give) name, preach, (make) proclaim(- ation), pronounce, publish, read, renowned, say.
H7122: A primitive root: to encounter, whether accidentally or in a hostile manner. In the KJV it is rendered: befall, (by) chance, (cause to) come (upon), fall out, happen, meet.
H7123: (Aramaic) corresponding to קָרָא. In the KJV it is rendered: call, cry, read.
H7124: Properly, active participle of קָרָא; a caller, i.e. partridge (from its cry). In the KJV it is rendered: partridge.
H7125: From קָרָא; an encountering, accidental, friendly or hostile (also adverbially, opposite). In the KJV it is rendered: X against (he come), help, meet, seek, X to, X in the way.
H7126: A primitive root; to approach (causatively, bring near) for whatever purpose. In the KJV it is rendered: (cause to) approach, (cause to) bring (forth, near), (cause to) come (near, nigh), (cause to) draw near (nigh), go (near), be at hand, join, be near, offer, present, produce, make ready, stand, take.
H7127: (Aramaic) corresponding to קָרַב. In the KJV it is rendered: approach, come (near, nigh), draw near.
H7128: From קָרַב; hostile encounter. In the KJV it is rendered: battle, war.
H7129: (Aramaic) corresponding to קְרָב. In the KJV it is rendered: war.
H7130: From קָרַב; properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition). In the KJV it is rendered: X among, X before, bowels, X unto charge, + eat (up), X heart, X him, X in, inward (X -ly, part, -s, thought), midst, + out of, purtenance, X therein, X through, X within self.
H7131: From קָרַב; near. In the KJV it is rendered: approach, come (near, nigh), draw near.
H7132: From קָרַב; approach. In the KJV it is rendered: approaching, draw near.
H7133: Or qurban; from קָרַב; something brought near the altar, i.e. a sacrificial present. In the KJV it is rendered: oblation, that is offered, offering.
H7134: Perhaps from קָדַם in the sense of striking upon; an axe. In the KJV it is rendered: ax.
H7135: Feminine of קַר; coolness. In the KJV it is rendered: cold.
H7136: A primitive root; to light upon (chiefly by accident); causatively, to bring about; specifically, to impose timbers (for roof or floor). In the KJV it is rendered: appoint, lay (make) beams, befall, bring, come (to pass unto), floor, (hap) was, happen (unto), meet, send good speed.
H7137: From קָרָה; an (unfortunate) occurrence, i.e. some accidental (ceremonial) disqualification. In the KJV it is rendered: uncleanness that chanceth.
H7138: Or qarob; from קָרַב; near (in place, kindred or time). In the KJV it is rendered: allied, approach, at hand, + any of kin, kinsfold(-sman), (that is) near (of kin), neighbour, (that is) next, (them that come) nigh (at hand), more ready, short(-ly).
H7139: A primitive root; to depilate. In the KJV it is rendered: make (self) bald.
H7140: Or qorach; from קָרַח; ice (as if bald, i.e. smooth); hence, hail; by resemblance, rock crystal. In the KJV it is rendered: crystal, frost, ice.
H7141: From קָרַח; ice; Korach, the name of two Edomites and three Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Korah.
H7142: From קָרַח; bald (on the back of the head). In the KJV it is rendered: bald (head).
H7143: From קָרַח; bald; Kareach, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Careah, Kareah.
H7144: Or qorcha (Ezek. 27:31); from קָרַח; baldness. In the KJV it is rendered: bald(-ness), X utterly.
H7145: Patronymic from קֹ֫רַח; a Korchite (collectively) or descendants of Korach. In the KJV it is rendered: Korahite, Korathite, sons of Kore, Korhite.
H7146: From קָרַח; a bald spot (on the back of the head); figuratively, a threadbare spot (on the back side of the cloth). In the KJV it is rendered: bald head, bare within.
H7147: From קָרָה; hostile encounter. In the KJV it is rendered: contrary.
H7148: From קָרָא; called, i.e. select. In the KJV it is rendered: famous, renowned.
H7149: (Aramaic) or qiryah (Aramaic); corresponding to קִרְיָה. In the KJV it is rendered: city.
H7150: From קָרָא; a proclamation. In the KJV it is rendered: preaching.
H7151: From קָרָה in the sense of flooring, i.e. building; a city. In the KJV it is rendered: city.
H7152: Plural of קִרְיָה; buildings; Kerioth, the name of two places in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kerioth, Kirioth.
H7153: Or (with the article interposed) Qiryath ha- Arbaw (Neh. 11:25); from קִרְיָה and אַרְבַּע or אַרְבַּע; city of Arba, or city of the four (giants); Kirjath-Arba or Kirjath-ha-Arba, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kirjath-arba.
H7154: From קִרְיָה and בַּ֫עַל; city of Baal; Kirjath-Baal, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kirjath-baal.
H7155: From קִרְיָה and the feminine plural of חוּץ; city of streets; Kirjath-Chutsoth, a place in Moab. In the KJV it is rendered: Kirjath-huzoth.
H7156: Dual of קִרְיָה; double city; Kirjathaim, the name of two placed in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kiriathaim, Kirjathaim.
H7157: Or (Jer. 26:20) with the article interposed; or (Josh. 18:28) simply the former part of the word; or Qiryath Ariym; from קִרְיָה and the plural of יָ֫עַר or עִיר; city of forests, or city of towns; Kirjath-Jearim or Kirjath-Arim, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kirjath, Kirjath-jearim, Kirjath-arim.
H7158: Or Qiryath Cepher; from קִרְיָה and a simpler feminine from the same as סַנְסִן, or (for the latter name) סֵ֫פֶר; city of branches, or of a book; Kirjath-Sannah or Kirjath-Sepher, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kirjath-sannah, Kirjath-sepher.
H7159: A primitive root; to cover. In the KJV it is rendered: cover.
H7160: A primitive root; to push or gore; used only as denominative from קָ֫רֶן, to shoot out horns; figuratively, rays. In the KJV it is rendered: have horns, shine.
H7161: From קָרַן; a horn (as projecting); by implication, a flask, cornet; by resembl. an elephant's tooth (i.e. ivory), a corner (of the altar), a peak (of a mountain), a ray (of light); figuratively, power. In the KJV it is rendered: X hill, horn.
H7162: (Aramaic) corresponding to קָ֫רֶן; a horn (literally or for sound). In the KJV it is rendered: horn, cornet.
H7163: From קָ֫רֶן and פּוּך; horn of cosmetic; Keren-hap-Puk, one of Job's daughters. In the KJV it is rendered: Keren-happuch.
H7164: A primitive root; properly, to protrude; used only as denominative from קְרָסִים (for alliteration with קָרַע), to hunch, i.e. be hump-backed. In the KJV it is rendered: stoop.
H7165: From קָרַס; a knob or belaying-pin (from its swelling form). In the KJV it is rendered: tache.
H7166: From קָרַס; an ankle (as a protuberance or joint). In the KJV it is rendered: foot.
H7167: A primitive root; to rend, literally or figuratively (revile, paint the eyes, as if enlarging them). In the KJV it is rendered: cut out, rend, X surely, tear.
H7168: From קָרַע; a rag. In the KJV it is rendered: piece, rag.
H7169: A primitive root; to pinch, i.e. (partially) to bite the lips, blink the eyes (as a gesture of malice), or (fully) to squeeze off (a piece of clay in order to mould a vessel from it). In the KJV it is rendered: form, move, wink.
H7170: (Aramaic) corresponding to קֶ֫רֶץ in the sense of a bit (to "eat the morsels of" any one, i.e. chew him up (figuratively) by slander). In the KJV it is rendered: + accuse.
H7171: From קָרַץ; extirpation (as if by constriction). In the KJV it is rendered: destruction.
H7172: From קָרַע; floor (as if a pavement of pieces or tesseroe), of a building or the sea. In the KJV it is rendered: bottom, (X one side of the) floor.
H7173: The same as קַרְקַע; ground-floor; Karka (with the article prefix), a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Karkaa.
H7174: From קוּר; foundation; Karkor, a place East of the Jordan. In the KJV it is rendered: Karkor.
H7175: From an unused root meaning to split off; a slab or plank; by implication, a deck of a ship. In the KJV it is rendered: bench, board.
H7176: From קָרָה in the sense of building; a city. In the KJV it is rendered: city.
H7177: From קָ֫רֶת; city; Kartah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kartah.
H7178: From קָ֫רֶת; city-plot; Kartan, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kartan.
H7179: From קָשַׁשׁ; straw (as dry). In the KJV it is rendered: stubble.
H7180: From an unused root (meaning to be hard); a cucumber (from the difficulty of digestion). In the KJV it is rendered: cucumber.
H7181: A primitive root; to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken. In the KJV it is rendered: attend, (cause to) hear(-ken), give heed, incline, mark (well), regard.
H7182: From קָשַׁב; a hearkening. In the KJV it is rendered: X diligently, hearing, much heed, that regarded.
H7183: Or qashshub; from קָשַׁב; hearkening. In the KJV it is rendered: attent(-ive).
H7184: Or qasvah; from an unused root meaning to be round; a jug (from its shape). In the KJV it is rendered: cover, cup.
H7185: A primitive root; properly, to be dense, i.e. tough or severe (in various applications). In the KJV it is rendered: be cruel, be fiercer, make grievous, be ((ask a), be in, have, seem, would) hard(-en, (labour), -ly, thing), be sore, (be, make) stiff(-en, (-necked)).
H7186: From קָשָׁה; severe (in various applications). In the KJV it is rendered: churlish, cruel, grievous, hard((-hearted), thing), heavy, + impudent, obstinate, prevailed, rough(-ly), sore, sorrowful, stiff((necked)), stubborn, + in trouble.
H7187: (Aramaic) or qshot (Aramaic); corresponding to קֹ֫שֶׁט; fidelity. In the KJV it is rendered: truth.
H7188: A primitive root; to be (causatively, make) unfeeling. In the KJV it is rendered: harden.
H7189: Or qosht; from an unused root meaning to balance; equity (as evenly weighed), i.e. reality. In the KJV it is rendered: truth.
H7190: From קָשָׁה; obstinacy. In the KJV it is rendered: stubbornness.
H7191: From קְשִׁי; hard ground; Kishjon, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Kishion, Keshon.
H7192: From an unused root (probably meaning to weigh out); an ingot (as definitely estimated and stamped for a coin). In the KJV it is rendered: piece of money (silver).
H7193: By reduplication from an unused root meaning to shale off as bark; a scale (of a fish); hence a coat of mail (as composed of or covered with jointed plates of metal). In the KJV it is rendered: mail, scale.
H7194: A primitive root: to tie, physically (gird, confine, compact) or mentally (in love, league). In the KJV it is rendered: bind (up), (make a) conspire(-acy, -ator), join together, knit, stronger, work (treason).
H7195: From קָשַׁר; an (unlawful) alliance. In the KJV it is rendered: confederacy, conspiracy, treason.
H7196: From קָשַׁר; an (ornamental) girdle (for women). In the KJV it is rendered: attire, headband.
H7197: A primitive root; to become sapless through drought; used only as denominative from קָשׁ; to forage for straw, stubble or wood; figuratively, to assemble. In the KJV it is rendered: gather (selves) (together).
H7198: From קָשָׁה in the original sense (of קוֹשׁ) of bending: a bow, for shooting (hence, figuratively, strength) or the iris. In the KJV it is rendered: X arch(-er), + arrow, bow((-man, -shot)).
H7199: Intensive (as denominative) from קָ֫שֶׁת; a bowman. In the KJV it is rendered: X archer.
H7200: A primitive root; to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative). In the KJV it is rendered: advise self, appear, approve, behold, X certainly, consider, discern, (make to) enjoy, have experience, gaze, take heed, X indeed, X joyfully, lo, look (on, one another, one on another, one upon another, out, up, upon), mark, meet, X be near, perceive, present, provide, regard, (have) respect, (fore-, cause to, let) see(-r, -m, one another), shew (self), X sight of others, (e-)spy, stare, X surely, X think, view, visions.
H7201: From רָאָה; a bird of prey (probably the vulture, from its sharp sight). In the KJV it is rendered: glede.
H7202: From רָאָה; seeing, i.e. experiencing. In the KJV it is rendered: see.
H7203: Active participle of רָאָה; a seer (as often rendered); but also (abstractly) a vision. In the KJV it is rendered: vision.
H7204: For רֹאֶה; prophet; Roeh, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Haroeh (including the article).
H7205: From the imperative of רָאָה and בֵּן; see ye a son; Reuben, a son of Jacob. In the KJV it is rendered: Reuben.
H7206: Patronymic from רְאוּבֵן; a Reubenite or descendant of Reuben. In the KJV it is rendered: children of Reuben, Reubenites.
H7207: From רָאָה; sight, i.e. satisfaction. In the KJV it is rendered: behold.
H7208: Feminine passive participle of רָאַם; raised; Reumah, a Syrian woman. In the KJV it is rendered: Reumah.
H7209: From רָאָה; a mirror (as seen). In the KJV it is rendered: looking glass.
H7210: From רָאָה; sight, whether abstractly (vision) or concretely (a spectacle). In the KJV it is rendered: gazingstock, look to, (that) see(-th).
H7211: From רָאָה and יָהּ; Jah has seen; Reajah, the name of three Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Reaia, Reaiah.
H7212: From רָאָה; sight. In the KJV it is rendered: beholding.
H7213: A primitive root; to rise. In the KJV it is rendered: be lifted up.
H7214: Or rieym; or reym; or rem; from רָאַם; a wild bull (from its conspicuousness). In the KJV it is rendered: unicorn.
H7215: From רָאַם; something high in value, i.e. perhaps coral. In the KJV it is rendered: coral.
H7216: Or Ramoth; plural of רָאמוֹת; heights; Ramoth, the name of two places in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Ramoth.
H7217: (Aramaic) corresponding to רֹאשׁ; the head; figuratively, the sum. In the KJV it is rendered: chief, head, sum.
H7218: From an unused root apparently meaning to shake; the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.). In the KJV it is rendered: band, beginning, captain, chapiter, chief(-est place, man, things), company, end, X every (man), excellent, first, forefront, ((be-))head, height, (on) high(-est part, (priest)), X lead, X poor, principal, ruler, sum, top.
H7219: Or rowsh (Deut. 32:32); apparently the same as רֹאשׁ; a poisonous plant, probably the poppy (from its conspicuous head); generally poison (even of serpents). In the KJV it is rendered: gall, hemlock, poison, venom.
H7220: Probably the same as רֹאשׁ; Rosh, the name of an Israelite and of a foreign nation. In the KJV it is rendered: Rosh.
H7221: From the same as רֹאשׁ; a beginning. In the KJV it is rendered: beginning.
H7222: Feminine of רֹאשׁ; the head. In the KJV it is rendered: head(-stone).
H7223: Or riishon; from רִאשֹׁת; first, in place, time or rank (as adjective or noun). In the KJV it is rendered: ancestor, (that were) before(-time), beginning, eldest, first, fore(-father) (-most), former (thing), of old time, past.
H7224: From רִאשׁוֹן; first. In the KJV it is rendered: first.
H7225: From the same as רֹאשׁ; the first, in place, time, order or rank (specifically, a firstfruit). In the KJV it is rendered: beginning, chief(-est), first(-fruits, part, time), principal thing.
H7226: From רֹאשׁ; a pillow (being for the head). In the KJV it is rendered: bolster.
H7227: By contracted from רָבַב; abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality). In the KJV it is rendered: (in) abound(-undance, -ant, -antly), captain, elder, enough, exceedingly, full, great(-ly, man, one), increase, long (enough, (time)), (do, have) many(-ifold, things, a time), ((ship-))master, mighty, more, (too, very) much, multiply(-tude), officer, often(-times), plenteous, populous, prince, process (of time), suffice(-lent).
H7228: By contraction from רָבַב; an archer (or perhaps the same as רָב). In the KJV it is rendered: archer.
H7229: (Aramaic) corresponding to רָב. In the KJV it is rendered: captain, chief, great, lord, master, stout.
H7230: From רָבַב; abundance (in any respect). In the KJV it is rendered: abundance(- antly), all, X common (sort), excellent, great(-ly, -ness, number), huge, be increased, long, many, more in number, most, much, multitude, plenty(-ifully), X very (age).
H7231: A primitive root; properly, to cast together (compare רְבִיבִים), i.e. increase, especially in number; also (as denominative from רְבָבָה) to multiply by the myriad. In the KJV it is rendered: increase, be many(-ifold), be more, multiply, ten thousands.
H7232: A primitive root (rather identical with רָבַב through the idea of projection); to shoot an arrow. In the KJV it is rendered: shoot.
H7233: From רָבַב; abundance (in number), i.e. (specifically) a myriad (whether definite or indefinite). In the KJV it is rendered: many, million, X multiply, ten thousand.
H7234: A primitive root; to spread. In the KJV it is rendered: deck.
H7235: A primitive root; to increase (in whatever respect). In the KJV it is rendered: (bring in) abundance (X -antly), + archer (by mistake for rabab), be in authority, bring up, X continue, enlarge, excel, exceeding(-ly), be full of, (be, make) great(-er, -ly, X -ness), grow up, heap, increase, be long, (be, give, have, make, use) many (a time), (any, be, give, give the, have) more (in number), (ask, be, be so, gather, over, take, yield) much (greater, more), (make to) multiply, nourish, plenty(-eous), X process (of time), sore, store, thoroughly, very.
H7236: (Aramaic) corresponding to רָבָה. In the KJV it is rendered: make a great man, grow.
H7237: Feminine of רָב; great; Rabbah, the name of two places in Palestine, East and West. In the KJV it is rendered: Rabbah, Rabbath.
H7238: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to רָבָה; increase (of dignity). In the KJV it is rendered: greatness, majesty.
H7239: From רָבַב; or ribbow from רָבַב; a myriad, i.e. indefinitely, large number. In the KJV it is rendered: great things, ten ((eight)-een, (for)-ty, + sixscore, + threescore, X twenty, (twen)-ty) thousand.
H7240: (Aramaic) corresponding to רִבּוֹ. In the KJV it is rendered: X ten thousand times ten thousand.
H7241: From רָבַב; a rain (as an accumulation of drops). In the KJV it is rendered: shower.
H7242: From רָבַד; a collar (as spread around the neck). In the KJV it is rendered: chain.
H7243: Or rbiiy; from רָבַע; fourth; also (fractionally) a fourth. In the KJV it is rendered: foursquare, fourth (part).
H7245: From רָבַב; multitude; Rabbith, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Rabbith.
H7246: A primitive root; to soak (bread in oil). In the KJV it is rendered: baken, (that which is) fried.
H7247: From an unused root meaning to be fruitful; fertile; Riblah, a place in Syria. In the KJV it is rendered: Riblah.
H7248: From רָב and a foreign word for a Magian; chief Magian; Rab-Mag, a Bab. official. In the KJV it is rendered: Rab-mag.
H7249: From רָב and a foreign word for a eunuch; chief chamberlain; Rab-Saris, a Babylonian official. In the KJV it is rendered: Rab-saris.
H7250: A primitive root; to squat or lie out flat, i.e. (specifically) in copulation. In the KJV it is rendered: let gender, lie down.
H7251: A primitive root (rather identical with רָבַע through the idea of sprawling "at all fours" (or possibly the reverse is the order of deriv.); compare אַרְבַּע); properly, to be four (sided); used only as denominative of רֶ֫בַע; to be quadrate. In the KJV it is rendered: (four-)square(-d).
H7252: From רָבַע; prostration (for sleep). In the KJV it is rendered: lying down.
H7253: From רָבַע; a fourth (part or side). In the KJV it is rendered: fourth part, side, square.
H7254: The same as רֶ֫בַע; Reba, a Midianite. In the KJV it is rendered: Reba.
H7256: From רָבַע; a descendant of the fourth generation, i.e. great great grandchild. In the KJV it is rendered: fourth.
H7257: A primitive root; to crouch (on all four legs folded, like a recumbent animal); be implication, to recline, repose, brood, lurk, imbed. In the KJV it is rendered: crouch (down), fall down, make a fold, lay, (cause to, make to) lie (down), make to rest, sit.
H7258: From רָבַץ; a couch or place of repose. In the KJV it is rendered: where each lay, lie down in, resting place.
H7259: From an unused root probably meaning to clog by tying up the fetlock; fettering (by beauty); Ribkah, the wife of Isaac. In the KJV it is rendered: Rebekah.
H7260: (Aramaic) from רַב; huge (in size); domineering (in character). In the KJV it is rendered: (very) great (things).
H7261: (Aramaic) from רַבְרְבִין; a magnate. In the KJV it is rendered: lord, prince.
H7262: From רָב and שָׁקָה; chief butler; Rabshakeh, a Bab. official. In the KJV it is rendered: Rabshakeh.
H7263: From an unused root meaning to pile together; a lump of clay. In the KJV it is rendered: clod.
H7264: A primitive root; to quiver (with any violent emotion, especially anger or fear). In the KJV it is rendered: be afraid, stand in awe, disquiet, fall out, fret, move, provoke, quake, rage, shake, tremble, trouble, be wroth.
H7265: (Aramaic) corresponding to רָגַז. In the KJV it is rendered: provoke unto wrath.
H7266: (Aramaic) from רְגַז; violent anger. In the KJV it is rendered: rage.
H7267: From רָגַז; commotion, restlessness (of a horse), crash (of thunder), disquiet, anger. In the KJV it is rendered: fear, noise, rage, trouble(-ing), wrath.
H7268: Intensive from רָגַז; timid. In the KJV it is rendered: trembling.
H7269: Feminine of רֹ֫גֶז; trepidation. In the KJV it is rendered: trembling.
H7270: A primitive root; to walk along; but only in specifically, applications, to reconnoiter, to be a tale-bearer (i.e. slander); also (as denominative from רָ֫גֶל) to lead about. In the KJV it is rendered: backbite, search, slander, (e-)spy (out), teach to go, view.
H7271: (Aramaic) corresponding to רָ֫גֶל. In the KJV it is rendered: foot.
H7272: From רָגַל; a foot (as used in walking); by implication, a step; by euphem. the pudenda. In the KJV it is rendered: X be able to endure, X according as, X after, X coming, X follow, ((broken-))foot((-ed, -stool)), X great toe, X haunt, X journey, leg, + piss, + possession, time.
H7273: From רָ֫גֶל; a footman (soldier). In the KJV it is rendered: (on) foot(- man).
H7274: Plural of active participle of רָגַל; fullers (as tramping the cloth in washing); Rogelim, a place East of the Jordan. In the KJV it is rendered: Rogelim.
H7275: A primitive root (compare רְגָבִים, ר֫וּעַ, רָקַם); to cast together (stones), i.e. to lapidate. In the KJV it is rendered: X certainly, stone.
H7276: From רָגַם; stoneheap; Regem, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Regem.
H7277: Feminine of the same as רֶ֫גֶם; a pile (of stones), i.e. (figuratively) a throng. In the KJV it is rendered: council.
H7278: From רֶ֫גֶם and מֶ֫לֶך; king's heap; Regem-Melek, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Regem-melech.
H7279: A primitive root; to grumble, i.e. rebel. In the KJV it is rendered: murmur.
H7280: A primitive root; properly, to toss violently and suddenly (the sea with waves, the skin with boils); figuratively (in a favorable manner) to settle, i.e. quiet; specifically, to wink (from the motion of the eye-lids). In the KJV it is rendered: break, divide, find ease, be a moment, (cause, give, make to) rest, make suddenly.
H7281: From רָגַע. a wink (of the eyes), i.e. a very short space of time. In the KJV it is rendered: instant, moment, space, suddenly.
H7282: From רָגַע; restful, i.e. peaceable. In the KJV it is rendered: that are quiet.
H7283: A primitive root; to be tumultuous. In the KJV it is rendered: rage.
H7284: (Aramaic) corresponding to רָגַשׁ; to gather tumultuously. In the KJV it is rendered: assemble (together).
H7285: Or (feminine) rigshah; from רָגַשׁ; a tumultuous crowd. In the KJV it is rendered: company, insurrection.
H7286: A primitive root; to tread in pieces, i.e. (figuratively) to conquer, or (specifically) to overlay. In the KJV it is rendered: spend, spread, subdue.
H7287: A primitive root; to tread down, i.e. subjugate; specifically, to crumble off. In the KJV it is rendered: (come to, make to) have dominion, prevail against, reign, (bear, make to) rule,(-r, over), take.
H7288: Intensive from רָדָה; domineering; Raddai, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Raddai.
H7289: From רָדַד in the sense of spreading; a veil (as expanded). In the KJV it is rendered: vail, veil.
H7290: A primitive root; to stun, i.e. stupefy (with sleep or death). In the KJV it is rendered: (be fast a-, be in a deep, cast into a dead, that) sleep(-er, -eth).
H7291: A primitive root; to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively (of time) gone by). In the KJV it is rendered: chase, put to flight, follow (after, on), hunt, (be under) persecute(-ion, -or), pursue(-r).
H7292: A primitive root; to urge severely, i.e. (figuratively) importune, embolden, capture, act insolently. In the KJV it is rendered: overcome, behave self proudly, make sure, strengthen.
H7293: From רָהַב, bluster(-er). In the KJV it is rendered: proud, strength.
H7294: The same as רָ֫הַב; Rahab (i.e. boaster), an epithet of Egypt. In the KJV it is rendered: Rahab.
H7295: From רָהַב; insolent. In the KJV it is rendered: proud.
H7296: From רָהַב; pride. In the KJV it is rendered: strength.
H7297: A primitive root; to fear. In the KJV it is rendered: be afraid.
H7298: From an unused root apparently meaning to hollow out; a channel or watering-box; by resemblance a ringlet of hair (as forming parallel lines). In the KJV it is rendered: gallery, gutter, trough.
H7299: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to רָאָה; aspect. In the KJV it is rendered: form.
H7300: A primitive root; to tramp about, i.e. ramble (free or disconsolate). In the KJV it is rendered: have the dominion, be lord, mourn, rule.
H7301: A primitive root; to slake the thirst (occasionally of other appetites). In the KJV it is rendered: bathe, make drunk, (take the) fill, satiate, (abundantly) satisfy, soak, water (abundantly).
