H7302: From רָוָה; sated (with drink). In the KJV it is rendered: drunkenness, watered.
H7303: From an unused root probably meaning to cry out; outcry; Rohagah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Rohgah.
H7304: A primitive root (identical with ר֫וּחַ); properly, to breathe freely, i.e. revive; by implication, to have ample room. In the KJV it is rendered: be refreshed, large.
H7305: From רָוַח; room, literally (an interval) or figuratively (deliverance). In the KJV it is rendered: enlargement, space.
H7306: A primitive root; properly, to blow, i.e. breathe; only (literally) to smell or (by implication, perceive (figuratively, to anticipate, enjoy). In the KJV it is rendered: accept, smell, X touch, make of quick understanding.
H7307: From ר֫וּחַ; wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions). In the KJV it is rendered: air, anger, blast, breath, X cool, courage, mind, X quarter, X side, spirit((-ual)), tempest, X vain, ((whirl-))wind(-y).
H7308: (Aramaic) corresponding to ר֫וּחַ. In the KJV it is rendered: mind, spirit, wind.
H7309: Feminine of רֶ֫וַח; relief. In the KJV it is rendered: breathing, respite.
H7310: From רָוָה; satisfaction. In the KJV it is rendered: runneth over, wealthy.
H7311: A primitive root; to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: bring up, exalt (self), extol, give, go up, haughty, heave (up), (be, lift up on, make on, set up on, too) high(-er, one), hold up, levy, lift(-er) up, (be) lofty, (X a-)loud, mount up, offer (up), + presumptuously, (be) promote(-ion), proud, set up, tall(-er), take (away, off, up), breed worms.
H7312: Or rum; from רוּם; (literally) elevation or (figuratively) elation. In the KJV it is rendered: haughtiness, height, X high.
H7313: (Aramaic) corresponding to רוּם; (figuratively only). In the KJV it is rendered: extol, lift up (self), set up.
H7314: (Aramaic) from רוּם; (literally) altitude. In the KJV it is rendered: height.
H7315: From רוּם; elevation, i.e. (adverbially) aloft. In the KJV it is rendered: on high.
H7316: From רוּם; height; Rumah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Rumah.
H7317: Feminine of רוֹם; elation, i.e. (adverbially) proudly. In the KJV it is rendered: haughtily.
H7318: From רָמַם; exaltation, i.e. (figuratively and specifically) praise. In the KJV it is rendered: be extolled.
H7319: Feminine active participle of רָמַם; exaltation, i.e. praise. In the KJV it is rendered: high.
H7320: (or Romam from רוּם and עֵ֫זֶר; I have raised up a help; Romamti-Ezer, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Romamti- ezer.
H7321: A primitive root; to mar (especially by breaking); figuratively, to split the ears (with sound), i.e. shout (for alarm or joy). In the KJV it is rendered: blow an alarm, cry (alarm, aloud, out), destroy, make a joyful noise, smart, shout (for joy), sound an alarm, triumph.
H7322: A primitive root; properly, to triturate (in a mortar), i.e. (figuratively) to agitate (by concussion). In the KJV it is rendered: tremble.
H7323: A primitive root; to run (for whatever reason, especially to rush). In the KJV it is rendered: break down, divide speedily, footman, guard, bring hastily, (make) run (away, through), post.
H7324: A primitive root; to pour out (literally or figuratively), i.e. empty. In the KJV it is rendered: X arm, cast out, draw (out), (make) empty, pour forth (out).
H7325: A primitive root; to slaver (with spittle), i.e. (by analogy) to emit a fluid (ulcerous or natural). In the KJV it is rendered: run.
H7326: A primitive root; to be destitute. In the KJV it is rendered: lack, needy, (make self) poor (man).
H7327: Probably for רְעוּת; friend; Ruth, a Moabitess. In the KJV it is rendered: Ruth.
H7328: (Aramaic) from an unused root probably meaning to attenuate, i.e. (figuratively) hide; a mystery. In the KJV it is rendered: secret.
H7329: A primitive root; to emaciate, i.e. make (become) thin (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: famish, wax lean.
H7330: From רָזָה; thin. In the KJV it is rendered: lean.
H7331: From רָזַן; prince; Rezon, a Syrian. In the KJV it is rendered: Rezon.
H7332: From רָזָה; thinness. In the KJV it is rendered: leanness, X scant.
H7333: From רָזַן; a dignitary. In the KJV it is rendered: prince.
H7334: From רָזָה; thinness. In the KJV it is rendered: leanness.
H7335: A primitive root; to twinkle the eye (in mockery): wink.
H7336: A primitive root; probably to be heavy, i.e. (figuratively) honorable. In the KJV it is rendered: prince, ruler.
H7337: A primitive root; to broaden (intransitive or transitive, literal or figurative). In the KJV it is rendered: be an en-(make) large(-ing), make room, make (open) wide.
H7338: From רָחַב; a width. In the KJV it is rendered: breadth, broad place.
H7339: Or rchowb; from רָחַב; a width, i.e. (concretely) avenue or area. In the KJV it is rendered: broad place (way), street.
H7340: Or Rchowb; the same as רְחוֹב; Rechob, the name of a place in Syria, also of a Syrian and an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Rehob.
H7341: From רָחַב; width (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: breadth, broad, largeness, thickness, wideness.
H7342: From רָחַב; roomy, in any (or every) direction, literally or figuratively. In the KJV it is rendered: broad, large, at liberty, proud, wide.
H7343: The same as רָחָב; proud; Rachab, a Canaanitess. In the KJV it is rendered: Rahab.
H7344: Or Rchoboth; plural of רְחוֹב; streets; Rechoboth, a place in Assyria and one in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Rehoboth.
H7345: Or Rchabyahuw; from רָחַב and יָהּ; Jah has enlarged; Rechabjah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Rehabiah.
H7346: From רָחַב and עָם; a people has enlarged; Rechabam, an Israelite king. In the KJV it is rendered: Rehoboam.
H7347: From an unused root meaning to pulverize; a mill-stone. In the KJV it is rendered: mill (stone).
H7348: A form of רַחוּם; Rechum, the name of a Persian and of three Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Rehum.
H7349: From רָחַם; compassionate. In the KJV it is rendered: full of compassion, merciful.
H7350: Or rachoq; from רָחַק; remote, literally or figuratively, of place or time; specifically, precious; often used adverbially (with preposition). In the KJV it is rendered: (a-)far (abroad, off), long ago, of old, space, great while to come.
H7351: From the same as רְהָטִים; a panel (as resembling a trough). In the KJV it is rendered: rafter.
H7352: (Aramaic) corresponding to רָחוֹק. In the KJV it is rendered: far.
H7353: From an unused root meaning to journey; a ewe (the females being the predominant element of a flock) (as a good traveller). In the KJV it is rendered: ewe, sheep.
H7354: The same as רָחֵל; Rachel, a wife of Jacob. In the KJV it is rendered: Rachel.
H7355: A primitive root; to fondle; by implication, to love, especially to compassionate. In the KJV it is rendered: have compassion (on, upon), love, (find, have, obtain, shew) mercy(-iful, on, upon), (have) pity, Ruhamah, X surely.
H7356: From רָחַם; compassion (in the plural); by extension, the womb (as cherishing the fetus); by implication, a maiden. In the KJV it is rendered: bowels, compassion, damsel, tender love, (great, tender) mercy, pity, womb.
H7357: The same as רָ֫חַם; pity; Racham, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Raham.
H7358: From רָחַם; the womb (compare רָ֫חַם). In the KJV it is rendered: matrix, womb.
H7359: (Aramaic) corresponding to רָ֫חַם; (plural) pity. In the KJV it is rendered: mercy.
H7360: Or (feminine) rachamah; from רָחַם; a kind of vulture (supposed to be tender towards its young). In the KJV it is rendered: gier- eagle.
H7361: Feminine of רָ֫חַם; a maiden. In the KJV it is rendered: damsel.
H7362: From רָחַם; compassionate. In the KJV it is rendered: pitiful.
H7363: A primitive root; to brood; by implication, to be relaxed. In the KJV it is rendered: flutter, move, shake.
H7364: A primitive root; to lave (the whole or a part of a thing). In the KJV it is rendered: bathe (self), wash (self).
H7365: (Aramaic) corresponding to רָחַץ (probably through the accessory idea of ministering as a servant at the bath); to attend upon. In the KJV it is rendered: trust.
H7366: From רָחַץ; a bath. In the KJV it is rendered: wash(-pot).
H7367: Feminine of רַ֫חַץ; a bathing place. In the KJV it is rendered: washing.
H7368: A primitive root; to widen (in any direction), i.e. (intransitively) recede or (transitively) remove (literally or figuratively, of place or relation). In the KJV it is rendered: (a-, be, cast, drive, get, go, keep (self), put, remove, be too, (wander), withdraw) far (away, off), loose, X refrain, very, (be) a good way (off).
H7369: From רָחַק; remote. In the KJV it is rendered: that are far.
H7370: A primitive root; to gush. In the KJV it is rendered: indite.
H7371: From ר֫וּחַ; a winnowing-fork (as blowing the chaff away). In the KJV it is rendered: shovel.
H7372: A primitive root; to be moist. In the KJV it is rendered: be wet.
H7373: From רָטַב; moist (with sap). In the KJV it is rendered: green.
H7374: From an unused root meaning to tremble; terror. In the KJV it is rendered: fear.
H7375: A root compounded from רָטֹב and טָפַשׁ; to be rejuvenated. In the KJV it is rendered: be fresh.
H7376: A primitive root; to dash down. In the KJV it is rendered: dash (in pieces).
H7377: From רָוָה; irrigation, i.e. a shower. In the KJV it is rendered: watering.
H7378: Or ruwb; a primitive root; properly, to toss, i.e. grapple; mostly figuratively, to wrangle, i.e. hold a controversy; (by implication) to defend. In the KJV it is rendered: adversary, chide, complain, contend, debate, X ever, X lay wait, plead, rebuke, strive, X thoroughly.
H7379: Or rib; from רִיב; a contest (personal or legal). In the KJV it is rendered: + adversary, cause, chiding, contend(-tion), controversy, multitude (from the margin), pleading, strife, strive(-ing), suit.
H7380: From רִיב; contentious; Ribai, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Ribai.
H7381: From ר֫וּחַ; odor (as if blown). In the KJV it is rendered: savour, scent, smell.
H7382: (Aramaic) corresponding to רֵ֫יחַ. In the KJV it is rendered: smell.
H7383: Or riphah; from רוּף; (only plural), grits (as pounded). In the KJV it is rendered: ground corn, wheat.
H7384: Or (probably by orthographical error) Diyphath; of foreign origin; Riphath, a grandson of Japheth and his descendants. In the KJV it is rendered: Riphath.
H7385: From רִיק; emptiness; figuratively, a worthless thing; adverbially, in vain. In the KJV it is rendered: empty, to no purpose, (in) vain (thing), vanity.
H7386: Or (shorter) req; from רִיק; empty; figuratively, worthless. In the KJV it is rendered: emptied(-ty), vain (fellow, man).
H7387: From רֵק; emptily; figuratively (objective) ineffectually, (subjective) undeservedly. In the KJV it is rendered: without cause, empty, in vain, void.
H7388: From רִיר; saliva; by resemblance, broth. In the KJV it is rendered: spittle, white (of an egg).
H7389: Or resh; or riysh; from רוּשׁ; poverty. In the KJV it is rendered: poverty.
H7390: From רָכַך; tender (literally or figuratively); by implication, weak. In the KJV it is rendered: faint((-hearted), soft, tender ((-hearted), one), weak.
H7391: From רָכַך; softness (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: tenderness.
H7392: A primitive root; to ride (on an animal or in a vehicle); causatively, to place upon (for riding or generally), to despatch. In the KJV it is rendered: bring (on (horse-)back), carry, get (oneself) up, on (horse-)back, put, (cause to, make to) ride (in a chariot, on, -r), set.
H7393: From רָכַב; a vehicle; by implication, a team; by extension, cavalry; by analogy a rider, i.e. the upper millstone. In the KJV it is rendered: chariot, (upper) millstone, multitude (from the margin), wagon.
H7394: From רָכַב; rider; Rekab, the name of two Arabs and of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Rechab.
H7395: From רָכַב; a charioteer. In the KJV it is rendered: chariot man, driver of a chariot, horseman.
H7396: Feminine of רֶ֫כֶב; a chariot (collectively). In the KJV it is rendered: chariots.
H7397: Probably feminine from רָכַך; softness; Rekah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Rechah.
H7398: From passive participle of רָכַב; a vehicle (as ridden on). In the KJV it is rendered: chariot.
H7399: Or rkush; from passive participle of רָכַשׁ; property (as gathered). In the KJV it is rendered: good, riches, substance.
H7400: From רָכַל a scandal-monger (as travelling about). In the KJV it is rendered: slander, carry tales, talebearer.
H7401: A primitive root; to soften (intransitively or transitively), used figuratively. In the KJV it is rendered: (be) faint((-hearted)), mollify, (be, make) soft(-er), be tender.
H7402: A primitive root; to travel for trading. In the KJV it is rendered: (spice) merchant.
H7403: From רָכַל; merchant; Rakal, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Rachal.
H7404: Feminine passive participle of רָכַל; trade (as peddled). In the KJV it is rendered: merchandise, traffic.
H7405: A primitive root; to tie. In the KJV it is rendered: bind.
H7406: From רָכַס; a mountain ridge (as of tied summits). In the KJV it is rendered: rough place.
H7407: From רָכַס; a snare (as of tied meshes). In the KJV it is rendered: pride.
H7408: A primitive root; to lay up, i.e. collect. In the KJV it is rendered: gather, get.
H7409: From רָכַשׁ; a relay of animals on a post-route (as stored up for that purpose); by implication, a courser. In the KJV it is rendered: dromedary, mule, swift beast.
H7410: Active participle of רוּם; high; Ram, the name of an Arabian and of an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Ram.
H7411: A primitive root; to hurl; specifically, to shoot; figuratively, to delude or betray (as if causing to fall). In the KJV it is rendered: beguile, betray, (bow-)man, carry, deceive, throw.
H7412: (Aramaic) corresponding to רָמָה; to throw, set, (figuratively) assess. In the KJV it is rendered: cast (down), impose.
H7413: Feminine active participle of רוּם; a height (as a seat of idolatry). In the KJV it is rendered: high place.
H7414: The same as רָמָה; Ramah, the name of four places in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Ramah.
H7415: From רָמַם in the sense of breading (compare רוּם); a maggot (as rapidly bred), literally or figuratively. In the KJV it is rendered: worm.
H7416: Or rimmon; from רָמַם; a pomegranate, the tree (from its upright growth) or the fruit (also an artificial ornament). In the KJV it is rendered: pomegranate.
H7417: Or (shorter) Rimmon; or Rimmownow (1 Chronicles 6:62 (77)); the same as רִמּוֹן; Rimmon, the name of a Syrian deity, also of five places in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Remmon, Rimmon.
H7418: Or Ramath Negeb; from the plural or construct form of רָמָה and נֶ֫גֶב; heights (or height) of the South; Ramoth-Negeb or Ramath-Negeb, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: south Ramoth, Ramath of the south.
H7419: From רוּם; a heap (of carcases). In the KJV it is rendered: height.
H7420: From an unused root meaning to hurl; a lance (as thrown); especially the iron point. In the KJV it is rendered: buckler, javelin, lancet, spear.
H7421: For אֲרַמִּי; a Ramite, i.e. Aramaean. In the KJV it is rendered: Syrian.
H7422: From רוּם and יָהּ; Jah has raised; Ramjah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Ramiah.
H7423: From רָמָה; remissness, treachery. In the KJV it is rendered: deceit(- ful, -fully), false, guile, idle, slack, slothful.
H7424: Of foreign origin; a brood mare. In the KJV it is rendered: dromedary.
H7425: From an unused root and יָהּ (perhaps meaning to deck); Jah has bedecked; Remaljah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Remaliah.
H7426: A primitive root; to rise (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: exalt, get (oneself) up, lift up (self), mount up.
H7427: From the active participle of רָמַם; exaltation. In the KJV it is rendered: lifting up of self.
H7428: From רִמּוֹן and פָּ֫רֶץ; pomegranate of the breach; Rimmon-Perets, a place in the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Rimmon-parez.
H7429: A primitive root; to tread upon (as a potter, in walking or abusively). In the KJV it is rendered: oppressor, stamp upon, trample (under feet), tread (down, upon).
H7430: A primitive root; properly, to glide swiftly, i.e. to crawl or move with short steps; by analogy to swarm. In the KJV it is rendered: creep, move.
H7431: From רָמַשׂ; a reptile or any other rapidly moving animal. In the KJV it is rendered: that creepeth, creeping (moving) thing.
H7432: From רָמָה; height; Remeth, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Remeth.
H7433: Or Ramoth Giliad (2 Chronicles 22:5); from the plural of רָמָה and גִּלְעָד; heights of Gilad; Ramoth-Gilad, a place East of the Jordan. In the KJV it is rendered: Ramoth-gilead, Ramoth in Gilead.
H7434: From רָמָה and מִצְפֶּה with the article interpolated; height of the watch-tower; Ramath-ham- Mitspeh, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Ramath-mizpeh.
H7435: Patronymic of רָמָה; a Ramathite or inhabitant of Ramah. In the KJV it is rendered: Ramathite.
H7436: From the dual of רָמָה and the plural of the active participle of צָפָה; double height of watchers; Ramathajim-Tsophim, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Ramathaimzophim.
H7437: From רָמָה and לֶ֫חִי; height of a jaw-bone; Ramath-Lechi, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Ramath-lehi.
H7438: From רָנַן; a shout (of deliverance). In the KJV it is rendered: song.
H7439: A primitive root; to whiz. In the KJV it is rendered: rattle.
H7440: From רָנַן; properly, a creaking (or shrill sound), i.e. shout (of joy or grief). In the KJV it is rendered: cry, gladness, joy, proclamation, rejoicing, shouting, sing(-ing), triumph.
H7441: The same as רִנָּה; Rinnah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Rinnah.
H7442: A primitive root; properly, to creak (or emit a stridulous sound), i.e. to shout (usually for joy). In the KJV it is rendered: aloud for joy, cry out, be joyful (greatly, make to) rejoice, (cause to) shout (for joy), (cause to) sing (aloud, for joy, out), triumph.
H7443: From רָנַן; an ostrich (from its wail). In the KJV it is rendered: X goodly.
H7444: Intensive from רָנַן; shouting (for joy). In the KJV it is rendered: singing.
H7445: From רָנַן; a shout (for joy). In the KJV it is rendered: joyful (voice), singing, triumphing.
H7446: From רָסַס; a ruin (as dripping to pieces); Rissah, a place in the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Rissah.
H7447: From רָסַס; properly, dripping to pieces, i.e. a ruin; also a dew-drop. In the KJV it is rendered: breach, drop.
H7448: From an unused root meaning to curb; a halter (as restraining); by implication, the jaw. In the KJV it is rendered: bridle.
H7449: The same as רֶ֫סֶן; Resen, a place in Assyrian. In the KJV it is rendered: Resen.
H7450: A primitive root; to comminute; used only as denominative from רְסִיסִים, to moisten (with drops). In the KJV it is rendered: temper.
H7451: From רָעַע; bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral). In the KJV it is rendered: adversity, affliction, bad, calamity, + displease(-ure), distress, evil((- favouredness), man, thing), + exceedingly, X great, grief(-vous), harm, heavy, hurt(-ful), ill (favoured), + mark, mischief(-vous), misery, naught(-ty), noisome, + not please, sad(-ly), sore, sorrow, trouble, vex, wicked(-ly, -ness, one), worse(-st), wretchedness, wrong.
H7452: From ר֫וּעַ; a crash (of thunder), noise (of war), shout (of joy). In the KJV it is rendered: X aloud, noise, shouted.
H7453: Or reya2; from רָעָה; an associate (more or less close). In the KJV it is rendered: brother, companion, fellow, friend, husband, lover, neighbour, X (an-)other.
H7454: From רָעָה; a thought (as association of ideas). In the KJV it is rendered: thought.
H7455: From רָעַע; badness (as marring), physically or morally. In the KJV it is rendered: X be so bad, badness, (X be so) evil, naughtiness, sadness, sorrow, wickedness.
H7456: A primitive root; to hunger. In the KJV it is rendered: (suffer to) famish, (be, have, suffer, suffer to) hunger(-ry).
H7457: From רָעֵב; hungry (more or less intensely). In the KJV it is rendered: hunger bitten, hungry.
H7458: From רָעֵב; hunger (more or less extensive). In the KJV it is rendered: dearth, famine, + famished, hunger.
H7459: From רָעֵב; famine. In the KJV it is rendered: famine.
H7460: A primitive root: to shudder (more or less violently). In the KJV it is rendered: tremble.
H7461: Or (feminine) radah; from רָעַד; a shudder. In the KJV it is rendered: trembling.
H7462: A primitive root; to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension, to associate with (as a friend). In the KJV it is rendered: X break, companion, keep company with, devour, eat up, evil entreat, feed, use as a friend, make friendship with, herdman, keep (sheep)(-er), pastor, + shearing house, shepherd, wander, waste.
H7463: From רָעָה; a (male) companion. In the KJV it is rendered: friend.
H7464: Feminine of רֵ֫עַ; a female associate. In the KJV it is rendered: companion, fellow.
H7465: For רֹ֫עַ; breakage. In the KJV it is rendered: broken, utterly.
H7466: For רֶ֫עִי in the sense of רֵ֫עַ; friend; Reu, a postdiluvian patriarch. In the KJV it is rendered: Reu.
H7467: From the same as רְעוּ and אֵל; friend of God; Reuel, the name of Moses' father-in-law, also of an Edomite and an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Raguel, Reuel.
H7468: From רָעָה in the sense of רֵ֫עַ; a female associate; generally an additional one. In the KJV it is rendered: + another, mate, neighbour.
H7469: Probably from רָעָה; a feeding upon, i.e. grasping after. In the KJV it is rendered: vexation.
H7470: (Aramaic) corresponding to רְעוּת; desire. In the KJV it is rendered: pleasure, will.
H7471: From רָעָה; pasture. In the KJV it is rendered: pasture.
H7472: From רֵ֫עַ; social; Rei, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Rei.
H7473: From active participle of רָעָה; pastoral; as noun, a shepherd. In the KJV it is rendered: shipherd.
H7474: Feminine of רֵ֫עַ; a female associate. In the KJV it is rendered: fellow, love.
H7475: From רָעָה in the sense of רְעוּת; desire. In the KJV it is rendered: vexation.
H7476: (Aramaic) corresponding to רַעְיוֹן; a grasp. i.e. (figuratively) mental conception. In the KJV it is rendered: cogitation, thought.
H7477: A primitive root; to reel, i.e. (figuratively) to brandish. In the KJV it is rendered: terribly shake.
H7478: From רָעַל; a reeling (from intoxication). In the KJV it is rendered: trembling.
H7479: Feminine of רַ֫עַל; a long veil (as fluttering). In the KJV it is rendered: muffler.
H7480: From רָעַל and יָהּ; made to tremble (i.e. fearful) of Jah; Reelajah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Reeliah.
H7481: A primitive root; to tumble, i.e. be violently agitated; specifically, to crash (of thunder); figuratively, to irritate (with anger). In the KJV it is rendered: make to fret, roar, thunder, trouble.
H7482: From רָעַם; a peal of thunder. In the KJV it is rendered: thunder.
H7483: Feminine of רַ֫עַם; the mane of a horse (as quivering in the wind). In the KJV it is rendered: thunder.
H7484: The same as רַעְמָה; Ramah, the name of a grandson of Ham, and of a place (perhaps founded by him). In the KJV it is rendered: Raamah.
H7485: From רָעַם and יָהּ; Jah has shaken; Raamjah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Raamiah.
H7486: Or Raamcec; of Egyptian origin; Rameses or Raamses, a place in Egypt. In the KJV it is rendered: Raamses, Rameses.
H7487: (Aramaic) corresponding to רַעֲנָן; green, i.e. (figuratively) prosperous; --flourishing.
H7488: From an unused root meaning to be green; verdant; by analogy, new; figuratively, prosperous. In the KJV it is rendered: green, flourishing.
H7489: A primitive root; properly, to spoil (literally, by breaking to pieces); figuratively, to make (or be) good for nothing, i.e. bad (physically, socially or morally). In the KJV it is rendered: afflict, associate selves (by mistake for ra`ah), break (down, in pieces), + displease, (be, bring, do) evil (doer, entreat, man), show self friendly (by mistake for ra`ah), do harm, (do) hurt, (behave self, deal) ill, X indeed, do mischief, punish, still, vex, (do) wicked (doer, -ly), be (deal, do) worse.
H7490: (Aramaic) corresponding to רָעַע. In the KJV it is rendered: break, bruise.
H7491: A primitive root; to drip. In the KJV it is rendered: distil, drop (down).
H7492: A primitive root; to break in pieces; figuratively, harass. In the KJV it is rendered: dash in pieces, vex.
H7493: A primitive root; to undulate (as the earth, the sky, etc.; also a field of grain), partic. through fear; specifically, to spring (as a locust). In the KJV it is rendered: make afraid, (re-)move, quake, (make to) shake, (make to) tremble.
H7494: From רָעַשׁ; vibration, bounding, uproar. In the KJV it is rendered: commotion, confused noise, earthquake, fierceness, quaking, rattling, rushing, shaking.
H7495: Or raphah; a primitive root; properly, to mend (by stitching), i.e. (figuratively) to cure. In the KJV it is rendered: cure, (cause to) heal, physician, repair, X thoroughly, make whole.
H7496: From רָפָא in the sense of רָפָה; properly, lax, i.e. (figuratively) a ghost (as dead; in plural only). In the KJV it is rendered: dead, deceased.
H7497: Or raphah; from רָפָא in the sense of invigorating; a giant. In the KJV it is rendered: giant, Rapha, Rephaim(-s).
H7498: Or Raphah; probably the same as רָפָא; giant; Rapha or Raphah, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Rapha.
H7499: Feminine passive participle of רָפָא; a medicament. In the KJV it is rendered: heal(-ed), medicine.
H7500: From רָפָא; a cure. In the KJV it is rendered: health.
H7501: From רָפָא and אֵל; God has cured; Rephael, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Rephael.
H7502: A primitive root; to spread (a bed); by implication, to refresh. In the KJV it is rendered: comfort, make (a bed), spread.
H7503: A primitive root; to slacken (in many applications, literal or figurative). In the KJV it is rendered: abate, cease, consume, draw (toward evening), fail, (be) faint, be (wax) feeble, forsake, idle, leave, let alone (go, down), (be) slack, stay, be still, be slothful, (be) weak(-en).
H7504: From רָפָה; slack (in body or mind). In the KJV it is rendered: weak.
H7505: Passive participle of רָפָא; cured; Raphu, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Raphu.
H7506: From an unused root apparently meaning to sustain; support; Rephach, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Rephah.
H7507: From רָפַד; a railing (as spread along). In the KJV it is rendered: bottom.
H7508: Plural of the masculine of the same as רְפִידַת; ballusters; Rephidim, a place in the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Rephidim.
H7509: From רָפָא and יָהּ; Jah has cured; Rephajah, the name of five Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Rephaiah.
H7510: From רָפָה; slackness. In the KJV it is rendered: feebleness.
H7511: A primitive root; to trample, i.e. prostrate. In the KJV it is rendered: humble self, submit self.
H7512: (Aramaic) corresponding to רָפַס. In the KJV it is rendered: stamp.
H7513: From רָפַס; a raft (as flat on the water). In the KJV it is rendered: flote.
H7514: A primitive root; to recline. In the KJV it is rendered: lean.
H7515: A primitive root; to trample, i.e. roil water. In the KJV it is rendered: foul, trouble.
H7516: From רָפַשׂ; mud (as roiled). In the KJV it is rendered: mire.
H7517: Probably from רָפָה; a stall for cattle (from their resting there). In the KJV it is rendered: stall.
H7518: Contracted from רָצַץ; a fragment. In the KJV it is rendered: piece.
H7519: A primitive root; to run; also to delight in. In the KJV it is rendered: accept, run.
H7520: A primitive root; probably to look askant, i.e. (figuratively) be jealous. In the KJV it is rendered: leap.
H7521: A primitive root; to be pleased with; specifically, to satisfy a debt. In the KJV it is rendered: (be) accept(-able), accomplish, set affection, approve, consent with, delight (self), enjoy, (be, have a) favour(-able), like, observe, pardon, (be, have, take) please(-ure), reconcile self.
H7522: Or ratson; from רָצָה; delight (especially as shown). In the KJV it is rendered: (be) acceptable(-ance, -ed), delight, desire, favour, (good) pleasure, (own, self, voluntary) will, as.
H7523: A primitive root; properly, to dash in pieces, i.e. kill (a human being), especially to murder. In the KJV it is rendered: put to death, kill, (man-)slay(-er), murder(-er).
H7524: From רָצַח; a crushing; specifically, a murder-cry. In the KJV it is rendered: slaughter, sword.
H7525: From רָצָה; delight; Ritsjah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Rezia.
H7526: Probably for רָצוֹן; Retsin, the name of a Syrian and of an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Rezin.
H7527: A primitive root; to pierce. In the KJV it is rendered: bore.
H7528: A denominative from רְצָפִים; to tessellate, i.e. embroider (as if with bright stones). In the KJV it is rendered: pave.
H7529: For רֶ֫שֶׁף; a red-hot stone (for baking). In the KJV it is rendered: coal.
H7530: The same as רְצָפִים; Retseph, a place in Assyrian. In the KJV it is rendered: Rezeph.
H7531: Feminine of רְצָפִים; a hot stone; also a tessellated pavement. In the KJV it is rendered: live coal, pavement.
H7532: The same as רִצְפָה; Ritspah, an Israelitess. In the KJV it is rendered: Rizpah.
H7533: A primitive root; to crack in pieces, literally or figuratively. In the KJV it is rendered: break, bruise, crush, discourage, oppress, struggle together.
H7534: From רָקַק in its original sense; emaciated (as if flattened out). In the KJV it is rendered: lean((-fleshed)), thin.
H7535: The same as רַקּוֹת as a noun; properly, leanness, i.e. (figuratively) limitation; only adverbial, merely, or conjunctional, although. In the KJV it is rendered: but, even, except, howbeit howsoever, at the least, nevertheless, nothing but, notwithstanding, only, save, so (that), surely, yet (so), in any wise.
H7536: From רָקַק; spittle. In the KJV it is rendered: spit(-ting, -tle).
H7537: A primitive root; to decay (as by worm-eating). In the KJV it is rendered: rot.
H7538: From רָקַב; decay (by caries). In the KJV it is rendered: rottenness (thing).
H7539: From רָקָב; decay (by caries). In the KJV it is rendered: rotten.

H7706: From שָׁדַד; the Almighty. In the KJV it is rendered: Almighty.
H7707: From the same as שָׂדֶה and אוּר; spreader of light; Shedejur, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shedeur.
H7708: Plural from the same as שָׂדֶה; flats; Siddim, a valley in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Siddim.
H7709: Apparently from שָׂדֶה; a cultivated field; -- blasted, field.
H7710: A primitive root; to scorch. In the KJV it is rendered: blast.
H7711: Or shiddaphown; from שָׁדַף; blight. In the KJV it is rendered: blasted(-ing).
H7712: (Aramaic) a primitive root; to endeavor. In the KJV it is rendered: labour.
H7713: From an unused root meaning to regulate; a row, i.e. rank (of soldiers), story (of rooms). In the KJV it is rendered: board, range.
H7714: Probably of foreign origin; Shadrak, the Bab. name of one of Daniel's companions. In the KJV it is rendered: Shadrach.
H7715: (Aramaic) the same as שַׁדְרַך. In the KJV it is rendered: Shadrach.
H7716: Or sey; probably from שָׁאָה through the idea of pushing out to graze; a member of a flock, i.e. a sheep or goat. In the KJV it is rendered: (lesser, small) cattle, ewe, goat, lamb, sheep.
H7717: From an unused root meaning to testify; a witness. In the KJV it is rendered: record.
H7718: From an unused root probably mean to blanch; a gem, probably the beryl (from its pale green color). In the KJV it is rendered: onyx.
H7719: The same as שֹׁ֫הַם; Shoham, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shoham.
H7720: From the same as סַ֫הַר; a round pendant for the neck. In the KJV it is rendered: ornament, round tire like the moon.
H7721: From an unused root (akin to נָשָׂא and שׁוֹאָה) meaning to rise; a rising. In the KJV it is rendered: arise.
H7722: Or (feminine) showtah; or shoah; from an unused root meaning to rush over; a tempest; by implication, devastation. In the KJV it is rendered: desolate(-ion), destroy, destruction, storm, wasteness.
H7723: Or shav; from the same as שׁוֹאָה in the sense of desolating; evil (as destructive), literally (ruin) or morally (especially guile); figuratively idolatry (as false, subjective), uselessness (as deceptive, objective; also adverbially, in vain). In the KJV it is rendered: false(-ly), lie, lying, vain, vanity.
H7724: From the same as שָׁוְא; false; Sheva, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Sheva.
H7725: A primitive root; to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again. In the KJV it is rendered: ((break, build, circumcise, dig, do anything, do evil, feed, lay down, lie down, lodge, make, rejoice, send, take, weep)) X again, (cause to) answer (+ again), X in any case (wise), X at all, averse, bring (again, back, home again), call (to mind), carry again (back), cease, X certainly, come again (back), X consider, + continually, convert, deliver (again), + deny, draw back, fetch home again, X fro, get (oneself) (back) again, X give (again), go again (back, home), (go) out, hinder, let, (see) more, X needs, be past, X pay, pervert, pull in again, put (again, up again), recall, recompense, recover, refresh, relieve, render (again), requite, rescue, restore, retrieve, (cause to, make to) return, reverse, reward, + say nay, send back, set again, slide back, still, X surely, take back (off), (cause to, make to) turn (again, self again, away, back, back again, backward, from, off), withdraw.
H7726: From שׁוּב; apostate, i.e. idolatrous. In the KJV it is rendered: backsliding, frowardly, turn away (from margin).
H7727: The same as שׁוֹבָב; rebellious; Shobab, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Shobab.
H7728: From שׁוּב; apostate, i.e. heathenish or (actually) heathen. In the KJV it is rendered: backsliding.
H7729: From שׁוּב; a return. In the KJV it is rendered: returning.
H7730: For סֻבְּכוֹ; a thicket, i.e. interlaced branches. In the KJV it is rendered: thick boughs.
H7731: Perhaps for שׂ֫וֹבֶך; Shobak, a Syrian. In the KJV it is rendered: Shobach.
H7732: From the same as שֹׁ֫בֶל; overflowing; Shobal, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Shobal.
H7733: Active participle from a primitive root meaning to leave (compare שְׁבַק); forsaking; Shobek, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shobek.
H7734: A primitive root; to retreat. In the KJV it is rendered: turn back.
H7735: A primitive root; to hedge in. In the KJV it is rendered: make to grow.
H7736: A primitive root; properly, to swell up, i.e. figuratively (by implication of insolence) to devastate. In the KJV it is rendered: waste.
H7737: A primitive root; properly, to level, i.e. equalize; figuratively, to resemble; by implication, to adjust (i.e. counterbalance, be suitable, compose, place, yield, etc.). In the KJV it is rendered: avail, behave, bring forth, compare, countervail, (be, make) equal, lay, be (make, a-)like, make plain, profit, reckon.
H7738: A primitive root; to destroy. In the KJV it is rendered: X substance (from the margin).
H7739: (Aramaic): corresponding to שָׁוָה; to resemble. In the KJV it is rendered: make like.
H7740: From שָׁוָה; plain; Shaveh, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Shaveh.
H7741: From the same as שָׁוֵה and the dual of קִרְיָה; plain of a double city; Shaveh-Kirjathajim, a place East of the Jordan. In the KJV it is rendered: Shaveh Kiriathaim.
H7742: A primitive root; to muse pensively. In the KJV it is rendered: meditate.
H7743: A primitive root; to sink, literally or figuratively. In the KJV it is rendered: bow down, incline, humble.
H7744: From שׁ֫וּחַ; dell; Shuach, a son of Abraham. In the KJV it is rendered: Shuah.
H7745: From שׁ֫וּחַ; a chasm. In the KJV it is rendered: ditch, pit.
H7746: The same as שׁוּחָה; Shuchah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shuah.
H7747: Patronymic from שׁ֫וּחַ; a Shuchite or descendant of Shuach. In the KJV it is rendered: Shuhite.
H7748: From שׁ֫וּחַ; humbly; Shucham, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shuham.
H7749: Patronymic from שׁוּחָם; a Shuchamite (collectively). In the KJV it is rendered: Shuhamites.
H7750: Or (by permutation) cuwt; a primitive root; to detrude, i.e. (intransitively and figuratively) become derelict (wrongly practise; namely, idolatry). In the KJV it is rendered: turn aside to.
H7751: A primitive root; properly, to push forth; (but used only figuratively) to lash, i.e. (the sea with oars) to row; by implication, to travel. In the KJV it is rendered: go (about, through, to and fro), mariner, rower, run to and fro.
H7752: From שׁוּט; a lash (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: scourge, whip.
H7753: A primitive root; to entwine, i.e. shut in (for formation, protection or restraint). In the KJV it is rendered: fence, (make an) hedge (up).
H7754: Or (feminine) sowkah; from שׂוּך; a branch (as interleaved). In the KJV it is rendered: bough.
H7755: Or Sokoh; or Sowkow; from שׂוּך; Sokoh or Soko, the name of two places in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Shocho, Shochoh, Sochoh, Soco, Socoh.
H7756: Probably patronymic from a name corresponding to שׂוֹך (feminine); a Sukathite or descendant of an unknown Israelite named Sukah. In the KJV it is rendered: Suchathite.
H7757: From an unused root meaning to hang down; a skirt; by implication, a bottom edge. In the KJV it is rendered: hem, skirt, train.
H7758: Or sheylal (Micah 1:8); from שָׁלַל; nude (especially bare-foot); by implication, captive. In the KJV it is rendered: spoiled, stripped.
H7759: From שָׁלַם; peaceful (with the article always prefixed, making it a pet name); the Shulammith, an epithet of Solomon's queen. In the KJV it is rendered: Shulamite.
H7760: Or siym; a primitive root; to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically). In the KJV it is rendered: X any wise, appoint, bring, call (a name), care, cast in, change, charge, commit, consider, convey, determine, + disguise, dispose, do, get, give, heap up, hold, impute, lay (down, up), leave, look, make (out), mark, + name, X on, ordain, order, + paint, place, preserve, purpose, put (on), + regard, rehearse, reward, (cause to) set (on, up), shew, + stedfastly, take, X tell, + tread down, ((over-))turn, X wholly, work.
H7761: (Aramaic) corresponding to שׂוּם. In the KJV it is rendered: + command, give, lay, make, + name, + regard, set.
H7762: From an unused root meaning to exhale; garlic (from its rank odor). In the KJV it is rendered: garlic.
H7763: Or Shomer; active participle of שָׁמַר; keeper; Shomer, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Shomer.
H7764: From an unused root meaning to rest; quiet; Shuni, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shuni.
H7765: Patronymic from שׁוּנִי; a Shunite (collectively) or descendants of Shuni. In the KJV it is rendered: Shunites.
H7766: Probably from the same as שׁוּנִי; quietly; Shunem, a place in Pal. In the KJV it is rendered: Shunem.
H7767: Patrial from שׁוּנֵם; a Shunammitess, or female inhabitant of Shunem. In the KJV it is rendered: Shunamite.
H7768: A primitive root; properly, to be free; but used only causatively and reflexively, to halloo (for help, i.e. freedom from some trouble). In the KJV it is rendered: cry (aloud, out), shout.
H7769: From שָׁוַע; a halloo. In the KJV it is rendered: cry, riches.
H7770: The same as שׁ֫וּעַ; Shua, a Canaanite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shua, Shuah.
H7771: From שָׁוַע in the original sense of freedom; a noble, i.e. liberal, opulent; also (as noun in the derived sense) a halloo. In the KJV it is rendered: bountiful, crying, rich.
H7772: The same as שׁ֫וֹעַ; rich; Shoa, an Oriental people. In the KJV it is rendered: Shoa.
H7773: From שָׁוַע; a halloo. In the KJV it is rendered: cry.
H7774: From שָׁוַע; wealth; Shua, an Israelitess. In the KJV it is rendered: Shua.
H7775: Feminine of שֶׁ֫וַע; a hallooing. In the KJV it is rendered: crying.
H7776: Or shunal; from the same as שֹׁ֫עַל; a jackal (as a burrower). In the KJV it is rendered: fox.
H7777: The same as שׁוּעָל; Shual, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Shual.
H7778: Or shomer : active participle of שָׁעַר (as denominative from שַׁ֫עַר); a janitor. In the KJV it is rendered: doorkeeper, porter.
H7779: A primitive root; properly, to gape, i.e. snap at; figuratively, to overwhelm. In the KJV it is rendered: break, bruise, cover.
H7780: From שָׁפַך; poured; Shophak, a Syrian. In the KJV it is rendered: Shophach.
H7781: Patronymic from שְׁפוּפָן; a Shuphamite (collectively) or descendants of Shephupham. In the KJV it is rendered: Shuphamite.
H7782: Or shophar; from שָׁפַר in the original sense of incising; a cornet (as giving a clear sound) or curved horn. In the KJV it is rendered: cornet, trumpet.
H7783: A primitive root; to run after or over, i.e. overflow. In the KJV it is rendered: overflow, water.
H7784: From שׁוּק; a street (as run over). In the KJV it is rendered: street.
H7785: From שׁוּק; the (lower) leg (as a runner). In the KJV it is rendered: hip, leg, shoulder, thigh.
H7786: A primitive root; properly, to vanquish; by implication, to rule (causatively, crown). In the KJV it is rendered: make princes, have power, reign.
H7787: A primitive root (identical with שׂוּר through the idea of reducing to pieces; compare מַשּׂוֹר); to saw. In the KJV it is rendered: cut.
H7788: A primitive root; properly, to turn, i.e. travel about (as a harlot or a merchant). In the KJV it is rendered: go, singular See also shiyr.
H7789: A primitive root (identical with שׁוּר through the idea of going round for inspection); to spy out, i.e. (generally) survey, (for evil) lurk for, (for good) care for. In the KJV it is rendered: behold, lay wait, look, observe, perceive, regard, see.
H7790: From שִׁימוֹן; a foe (as lying in wait). In the KJV it is rendered: enemy.
H7791: From שׁוּר; a wall (as going about). In the KJV it is rendered: wall.
H7792: (Aramaic) corresponding to שׁוּר. In the KJV it is rendered: wall.
H7793: The same as שׁוּר; Shur, a region of the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Shur.
H7794: From שׁוּר; a bullock (as a traveller). In the KJV it is rendered: bull(-ock), cow, ox, wall (by mistake for shuwr).
H7795: From שׂוּר in the primitive sense of סוּר; properly, a ring, i.e. (by analogy) a row (adverbially). In the KJV it is rendered: principal.
H7796: The same as שֹׂרֵק; a vine; Sorek, a valley in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Sorek.
H7797: Or siys; a primitive root; to be bright, i.e. cheerful. In the KJV it is rendered: be glad, X greatly, joy, make mirth, rejoice.
H7798: From שׂוּשׂ; joyful; Shavsha, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shavsha.
H7799: Or showshan; or shoshan; and (feminine) showshannah; from שׂוּשׂ; a lily (from its whiteness), as a flower of arch. ornament; also a (straight) trumpet (from the tubular shape): lily, Shoshannim.
H7800: The same as שׁוֹשָׁן; Shushan, a place in Persia. In the KJV it is rendered: Shushan.
H7801: (Aramaic) of foreign origin; a Shushankite (collectively) or inhabitants of some unknown place in Assyrian. In the KJV it is rendered: Susanchites.
H7802: Or (plural of former) Showshanniym Eduwth; from שׁוֹשָׁן and עֵדוּת; lily (or trumpet) of assemblage; Shushan-Eduth or Shoshannim-Eduth, the title of a popular song. In the KJV it is rendered: Shoshannim-Eduth, Shushan-eduth.
H7803: Probably from שָׁאָה and the same as תָּ֫לַח; crash of breakage; Shuthelach, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Shuthelah.
H7804: (Aramaic) corresponding to עָזַב; to leave, i.e. (causatively) free. In the KJV it is rendered: deliver.
H7805: A primitive root; to tan (by sun-burning); figuratively (as if by a piercing ray) to scan. In the KJV it is rendered: look up, see.
H7806: A primitive root; to twist (a thread of straw). In the KJV it is rendered: twine.
H7807: From שָׁחַח; sunk, i.e. downcast. In the KJV it is rendered: + humble.
H7808: For שִׂ֫יחַ; communion, i.e. (reflexively) meditation. In the KJV it is rendered: thought.
H7809: A primitive root; to donate, i.e. bribe. In the KJV it is rendered: hire, give a reward.
H7810: From שָׁחַד; a donation (venal or redemptive). In the KJV it is rendered: bribe(-ry), gift, present, reward.
H7811: A primitive root; to swim; causatively, to inundate. In the KJV it is rendered: (make to) swim.
H7812: A primitive root; to depress, i.e. prostrate (especially reflexive, in homage to royalty or God). In the KJV it is rendered: bow (self) down, crouch, fall down (flat), humbly beseech, do (make) obeisance, do reverence, make to stoop, worship.
H7813: From שָׂחָה; a pond (for swimming). In the KJV it is rendered: to swim in.
H7814: Or schoq; from שָׂחַק; laughter (in merriment or defiance). In the KJV it is rendered: derision, laughter(-ed to scorn, -ing), mocked, sport.
H7815: From שָׁחַר; dinginess, i.e. perhaps soot. In the KJV it is rendered: coal.
H7816: From שָׁחָה; pit. In the KJV it is rendered: pit.
H7817: A primitive root; to sink or depress (reflexive or causative). In the KJV it is rendered: bend, bow (down), bring (cast) down, couch, humble self, be (bring) low, stoop.
H7818: A primitive root; to tread out, i.e. squeeze (grapes). In the KJV it is rendered: press.
H7819: A primitive root; to slaughter (in sacrifice or massacre). In the KJV it is rendered: kill, offer, shoot out, slay, slaughter.
H7820: A primitive root (identical with שָׁחַט through the idea of striking); to hammer out. In the KJV it is rendered: beat.
H7821: From שָׁחַט; slaughter. In the KJV it is rendered: killing.
H7822: From an unused root probably meaning to burn; inflammation, i.e. an ulcer; --boil, botch.
H7823: Or cachiysh; from an unused root apparently meaning to sprout; after-growth. In the KJV it is rendered: (that) which springeth of the same.
H7824: From the same as שָׁ֫חַף; a board (as chipped thin). In the KJV it is rendered: cieled with.
H7825: From שָׁחָה; a pit-fall (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: destruction, pit.
H7826: From an unused root probably meaning to roar; a lion (from his characteristic roar). In the KJV it is rendered: (fierce) lion.
H7827: Apparently from the same as שָׁ֫חַל through some obscure idea, perhaps that of peeling off by concussion of sound; a scale or shell, i.e. the aromatic mussel. In the KJV it is rendered: onycha.
H7828: From an unused root meaning to peel, i.e. emaciate; the gull (as thin). In the KJV it is rendered: cuckoo.
H7829: From the same as שָׁ֫חַף; emaciation. In the KJV it is rendered: consumption.
H7830: From an unused root apparently meaning to strut; haughtiness (as evinced by the attitude). In the KJV it is rendered: X lion, pride.
H7831: From the same as שָׁ֫חַץ; proudly; Shachatsom, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Shahazimah (from the margin).
H7832: A primitive root; to laugh (in pleasure or detraction); by implication, to play. In the KJV it is rendered: deride, have in derision, laugh, make merry, mock(-er), play, rejoice, (laugh to) scorn, be in (make) sport.
H7833: A primitive root; to comminate (by trituration or attrition). In the KJV it is rendered: beat, wear.
H7834: From שָׁחַק; a powder (as beaten small): by analogy, a thin vapor; by extension, the firmament. In the KJV it is rendered: cloud, small dust, heaven, sky.
H7835: A primitive root (identical with שָׁחַר through the idea of the duskiness of early dawn); to be dim or dark (in color). In the KJV it is rendered: be black.
H7836: A primitive root; properly, to dawn, i.e. (figuratively) be (up) early at any task (with the implication of earnestness); by extension, to search for (with painstaking). In the KJV it is rendered: (do something) betimes, enquire early, rise (seek) betimes, seek diligently) early, in the morning).
H7837: From שָׁחַר; dawn (literal, figurative or adverbial). In the KJV it is rendered: day(-spring), early, light, morning, whence riseth.
H7838: Or shachowr; from שָׁחַר; properly, dusky, but also (absol.) jetty. In the KJV it is rendered: black.
H7839: From שָׁחַר; a dawning, i.e. (figuratively) juvenescence. In the KJV it is rendered: youth.
H7840: From שָׁחַר; swarthy. In the KJV it is rendered: black.
H7841: From שָׁחַר and יָהּ; Jah has sought; Shecharjah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shehariah.
H7842: Dual of שָׁ֫חַר; double dawn; Shacharajim, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shaharaim.
H7843: A primitive root; to decay, i.e. (causatively) ruin (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: batter, cast off, corrupt(-er, thing), destroy(-er, -uction), lose, mar, perish, spill, spoiler, X utterly, waste(-r).
H7844: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁחַת. In the KJV it is rendered: corrupt, fault.
H7845: From שׁ֫וּחַ; a pit (especially as a trap); figuratively, destruction. In the KJV it is rendered: corruption, destruction, ditch, grave, pit.
H7846: Or cet; from סוּט; a departure from right, i.e. sin. In the KJV it is rendered: revolter, that turn aside.
H7847: A primitive root; to deviate from duty. In the KJV it is rendered: decline, go aside, turn.
H7848: Feminine of a derivative (only in the plural shittiym; meaning the sticks of wood) from the same as שֹׁטֵט; the acacia (from its scourging thorns). In the KJV it is rendered: shittah, shittim.
H7849: A primitive root; to expand. In the KJV it is rendered: all abroad, enlarge, spread, stretch out.
H7850: Active participle of an otherwise unused root meaning (properly, to pierce; but only as a denominative from שׁוֹט) to flog; a goad. In the KJV it is rendered: scourge.
H7851: The same as the plural of שִׁטִּים; acacia trees; Shittim, a place East of the Jordan. In the KJV it is rendered: Shittim.
H7852: A primitive root; properly, to lurk for, i.e. persecute. In the KJV it is rendered: hate, oppose self against.
H7853: A primitive root; to attack, (figuratively) accuse. In the KJV it is rendered: (be an) adversary, resist.
H7854: From שָׂטַן; an opponent; especially (with the article prefixed) Satan, the arch-enemy of good. In the KJV it is rendered: adversary, Satan, withstand.
H7855: From שָׂטַן; opposition (by letter). In the KJV it is rendered: accusation.
H7856: The same as שִׂטְנָה; Sitnah, the name of a well in Pal. In the KJV it is rendered: Sitnah.
H7857: A primitive root; to gush; by implication, to inundate, cleanse; by analogy, to gallop, conquer. In the KJV it is rendered: drown, (over-)flow(- whelm, rinse, run, rush, (throughly) wash (away).
H7858: Or sheteph; from שָׁטַף; a deluge (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: flood, outrageous, overflowing.
H7859: (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation; a side. In the KJV it is rendered: side.
H7860: Active participle of an otherwise unused root probably meaning to write; properly, a scribe, i.e. (by analogy or implication) an official superintendent or magistrate. In the KJV it is rendered: officer, overseer, ruler.
H7861: From the same as שֹׁטֵר; magisterial; Shitrai, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shitrai.
H7862: Probably from שָׁוָה; a gift (as available). In the KJV it is rendered: present.
H7863: From the same as שׂוֹא by permutation; elevation. In the KJV it is rendered: excellency.
H7864: For שְׁוָא; Sheja, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Sheva (from the margin).
H7865: From שִׂיא; peak; Sion, the summit of Mt. Hermon. In the KJV it is rendered: Sion.
H7866: From the same as שׁוֹאָה; ruin; Shijon, a place in Palestine --Shihon.
H7867: A primitive root; properly, to become aged, i.e. (by implication) to grow gray. In the KJV it is rendered: (be) grayheaded.
H7868: (Aramaic) corresponding to שִׂיב. In the KJV it is rendered: elder.
H7869: From שִׂיב; old age. In the KJV it is rendered: age.
H7870: By permutation from שׁוּב; a return (of property). In the KJV it is rendered: captivity.
H7871: From יָשַׁב; residence. In the KJV it is rendered: while.
H7872: Feminine of שֵׂיב; old age. In the KJV it is rendered: (be) gray (grey hoar,-y) hairs (head,-ed), old age.
H7873: From שׂוּג; a withdrawal (into a private place). In the KJV it is rendered: pursuing.
H7874: A primitive root probably meaning to boil up (compare שׁוּד); used only as denominative from שִׂיד; to plaster. In the KJV it is rendered: plaister.
H7875: From שִׂיד; lime (as boiling when slacked). In the KJV it is rendered: lime, plaister.
H7876: A primitive root; to keep in memory. In the KJV it is rendered: be unmindful.
H7877: Of unknown derivation; Shiza, an Is. In the KJV it is rendered: Shiza.
H7878: A primitive root; to ponder, i.e. (by implication) converse (with oneself, and hence, aloud) or (transitively) utter. In the KJV it is rendered: commune, complain, declare, meditate, muse, pray, speak, talk (with).
H7879: From שִׂ֫יחַ; a contemplation; by implication, an utterance. In the KJV it is rendered: babbling, communication, complaint, meditation, prayer, talk.
H7880: From שִׂ֫יחַ; a shoot (as if uttered or put forth), i.e. (generally) shrubbery. In the KJV it is rendered: bush, plant, shrub.
H7881: Feminine of שִׂ֫יחַ; reflection; be extension, devotion. In the KJV it is rendered: meditation, prayer.
H7882: For שׁוּחָה; a pit-fall. In the KJV it is rendered: pit.
H7883: Or Shichowr; or Shichor; probably from שָׁחַר; dark, i.e. turbid; Shichor, a stream of Egypt. In the KJV it is rendered: Shihor, Sihor.
H7884: From the same as שִׁיחוֹר and לָבַן; darkish whiteness; Shichor-Libnath, a stream of Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Shihor-libnath.
H7885: From שׁוּט; an oar; also (compare שׁוֹט) a scourge (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: oar, scourge.
H7886: From שָׁלָה; tranquil; Shiloh, an epithet of the Messiah. In the KJV it is rendered: Shiloh.
H7887: Or Shiloh; or Shiylow; or Shilow; from the same as שִׁילֹה; Shiloh, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Shiloh.
H7888: Or Shiyloniy; or Shiloniy; from שִׁלֹה; a Shilonite or inhabitant of Shiloh. In the KJV it is rendered: Shilonite.
H7889: Apparently for יְשִׁימוֹן; desert; Shimon, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shimon.
H7890: From an unused root meaning to urinate; urine. In the KJV it is rendered: piss.
H7891: Or (the original form) shuwr (1 Sam. 18:6); a primitive root (identical with שׁוּר through the idea of strolling minstrelsy); to sing. In the KJV it is rendered: behold (by mistake for shuwr), sing(-er, -ing man, - ing woman).
H7892: Or feminine shiyrah; from שִׁיר; a song; abstractly, singing. In the KJV it is rendered: musical(-ick), X sing(-er, -ing), song.
H7893: From an unused root meaning to bleach, i.e. whiten; white, i.e. marble. See שֵׁשׁ.
H7894: From the same as שַׁ֫יִשׁ; whiteness; Shisha, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shisha.
H7895: Or Shuwshaq; of Egyptian derivation; Shishak, an Egyptian king. In the KJV it is rendered: Shishak.
H7896: A primitive root; to place (in a very wide application). In the KJV it is rendered: apply, appoint, array, bring, consider, lay (up), let alone, X look, make, mark, put (on), + regard, set, shew, be stayed, X take.
H7897: From שִׁית; a dress (as put on). In the KJV it is rendered: attire.
H7898: From שִׁית; scrub or trash, i.e. wild growth of weeds or briers (as if put on the field). In the KJV it is rendered: thorns.
H7899: From סָכַך in the sense of שׂוּך; a brier (as of a hedge). In the KJV it is rendered: prick.
H7900: From סָכַך in the sense of שׂוּך; a booth (as interlaced). In the KJV it is rendered: tabernacle.
H7901: A primitive root; to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose). In the KJV it is rendered: X at all, cast down, ((lover-))lay (self) (down), (make to) lie (down, down to sleep, still with), lodge, ravish, take rest, sleep, stay.
H7902: From שָׁכַב; a lying down (of dew, or for the sexual act). In the KJV it is rendered: X carnally, copulation, X lay, seed.
H7903: From שָׁכַב; a (sexual) lying with. In the KJV it is rendered: X lie.
H7904: A primitive root; to roam (through lust). In the KJV it is rendered: in the morning (by mistake for shakam).
H7905: Feminine of שֹׂך in the sense of שִׂכִּים; a dart (as pointed like a thorn). In the KJV it is rendered: barbed iron.
H7906: From an unused root apparently meaning to surmount; an observatory (with the article); Seku, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Sechu.
H7907: From the same as שֶׂ֫כוּ; observant, i.e. (concretely) the mind. In the KJV it is rendered: heart.
H7908: Infinitive of שָׁכֹל; bereavement. In the KJV it is rendered: loss of children, spoiling.
H7909: Or shakkul; from שָׁכֹל; bereaved. In the KJV it is rendered: barren, bereaved (robbed) of children (whelps).
H7910: Or shikkor; from שָׁכַר; intoxicated, as a state or a habit. In the KJV it is rendered: drunk(-ard, -en, -en man).
H7911: Or shakeach; a primitive root; to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of, from want of memory or attention. In the KJV it is rendered: X at all, (cause to) forget.
H7912: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁכַח through the idea of disclosure of a covered or forgotten thing; to discover (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: find.
H7913: From שָׁכַח; oblivious. In the KJV it is rendered: forget.
H7914: Feminine from the same as שֶׂ֫כוּ; a conspicuous object. In the KJV it is rendered: picture.
H7915: Intensive perhaps from the same as שֶׂ֫כוּ in the sense of שׂוּך; a knife (as pointed or edged). In the KJV it is rendered: knife.
H7916: From שָׂכַר; a man at wages by the day or year. In the KJV it is rendered: hired (man, servant), hireling.
H7917: Feminine of שָׂכִיר; a hiring. In the KJV it is rendered: that is hired.
H7918: A primitive root; to weave (i.e. lay) a trap; figuratively, (through the idea of secreting) to allay (passions; physically, abate a flood). In the KJV it is rendered: appease, assuage, make to cease, pacify, set.
H7919: A primitive root; to be (causatively, make or act) circumspect and hence, intelligent. In the KJV it is rendered: consider, expert, instruct, prosper, (deal) prudent(-ly), (give) skill(-ful), have good success, teach, (have, make to) understand(-ing), wisdom, (be, behave self, consider, make) wise(- ly), guide wittingly.
H7920: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׂכַל. In the KJV it is rendered: consider.
H7921: A primitive root; properly, to miscarry, i.e. suffer abortion; by analogy, to bereave (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: bereave (of children), barren, cast calf (fruit, young), be (make) childless, deprive, destroy, X expect, lose children, miscarry, rob of children, spoil.
H7922: Or sekel; from שָׂכַל; intelligence; by implication, success. In the KJV it is rendered: discretion, knowledge, policy, prudence, sense, understanding, wisdom, wise.
H7923: Plural from שָׁכֹל; childlessness (by continued bereavements). In the KJV it is rendered: to have after loss of others.
H7924: (Aramaic) from שְׂכַל; intelligence. In the KJV it is rendered: understanding.
H7925: A primitive root; properly, to incline (the shoulder to a burden); but used only as denominative from שְׁכֶם; literally, to load up (on the back of man or beast), i.e. to start early in the morning. In the KJV it is rendered: (arise, be up, get (oneself) up, rise up) early (betimes), morning.
H7926: From שָׁכַם; the neck (between the shoulders) as the place of burdens; figuratively, the spur of a hill. In the KJV it is rendered: back, X consent, portion, shoulder.
H7927: The same as שְׁכֶם; ridge; Shekem, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Shechem.
H7928: For שְׁכֶם; Shekem, the name of a Hivite and two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Shechem.
H7929: Feminine of שְׁכֶם; the shoulder-bone. In the KJV it is rendered: shoulder blade.
H7930: Patronymic from שֶׁ֫כֶם; a Shikmite (collectively), or descendants of Shekem. In the KJV it is rendered: Shichemites.
H7931: A primitive root (apparently akin (by transmission) to שָׁכַב through the idea of lodging; compare סִכְלוּת, שָׁכַם); to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: abide, continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-er), have habitation, inhabit, lay, place, (cause to) remain, rest, set (up).
H7932: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁכַן. In the KJV it is rendered: cause to dwell, have habitation.
H7933: From שָׁכַן; a residence. In the KJV it is rendered: habitation.
H7934: From שָׁכַן; a resident; by extension, a fellow-citizen. In the KJV it is rendered: inhabitant, neighbour, nigh.
H7935: Or (prol.) Shkanyahuw; from שָׁכַן and יָהּ; Jah has dwelt; Shekanjah, the name of nine Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Shecaniah, Shechaniah.
H7936: Or (by permutation) cakar (Ezra 4:5); a primitive root (apparently akin (by prosthesis) to כָּרָה through the idea of temporary purchase; compare שָׁכַר); to hire. In the KJV it is rendered: earn wages, hire (out self), reward, X surely.
H7937: A primitive root; to become tipsy; in a qualified sense, to satiate with a stimulating drink or (figuratively) influence. In the KJV it is rendered: (be filled with) drink (abundantly), (be, make) drunk(-en), be merry.
H7938: From שָׂכַר; wages. In the KJV it is rendered: reward, sluices.
H7939: From שָׂכַר; payment of contract; concretely, salary, fare, maintenance; by implication, compensation, benefit. In the KJV it is rendered: hire, price, reward(-ed), wages, worth.
H7940: The same as שָׂכָר; recompense; Sakar, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Sacar.
H7941: From שָׁכַר; an intoxicant, i.e. intensely alcoholic liquor. In the KJV it is rendered: strong drink, + drunkard, strong wine.
H7942: For שִׁכָּרוֹן; drunkenness, Shikkeron, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Shicron.
H7943: From שָׁכַר; intoxication. In the KJV it is rendered: (be) drunken(-ness).
H7944: From שָׁלָה abbrev.; a fault. In the KJV it is rendered: error.
H7945: For the rel. אֲשֶׁר; used with prepositional prefix, and often followed by some pronominal affix; on account of, whatsoever, whichsoever. In the KJV it is rendered: cause, sake.
H7946: For שַׁאֲנָן; tranquil. In the KJV it is rendered: being at ease.
H7947: A primitive root; to space off; intensive (evenly) to make equidistant. In the KJV it is rendered: equally distant, set in order.
H7948: From שָׁלַב; a spacer or raised interval, i.e. the stile in a frame or panel. In the KJV it is rendered: ledge.
H7949: A primitive root; properly, meaning to be white; used only as denominative from שָׁ֫לֶג; to be snow-white (with the linen clothing of the slain). In the KJV it is rendered: be as snow.
H7950: From שָׁלַג; snow (probably from its whiteness). In the KJV it is rendered: snow(-y).
H7951: Or shalav (Job 3:26); a primitive root; to be tranquil, i.e. secure or successful. In the KJV it is rendered: be happy, prosper, be in safety.
H7952: A primitive root (probably identical with שָׁלָה through the idea of educing); to mislead. In the KJV it is rendered: deceive, be negligent.
H7953: A primitive root (rather cognate (by contraction) to the base of נָשַׁל, שָׁלַל and their congeners through the idea of extracting); to draw out or off, i.e. remove (the soul by death). In the KJV it is rendered: take away.
H7954: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁלָה; to be secure. In the KJV it is rendered: at rest.
H7955: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to שָׁלָה; a wrong. In the KJV it is rendered: thing amiss.
H7956: The same as שְׁאֵלָה (shortened); request; Shelah, the name of a postdiluvian patriarch and of an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shelah.
H7957: From the same as לַ֫הַב with sibilant prefix; a flare of fire. In the KJV it is rendered: (flaming) flame.
H7958: Or slayv; by orthographical variation from שָׁלָה through the idea of sluggishness; the quail collectively (as slow in flight from its weight). In the KJV it is rendered: quails.
H7959: From שָׁלָה; security. In the KJV it is rendered: prosperity.
H7960: (Aramaic) or shaluwth (Aramaic); from the same as שָׁלֻה; a fault. In the KJV it is rendered: error, X fail, thing amiss.
H7961: Or shaleyv; feminine shlevah; from שָׁלָה; tranquil; (in a bad sense) careless; abstractly, security. In the KJV it is rendered: (being) at ease, peaceable, (in) prosper(-ity), quiet(-ness), wealthy.
H7962: From שָׁלָה; security (genuine or false). In the KJV it is rendered: abundance, peace(-ably), prosperity, quietness.
H7963: (Aramaic) corresponding to שַׁלְוָה; safety. In the KJV it is rendered: tranquillity.
H7964: Or shilluach; from שָׁלַח; (only in plural) a dismissal, i.e. (of a wife) divorce (especially the document); also (of a daughter) dower. In the KJV it is rendered: presents, have sent back.
H7965: Or shalom; from שָׁלַם; safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace. In the KJV it is rendered: X do, familiar, X fare, favour, + friend, X great, (good) health, (X perfect, such as be at) peace(-able, -ably), prosper(-ity, -ous), rest, safe(-ty), salute, welfare, (X all is, be) well, X wholly.
H7966: Or shillum; from שָׁלַם; a requital, i.e. (secure) retribution, (venal) a fee. In the KJV it is rendered: recompense, reward.
H7967: Or (shorter) Shallum; the same as שִׁלּוּם; Shallum, the name of fourteen Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Shallum.
H7968: Probably for שַׁלּוּם; Shallun, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shallum.
H7969: Or shalosh; masculine shlowshah; or shloshah; a primitive number; three; occasionally (ordinal) third, or (multipl.) thrice. In the KJV it is rendered: + fork, + often(-times), third, thir(-teen, -teenth), three, + thrice.
H7970: Or shloshiym; multiple of שָׁלוֹשׁ; thirty; or (ordinal) thirtieth. In the KJV it is rendered: thirty, thirtieth.
H7971: A primitive root; to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications). In the KJV it is rendered: X any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, X earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out).
H7972: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁלַח. In the KJV it is rendered: put, send.
H7973: From שָׁלַח; a missile of attack, i.e. spear; also (figuratively) a shoot of growth; i.e. branch. In the KJV it is rendered: dart, plant, X put off, sword, weapon.
H7974: The same as שָׁ֫לַח; Shelach, a postdiluvian patriarch. In the KJV it is rendered: Salah, Shelah.
H7975: Or (in imitation of שָׁ֫לַח) Shelach (Neh. 3:15); from שָׁלַח; rill; Shiloach, a fountain of Jerusalem. In the KJV it is rendered: Shiloah, Siloah.
H7976: Feminine of שִׁלּוּחִים; a shoot. In the KJV it is rendered: branch.
H7977: From שָׁ֫לַח; missive, i.e. armed; Shilchi, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shilhi.
H7978: Plural of שָׁ֫לַח; javelins or sprouts; Shilchim, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Shilhim.
H7979: From שָׁלַח; a table (as spread out); by implication, a meal. In the KJV it is rendered: table.
H7980: A primitive root; to dominate, i.e. govern; by implication, to permit. In the KJV it is rendered: (bear, have) rule, have dominion, give (have) power.
H7981: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁלַט. In the KJV it is rendered: have the mastery, have power, bear rule, be (make) ruler.
H7982: From שָׁלַט; probably a shield (as controlling, i.e. protecting the person). In the KJV it is rendered: shield.
H7984: (Aramaic) or shilton (Aramaic); corresponding to שִׁלְטוֹן. In the KJV it is rendered: ruler.
H7985: (Aramaic) from שְׁלֵט; empire (abstractly or concretely). In the KJV it is rendered: dominion.
H7986: Feminine from שָׁלַט; a vixen. In the KJV it is rendered: imperious.
H7987: From שָׁלָה; privacy. In the KJV it is rendered: + quietly.
H7988: Feminine from שָׁלָה; a fetus or babe (as extruded in birth). In the KJV it is rendered: young one.
H7989: From שָׁלַט; potent; concretely, a prince or warrior. In the KJV it is rendered: governor, mighty, that hath power, ruler.
H7990: (Aramaic) corresponding to שַׁלִּיט; mighty; abstractly, permission; concretely, a premier. In the KJV it is rendered: captain, be lawful, rule(- r).
H7991: Or shalowsh ( 1 Chron. 11:11; 12:18); or shalosh (2 Sam. 23:13); from שָׁלוֹשׁ; a triple, i.e. (as a musical instrument) a triangle (or perhaps rather three-stringed lute); also (as an indefinite, great quantity) a three-fold measure (perhaps a treble ephah); also (as an officer) a general of the third rank (upward, i.e. the highest). In the KJV it is rendered: captain, instrument of musick, (great) lord, (great) measure, prince, three (from the margin).
H7992: Ordinal from שָׁלוֹשׁ; third; feminine a third (part); by extension, a third (day, year or time); specifically, a third-story cell). In the KJV it is rendered: third (part, rank, time), three (years old).
H7993: A primitive root; to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: adventure, cast (away, down, forth, off, out), hurl, pluck, throw.
H7994: From שָׁלַך; bird of prey, usually thought to be the pelican (from casting itself into the sea). In the KJV it is rendered: cormorant.
H7995: From שָׁלַך; a felling (of trees). In the KJV it is rendered: when cast.
H7996: The same as שַׁלֶּ֫כֶת; Shalleketh, a gate in Jerusalem. In the KJV it is rendered: Shalleketh.
H7997: A primitive root; to drop or strip; by implication, to plunder. In the KJV it is rendered: let fall, make self a prey, X of purpose, (make a, (take)) spoil.
H7998: From שָׁלַל; booty. In the KJV it is rendered: prey, spoil.
H7999: A primitive root; to be safe (in mind, body or estate); figuratively, to be (causatively, make) completed; by implication, to be friendly; by extension, to reciprocate (in various applications). In the KJV it is rendered: make amends, (make an) end, finish, full, give again, make good, (re-)pay (again), (make) (to) (be at) peace(-able), that is perfect, perform, (make) prosper(-ous), recompense, render, requite, make restitution, restore, reward, X surely.
H8000: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁלַם; to complete, to restore. In the KJV it is rendered: deliver, finish.
H8001: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁלוֹם; prosperity. In the KJV it is rendered: peace.
H8002: From שָׁלַם; properly, requital, i.e. a (voluntary) sacrifice in thanks. In the KJV it is rendered: peace offering.
H8003: From שָׁלַם; complete (literally or figuratively); especially friendly. In the KJV it is rendered: full, just, made ready, peaceable, perfect(-ed), quiet, Shalem (by mistake for a name), whole.
H8004: The same as שָׁלֵם; peaceful; Shalem, an early name of Jerusalem. In the KJV it is rendered: Salem.
H8005: From שָׁלַם; requital. In the KJV it is rendered: recompense.
H8006: The same as שִׁלֵּם; Shillem, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shillem.
H8007: Probably for שַׂלְמָה; clothing; Salma, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Salma.
H8008: Transp. for שִׂמְלָה; a dress. In the KJV it is rendered: clothes, garment, raiment.
H8009: The same as שַׂלְמָה; clothing; Salmah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Salmon.
H8010: From שָׁלוֹם; peaceful; Shelomah, David's successor. In the KJV it is rendered: Solomon.
H8011: Feminine of שִׁלּוּם; retribution. In the KJV it is rendered: recompense.
H8012: From שַׂלְמָה; investiture; Salmon, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Salmon.
H8013: Feminine plural of שָׁלוֹם; pacifications; Shelomoth, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Shelomith (from the margin), Shelomoth.
H8014: From שַׂלְמָה; clothed; Salmai, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shalmai.
H8015: From שָׁלוֹם; peaceable; Shelomi, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shelomi.
H8016: Patronymically from שִׁלֵּם; a Shilemite (collectively) or descendants of Shillem. In the KJV it is rendered: Shillemites.
H8017: From שָׁלוֹם and אֵל; peace of God; Shelumiel, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shelumiel.
H8018: Or Shelemyahuw; from שֶׁ֫לֶם and יָהּ; thank-offering of Jah; Shelemjah, the name of nine Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Shelemiah.
H8019: Or Shlowmiyth (Ezra 8:10); from שָׁלוֹם; peaceableness; Shelomith, the name of five Israelites and three Israelitesses. In the KJV it is rendered: Shelomith.
H8020: Of foreign derivation; Shalman, a king apparently of Assyria. In the KJV it is rendered: Shalman.
H8021: From שָׁלַם; a bribe. In the KJV it is rendered: reward.
H8022: Of foreign derivation; Shalmaneser, an Assyrian king. In the KJV it is rendered: Shalmaneser.
H8023: The same as שִׁילוֹנִי; Shiloni, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shiloni.
H8024: From שֵׁלָה; a Shelanite (collectively), or descendants of Shelah. In the KJV it is rendered: Shelanites.
H8025: A primitive root; to pull out, up or off. In the KJV it is rendered: draw (off), grow up, pluck off.
H8026: From שָׁלַף; extract; Sheleph, a son of Jokthan. In the KJV it is rendered: Sheleph.
H8027: A primitive root perhaps originally to intensify, i.e. treble; but apparently used only as denominative from שָׁלוֹשׁ, to be (causatively, make) triplicate (by restoration, in portions, strands, days or years). H8028: From שָׁלַשׁ; triplet; Shelesh, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shelesh.

H8185: Feminine of שֵׂעָר; hairiness. In the KJV it is rendered: hair.
H8186: Or shanariyriyah; or shaparurith; feminine from שָׁעַר in the sense of שָׂעַר; something fearful. In the KJV it is rendered: horrible thing.
H8187: From שָׁעַר and יָהּ; Jah has stormed; Shearjah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Sheariah.
H8188: Masculine plural of שְׂעֹרִים; barley grains; Seorim, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Seorim.
H8189: Dual of שַׁ֫עַר; double gates; Shaarajim, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Shaaraim.
H8190: Of Persian derivation; Shaashgaz, a eunuch of Xerxes. In the KJV it is rendered: Shaashgaz.
H8191: From שָׁעַע; enjoyment. In the KJV it is rendered: delight, pleasure.
H8192: A primitive root; to abrade, i.e. bare. In the KJV it is rendered: high, stick out.
H8193: Or (in dual and plural) sepheth; probably from סָפָה or שָׁפָה through the idea of termination (compare סוֹף); the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.). In the KJV it is rendered: band, bank, binding, border, brim, brink, edge, language, lip, prating, ((sea-))shore, side, speech, talk, (vain) words.
H8194: From שָׁפָה in the sense of clarifying; a cheese (as strained from the whey). In the KJV it is rendered: cheese.
H8195: Or Shphiy; from שָׁפָה; baldness (compare שֶׁ֫פִי); Shepho or Shephi, an Idumaean. In the KJV it is rendered: Shephi, Shepho.
H8196: Or shphuwt; from שָׁפַט; a judicial sentence, i.e. punishment. In the KJV it is rendered: judgment.
H8197: Or Shphuwphan; from the same as שְׁפִיפֹן; serpent-like; Shephupham or Shephuphan, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shephuphan, Shupham.
H8198: Feminine from an unused root meaning to spread out (as a family; see מִשְׁפָּחָה); a female slave (as a member of the household). In the KJV it is rendered: (bond-, hand-)maid(-en, -servant), wench, bondwoman, womanservant.
H8199: A primitive root; to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: + avenge, X that condemn, contend, defend, execute (judgment), (be a) judge(-ment), X needs, plead, reason, rule.
H8200: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁפַט; to judge. In the KJV it is rendered: magistrate.
H8201: From שָׁפַט; a sentence, i.e. infliction. In the KJV it is rendered: judgment.
H8202: From שָׁפַט; judge; Shaphat, the name of four Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Shaphat.
H8203: Or Shphatyahuw; from שָׁפַט and יָהּ; Jah has judged; Shephatjah, the name of ten Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Shephatiah.
H8204: From שָׁפַט; judge-like; Shiphtan, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shiphtan.
H8205: From שָׁפָה; bareness; concretely, a bare hill or plain. In the KJV it is rendered: high place, stick out.
H8206: Plural of an unused noun from the same as שְׁפִיפֹן and meaning the same; serpents; Shuppim, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shuppim.
H8207: From an unused root meaning the same as שׁוּף; a kind of serpent (as snapping), probably the cerastes or horned adder. In the KJV it is rendered: adder.
H8208: From שָׁפַר; beautiful; Shaphir, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Saphir.
H8209: (Aramaic) intensive of a form corresponding to שָׁפִיר; beautiful. In the KJV it is rendered: fair.
H8210: A primitive root; to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out. In the KJV it is rendered: cast (up), gush out, pour (out), shed(-der, out), slip.
H8211: From שָׁפַך; an emptying place, e.g. an ash-heap. In the KJV it is rendered: are poured out.
H8212: Feminine of a derivative from שָׁפַך; a pipe (for pouring forth, e.g. wine), i.e. the penis. In the KJV it is rendered: privy member.
H8213: A primitive root; to depress or sink (expec. figuratively, to humiliate, intransitive or transitive). In the KJV it is rendered: abase, bring (cast, put) down, debase, humble (self), be (bring, lay, make, put) low(-er).
H8214: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁפֵל. In the KJV it is rendered: abase, humble, put down, subdue.
H8215: (Aramaic) from שְׁפַל; low. In the KJV it is rendered: basest.
H8216: From שָׁפֵל; an humble rank. In the KJV it is rendered: low estate (place).
H8217: From שָׁפֵל; depressed, literally or figuratively. In the KJV it is rendered: base(-st), humble, low(-er, -ly).
H8218: Feminine of שֵׁ֫פֶל; depression. In the KJV it is rendered: low place.
H8219: From שָׁפֵל; Lowland, i.e. (with the article) the maritime slope of Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: low country, (low) plain, vale(-ley).
H8220: From שָׁפֵל; remissness. In the KJV it is rendered: idleness.
H8221: Probably from שָׁפָה; bare spot; Shepham, a place in or near Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Shepham.
H8222: From שָׂפָה; the beard (as a lip-piece). In the KJV it is rendered: beard, (upper) lip.
H8223: Formed like שְׁפָם; baldly; Shapham, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shapham.
H8224: Feminine plural of שְׁפָם; Siphmoth, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Siphmoth.
H8225: Patrial from שְׁפָם; a Shiphmite or inhabitant of Shepham. In the KJV it is rendered: Shiphmite.
H8226: A primitive root; to conceal (as a valuable). In the KJV it is rendered: treasure.
H8227: From שָׂפַן; a species of rock-rabbit (from its hiding), i.e. probably the hyrax. In the KJV it is rendered: coney.
H8228: From an unused root meaning to abound; resources. In the KJV it is rendered: abundance.
H8229: Feminine of שֶׁ֫פַע; copiousness. In the KJV it is rendered: abundance, company, multitude.
H8230: From שֶׁ֫פַע; copious; Shiphi, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shiphi.
H8231: A primitive root; to glisten, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) fair. In the KJV it is rendered: X goodly.
H8232: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁפַר; to be beautiful. In the KJV it is rendered: be acceptable, please, + think good.
H8233: From שָׁפַר; beauty. In the KJV it is rendered: X goodly.
H8234: The same as שָׁ֫פֶר; Shepher, a place in the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Shapper.
H8235: From שָׁפַר; brightness. In the KJV it is rendered: garnish.
H8236: The same as שִׁפְרָה; Shiphrah, an Israelitess. In the KJV it is rendered: Shiphrah.
H8237: From שָׁפַר; splendid, i.e. a tapestry or canopy. In the KJV it is rendered: royal pavilion.
