H8238: (Aramaic) from שָׁפַר; the dawn (as brilliant with aurora). In the KJV it is rendered: X very early in the morning.
H8239: A primitive root; to locate, i.e. (generally) hang on or (figuratively) establish, reduce. In the KJV it is rendered: bring, ordain, set on.
H8240: From שָׁפַת; a (double) stall (for cattle); also a (two-pronged) hook (for flaying animals on). In the KJV it is rendered: hook, pot.
H8241: From שָׁטַף (for alliteration with קָ֫צֶף); an outburst (of anger). In the KJV it is rendered: little.
H8242: From שָׁקַק; properly, a mesh (as allowing a liquid to run through), i.e. coarse loose cloth or sacking (used in mourning and for bagging); hence, a bag (for grain, etc.). In the KJV it is rendered: sack(-cloth, -clothes).
H8243: (Aramaic) corresponding to שׁוֹק; the leg. In the KJV it is rendered: leg.
H8244: A primitive root; to fasten. In the KJV it is rendered: bind.
H8245: A primitive root; to be alert, i.e. sleepless; hence to be on the lookout (whether for good or ill). In the KJV it is rendered: hasten, remain, wake, watch (for).
H8246: A denominative from שָׁקֵד; to be (intensively, make) almond-shaped. In the KJV it is rendered: make like (unto, after the fashion of) almonds.
H8247: From שָׁקַד; the almond (tree or nut; as being the earliest in bloom). In the KJV it is rendered: almond (tree).
H8248: A primitive root; to quaff, i.e. (causatively) to irrigate or furnish a potion to. In the KJV it is rendered: cause to (give, give to, let, make to) drink, drown, moisten, water.
H8249: From שָׁקָה; (plural collective) a draught. In the KJV it is rendered: drink.
H8250: From שָׁקָה; a beverage; moisture, i.e. (figuratively) refreshment. In the KJV it is rendered: drink, marrow.
H8251: Or shiqquts; from שָׁקַץ; disgusting, i.e. filthy; especially idolatrous or (concretely) an idol. In the KJV it is rendered: abominable filth (idol, -ation), detestable (thing).
H8252: A primitive root; to repose (usually figurative). In the KJV it is rendered: appease, idleness, (at, be at, be in, give) quiet(-ness), (be at, be in, give, have, take) rest, settle, be still.
H8253: From שָׁקַט; tranquillity. In the KJV it is rendered: quietness.
H8254: A primitive root; to suspend or poise (especially in trade). In the KJV it is rendered: pay, receive(-r), spend, X throughly, weigh.
H8255: From שָׁקַל; probably a weight; used as a commercial standard. In the KJV it is rendered: shekel.
H8256: Or (feminine) shiqmah; of uncertain derivation; a sycamore (usually the tree). In the KJV it is rendered: sycamore (fruit, tree).
H8257: (abbreviated Am. 8:8); a primitive root; to subside; by implication, to be overflowed, cease; causatively, to abate, subdue. In the KJV it is rendered: make deep, let down, drown, quench, sink.
H8258: From שָׁקַע; a depression. In the KJV it is rendered: hollow strake.
H8259: A primitive root; properly, to lean out (of a window), i.e. (by implication) peep or gaze (passively, be a spectacle). In the KJV it is rendered: appear, look (down, forth, out).
H8260: From שָׁקַף; a loophole (for looking out), to admit light and air. In the KJV it is rendered: window.
H8261: Passive participle of שָׁקַף; an embrasure or opening (compare שָׁ֫קֶף) with bevelled jam. In the KJV it is rendered: light, window.
H8262: A primitive root; to be filthy, i.e. (intensively) to loathe, pollute. In the KJV it is rendered: abhor, make abominable, have in abomination, detest, X utterly.
H8263: From שָׁקַץ; filth, i.e. (figuratively and specifically) an idolatrous object. In the KJV it is rendered: abominable(-tion).
H8264: A primitive root; to course (like a beast of prey); by implication, to seek greedily. In the KJV it is rendered: have appetite, justle one against another, long, range, run (to and fro).
H8265: A primitive root; to ogle, i.e. blink coquettishly. In the KJV it is rendered: wanton.
H8266: A primitive root; to cheat, i.e. be untrue (usually in words). In the KJV it is rendered: fail, deal falsely, lie.
H8267: From שָׁקַר; an untruth; by implication, a sham (often adverbial). In the KJV it is rendered: without a cause, deceit(-ful), false(-hood, -ly), feignedly, liar, + lie, lying, vain (thing), wrongfully.
H8268: From שָׁקָה; a trough (for watering). In the KJV it is rendered: trough.
H8269: From שָׂרַר; a head person (of any rank or class). In the KJV it is rendered: captain (that had rule), chief (captain), general, governor, keeper, lord, ((-task-))master, prince(-ipal), ruler, steward.
H8270: From שֹׁרְרֵי; a string (as twisted (compare שְׁרִירֵי)), i.e. (specifically) the umbilical cord (also figuratively, as the centre of strength). In the KJV it is rendered: navel.
H8271: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to that of שֵׁרוּת; to free, separate; figuratively, to unravel, commence; by implication (of unloading beasts) to reside. In the KJV it is rendered: begin, dissolve, dwell, loose.
H8272: Of foreign derivation; Sharetser, the name of an Assyrian and an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Sharezer.
H8273: From an unused root meaning to glare; quivering glow (of the air), expec. the mirage. In the KJV it is rendered: heat, parched ground.
H8274: From שָׁרָב and יָהּ; Jah has brought heat; Sherebjah, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Sherebiah.
H8275: For שָׁ֫בֶט; a rod of empire. In the KJV it is rendered: sceptre.
H8276: A primitive root; to intwine. In the KJV it is rendered: wrap together, wreath.
H8277: A primitive root; properly, to puncture (compare שֶׂ֫רֶד), i.e. (figuratively through the idea of slipping out) to escape or survive. In the KJV it is rendered: remain.
H8278: From שָׂרַד; stitching (as pierced with a needle). In the KJV it is rendered: service.
H8279: From שָׂרַד; a (carpenter's) scribing-awl (for pricking or scratching measurements). In the KJV it is rendered: line.
H8280: A primitive root; to prevail. In the KJV it is rendered: have power (as a prince).
H8281: A primitive root; to free. In the KJV it is rendered: direct.
H8282: Feminine of שָׂר; a mistress, i.e. female noble. In the KJV it is rendered: lady, princess, queen.
H8283: The same as שָׂרַת; Sarah, Abraham's wife. In the KJV it is rendered: Sarah.
H8284: Probably feminine of שׁוּר; a fortification (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: sing (by mistake for shiyr), wall.
H8285: From שֹׁרְרֵי in its original sense of pressing; a wrist-band (as compact or clasping). In the KJV it is rendered: bracelet.
H8286: From שָׂרַג; tendril; Serug, a postdiluvian patriarch. In the KJV it is rendered: Serug.
H8287: Probably from שָׁרָה (in the sense of dwelling (compare שְׁרָא) and חֵן; abode of pleasure; Sharuchen, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Sharuhen.
H8288: From שָׂרַך; a thong (as laced or tied). In the KJV it is rendered: ((shoe-)) latchet.
H8289: Probably abridged from יָשַׁר; plain, Sharon, the name of a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Lasharon, Sharon.
H8290: Patrial from NONE; a Sharonite or inhabitant of Sharon. In the KJV it is rendered: Sharonite.
H8291: Passive participle from the same as שֹׂרֵק; a grapevine. In the KJV it is rendered: principal plant.
H8292: Or (by permutation) shriyqah; feminine passive participle of שָׁרַק; a whistling (in scorn); by analogy, a piping. In the KJV it is rendered: bleating, hissing.
H8293: From שָׁרָה abbreviated; freedom. In the KJV it is rendered: remnant.
H8294: By permutation for סֶ֫רַח; superfluity; Serach, an Israelitess. In the KJV it is rendered: Sarah, Serah.
H8295: A primitive root; to gash. In the KJV it is rendered: cut in pieces, make (cuttings) pieces.
H8296: And sareteth; from שָׂרַט; an incision. In the KJV it is rendered: cutting.
H8297: From שָׂר; dominative; Sarai, the wife of Abraham. In the KJV it is rendered: Sarai.
H8298: Probably from שֹׁרְרֵי; hostile; Sharay, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Sharai.
H8299: From שָׂרַג; a tendril (as entwining). In the KJV it is rendered: branch.
H8300: From שָׂרַד; a survivor. In the KJV it is rendered: X alive, left, remain(- ing), remnant, rest.
H8301: The same as שָׂרִיד; Sarid, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Sarid.
H8302: Or shiryon; and shiryan; also (feminine) shiryah; and shiryonah; from שָׁרָה in the original sense of turning; a corslet (as if twisted). In the KJV it is rendered: breastplate, coat of mail, habergeon, harness.
H8303: And Siryon; the same as שְׂרָיָה (i.e. sheeted with snow); Shirjon or Sirjon, a peak of the Lebanon. In the KJV it is rendered: Sirion.
H8304: Or Srayahuw; from שָׂרָה and יָהּ; Jah has prevailed; Serajah, the name of nine Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Seraiah.
H8305: From the same as שֹׂרֵק in the original sense of piercing; hetchelling (or combing flax), i.e. (concretely) tow (by extension, linen cloth). In the KJV it is rendered: fine.
H8306: From שֹׁרְרֵי in the original sense as in שֹׁר (compare שֹׁ֫רֶר); a cord, i.e. (by analogy) sinew. In the KJV it is rendered: navel.
H8307: From שֹׁרְרֵי in the sense of twisted, i.e. firm; obstinacy. In the KJV it is rendered: imagination, lust.
H8308: A primitive root; to interlace. In the KJV it is rendered: traverse.
H8309: Probably by an orthographical error for שַׁדְמוֹת; a common. In the KJV it is rendered: field.
H8310: Of foreign derivation; Sarsekim, a Babylonian general. In the KJV it is rendered: Sarsechim.
H8311: A primitive root; to prolong, i.e. (reflex) be deformed by excess of members. In the KJV it is rendered: stretch out self, (have any) superfluous thing.
H8312: For סְעִפִּים; cogitation. In the KJV it is rendered: thought.
H8313: A primitive root; to be (causatively, set) on fire. In the KJV it is rendered: (cause to, make a) burn((-ing), up) kindle, X utterly.
H8314: From שָׂרַף; burning, i.e. (figuratively) poisonous (serpent); specifically, a saraph or symbolical creature (from their copper color). In the KJV it is rendered: fiery (serpent), seraph.
H8315: The same as שָׂרָף; Saraph, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Saraph.
H8316: From שָׂרַף; cremation. In the KJV it is rendered: burning.
H8317: A primitive root; to wriggle, i.e. (by implication) swarm or abound. In the KJV it is rendered: breed (bring forth, increase) abundantly (in abundance), creep, move.
H8318: From שָׁרַץ; a swarm, i.e. active mass of minute animals. In the KJV it is rendered: creep(-ing thing), move(-ing creature).
H8319: A primitive root; properly, to be shrill, i.e. to whistle or hiss (as a call or in scorn). In the KJV it is rendered: hiss.
H8320: From שָׁרַק; bright red (as piercing to the sight), i.e. bay. In the KJV it is rendered: speckled.
H8321: Or sowreq; and (feminine) soreqah; from שָׁרַק in the sense of redness (compare שְׂרֻקִּים); a vine stock (properly, one yielding purple grapes, the richest variety). In the KJV it is rendered: choice(-st, noble) wine.
H8322: From שָׁרַק; a derision. In the KJV it is rendered: hissing.
H8323: A primitive root; to have (transitively, exercise; reflexively, get) dominion. In the KJV it is rendered: X altogether, make self a prince, (bear) rule.
H8324: A primitive root; to be hostile (only active participle an opponent). In the KJV it is rendered: enemy.
H8325: From שֹׁרְרֵי; hostile; Sharar, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Sharar.
H8326: From שֹׁרְרֵי in the sense of twisting (compare שֹׁר); the umbilical cord, i.e. (by extension) a bodice. In the KJV it is rendered: navel.
H8327: A primitive root; to root, i.e. strike into the soil, or (by implication) to pluck from it. In the KJV it is rendered: (take, cause to take) root (out).
H8328: From שָׁרַשׁ; a root (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: bottom, deep, heel, root.
H8329: The same as שֹׁ֫רֶשׁ; Sheresh, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Sharesh.
H8330: (Aramaic) corresponding to שֹׁ֫רֶשׁ. In the KJV it is rendered: root.
H8331: From שָׁרַשׁ; a chain (as rooted, i.e. linked). In the KJV it is rendered: chain.
H8332: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to שָׁרַשׁ; eradication, i.e. (figuratively) exile. In the KJV it is rendered: banishment.
H8333: From שָׁרַשׁ (compare שַׁרְשֹׁת); a chain; (arch.) probably a garland. In the KJV it is rendered: chain.
H8334: A primitive root; to attend as a menial or worshipper; figuratively, to contribute to. In the KJV it is rendered: minister (unto), (do) serve(- ant, -ice, -itor), wait on.
H8335: Infinitive of שָׁרַת; service (in the Temple). In the KJV it is rendered: minister(-ry).
H8336: Or (for alliteration with מֶ֫שִׁי) shshiy; for שַׁ֫יִשׁ; bleached stuff, i.e. white linen or (by analogy) marble. In the KJV it is rendered: X blue, fine ((twined)) linen, marble, silk.
H8337: Masculine shishshah; a primitive number; six (as an overplus (see שׂוּשׂ) beyond five or the fingers of the hand); as ord. sixth. In the KJV it is rendered: six((-teen, -teenth)), sixth.
H8338: A primitive root; apparently, to annihilate. In the KJV it is rendered: leave by the sixth part (by confusion with shashah).
H8339: Of foreign derivation; Sheshbatstsar, Zerubbabel's Persian name. In the KJV it is rendered: Sheshbazzar.
H8340: (Aramaic) corresponding to שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר. In the KJV it is rendered: Sheshbazzar.
H8341: A denominative from שֵׁשׁ; to sixth or divide into sixths:--give the sixth participle.
H8342: Or sason; from שׂוּשׂ; cheerfulness; specifically, welcome. In the KJV it is rendered: gladness, joy, mirth, rejoicing.
H8343: Perhaps from שֵׁשׁ; whitish; Shashai, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shashai.
H8344: Probably for שָׁשַׁי; Sheshai, a Canaanite. In the KJV it is rendered: Sheshai.
H8345: From שֵׁשׁ; sixth, ord. or (feminine) fractional. In the KJV it is rendered: sixth (part).
H8346: Multiple of שֵׁשׁ; sixty. In the KJV it is rendered: sixty, three score.
H8347: Of foreign derivation; Sheshak, a symbol. name of Babylon. In the KJV it is rendered: Sheshach.
H8348: Perhaps for שׁוֹשָׁן; lily; Sheshan, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Sheshan.
H8349: Probably from the base of שׁוֹק; pedestrian; Shashak, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Shashak.
H8350: Perhaps from the base of שֹׁרְרֵי in the sense of that of שְׂרֻקִּים; red ochre (from its piercing color). In the KJV it is rendered: vermillion.
H8351: (Numbers from שָׁאָה; tumult. In the KJV it is rendered: Sheth.
H8352: From שִׁית; put, i.e. substituted; Sheth, third son of Adam. In the KJV it is rendered: Seth, Sheth.
H8353: (Aramaic) or shith (Aramaic); corresponding to שֵׁשׁ. In the KJV it is rendered: six(-th).
H8354: A primitive root; to imbibe (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: X assuredly, banquet, X certainly, drink(-er, -ing), drunk (X -ard), surely.
H8355: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁתָה. In the KJV it is rendered: drink.
H8356: From שִׁית; a basis, i.e. (figuratively) political or moral support. In the KJV it is rendered: foundation, purpose.
H8357: From שִׁית; the seat (of the person). In the KJV it is rendered: buttock.
H8358: From שָׁתָה; intoxicaion. In the KJV it is rendered: drunkenness.
H8359: From שִׁית; a fixture, i.e. the warp in weaving. In the KJV it is rendered: warp.
H8360: Feminine of שְׁתִי; potation. In the KJV it is rendered: drinking.
H8361: (Aramaic) corresponding to שִׁשִּׁים (compare שִׁת); sixty. In the KJV it is rendered: threescore.
H8362: A primitive root; to transplant. In the KJV it is rendered: plant.
H8363: From שָׁתַל; a sprig (as if transplanted), i.e. sucker. In the KJV it is rendered: plant.
H8364: Patronymically from שׁוּתָ֫לַח; a Shuthalchite (collectively) or descendants of Shuthelach. In the KJV it is rendered: Shuthalhites.
H8365: A primitive root; to unveil (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: be open.
H8366: A primitive root; (causatively) to make water, i.e. urinate. In the KJV it is rendered: piss.
H8367: A primitive root; to subside. In the KJV it is rendered: be calm, cease, be quiet.
H8368: A primitive root; to break out (as an eruption). In the KJV it is rendered: have in (one's) secret parts.
H8369: Of foreign derivation; Shethar, a Persian satrap. In the KJV it is rendered: Shethar.
H8370: Of foreign derivation; Shethar-Bozenai, a Persian officer. In the KJV it is rendered: Shethar-boznai.
H8371: A primitive root; to place, i.e. array; reflex. to lie. In the KJV it is rendered: be laid, set.
H8372: And (feminine) ta ah (Ezek. 40:12); from (the base of) תָּאַו; a room (as circumscribed). In the KJV it is rendered: (little) chamber.
H8373: A primitive root; to desire. In the KJV it is rendered: long.
H8374: A primitive root (probably identical with תָּאַב through the idea of puffing disdainfully at; compare אָיַב); to loathe (morally). In the KJV it is rendered: abhor.
H8375: From תָּאַב (compare אָבִי); desire. In the KJV it is rendered: longing.
H8376: A primitive root; to mark off, i.e. (intensively) designate. In the KJV it is rendered: point out.
H8377: And towt (the original form); from תָּאַו; a species of antelope (probably from the white stripe on the cheek). In the KJV it is rendered: wild bull (ox).
H8378: From אָוָה (abbreviated); a longing; by implication, a delight (subjectively, satisfaction, objectively, a charm). In the KJV it is rendered: dainty, desire, X exceedingly, X greedily, lust(ing), pleasant.
H8379: From תָּאַו; a limit, i.e. full extent. In the KJV it is rendered: utmost bound.
H8380: Or taom; from תָּאַם; a twin (in plural only), literally or figuratively. In the KJV it is rendered: twins.
H8381: From אָלָה; an imprecation. In the KJV it is rendered: curse.
H8382: A primitive root; to be complete; but used only as denominative from תְאוֹמִים, to be (causatively, make) twinned, i.e. (figuratively) duplicate or (arch.) jointed. In the KJV it is rendered: coupled (together), bear twins.
H8383: From אָ֫וֶן; naughtiness, i.e. toil. In the KJV it is rendered: lie.
H8384: Or (in the singular, feminine) t:enah; perhaps of foreign derivation; the fig (tree or fruit). In the KJV it is rendered: fig (tree).
H8385: Or tonanah; from אָנָה; an opportunity or (subjectively) purpose. In the KJV it is rendered: occasion.
H8386: From אָנָה; lamentation. In the KJV it is rendered: heaviness, mourning.
H8387: From תַּאֲנַת and שִׁלֹה; approach of Shiloh; Taanath-Shiloh, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Taanath-shiloh.
H8388: A primitive root; to delineate; reflex. to extend. In the KJV it is rendered: be drawn, mark out, (Rimmon-)methoar (by union with Rimmown).
H8389: From תָּאַר; outline, i.e. figure or appearance. In the KJV it is rendered: + beautiful, X comely, countenance, + fair, X favoured, form, X goodly, X resemble, visage.
H8390: Perhaps from אַרְעָא; Taarea, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Tarea.
H8391: From אָשַׁר; a species of cedar (from its erectness). In the KJV it is rendered: box (tree).
H8392: Perhaps of foreign derivation; a box. In the KJV it is rendered: ark.
H8393: From בּוֹא; income, i.e. produce (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: fruit, gain, increase, revenue.
H8394: And (feminine) tbuwnah; or towbunah; from בִּין; intelligence; by implication, an argument; by extension, caprice. In the KJV it is rendered: discretion, reason, skilfulness, understanding, wisdom.
H8395: From בּוּס; a treading down, i.e. ruin. In the KJV it is rendered: destruction.
H8396: From a root corresponding to תְּבַר; broken region; Tabor, a mountain in Palestine, also a city adjacent. In the KJV it is rendered: Tabor.
H8397: Apparently from בָּלַל; mixture, i.e. unnatural bestiality. In the KJV it is rendered: confusion.
H8398: From יָבַל; the earth (as moist and therefore inhabited); by extension, the globe; by implication, its inhabitants; specifically, a partic. land, as Babylonia, Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: habitable part, world.
H8399: From בָּלָה; consumption. In the KJV it is rendered: destruction.
H8400: From בָּלַל in the original sense of flowing: a cataract (in the eye). In the KJV it is rendered: blemish.
H8401: Probably from בָּנָה; properly, material, i.e. (specifically) refuse haum or stalks of grain (as chopped in threshing and used for fodder). In the KJV it is rendered: chaff, straw, stubble.
H8402: From תֶּ֫בֶן; strawy; Tibni, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Tibni.
H8403: From בָּנָה; structure; by implication, a model, resemblance. In the KJV it is rendered: figure, form, likeness, pattern, similitude.
H8404: From בָּעַר; burning; Taberah, a place in the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Taberah.
H8405: From the same as בּוּץ; whiteness; Tebets, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Thebez.
H8406: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁבַר; to be fragile (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: broken.
H8407: Or Tiglath Plecer; or Tilgath Pilnlecer or Tilgath Pilnecer; of foreign derivation; Tiglath- Pileser or Tilgath-pilneser, an Assyr. king. In the KJV it is rendered: Tiglath-pileser, Tilgath- pilneser.
H8408: From גָּמַל; a bestowment. In the KJV it is rendered: benefit.
H8409: From גָּרָה; strife, i.e. infliction. In the KJV it is rendered: blow.
H8410: Apparently from דָּהַר; enduring; a species of hard-wood or lasting tree (perhaps oak). In the KJV it is rendered: pine (tree).
H8411: (Aramaic) from דּוּר in the original sense of enduring; permanence, i.e. (adverb) constantly. In the KJV it is rendered: continually.
H8412: Or Tammor (1 Kings 9:18); apparently from תָּמָר; palm-city; Tadmor, a place near Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Tadmor.
H8413: Perhaps from דְּחַל; fearfulness; Tidal, a Canaanite. In the KJV it is rendered: Tidal.
H8414: From an unused root meaning to lie waste; a desolation (of surface), i.e. desert; figuratively, a worthless thing; adverbially, in vain. In the KJV it is rendered: confusion, empty place, without form, nothing, (thing of) nought, vain, vanity, waste, wilderness.
H8415: Or thom; (usually feminine) from הוּם; an abyss (as a surging mass of water), especially the deep (the main sea or the subterranean water-supply). In the KJV it is rendered: deep (place), depth.
H8416: From הָלַל; laudation; specifically (concretely) a hymn. In the KJV it is rendered: praise.
H8417: Feminine of an unused noun (apparently from הָלַל) meaning bluster; braggadocio, i.e. (by implication) fatuity. In the KJV it is rendered: folly.
H8418: From הָלַך; a procession. In the KJV it is rendered: X went.
H8419: From הָפַך; a perversity or fraud. In the KJV it is rendered: (very) froward(-ness, thing), perverse thing.
H8420: From תָּוָה; a mark; by implication, a signature. In the KJV it is rendered: desire, mark.
H8421: (Aramaic) corresponding to שׁוּב, to come back; specifically (transitive and ellip.) to reply. In the KJV it is rendered: answer, restore, return (an answer).
H8422: Or Tubal; probably of foreign derivation; Tubal, a postdiluvian patriarch and his posterity. In the KJV it is rendered: Tubal.
H8423: Apparently from יָבַל (compare יְבוּל) and קָ֫יִן; offspring of Cain; Tubal-Kajin, an antidiluvian patriarch. In the KJV it is rendered: Tubal-cain.
H8424: From יָגָה; depression (of spirits); concretely a grief. In the KJV it is rendered: heaviness, sorrow.
H8425: Or Togarmah; probably of foreign derivation; Togarmah, a son of Gomer and his posterity. In the KJV it is rendered: Togarmah.
H8426: From יָדָה; properly, an extension of the hand, i.e. (by implication) avowal, or (usually) adoration; specifically, a choir of worshippers. In the KJV it is rendered: confession, (sacrifice of) praise, thanks(-giving, offering).
H8427: A primitive root; to mark out, i.e. (primitive) scratch or (definite) imprint. In the KJV it is rendered: scrabble, set (a mark).
H8428: A primitive root (or perhaps ident. with תָּוָה through a similar idea from scraping to pieces); to grieve. In the KJV it is rendered: limit (by confusion with tavah).
H8429: (Aramaic) corresponding to תָּמַהּ or perhaps to שָׁאָה through the idea of sweeping to ruin (compare תָּוָה); to amaze, i.e. (reflex. by implication) take alarm. In the KJV it is rendered: be astonied.
H8430: From an unused root meaning to depress; humble; Toach, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Toah.
H8431: From יָחַל; expectation. In the KJV it is rendered: hope.
H8432: From an unused root meaning to sever; a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre. In the KJV it is rendered: among(-st), X between, half, X (there-,where-), in(-to), middle, mid(-night), midst (among), X out (of), X through, X with(-in).
H8433: And towkachath; from יָכַח; chastisement; figuratively (by words) correction, refutation, proof (even in defence). In the KJV it is rendered: argument, X chastened, correction, reasoning, rebuke, reproof, X be (often) reproved.
H8434: From יָלַד; posterity; Tolad, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Tolad.
H8435: Or toldah; from יָלַד; (plural only) descent, i.e. family; (figuratively) history. In the KJV it is rendered: birth, generations.
H8436: From תָּלַל; suspension; Tulon, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Tilon (from the margin).
H8437: From יָלַל; causing to howl, i.e. an oppressor. In the KJV it is rendered: that wasted.
H8438: And (feminine) towleoah; or towla ath; or tolaiath; from יָלַע; a maggot (as voracious); specifically (often with ellipsis of שָׁנִי) the crimson-grub, but used only (in this connection) of the color from it, and cloths dyed therewith. In the KJV it is rendered: crimson, scarlet, worm.
H8439: The same as תּוֹלָע; worm; Tola, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Tola.
H8440: Patronymically from תּוֹלָע; a Tolaite (collectively) or descendants of Tola. In the KJV it is rendered: Tolaites.
H8441: Or tonebah; feminine active participle of תָּעַב; properly, something disgusting (morally), i.e. (as noun) an abhorrence; especially idolatry or (concretely) an idol. In the KJV it is rendered: abominable (custom, thing), abomination.
H8442: Feminine active participle of תָּעָה; mistake, i.e. (morally) impiety, or (political) injury. In the KJV it is rendered: error, hinder.
H8443: From יָעַף; (only in plural collective) weariness, i.e. (by implication) toil (treasure so obtained) or speed. In the KJV it is rendered: plenty, strength.
H8444: Or totsaah; from יָצָא; (only in plural collective) exit, i.e. (geographical) boundary, or (figuratively) deliverance, (actively) source. In the KJV it is rendered: border(-s), going(-s) forth (out), issues, outgoings.
H8445: From the same as יִקְּהַת; obedience; Tokahath, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Tikvath (by correction for Tiqvah).
H8446: A primitive root; to meander (causatively, guide) about, especially for trade or reconnoitring. In the KJV it is rendered: chap(-man), sent to descry, be excellent, merchant(-man), search (out), seek, (e-)spy (out).
H8447: Or tor; from תּוּר; a succession, i.e. a string or (abstractly) order. In the KJV it is rendered: border, row, turn.
H8448: Probably the same as תֹּרִים; a manner (as a sort of turn). In the KJV it is rendered: estate.
H8449: Or tor; probably the same as תֹּרִים; a ring-dove, often (figuratively) as a term of endearment. In the KJV it is rendered: (turtle) dove.
H8450: (Aramaic) corresponding (by permutation) to שׁוֹר; a bull. In the KJV it is rendered: bullock, ox.
H8451: Or torah; from יָרָה; a precept or statute, especially the Decalogue or Pentateuch. In the KJV it is rendered: law.
H8452: Probably feminine of תּוֹר; a custom. In the KJV it is rendered: manner.
H8453: Or toshab (1 Kings 17:1); from יָשַׁב; a dweller (but not outlandish (נָכְרִי)); especially (as distinguished from a native citizen (active participle of יָשַׁב) and a temporary inmate (גֵּר) or mere lodger (לוּן)) resident alien. In the KJV it is rendered: foreigner, inhabitant, sojourner, stranger.
H8454: Or tushiyah; from an unused root probably meaning to substantiate; support or (by implication) ability, i.e. (direct) help, (in purpose) an undertaking, (intellectual) understanding. In the KJV it is rendered: enterprise, that which (thing as it) is, substance, (sound) wisdom, working.
H8455: From an unused root meaning to smite; a club. In the KJV it is rendered: darts.
H8456: A primitive root; to lop off. In the KJV it is rendered: cut down.
H8457: Or taznuth; from זָנָה; harlotry, i.e. (figuratively) idolatry. In the KJV it is rendered: fornication, whoredom.
H8458: Or tachbuwlah; from חָבַל as denominative from חֵ֫בֶל; (only in plural) properly, steerage (as a management of ropes), i.e. (figuratively) guidance or (by implication) a plan. In the KJV it is rendered: good advice, (wise) counsels.
H8459: From an unused root meaning to depress; abasement; Tochu, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Tohu.
H8460: (Aramaic) or tchoth (Aramaic); corresponding to תָּ֫חַת; beneath. In the KJV it is rendered: under.
H8461: Probably for חַכְמוֹנִי; sagacious; Tachkemoni, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Tachmonite.
H8462: From חָלַל in the sense of opening; a commencement; rel. original (adverb, -ly). In the KJV it is rendered: begin(-ning), first (time).
H8463: Or tachalui; from חָלָא; a malady. In the KJV it is rendered: disease, X grievous, (that are) sick(-ness).
H8464: From חָמַס; a species of unclean bird (from its violence), perhaps an owl. In the KJV it is rendered: night hawk.
H8465: Probably from חָנָה; station; Tachan, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Tahan.
H8466: From חָנָה; (only plural collectively) an encampment. In the KJV it is rendered: camp.
H8467: From חָנַן; graciousness; causatively, entreaty. In the KJV it is rendered: favour, grace, supplication.
H8468: The same as תְּחִנָּה; Techinnah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Tehinnah.
H8469: Or (feminine) tachanuwnah; from חָנַן; earnest prayer. In the KJV it is rendered: intreaty, supplication.
H8470: Patronymically from תַּ֫חַן; a Tachanite (collectively) or descendants of Tachan. In the KJV it is rendered: Tahanites.
H8471: Or Tchaphnchec (Ezek. 30:18); or Tachpnec (Jeremiah 2:16); of Egyptian derivation; Tachpanches, Techaphneches or Tachpenes, a place in Egypt. In the KJV it is rendered: Tahapanes, Tahpanhes, Tehaphnehes.
H8472: Of Egyptian derivation; Tachpenes, an Egyptian woman. In the KJV it is rendered: Tahpenes.
H8473: From חָרָה in the original sense of חֻר or חוּר; a linen corslet (as white or hollow). In the KJV it is rendered: habergeon.
H8474: A facitious root from חָרָה through the idea of the heat of jealousy; to vie with a rival. In the KJV it is rendered: close, contend.
H8475: For תַּאְרֵ֫עַ; Tachrea, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Tahrea.
H8476: Probably of foreign derivation; a (clean) animal with fur, probably a species of antelope. In the KJV it is rendered: badger.
H8477: The same as תָּ֫חַשׁ; Tachash, a relative of Abraham. In the KJV it is rendered: Thahash.
H8478: From the same as תּ֫וֹחַ; the bottom (as depressed); only adverbially, below (often with prepositional prefix underneath), in lieu of, etc. In the KJV it is rendered: as, beneath, X flat, in(-stead), (same) place (where.
H8479: (Aramaic) corresponding to תָּ֫חַת. In the KJV it is rendered: under.
H8480: The same as תָּ֫חַת; Tachath, the name of a place in the Desert, also of three Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Tahath.
H8481: Or tachton; from תָּ֫חַת; bottommost. In the KJV it is rendered: lower(-est), nether(-most).
H8482: From תָּ֫חַת; lowermost; as noun (feminine plural) the depths (figuratively, a pit, the womb). In the KJV it is rendered: low (parts, -er, -er parts, - est), nether (part).
H8483: Apparently from the plural masculine of תַּחְתִּי or תָּ֫חַת and חֹ֫דֶשׁ; lower (ones) monthly; Tachtim-Chodshi, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Tahtim-hodshi.
H8484: Or tiykon; from תָּ֫וֶך; central. In the KJV it is rendered: middle(-most), midst.
H8485: Or Temao; probably of foreign derivation; Tema, a son of Ishmael, and the region settled by him. In the KJV it is rendered: Tema.
H8486: Or teman; denominative from יָמִין; the south (as being on the right hand of a person facing the east). In the KJV it is rendered: south (side, -ward, wind).
H8487: Or Teman; the same as תֵּמָן; Teman, the name of two Edomites, and of the region and descendant of one of them. In the KJV it is rendered: south, Teman.
H8488: Probably for תֵּימָנִי; Temeni, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Temeni.
H8489: Patronymically from תֵּימָן; a Temanite or descendant of Teman. In the KJV it is rendered: Temani, Temanite.
H8490: Or timarah; from the same as תָּמָר; a column, i.e. cloud. In the KJV it is rendered: pillar.
H8491: Patrial or patronymically from an unused noun of uncertain meaning; a Titsite or descendant or inhabitant of an unknown Tits. In the KJV it is rendered: Tizite.
H8492: Or tiyrosh; from יָרַשׁ in the sense of expulsion; must or fresh grape-juice (as just squeezed out); by implication (rarely) fermented wine. In the KJV it is rendered: (new, sweet) wine.
H8493: Probably from יָרֵא; fearful, Tirja, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Tiria.
H8494: Probably of foreign derivation; Tiras, a son of Japheth. In the KJV it is rendered: Tiras.
H8495: From an unused root meaning to butt; a buck or he-goat (as given to butting). In the KJV it is rendered: he goat.
H8496: Or towk (Psa. 72:14); from the same base as תָּ֫וֶך (in the sense of cutting to pieces); oppression. In the KJV it is rendered: deceit, fraud.
H8497: A primitive root; to strew, i.e. encamp. In the KJV it is rendered: sit down.
H8498: Feminine passive participle of תָּכַן; adjustment, i.e. structure; by implication, equipage. In the KJV it is rendered: fashion, store.
H8499: From כּוּן; or probably ident. with תְּכוּנָה; something arranged or fixed, i.e. a place. In the KJV it is rendered: seat.
H8500: Or tuwkkiy; probably of foreign derivation; some imported creature, probably a peacock. In the KJV it is rendered: peacock.
H8501: From an unused root meaning to dissever, i.e. crush. In the KJV it is rendered: deceitful.
H8502: From כָּלָה; completeness. In the KJV it is rendered: perfection.
H8503: From כָּלָה; completion; by implication, an extremity. In the KJV it is rendered: end, perfect(-ion).
H8504: Probably for שְׁחֵ֫לֶ֫ת; the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color (violet) obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith. In the KJV it is rendered: blue.
H8505: A primitive root; to balance, i.e. measure out (by weight or dimension); figuratively, arrange, equalize, through the idea of levelling (ment. estimate, test). In the KJV it is rendered: bear up, direct, be ((un-))equal, mete, ponder, tell, weigh.
H8506: From תָּכַן; a fixed quantity. In the KJV it is rendered: measure, tale.
H8507: The same as תֹּ֫כֶן; Token, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Tochen.
H8508: From תֹּ֫כֶן; admeasurement, i.e. consummation. In the KJV it is rendered: pattern, sum.
H8509: Apparently from an unused root meaning to encompass; a wrapper or robe. In the KJV it is rendered: garment.
H8510: By contraction from תָּלַל; a mound. In the KJV it is rendered: heap, X strength.
H8511: A primitive root; to suspend; figuratively (through hesitation) to be uncertain; by implication (of mental dependence) to habituate. In the KJV it is rendered: be bent, hang (in doubt).
H8512: From תֵּל and אָבִיב; mound of green growth; Tel-Abib, a place in Chaldaea. In the KJV it is rendered: Tel-abib.
H8513: From לָאָה; distress. In the KJV it is rendered: travail, travel, trouble.
H8514: From לַ֫הַב; desiccation. In the KJV it is rendered: great drought.
H8515: Or Tlassar; of foreign derivation; Telassar, a region of Assyria. In the KJV it is rendered: Telassar.
H8516: From לָבַשׁ; a garment. In the KJV it is rendered: clothing.
H8517: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁ֫לֶג; snow. In the KJV it is rendered: snow.
H8518: A primitive root; to suspend (especially to gibbet). In the KJV it is rendered: hang (up).
H8519: Or tlunnah; from לוּן in the sense of obstinacy; a grumbling. In the KJV it is rendered: murmuring.
H8520: Probably from an unused root meaning to dissever; breach; Telach, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Telah.
H8521: From תֵּל and the feminine of חֲרָשִׁים; mound of workmanship; Tel-Charsha, a place in Babylonia. In the KJV it is rendered: Tel-haresha, Tel-harsa.
H8522: Probably from תָּלָה; a quiver (as slung). In the KJV it is rendered: quiver.
H8523: (Aramaic) or taltiy (Aramaic); ordinal from תְּלָת; third. In the KJV it is rendered: third.
H8524: A primitive root; to pile up, i.e. elevate. In the KJV it is rendered: eminent.
H8525: From an unused root meaning to accumulate; a bank or terrace. In the KJV it is rendered: furrow, ridge.
H8526: From תֶּ֫לֶם; ridged; Talmai, the name of a Canaanite and a Syrian. In the KJV it is rendered: Talmai.
H8527: From לָמַד; a pupil. In the KJV it is rendered: scholar.
H8528: From תֵּל and מֶ֫לַח; mound of salt; Tel-Melach, a place in Babylonia. In the KJV it is rendered: Tel-melah.
H8529: A denominative from תּוֹלָע; to crimson, i.e. dye that color. In the KJV it is rendered: X scarlet.
H8530: Feminine from an unused root meaning to tower; something tall, i.e. (plural collective) slenderness. In the KJV it is rendered: armoury.
H8531: (Aramaic) from תְּלָת; a tertiary rank. In the KJV it is rendered: third.
H8532: (Aramaic) masculine tlathah (Aramaic); or tlatha (Aramaic); corresponding to שָׁלוֹשׁ; three or third. In the KJV it is rendered: third, three.
H8533: (Aramaic) mult. of תְּלָת; ten times three. In the KJV it is rendered: thirty.
H8534: By reduplication, from תָּלַל through the idea of vibration; a trailing bough (as pendulous). In the KJV it is rendered: bushy.
H8535: From תָּמַם; complete; usually (morally) pious; specifically, gentle, dear. In the KJV it is rendered: coupled together, perfect, plain, undefiled, upright.
H8536: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁם; there. In the KJV it is rendered: X thence, there, X where.
H8537: From תָּמַם; completeness; figuratively, prosperity; usually (morally) innocence. In the KJV it is rendered: full, integrity, perfect(-ion), simplicity, upright(-ly, -ness), at a venture.
H8538: Feminine of תֹּם; innocence. In the KJV it is rendered: integrity.
H8539: A primitive root; to be in consternation. In the KJV it is rendered: be amazed, be astonished, marvel(-lously), wonder.
H8540: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to תָּמַהּ; a miracle. In the KJV it is rendered: wonder.
H8541: From תָּמַהּ; consternation. In the KJV it is rendered: astonishment.
H8542: Of uncertain derivation; Tammuz, a Phoenician deity. In the KJV it is rendered: Tammuz.
H8543: Or tmol; probably for אֶתְמוֹל; properly, ago, i.e. a (short or long) time since; especially yesterday, or (with שִׁלְשֹׁם) day before yesterday. In the KJV it is rendered: + before (-time), + these (three) days, + heretofore, + time past, yesterday.
H8544: Or tmunah; from מִין; something portioned (i.e. fashioned) out, as a shape, i.e. (indefinitely) phantom, or (specifically) embodiment, or (figuratively) manifestation (of favor). In the KJV it is rendered: image, likeness, similitude.
H8545: From מוּר; barter, compensation. In the KJV it is rendered: (ex-)change(-ing), recompense, restitution.
H8546: From מוּת; execution (as a doom). In the KJV it is rendered: death, die.
H8547: Of uncertain derivation; Temach, one of the Nethinim. In the KJV it is rendered: Tamah, Thamah.
H8548: From an unused root meaning to stretch; properly, continuance (as indefinite extension); but used only (attributively as adjective) constant (or adverbially, constantly); ellipt. the regular (daily) sacrifice. In the KJV it is rendered: alway(-s), continual (employment, -ly), daily, ((n-))ever(-more), perpetual.
H8549: From תָּמַם; entire (literally, figuratively or morally); also (as noun) integrity, truth. In the KJV it is rendered: without blemish, complete, full, perfect, sincerely (-ity), sound, without spot, undefiled, upright(-ly), whole.
H8550: Plural of תֹּם; perfections, i.e. (techn.) one of the epithets of the objects in the high-priest's breastplate as an emblem of complete Truth. In the KJV it is rendered: Thummim.
H8551: A primitive root; to sustain; by implication, to obtain, keep fast; figuratively, to help, follow close. In the KJV it is rendered: (take, up-)hold (up), maintain, retain, stay (up).
H8552: A primitive root; to complete, in a good or a bad sense, literal, or figurative, transitive or intransitive (as follows). In the KJV it is rendered: accomplish, cease, be clean (pass-)ed, consume, have done, (come to an, have an, make an) end, fail, come to the full, be all gone, X be all here, be (make) perfect, be spent, sum, be (shew self) upright, be wasted, whole.
H8553: From מָנָא; a portion assigned; Timnah, the name of two places in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Timnah, Timnath, Thimnathah.
H8554: Patrial from תִמְנָה; a Timnite or inhabitant of Timnah. In the KJV it is rendered: Timnite.
H8555: From מָנַע; restraint; Timna, the name of two Edomites. In the KJV it is rendered: Timna, Timnah.
H8556: Or Timnath Cerach; from תִמְנָה and חָ֫רֶס; portion of (the) sun; Timnath-Cheres, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Timnath-heres, Timnath-serah.
H8557: From מָסָה; liquefaction, i.e. disappearance. In the KJV it is rendered: melt.
H8558: From an unused root meaning to be erect; a palm tree. In the KJV it is rendered: palm (tree).
H8559: The same as תָּמָר; Tamar, the name of three women and a place. In the KJV it is rendered: Tamar.
H8560: From the same root as תָּמָר; a palm trunk. In the KJV it is rendered: palm tree.
H8561: Plural or feminine timmorah (singular and plural); from the same root as תָּמָר; (arch.) a palm-like pilaster (i.e. umbellate). In the KJV it is rendered: palm tree.
H8562: Or tamruq; or tamriyq; from מָרַק; properly, a scouring, i.e. soap or perfumery for the bath; figuratively, a detergent. In the KJV it is rendered: X cleanse, (thing for) purification(-fying).
H8563: From מָרַר; bitterness (plural as collective). In the KJV it is rendered: X most bitter(-ly).
H8564: From the same root as תָּמָר; an erection, i.e. pillar (probably for a guide-board). In the KJV it is rendered: high heap.
H8565: From an unused root probably meaning to elongate; a monster (as preternaturally formed), i.e. a sea-serpent (or other huge marine animal); also a jackal (or other hideous land animal). In the KJV it is rendered: dragon, whale.
H8566: A primitive root; to present (a mercenary inducement), i.e. bargain with (a harlot). In the KJV it is rendered: hire.
H8567: A primitive root (identical with תָּנָה through the idea of attributing honor); to ascribe (praise), i.e. celebrate, commemorate. In the KJV it is rendered: lament, rehearse.
H8568: Probably feminine of תַּנִּים; a female jackal. In the KJV it is rendered: dragon.
H8569: From נוּא; alienation; by implication, enmity. In the KJV it is rendered: breach of promise, occasion.
H8570: From נוּב; produce. In the KJV it is rendered: fruit, increase.
H8571: Perhaps from the same as אֲנָך through the idea of protraction; a pinnacle, i.e. extremity. In the KJV it is rendered: tip.
H8572: From נוּם; drowsiness, i.e. sleep. In the KJV it is rendered: slumber(-ing).
H8573: From נוּף; a brandishing (in threat); by implication, tumult; specifically, the official undulation of sacrificial offerings. In the KJV it is rendered: offering, shaking, wave (offering).
H8574: From נֵר; a fire-pot. In the KJV it is rendered: furnace, oven.
H8575: Or tanchum; and (feminine) tanchuwmah; from נָחַם; compassion, solace. In the KJV it is rendered: comfort, consolation.
H8576: For תַּנְחוּמִים (feminine); Tanchumeth, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Tanhumeth.
H8577: Or tanniym (Ezek. 29:3); intensive from the same as תַּנִּים; a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal. In the KJV it is rendered: dragon, sea-monster, serpent, whale.
H8578: (Aramaic) corresponding to שְׁנַ֫יִם; second. In the KJV it is rendered: second.
H8579: (Aramaic) from תִּנְיָנָה; a second time. In the KJV it is rendered: again.
H8580: From נָשַׁם; properly, a hard breather, i.e. the name of two unclean creatures, a lizard and a bird (both perhaps from changing color through their irascibility), probably the tree-toad and the water-hen. In the KJV it is rendered: mole, swan.
H8581: A primitive root; to loathe, i.e. (morally) detest. In the KJV it is rendered: (make to be) abhor(-red), (be, commit more, do) abominable(-y), X utterly.
H8582: A primitive root; to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray (literally or figuratively); also causative of both. In the KJV it is rendered: (cause to) go astray, deceive, dissemble, (cause to, make to) err, pant, seduce, (make to) stagger, (cause to) wander, be out of the way.
H8583: Or Tomiy; from תָּעָה; error, Tou or Toi, a Syrian king. In the KJV it is rendered: Toi, Tou.
H8584: From עוּד; attestation, i.e. a precept, usage. In the KJV it is rendered: testimony.
H8585: From עָלָה; a channel (into which water is raised for irrigation); also a bandage or plaster (as placed upon a wound). In the KJV it is rendered: conduit, cured, healing, little river, trench, watercourse.
H8586: From עָלַל; caprice (as a fit coming on), i.e. vexation; concretely a tyrant. In the KJV it is rendered: babe, delusion.
H8587: From עָלַם; a secret. In the KJV it is rendered: thing that is hid, secret.
H8588: Or taanug; and (feminine) taeanugah; from עָנַג; luxury. In the KJV it is rendered: delicate, delight, pleasant.
H8589: From עָנָה; affliction (of self), i.e. fasting. In the KJV it is rendered: heaviness.
H8590: Or Tanak; of uncertain derivation; Taanak or Tanak, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Taanach, Tanach.
H8591: A primitive root; to cheat; by analogy, to maltreat. In the KJV it is rendered: deceive, misuse.
H8592: From עָצַם; might (plural collective). In the KJV it is rendered: power.
H8593: From עָרָה; a knife or razor (as making bare): also a scabbard (as being bare, i.e. empty). In the KJV it is rendered: (pen-)knife, razor, scabbard, shave, sheath.
H8594: From עָרַב; suretyship, i.e. (concretely) a pledge. In the KJV it is rendered: + hostage.
H8595: From תָּעַע; a fraud. In the KJV it is rendered: error.
H8596: From תָּפַף contracted; a tambourine. In the KJV it is rendered: tabret, timbrel.
H8597: Or tiphereth; from פָּאַר; ornament (abstractly or concretely, literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: beauty(- iful), bravery, comely, fair, glory(-ious), hono; ornament (abstractly or concretely, literally or figuratively):--beauty(-iful), bravery, comely, fair, glory(-ious), honour, majesty.
H8598: From נָפַח; an apple (from its fragrance), i.e. the fruit or the tree (probably includ. others of the pome order, as the quince, the orange, etc.). In the KJV it is rendered: apple (tree).
H8599: The same as תַּפּ֫וּחַ; Tappuach, the name of two places in Palestine, also of an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Tappuah.
H8600: From פּוּץ; a dispersal. In the KJV it is rendered: dispersion.
H8601: From אָפָה; cookery, i.e. (concretely) a cake. In the KJV it is rendered: baked piece.
H8602: From an unused root meaning to smear; plaster (as gummy) or slime; (figuratively) frivolity. In the KJV it is rendered: foolish things, unsavoury, untempered.
H8603: From the same as תָּפֵל; quagmire; Tophel, a place near the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Tophel.
H8604: From the same as תָּפֵל; frivolity. In the KJV it is rendered: folly, foolishly.
H8605: From פָּלַל; intercession, supplication; by implication, a hymn. In the KJV it is rendered: prayer.
H8606: From פָּלַץ; fearfulness. In the KJV it is rendered: terrible.
H8607: From פָּסַח; ford; Tiphsach, a place in Mesopotamia. In the KJV it is rendered: Tipsah.
H8608: A primitive root; to drum, i.e. play (as) on the tambourine. In the KJV it is rendered: taber, play with timbrels.
H8609: A primitive root; to sew. In the KJV it is rendered: (women that) sew (together).
H8610: A primitive root; to manipulate, i.e. seize; chiefly to capture, wield, specifically, to overlay; figuratively, to use unwarrantably. In the KJV it is rendered: catch, handle, (lay, take) hold (on, over), stop, X surely, surprise, take.
H8611: From the base of תָּפַף; a smiting, i.e. (figuratively) contempt. In the KJV it is rendered: tabret.
H8612: The same as תֹּ֫פֶת; Topheth, a place near Jerusalem. In the KJV it is rendered: Tophet, Topheth.
H8613: Probably a form of תֹּ֫פֶת; Tophteh, a place of cremation. In the KJV it is rendered: Tophet.
H8614: (Aramaic) perhaps from שָׁפַט; judicial, i.e. a lawyer. In the KJV it is rendered: sheriff.
H8615: From קָוָה; literally, a cord (as an attachment (compare קָוה)); figuratively, expectancy. In the KJV it is rendered: expectation ((-ted)), hope, live, thing that I long for.
H8616: The same as תִּקְוָה; Tikvah, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Tikvah.
H8617: From קוּם; resistfulness. In the KJV it is rendered: power to stand.
H8618: From קוּם; an opponent. In the KJV it is rendered: rise up against.
H8619: From תָּקַע (in the musical sense); a trumpet. In the KJV it is rendered: trumpet.
H8620: A form of תָּק֫וֹעַ; Tekoa, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Tekoa, Tekoah.
H8621: Or Tqo iy; patronymically from תְּק֫וֹעַ; a Tekoite or inhabitant of Tekoah. In the KJV it is rendered: Tekoite.
H8622: Or tquphah; from נָקַף; a revolution, i.e. (of the sun) course, (of time) lapse. In the KJV it is rendered: circuit, come about, end.
H8623: From תָּקַף; powerful. In the KJV it is rendered: mightier.
H8624: (Aramaic) corresponding to תַּקִּיף. In the KJV it is rendered: mighty, strong.
H8625: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁקַל; to balance. In the KJV it is rendered: Tekel, be weighed.
H8626: A primitive root; to equalize, i.e. straighten (intransitive or transitive); figuratively, to compose. In the KJV it is rendered: set in order, make straight.
H8627: (Aramaic) corresponding to תָּקַן; to straighten up, i.e. confirm. In the KJV it is rendered: establish.
H8628: A primitive root; to clatter, i.e. slap (the hands together), clang (an instrument); by analogy, to drive (a nail or tent-pin, a dart, etc.); by implication, to become bondsman by handclasping). In the KJV it is rendered: blow ((a trumpet)), cast, clap, fasten, pitch (tent), smite, sound, strike, X suretiship, thrust.
H8629: From תָּקַע; a blast of a trumpet. In the KJV it is rendered: sound.
H8630: A primitive root; to overpower. In the KJV it is rendered: prevail (against).
H8631: (Aramaic) corresponding to תָּקַף; to become (causatively, make) mighty or (figuratively) obstinate. In the KJV it is rendered: make firm, harden, be(-come) strong.
H8632: (Aramaic) corresponding to תֹּ֫קֶף; power. In the KJV it is rendered: might, strength.
H8633: From תָּקַף; might or (figuratively) positiveness. In the KJV it is rendered: authority, power, strength.
H8634: Probably for תַּרְעֵלָה; a reeling; Taralah, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Taralah.
H8635: From רָבָה; multiplication, i.e. progeny. In the KJV it is rendered: increase.
H8636: From רָבָה; multiplication, i.e. percentage or bonus in addition to principal. In the KJV it is rendered: increase, unjust gain.
H8637: A denominative from רָגַל; to cause to walk. In the KJV it is rendered: teach to go.
H8638: A denominative from רָגַם in the sense of throwing over; to transfer, i.e. translate. In the KJV it is rendered: interpret.
H8639: From רָדַם; a lethargy or (by implication) trance. In the KJV it is rendered: deep sleep.
H8640: Of foreign derivation; Tirhakah, a king of Kush. In the KJV it is rendered: Tirhakah.
H8641: Or trumah (Deut. 12:11); from רוּם; a present (as offered up), especially in sacrifice or as tribute. In the KJV it is rendered: gift, heave offering ((shoulder)), oblation, offered(-ing).
H8642: Formed as תְּרוּמָה; a sacrificial offering. In the KJV it is rendered: oblation.
H8643: From ר֫וּעַ; clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry; especially clangor of trumpets, as an alarum. In the KJV it is rendered: alarm, blow(- ing) (of, the) (trumpets), joy, jubile, loud noise, rejoicing, shout(-ing), (high, joyful) sound(-ing).
H8644: From רוּף in the sense of its congener רָפָא; a remedy. In the KJV it is rendered: medicine.
H8645: Probably from רָזָה; a species of tree (apparently from its slenderness), perhaps the cypress. In the KJV it is rendered: cypress.
H8646: Of uncertain derivation; Terach, the father of Abraham; also a place in the Desert. In the KJV it is rendered: Tarah, Terah.
H8647: Of uncertain derivation; Tirchanah, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Tirhanah.
H8648: (Aramaic) feminine tarteyn (Aramaic); corresponding to שְׁנַ֫יִם; two. In the KJV it is rendered: second, + twelve, two.
H8649: And tarmuwth; or tarmiyth; from רָמָה; fraud. In the KJV it is rendered: deceit(-ful), privily.
H8650: Probably for אֹ֫רֶן; a pole (as a mast or flag-staff). In the KJV it is rendered: beacon, mast.
H8651: (Aramaic) corresponding to שַׁ֫עַר; a door; by implication, a palace. In the KJV it is rendered: gate mouth.
H8652: (Aramaic) from תְּרַע; a doorkeeper. In the KJV it is rendered: porter.
H8653: From רָעַל; reeling. In the KJV it is rendered: astonishment, trembling.
H8654: Patrial from an unused name meaning gate; a Tirathite or inhabitant of an unknown Tirah. In the KJV it is rendered: Tirathite.
H8655: Plural from רָפָא; a healer; Teraphim (singular or plural) a family idol. In the KJV it is rendered: idols(-atry), images, teraphim.
H8656: From רָצָה; delightsomeness; Tirtsah, a place in Palestine; also an Israelitess. In the KJV it is rendered: Tirzah.
H8657: Of foreign derivation; Teresh, a eunuch of Xerxes. In the KJV it is rendered: Teresh.
H8658: Probably of foreign derivation (compare תַּרְשִׁישׁ); a gem, perhaps the topaz. In the KJV it is rendered: beryl.
H8659: Probably the same as תַּרְשִׁישׁ (as the region of the stone, or the reverse); Tarshish, a place on the Mediterranean, hence, the ephithet of a merchant vessel (as if for or from that port); also the name of a Persian and of an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Tarshish, Tharshish.
H8660: Of foreign derivation; the title of a Persian deputy or governor. In the KJV it is rendered: Tirshatha.
H8661: Of foreign derivation; Tartan, an Assyrian. In the KJV it is rendered: Tartan.
H8662: Of foreign derivation; Tartak, a deity of the Avvites. In the KJV it is rendered: Tartak.
H8663: From שׁוֹאָה; a crashing or loud clamor. In the KJV it is rendered: crying, noise, shouting, stir.
H8664: Patrial from an unused name meaning recourse; a Tishbite or inhabitant of Tishbeh (in Gilead). In the KJV it is rendered: Tishbite.
H8665: From שָׁבַץ; checkered stuff (as reticulated). In the KJV it is rendered: broidered.
H8666: Or tshubah; from שׁוּב; a recurrence (of time or place); a reply (as returned). In the KJV it is rendered: answer, be expired, return.
H8667: From שׂוּם; a deposit, i.e. pledging. In the KJV it is rendered: + fellowship.
H8668: Or tshuah; from שָׁוַע in the sense of יָשַׁע; rescue (literal or figurative, pers., national or spir.). In the KJV it is rendered: deliverance, help, safety, salvation, victory.
H8669: From שׁוּק in the original sense of stretching out after; a longing. In the KJV it is rendered: desire.
H8670: From שׁוּר in the sense of arrival; a gift. In the KJV it is rendered: present.
H8671: Ord. from תֵּ֫שַׁע; ninth. In the KJV it is rendered: ninth.
H8672: Or (masculine) tishtah; perhaps from שָׁעָה through the idea of a turn to the next or full number ten; nine or (ord.) ninth. In the KJV it is rendered: nine (+ -teen, + -teenth, -th).
H8673: Multiple from תֵּ֫שַׁע; ninety. In the KJV it is rendered: ninety.
H8674: Of foreign derivation; Tattenai, a Persian. In the KJV it is rendered: Tatnai.
G1: Of Hebrew origin; the first letter of the alphabet; figuratively, only (from its use as a numeral) the first. In the KJV it is rendered: Alpha.
G2: Of Hebrew origin (אַהֲרוֹן); Aaron, the brother of Moses. In the KJV it is rendered: Aaron.
G3: Of Hebrew origin (אֲבַדּוֹן); a destroying angel. In the KJV it is rendered: Abaddon.
G4: From Α (as a negative particle) and βάρος; weightless, i.e. (figuratively) not burdensome. In the KJV it is rendered: from being burdensome.
G5: Of Chaldee origin (אַב); father as a vocative. In the KJV it is rendered: Abba.
G6: Of Hebrew origin (הָ֫בֶל); Abel, the son of Adam. In the KJV it is rendered: Abel.
G7: Of Hebrew origin (אֲבִיָּה); Abijah, the name of two Israelites. In the KJV it is rendered: Abia.
G8: Of Hebrew origin (אֶבְיָתָר); Abiathar, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Abiathar.
G9: Of foreign origin (compare אָבֵל); Abilene, a region of Syria. In the KJV it is rendered: Abilene.
G10: Of Hebrew origin (אֲבִיהוּד); Abihud, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Abiud.
G11: Of Hebrew origin (אַבְרָהָם); Abraham, the Hebrew patriarch. In the KJV it is rendered: Abraham.
G12: From Α (as a negative particle) and a variation of βυθός; depthless, i.e. (specially) (infernal) "abyss". In the KJV it is rendered: deep, (bottomless) pit.
G13: Of Hebrew origin (compare חָגָב); Agabus, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Agabus.
G14: From ἀγαθός and ἔργον; to work good. In the KJV it is rendered: do good.
G15: From ἀγαθοποιός; to be a well-doer (as a favor or a duty). In the KJV it is rendered: (when) do good (well).
G16: From ἀγαθοποιός; well-doing, i.e. virtue. In the KJV it is rendered: well-doing.
G17: From ἀγαθός and ποιέω; a well-doer, i.e. virtuous. In the KJV it is rendered: them that do well.
G18: A primary word; "good" (in any sense, often as noun). In the KJV it is rendered: benefit, good(-s, things), well.
G19: From ἀγαθός; goodness, i.e. virtue or beneficence. In the KJV it is rendered: goodness.
G20: From ἀγαλλιάω; exultation; specially, welcome. In the KJV it is rendered: gladness, (exceeding) joy.
G21: From agan (much) and ἅλλομαι; properly, to jump for joy, i.e. exult. In the KJV it is rendered: be (exceeding) glad, with exceeding joy, rejoice (greatly).
G22: From Α (as a negative particle) and γάμος; unmarried. In the KJV it is rendered: unmarried.
G23: From agan (much) and achthos (grief; akin to the base of ἀγκάλη); to be greatly afflicted, i.e. (figuratively) indignant. In the KJV it is rendered: be much (sore) displeased, have (be moved with, with) indignation.
G24: From ἀγανακτέω; indignation. In the KJV it is rendered: indignation.
G25: Perhaps from agan (much) (or compare עָגַב); to love (in a social or moral sense). In the KJV it is rendered: (be-)love(-ed).
G26: From ἀγαπάω; love, i.e. affection or benevolence; specially (plural) a love-feast. In the KJV it is rendered: (feast of) charity(-ably), dear, love.
G27: From ἀγαπάω; beloved. In the KJV it is rendered: (dearly, well) beloved, dear.
G28: Of Hebrew origin (הָגָר); Hagar, the concubine of Abraham. In the KJV it is rendered: Hagar.
G29: Of foreign origin (compare אּגְּרָה); properly, to be a courier, i.e. (by implication) to press into public service. In the KJV it is rendered: compel (to go).
G30: From aggos (a pail, perhaps as bent; compare the base of ἀγκάλη); a receptacle. In the KJV it is rendered: vessel.
G31: From ἄγγελος; an announcement, i.e. (by implication) precept. In the KJV it is rendered: message.
G32: From aggello (probably derived from ἄγω; compare ἀγέλη) (to bring tidings); a messenger; especially an "angel"; by implication, a pastor. In the KJV it is rendered: angel, messenger.
G33: Imperative of ἄγω; properly, lead, i.e. come on. In the KJV it is rendered: go to.
G34: From ἄγω (compare ἄγγελος); a drove. In the KJV it is rendered: herd.
G35: From Α (as negative particle) and γενεαλογέω; unregistered as to birth. In the KJV it is rendered: without descent.
G36: From Α (as negative particle) and γένος; properly, without kin, i.e. (of unknown descent, and by implication) ignoble. In the KJV it is rendered: base things.
G37: From ἅγιος; to make holy, i.e. (ceremonially) purify or consecrate; (mentally) to venerate. In the KJV it is rendered: hallow, be holy, sanctify.
G38: From ἁγιάζω; properly, purification, i.e. (the state) purity; concretely (by Hebraism) a purifier. In the KJV it is rendered: holiness, sanctification.
G39: Neuter of ἅγιος; a sacred thing (i.e. spot). In the KJV it is rendered: holiest (of all), holy place, sanctuary.
G40: From hagos (an awful thing) (compare ἁγνός, θάλπω); sacred (physically, pure, morally blameless or religious, ceremonially, consecrated). In the KJV it is rendered: (most) holy (one, thing), saint.
G41: From ἅγιος; sanctity (i.e. properly, the state). In the KJV it is rendered: holiness.
G42: From ἅγιος; sacredness (i.e. properly, the quality). In the KJV it is rendered: holiness.
G43: From agkos (a bend, "ache"); an arm (as curved). In the KJV it is rendered: arm.
G44: From the same as ἀγκάλη; a hook (as bent). In the KJV it is rendered: hook.
G45: From the same as ἀγκάλη; an "anchor" (as crooked). In the KJV it is rendered: anchor.
G46: From Α (as a negative particle) and the same as γναφεύς; properly, unfulled, i.e. (by implication) new (cloth). In the KJV it is rendered: new.
G47: From ἁγνός; cleanliness (the quality), i.e. (specially) chastity. In the KJV it is rendered: purity.
G48: From ἁγνός; to make clean, i.e. (figuratively) sanctify (ceremonially or morally). In the KJV it is rendered: purify (self).
G49: From ἁγνίζω; a cleansing (the act), i.e. (ceremonially) lustration. In the KJV it is rendered: purification.
G50: From Α (as a negative particle) and νοιέω; not to know (through lack of information or intelligence); by implication, to ignore (through disinclination). In the KJV it is rendered: (be) ignorant(-ly), not know, not understand, unknown.
G51: From ἀγνοέω; a thing ignored, i.e. shortcoming. In the KJV it is rendered: error.
G52: From ἀγνοέω; ignorance (properly, the quality). In the KJV it is rendered: ignorance.
G53: From the same as ἅγιος; properly, clean, i.e. (figuratively) innocent, modest, perfect. In the KJV it is rendered: chaste, clean, pure.
G54: From ἁγνός; cleanness (the state), i.e. (figuratively) blamelessness. In the KJV it is rendered: pureness.
G55: Adverb from ἁγνός; purely, i.e. honestly. In the KJV it is rendered: sincerely.
G56: From Α (as negative particle) and γνῶσις; ignorance (properly, the state). In the KJV it is rendered: ignorance, not the knowledge.
G57: From Α (as negative particle) and γνωστός; unknown. In the KJV it is rendered: unknown.
G58: From ageiro (to gather; probably akin to ἐγείρω); properly, the town-square (as a place of public resort); by implication, a market or thoroughfare. In the KJV it is rendered: market(-place), street.
G59: From ἀγορά; properly, to go to market, i.e. (by implication) to purchase; specially, to redeem. In the KJV it is rendered: buy, redeem.
G60: From ἀγορά; relating to the market-place, i.e. forensic (times); by implication, vulgar. In the KJV it is rendered: baser sort, low.
G61: From ἄγω; (abstractly) a catching (of fish); also (concretely) a haul (of fish). In the KJV it is rendered: draught.
G62: From Α (as negative particle) and γράμμα; unlettered, i.e. illiterate. In the KJV it is rendered: unlearned.
G63: From ἀγρός and αὐλέω (in the sense of αὐλή); to camp out. In the KJV it is rendered: abide in the field.
G64: From ἄγρα; to hunt, i.e. (figuratively) to entrap. In the KJV it is rendered: catch.
G65: From ἄγριος and ἐλαία; an oleaster. In the KJV it is rendered: olive tree (which is) wild.
G66: From ἀγρός; wild (as pertaining to the country), literally (natural) or figuratively (fierce). In the KJV it is rendered: wild, raging.
G67: Apparently from ἄγριος and ἵππος; wild-horse tamer; Agrippas, one of the Herods. In the KJV it is rendered: Agrippa.
G68: From ἄγω; a field (as a drive for cattle); genitive case, the country; specially, a farm, i.e. hamlet. In the KJV it is rendered: country, farm, piece of ground, land.
G69: Ultimately from Α (as negative particle) and ὕπνος; to be sleepless, i.e. keep awake. In the KJV it is rendered: watch.
G70: From ἀγρυπνέω; sleeplessness, i.e. a keeping awake. In the KJV it is rendered: watch.
G71: A primary verb; properly, to lead; by implication, to bring, drive, (reflexively) go, (specially) pass (time), or (figuratively) induce. In the KJV it is rendered: be, bring (forth), carry, (let) go, keep, lead away, be open.
G72: Reduplicated from ἄγω; a bringing up, i.e. mode of living. In the KJV it is rendered: manner of life.
G73: From ἄγω; properly, a place of assembly (as if led), i.e. (by implication) a contest (held there); figuratively, an effort or anxiety. In the KJV it is rendered: conflict, contention, fight, race.
G74: From ἀγών; a struggle (properly, the state), i.e. (figuratively) anguish. In the KJV it is rendered: agony.
G75: From ἀγών; to struggle, literally (to compete for a prize), figuratively (to contend with an adversary), or genitive case (to endeavor to accomplish something). In the KJV it is rendered: fight, labor fervently, strive.
G76: Of Hebrew origin (אָדָם); Adam, the first man; typically (of Jesus) man (as his representative). In the KJV it is rendered: Adam.
G77: From Α (as negative particle); and δαπάνη; costless, i.e. gratuitous. In the KJV it is rendered: without expense.
G78: Probably of Hebrew origin (compare עֶ֫דִי); Addi, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Addi.
G79: Feminine of ἀδελφός; a sister (naturally or ecclesiastically). In the KJV it is rendered: sister.
G80: From Α (as a connective particle) and delphus (the womb); a brother (literally or figuratively) near or remote (much like Α). In the KJV it is rendered: brother.
G81: From ἀδελφός; brotherhood (properly, the feeling of brotherliness), i.e. the (Christian) fraternity. In the KJV it is rendered: brethren, brotherhood.
G82: From Α (as a negative particle) and δῆλος; hidden, figuratively, indistinct. In the KJV it is rendered: appear not, uncertain.
G83: From ἄδηλος; uncertainty. In the KJV it is rendered: X uncertain.
G84: Adverb from ἄδηλος; uncertainly. In the KJV it is rendered: uncertainly.
G85: From a derivative of adeo (to be sated to loathing); to be in distress (of mind). In the KJV it is rendered: be full of heaviness, be very heavy.
G86: From Α (as negative particle) and εἴδω; properly, unseen, i.e. "Hades" or the place (state) of departed souls. In the KJV it is rendered: grave, hell.
G87: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of διακρίνω; properly, undistinguished, i.e. (actively) impartial. In the KJV it is rendered: without partiality.
G88: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of διά and λείπω; unintermitted, i.e. permanent. In the KJV it is rendered: without ceasing, continual.
G89: Adverb from ἀδιάλειπτος; uninterruptedly, i.e. without omission (on an appropriate occasion). In the KJV it is rendered: without ceasing.
G90: From a derivative of a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of διαφθείρω; incorruptibleness, i.e. (figuratively) purity (of doctrine). In the KJV it is rendered: uncorruptness.
G91: From ἄδικος; to be unjust, i.e. (actively) do wrong (morally, socially or physically). In the KJV it is rendered: hurt, injure, be an offender, be unjust, (do, suffer, take) wrong.
G92: From ἀδικέω; a wrong done. In the KJV it is rendered: evil doing, iniquity, matter of wrong.
G93: From ἄδικος; (legal) injustice (properly, the quality, by implication, the act); morally, wrongfulness (of character, life or act). In the KJV it is rendered: iniquity, unjust, unrighteousness, wrong.
G94: From Α (as a negative particle) and δίκη; unjust; by extension wicked; by implication, treacherous; specially, heathen. In the KJV it is rendered: unjust, unrighteous.
G95: Adverb from ἄδικος; unjustly. In the KJV it is rendered: wrongfully.
G96: From Α (as a negative particle) and δόκιμος; unapproved, i.e. rejected; by implication, worthless (literally or morally). In the KJV it is rendered: castaway, rejected, reprobate.
G97: From Α (as a negative particle); and δόλος; undeceitful, i.e. (figuratively) unadulterated. In the KJV it is rendered: sincere.
G98: From Adramutteion (a place in Asia Minor); Adramyttene or belonging to Adramyttium. In the KJV it is rendered: of Adramyttium.
G99: From Adria (a place near its shore); the Adriatic sea (including the Ionian). In the KJV it is rendered: Adria.
G100: From hadros (stout); plumpness, i.e. (figuratively) liberality. In the KJV it is rendered: abundance.
G101: From ἀδύνατος; to be unable, i.e. (passively) impossible. In the KJV it is rendered: be impossible.
G102: From Α (as a negative particle) and δυνατός; unable, i.e. weak (literally or figuratively); passively, impossible. In the KJV it is rendered: could not do, impossible, impotent, not possible, weak.
G103: A primary verb; to sing. In the KJV it is rendered: sing.
G104: From an obsolete primary noun (apparently meaning continued duration); "ever," by qualification regularly; by implication, earnestly. In the KJV it is rendered: always, ever.
G105: From the same as ἀήρ; an eagle (from its wind-like flight). In the KJV it is rendered: eagle.
G106: From Α (as a negative particle) and ζύμη; unleavened, i.e. (figuratively) uncorrupted; (in the neutral plural) specially (by implication) the Passover week. In the KJV it is rendered: unleavened (bread).
G107: Of Hebrew origin (compare עַזּוּר); Azor, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Azorigin.
G108: Of Hebrew origin (אַשְׁדּוֹד); Azotus (i.e. Ashdod), a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Azotus.
G109: From aemi (to breathe unconsciously, i.e. respire; by analogy, to blow); "air" (as naturally circumambient). In the KJV it is rendered: air.
G110: From a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and θάνατος; deathlessness. In the KJV it is rendered: immortality.
G111: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of themis (statute; from the base of τίθημι); illegal; by implication, flagitious. In the KJV it is rendered: abominable, unlawful thing.
G112: From Α (as a negative particle) and θεός; godless. In the KJV it is rendered: without God.
G113: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of τίθημι (in the sense of enacting); lawless, i.e. (by implication) criminal. In the KJV it is rendered: wicked.
G114: From a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of τίθημι; to set aside, i.e. (by implication) to disesteem, neutralize or violate. In the KJV it is rendered: cast off, despise, disannul, frustrate, bring to nought, reject.
G115: From ἀθετέω; cancellation (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: disannulling, put away.
G116: Plural of Athene (the goddess of wisdom, who was reputed to have founded the city); Athenæ, the capitol of Greece. In the KJV it is rendered: Athens.
G117: From Ἀθῆναι; an Athenæan or inhabitant of Athenæ. In the KJV it is rendered: Athenian.
G118: From athlos (a contest in the public lists); to contend in the competitive games. In the KJV it is rendered: strive.
G119: From ἀθλέω; a struggle (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: fight.
G120: From a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and θυμός; to be spiritless, i.e. disheartened. In the KJV it is rendered: be dismayed.
G121: From Α (as a negative particle) and probably a derivative of τίθημι (meaning a penalty); not guilty. In the KJV it is rendered: innocent.
G122: From aix (a goat); belonging to a goat. In the KJV it is rendered: goat.
G123: From aisso (to rush) and ἅλς (in the sense of the sea; a beach (on which the waves dash). In the KJV it is rendered: shore.
G124: From Αἴγυπτος; an Ægyptian or inhabitant of Ægyptus. In the KJV it is rendered: Egyptian.
G125: Of uncertain derivation; Ægyptus, the land of the Nile. In the KJV it is rendered: Egypt.
G126: From ἀεί; everduring (forward and backward, or forward only). In the KJV it is rendered: eternal, everlasting.
G127: Perhaps from Α (as a negative particle) and εἴδω (through the idea of downcast eyes); bashfulness, i.e. (towards men), modesty or (towards God) awe. In the KJV it is rendered: reverence, shamefacedness.
G128: From aitho (to scorch) and ops (the face, from ὀπτάνομαι); an Æthiopian (as a blackamoor). In the KJV it is rendered: Ethiopian.
G129: Of uncertain derivation; blood, literally (of men or animals), figuratively (the juice of grapes) or specially (the atoning blood of Christ); by implication, bloodshed, also kindred. In the KJV it is rendered: blood.
G130: From αἷμα and a derivative of ἐκχέω; an effusion of blood. In the KJV it is rendered: shedding of blood.
G131: From αἷμα and ῥέω; to flow blood, i.e. have a hæmorrhage. In the KJV it is rendered: diseased with an issue of blood.
G132: Of uncertain derivation; Ænĕas, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Æneas.
G133: From αἰνέω; a praising (the act), i.e. (specially) a thank(-offering). In the KJV it is rendered: praise.
G134: From αἶνος; to praise (God). In the KJV it is rendered: praise.
G135: From a derivative of αἶνος (in its primary sense); an obscure saying ("enigma"), i.e. (abstractly) obscureness. In the KJV it is rendered: X darkly.
G136: Apparently a prime word; properly, a story, but used in the sense of ἔπαινος; praise (of God). In the KJV it is rendered: praise.
G137: Of Hebrew origin (a derivative of עַ֫יִן, place of springs); Ænon, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Ænon.
G138: Probably akin to αἴρω; to take for oneself, i.e. to prefer. In the KJV it is rendered: choose.
G139: From αἱρέομαι; properly, a choice, i.e. (specially) a party or (abstractly) disunion. In the KJV it is rendered: heresy (which is the Greek word itself), sect.
G140: From a derivative of αἱρέομαι; to make a choice. In the KJV it is rendered: choose.
G141: From the same as αἱρετίζω; a schismatic. In the KJV it is rendered: heretic (the Greek word itself).
G142: A primary root; to lift up; by implication, to take up or away; figuratively, to raise (the voice), keep in suspense (the mind), specially, to sail away (i.e. weigh anchor); by Hebraism (compare נָשָׂא) to expiate sin. In the KJV it is rendered: away with, bear (up), carry, lift up, loose, make to doubt, put away, remove, take (away, up).
G143: Of uncertain derivation; to apprehend (properly, by the senses). In the KJV it is rendered: perceive.
G144: From αἰσθάνομαι; perception, i.e. (figuratively) discernment. In the KJV it is rendered: judgment.
G145: From a derivative of αἰσθάνομαι; properly, an organ of perception, i.e. (figuratively) judgment. In the KJV it is rendered: senses.
G146: From αἰσχρός and kerdos (gain); sordid. In the KJV it is rendered: given to (greedy of) filthy lucre.
G147: Adverb from αἰσχροκερδής; sordidly. In the KJV it is rendered: for filthy lucre's sake.
G148: From αἰσχρός and λόγος; vile conversation. In the KJV it is rendered: filthy communication.
G149: Neuter of αἰσχρός; a shameful thing, i.e. indecorum. In the KJV it is rendered: shame.
G150: From the same as αἰσχύνομαι; shameful, i.e. base (specially, venal). In the KJV it is rendered: filthy.
G151: From αἰσχρός; shamefulness, i.e. obscenity. In the KJV it is rendered: filthiness.
G152: From αἰσχύνομαι; shame or disgrace (abstractly or concretely). In the KJV it is rendered: dishonesty, shame.
G153: From aischos (disfigurement, i.e. disgrace); to feel shame (for oneself). In the KJV it is rendered: be ashamed.
G154: Of uncertain derivation; to ask (in genitive case). In the KJV it is rendered: ask, beg, call for, crave, desire, require.
G155: From αἰτέω; a thing asked or (abstractly) an asking. In the KJV it is rendered: petition, request, required.
G156: From the same as αἰτέω; a cause (as if asked for), i.e. (logical) reason (motive, matter), (legal) crime (alleged or proved). In the KJV it is rendered: accusation, case, cause, crime, fault, (wh-)ere(-fore).
G157: From a derivative of αἰτία; a thing charged. In the KJV it is rendered: complaint.
G158: Neuter of αἴτιος; a reason or crime (like αἰτία). In the KJV it is rendered: cause, fault.
G159: From the same as αἰτέω; causative, i.e. (concretely) a causer. In the KJV it is rendered: author.
G160: From a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and φαίνω (compare ἐξαίφνης) (meaning non-apparent); unexpected, i.e. (adverbially) suddenly. In the KJV it is rendered: sudden, unawares.
G161: From αἰχμάλωτος; captivity. In the KJV it is rendered: captivity.
G162: From αἰχμάλωτος; to capture (like αἰχμαλωτίζω). In the KJV it is rendered: lead captive.
G163: From αἰχμάλωτος; to make captive. In the KJV it is rendered: lead away captive, bring into captivity.
G164: From aichme (a spear) and a derivative of the same as ἅλωσις; properly, a prisoner of war, i.e. (genitive case) a captive. In the KJV it is rendered: captive.
G165: From the same as ἀεί; properly, an age; by extension, perpetuity (also past); by implication, the world; specially (Jewish) a Messianic period (present or future). In the KJV it is rendered: age, course, eternal, (for) ever(-more), (n-)ever, (beginning of the, while the) world (began, without end).
G166: From αἰών; perpetual (also used of past time, or past and future as well). In the KJV it is rendered: eternal, for ever, everlasting, world (began).
G167: From ἀκάθαρτος; impurity (the quality), physically or morally. In the KJV it is rendered: uncleanness.
G168: From ἀκάθαρτος; impurity (the state), morally. In the KJV it is rendered: filthiness.
G169: From Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of καθαίρω (meaning cleansed); impure (ceremonially, morally (lewd) or specially, (demonic)). In the KJV it is rendered: foul, unclean.
G170: From a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and καιρός (meaning unseasonable); to be inopportune (for oneself), i.e. to fail of a proper occasion. In the KJV it is rendered: lack opportunity.
G171: Adverb from the same as ἀκαιρέομαι; inopportunely. In the KJV it is rendered: out of season.
G172: From Α (as a negative particle) and κακός; not bad, i.e. (objectively) innocent or (subjectively) unsuspecting. In the KJV it is rendered: harmless, simple.
G173: Probably from the same as ἀκμήν; a thorn. In the KJV it is rendered: thorn.
G174: From ἄκανθα; thorny. In the KJV it is rendered: of thorns.
G175: From Α (as a negative particle) and καρπός; barren (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: without fruit, unfruitful.
G176: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καταγινώσκω; unblamable. In the KJV it is rendered: that cannot be condemned.
G177: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of κατά and καλύπτω; unveiled. In the KJV it is rendered: uncovered.
G178: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of κατακρίνω; without (legal) trial. In the KJV it is rendered: uncondemned.
G179: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καταλύω; indissoluble, i.e. (figuratively) permanent. In the KJV it is rendered: endless.
G180: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καταπαύω; unrefraining. In the KJV it is rendered: that cannot cease.
G181: From ἀκατάστατος; instability, i.e. disorder. In the KJV it is rendered: commotion, confusion, tumult.
G182: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καθίστημι; inconstant. In the KJV it is rendered: unstable.
G183: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of κατέχω; unrestrainable. In the KJV it is rendered: unruly.
G184: Of Chaldee origin (meaning field of blood; corresponding to חֵ֫לֶק and דָּם); Akeldama, a place near Jerusalem. In the KJV it is rendered: Aceldama.
G185: From Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of κεράννυμι; unmixed, i.e. (figuratively) innocent. In the KJV it is rendered: harmless, simple.
G186: From Α (as a negative particle) and κλίνω; not leaning, i.e. (figuratively) firm. In the KJV it is rendered: without wavering.
G187: From the same as ἀκμήν; to make a point, i.e. (figuratively) mature. In the KJV it is rendered: be fully ripe.
G188: Accusative case of a noun ("acme") akin to ake (a point) and meaning the same; adverbially, just now, i.e. still. In the KJV it is rendered: yet.
G189: From ἀκούω; hearing (the act, the sense or the thing heard). In the KJV it is rendered: audience, ear, fame, which ye heard, hearing, preached, report, rumor.
