G568: From ἀπό and ἔχω; (actively) to have out, i.e. receive in full; (intransitively) to keep (oneself) away, i.e. be distant (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: be, have, receive.
G569: From ἄπιστος; to be unbelieving, i.e. (transitively) disbelieve, or (by implication) disobey. In the KJV it is rendered: believe not.
G570: From ἄπιστος; faithlessness, i.e. (negatively) disbelief (lack of Christian faith), or (positively) unfaithfulness (disobedience). In the KJV it is rendered: unbelief.
G571: From Α (as a negative particle) and πιστός; (actively) disbelieving, i.e. without Christian faith (specially, a heathen); (passively) untrustworthy (person), or incredible (thing). In the KJV it is rendered: that believeth not, faithless, incredible thing, infidel, unbeliever(-ing).
G572: From ἁπλοῦς; singleness, i.e. (subjectively) sincerity (without dissimulation or self-seeking), or (objectively) generosity (copious bestowal). In the KJV it is rendered: bountifulness, liberal(-ity), simplicity, singleness.
G573: Probably from Α (as a particle of union) and the base of πλέκω; properly, folded together, i.e. single (figuratively, clear). In the KJV it is rendered: single.
G574: Adverb from ἁπλοῦς (in the objective sense of ἁπλότης); bountifully; --liberally.
G575: A primary particle; "off," i.e. away (from something near), in various senses (of place, time, or relation; literal or figurative). In the KJV it is rendered: (X here-)after, ago, at, because of, before, by (the space of), for(-th), from, in, (out) of, off, (up-)on(-ce), since, with.
G576: From ἀπό and the base of βάσις; literally, to disembark; figuratively, to eventuate. In the KJV it is rendered: become, go out, turn.
G577: From ἀπό and βάλλω; to throw off; figuratively, to lose. In the KJV it is rendered: cast away.
G578: From ἀπό and βλέπω; to look away from everything else, i.e. (figuratively) intently regard. In the KJV it is rendered: have respect.
G579: From ἀποβάλλω; cast off, i.e. (figuratively) such as to be rejected. In the KJV it is rendered: be refused.
G580: From ἀποβάλλω; rejection; figuratively, loss. In the KJV it is rendered: casting away, loss.
G581: Past participle of a compound of ἀπό and γίνομαι; absent, i.e. deceased (figuratively, renounced). In the KJV it is rendered: being dead.
G582: From ἀπογράφω; an enrollment; by implication, an assessment. In the KJV it is rendered: taxing.
G583: From ἀπό and γράφω; to write off (a copy or list), i.e. enrol. In the KJV it is rendered: tax, write.
G584: From ἀπό and δεικνύω; to show off, i.e. exhibit; figuratively, to demonstrate, i.e. accredit. In the KJV it is rendered: (ap-)prove, set forth, shew.
G585: From ἀποδείκνυμι; manifestation. In the KJV it is rendered: demonstration.
G586: From ἀπό and δεκατόω; to tithe (as debtor or creditor). In the KJV it is rendered: (give, pay, take) tithe.
G587: From ἀποδέχομαι; accepted, i.e. agreeable. In the KJV it is rendered: acceptable.
G588: From ἀπό and δέχομαι; to take fully, i.e. welcome (persons), approve (things). In the KJV it is rendered: accept, receive (gladly).
G589: From ἀπόδημος; to go abroad, i.e. visit a foreign land. In the KJV it is rendered: go (travel) into a far country, journey.
G590: From ἀπό and δῆμος; absent from one's own people, i.e. a foreign traveller. In the KJV it is rendered: taking a far journey.
G591: From ἀπό and δίδωμι; to give away, i.e. up, over, back, etc. (in various applications). In the KJV it is rendered: deliver (again), give (again), (re-)pay(-ment be made), perform, recompense, render, requite, restore, reward, sell, yield.
G592: From ἀπό and a compound of Ἀλέξανδρος and ὁρίζω; to disjoin (by a boundary, figuratively, a party). In the KJV it is rendered: separate.
G593: From ἀπό and δοκιμάζω; to disapprove, i.e. (by implication) to repudiate. In the KJV it is rendered: disallow, reject.
G594: From ἀποδέχομαι; acceptance. In the KJV it is rendered: acceptation.
G595: From ἀποτίθημι; a laying aside (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: putting away (off).
G596: From ἀποτίθημι; a repository, i.e. granary. In the KJV it is rendered: barn, garner.
G597: From ἀπό and θησαυρίζω; to treasure away. In the KJV it is rendered: lay up in store.
G598: From ἀπό and θλίβω; to crowd (from every side). In the KJV it is rendered: press.
G599: From ἀπό and θνήσκω; to die off (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: be dead, death, die, lie a-dying, be slain (X with).
G600: From ἀπό and καθίστημι; to reconstitute (in health, home or organization). In the KJV it is rendered: restore (again).
G601: From ἀπό and καλύπτω; to take off the cover, i.e. disclose. In the KJV it is rendered: reveal.
G602: From ἀποκαλύπτω; disclosure. In the KJV it is rendered: appearing, coming, lighten, manifestation, be revealed, revelation.
G603: From a comparative of ἀπό and a compound of kara (the head) and δοκέω (in the sense of watching); intense anticipation. In the KJV it is rendered: earnest expectation.
G604: From ἀπό and καταλλάσσω; to reconcile fully. In the KJV it is rendered: reconcile.
G605: From ἀποκαθίστημι; reconstitution. In the KJV it is rendered: restitution.
G606: From ἀπό and κεῖμαι; to be reserved; figuratively, to await. In the KJV it is rendered: be appointed, (be) laid up.
G607: From ἀπό and κεφαλή; to decapitate. In the KJV it is rendered: behead.
G608: From ἀπό and κλείω; to close fully. In the KJV it is rendered: shut up.
G609: From ἀπό and κόπτω; to amputate; reflexively (by irony) to mutilate (the privy parts). In the KJV it is rendered: cut off.
G610: From ἀποκρίνομαι (in its original sense of judging); a judicial decision. In the KJV it is rendered: sentence.
G611: From ἀπό and krino; to conclude for oneself, i.e. (by implication) to respond; by Hebraism (compare עָנָה) to begin to speak (where an address is expected). In the KJV it is rendered: answer.
G612: From ἀποκρίνομαι; a response. In the KJV it is rendered: answer.
G613: From ἀπό and κρύπτω; to conceal away (i.e. fully); figuratively, to keep secret. In the KJV it is rendered: hide.
G614: From ἀποκρύπτω; secret; by implication, treasured. In the KJV it is rendered: hid, kept secret.
G615: From ἀπό and kteino (to slay); to kill outright; figuratively, to destroy. In the KJV it is rendered: put to death, kill, slay.
G616: From ἀπό and the base of κῦμα; to breed forth, i.e. (by transference) to generate (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: beget, produce.
G617: From ἀπό and κυλιόω; to roll away. In the KJV it is rendered: roll away (back).
G618: From ἀπό and λαμβάνω; to receive (specially, in full, or as a host); also to take aside. In the KJV it is rendered: receive, take.
G619: From a comparative of ἀπό and lauo (to enjoy); full enjoyment. In the KJV it is rendered: enjoy(-ment).
G620: From ἀπό and λείπω; to leave behind (passively, remain); by implication, to forsake. In the KJV it is rendered: leave, remain.
G621: From ἀπό and leicho (to "lick"); to lick clean. In the KJV it is rendered: lick.
G622: From ἀπό and the base of ὄλεθρος; to destroy fully (reflexively, to perish, or lose), literally or figuratively. In the KJV it is rendered: destroy, die, lose, mar, perish.
G623: Active participle of ἀπόλλυμι; a destroyer (i.e. Satan). In the KJV it is rendered: Apollyon.
G624: From the pagan deity Apollon (i.e. the sun; from ἀπόλλυμι); Apollonia, a place in Macedonia. In the KJV it is rendered: Apollonia.
G625: Probably from the same as Ἀπολλωνία; Apollos, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Apollos.
G626: Middle voice from a compound of ἀπό and λόγος; to give an account (legal plea) of oneself, i.e. exculpate (self). In the KJV it is rendered: answer (for self), make defence, excuse (self), speak for self.
G627: From the same as ἀπολογέομαι; a plea ("apology"). In the KJV it is rendered: answer (for self), clearing of self, defence.
G628: From ἀπό and λούω; to wash fully, i.e. (figuratively) have remitted (reflexively). In the KJV it is rendered: wash (away).
G629: From a compound of ἀπό and λύτρον; (the act) ransom in full, i.e. (figuratively) riddance, or (specially) Christian salvation. In the KJV it is rendered: deliverance, redemption.
G630: From ἀπό and λύω; to free fully, i.e. (literally) relieve, release, dismiss (reflexively, depart), or (figuratively) let die, pardon or (specially) divorce. In the KJV it is rendered: (let) depart, dismiss, divorce, forgive, let go, loose, put (send) away, release, set at liberty.
G631: Middle voice from ἀπό and masso (to squeeze, knead, smear); to scrape away. In the KJV it is rendered: wipe off.
G632: From ἀπό and the base of νόμος; to apportion, i.e. bestow. In the KJV it is rendered: give.
G633: From ἀπό and νίπτω; to wash off (reflexively, one's own hands symbolically). In the KJV it is rendered: wash.
G634: From ἀπό and πίπτω; to fall off. In the KJV it is rendered: fall.
G635: From ἀπό and πλανάω; to lead astray (figuratively); passively, to stray (from truth). In the KJV it is rendered: err, seduce.
G636: From ἀπό and πλέω; to set sail. In the KJV it is rendered: sail away.
G637: From ἀπό and πλύνω; to rinse off. In the KJV it is rendered: wash.
G638: From ἀπό and πνίγω; to stifle (by drowning or overgrowth). In the KJV it is rendered: choke.
G639: From a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and the base of πορεύομαι; to have no way out, i.e. be at a loss (mentally). In the KJV it is rendered: (stand in) doubt, be perplexed.
G640: From the same as ἀπορέω; a (state of) quandary. In the KJV it is rendered: perplexity.
G641: From ἀπό and ῥίπτω; to hurl off, i.e. precipitate (oneself). In the KJV it is rendered: cast.
G642: From ἀπό and a derivative of ὀρφανός; to bereave wholly, i.e. (figuratively) separate (from intercourse). In the KJV it is rendered: take.
G643: From ἀπό and a derivative of σκεῦος; to pack up (one's) baggage. In the KJV it is rendered: take up… carriages.
G644: From a compound of ἀπό and a derivative of σκιά; a shading off, i.e. obscuration. In the KJV it is rendered: shadow.
G645: From ἀπό and σπάω; to drag forth, i.e. (literally) unsheathe (a sword), or relatively (with a degree of force implied) retire (personally or factiously). In the KJV it is rendered: (with-)draw (away), after we were gotten from.
G646: Feminine of the same as ἀποστάσιον; defection from truth (properly, the state) ("apostasy"). In the KJV it is rendered: falling away, forsake.
G647: Neuter of a (presumed) adjective from a derivative of ἀφίστημι; properly, something separative, i.e. (specially) divorce. In the KJV it is rendered: (writing of) divorcement.
G648: From ἀπό and a derivative of στέγη; to unroof. In the KJV it is rendered: uncover.
G649: From ἀπό and στέλλω; set apart, i.e. (by implication) to send out (properly, on a mission) literally or figuratively. In the KJV it is rendered: put in, send (away, forth, out), set (at liberty).
G650: From ἀπό and stereo (to deprive); to despoil. In the KJV it is rendered: defraud, destitute, kept back by fraud.
G651: From ἀποστέλλω; commission, i.e. (specially) apostolate. In the KJV it is rendered: apostleship.
G652: From ἀποστέλλω; a delegate; specially, an ambassador of the Gospel; officially a commissioner of Christ ("apostle") (with miraculous powers). In the KJV it is rendered: apostle, messenger, he that is sent.
G653: From ἀπό and a (presumed) derivative of στόμα; to speak off-hand (properly, dictate), i.e. to catechize (in an invidious manner). In the KJV it is rendered: provoke to speak.
G654: From ἀπό and στρέφω; to turn away or back (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: bring again, pervert, turn away (from).
G655: From ἀπό and the base of στυγνητός; to detest utterly. In the KJV it is rendered: abhor.
G656: From ἀπό and συναγωγή; excommunicated. In the KJV it is rendered: (put) out of the synagogue(-s).
G657: Middle voice from ἀπό and τάσσω; literally, to say adieu (by departing or dismissing); figuratively, to renounce. In the KJV it is rendered: bid farewell, forsake, take leave, send away.
G658: From ἀπό and τελέω; to complete entirely, i.e. consummate. In the KJV it is rendered: finish.
G659: From ἀπό and τίθημι; to put away (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: cast off, lay apart (aside, down), put away (off).
G660: From ἀπό and tinasso (to jostle); to brush off. In the KJV it is rendered: shake off.
G661: From ἀπό and τίνω; to pay in full. In the KJV it is rendered: repay.
G662: From ἀπό and τολμάω; to venture plainly. In the KJV it is rendered: be very bold.
G663: From the base of ἀποτόμως; (figuratively) decisiveness, i.e. rigor. In the KJV it is rendered: severity.
G664: Adverb from a derivative of a comparative of ἀπό and temno (to cut); abruptly, i.e. peremptorily. In the KJV it is rendered: sharply(-ness).
G665: From ἀπό and the base of τροπή; to deflect, i.e. (reflexively) avoid. In the KJV it is rendered: turn away.
G666: From the participle of ἄπειμι; a being away. In the KJV it is rendered: absence.
G667: From ἀπό and φέρω; to bear off (literally or relatively). In the KJV it is rendered: bring, carry (away).
G668: From ἀπό and φεύγω; (figuratively) to escape. In the KJV it is rendered: escape.
G669: From ἀπό and φθέγγομαι; to enunciate plainly, i.e. declare. In the KJV it is rendered: say, speak forth, utterance.
G670: From ἀπό and the middle voice of φορτίζω; to unload. In the KJV it is rendered: unlade.
G671: From a compound of ἀπό and χράομαι; the act of using up, i.e. consumption. In the KJV it is rendered: using.
G672: From ἀπό and χωρέω; to go away. In the KJV it is rendered: depart.
G673: From ἀπό and χωρίζω; to rend apart; reflexively, to separate. In the KJV it is rendered: depart (asunder).
G674: From ἀπό and ψύχω; to breathe out, i.e. faint. In the KJV it is rendered: hearts failing.
G675: Of Latin origin; (in the genitive, i.e. possessive case) of Appius, the name of a Roman. In the KJV it is rendered: Appii.
G676: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a comparative of πρός and eimi (to go); inaccessible. In the KJV it is rendered: which no man can approach.
G677: From Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of προσκόπτω; actively, inoffensive, i.e. not leading into sin; passively, faultless, i.e. not led into sin. In the KJV it is rendered: none (void of, without) offence.
G678: Adverb from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a presumed compound of πρόσωπον and λαμβάνω (compare προσωπολήπτης); in a way not accepting the person, i.e. impartially. In the KJV it is rendered: without respect of persons.
G679: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of πταίω; not stumbling, i.e. (figuratively) without sin. In the KJV it is rendered: from falling.
G680: Reflexive of ἅπτω; properly, to attach oneself to, i.e. to touch (in many implied relations). In the KJV it is rendered: touch.
G681: A primary verb; properly, to fasten to, i.e. (specially) to set on fire. In the KJV it is rendered: kindle, light.
G682: Probably of foreign origin; Apphia, a woman of Collosæ. In the KJV it is rendered: Apphia.
G683: Or apothomai from ἀπό and the middle voice of otheo or otho (to shove); to push off, figuratively, to reject. In the KJV it is rendered: cast away, put away (from), thrust away (from).
G684: From a presumed derivative of ἀπόλλυμι; ruin or loss (physical, spiritual or eternal). In the KJV it is rendered: damnable(-nation), destruction, die, perdition, X perish, pernicious ways, waste.
G685: Probably from αἴρω; properly, prayer (as lifted to Heaven), i.e. (by implication) imprecation. In the KJV it is rendered: curse.
G686: Probably from αἴρω (through the idea of drawing a conclusion); a particle denoting an inference more or less decisive (as follows). In the KJV it is rendered: haply, (what) manner (of man), no doubt, perhaps, so be, then, therefore, truly, wherefore.
G687: A form of ἄρα, denoting an interrogation to which a negative answer is presumed. In the KJV it is rendered: therefore.
G688: Of Hebrew origin (עֲרָב); Arabia, a region of Asia. In the KJV it is rendered: Arabia.
G689: Of Hebrew origin (רָם); Aram (i.e. Ram), an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Aram.
G690: From Ἀραβία; an Arab or native of Arabia. In the KJV it is rendered: Arabian.
G691: From ἀργός; to be idle, i.e. (figuratively) to delay. In the KJV it is rendered: linger.
G692: From Α (as a negative particle) and ἔργον; inactive, i.e. unemployed; (by implication) lazy, useless. In the KJV it is rendered: barren, idle, slow.
G693: From ἄργυρος; made of silver. In the KJV it is rendered: (of) silver.
G694: Neuter of a presumed derivative of ἄργυρος; silvery, i.e. (by implication) cash; specially, a silverling (i.e. drachma or shekel). In the KJV it is rendered: money, (piece of) silver (piece).
G695: From ἄργυρος and κόπτω; a beater (i.e. worker) of silver. In the KJV it is rendered: silversmith.
G696: From argos (shining); silver (the metal, in the articles or coin). In the KJV it is rendered: silver.
G697: From Ares (the name of the Greek deity of war) and a derivative of πήγνυμι; rock of Ares, a place in Athens. In the KJV it is rendered: Areopagus, Mars' Hill.
G698: From Ἄρειος Πάγος; an Areopagite or member of the court held on Mars' Hill. In the KJV it is rendered: Areopagite.
G699: From a derivative of ἀρέσκω; complaisance. In the KJV it is rendered: pleasing.
G700: Probably from αἴρω (through the idea of exciting emotion); to be agreeable (or by implication, to seek to be so). In the KJV it is rendered: please.
G701: From ἀρέσκω; agreeable; by implication, fit. In the KJV it is rendered: (things that) please(-ing), reason.
G702: Of foreign origin; Aretas, an Arabian. In the KJV it is rendered: Aretas.
G703: From the same as ἄῤῥην; properly, manliness (valor), i.e. excellence (intrinsic or attributed). In the KJV it is rendered: praise, virtue.
G704: Perhaps the same as ἄῤῥην; a lamb (as a male). In the KJV it is rendered: lamb.
G705: From ἀριθμός; to enumerate or count. In the KJV it is rendered: number.
G706: From αἴρω; a number (as reckoned up). In the KJV it is rendered: number.
G707: Of Hebrew origin (רָמָה); Arimathæa (or Ramah), a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Arimathæa.
G708: From the same as ἄριστον and ἄρχω; best ruling; Aristarchus, a Macedonian. In the KJV it is rendered: Aristarchus.
G709: From ἄριστον; to take the principle meal. In the KJV it is rendered: dine.
G710: Apparently a comparative of the same as ἄριστον; the left hand (as second-best). In the KJV it is rendered: left (hand).
G711: From the same as ἄριστον and βουλή; best counselling; Aristoboulus, a Christian. In the KJV it is rendered: Aristobulus.
G712: Apparently neuter of a superlative from the same as ἄῤῥην; the best meal (or breakfast; perhaps from eri ("early")), i.e. luncheon. In the KJV it is rendered: dinner.
G713: From ἀρκέω; satisfactory. In the KJV it is rendered: enough, suffice (-ient).
G714: Apparently a primary verb (but probably akin to αἴρω through the idea of raising a barrier); properly, to ward off, i.e. (by implication) to avail (figuratively, be satisfactory). In the KJV it is rendered: be content, be enough, suffice, be sufficient.
G715: Probably from ἀρκέω; a bear (as obstructing by ferocity). In the KJV it is rendered: bear.
G716: Probably from αἴρω (perhaps with Α (as a particle of union) prefixed); a chariot (as raised or fitted together (compare ἁρμός)). In the KJV it is rendered: chariot.
G717: Of Hebrew origin (הָר and מְגִדּוֹן); Armageddon (or Har-Meggiddon), a symbolic name. In the KJV it is rendered: Armageddon.
G718: From ἁρμός; to joint, i.e. (figuratively) to woo (reflexively, to betroth). In the KJV it is rendered: espouse.
G719: From the same as ἅρμα; an articulation (of the body). In the KJV it is rendered: joint.
G720: Perhaps from Α (as a negative particle) and the middle voice of ῥέω; to contradict, i.e. disavow, reject, abnegate. In the KJV it is rendered: deny, refuse.
G721: Diminutive from ἀρήν; a lambkin. In the KJV it is rendered: lamb.
G722: From ἄροτρον; to plow. In the KJV it is rendered: plough.
G723: From aroo (to till); a plow. In the KJV it is rendered: plough.
G724: From ἁρπάζω; pillage (properly abstract). In the KJV it is rendered: extortion, ravening, spoiling.
G725: From ἁρπάζω; plunder (properly concrete). In the KJV it is rendered: robbery.
G726: From a derivative of αἱρέομαι; to seize (in various applications). In the KJV it is rendered: catch (away, up), pluck, pull, take (by force).
G727: From ἁρπάζω; rapacious. In the KJV it is rendered: extortion, ravening.
G728: Of Hebrew origin (עֲרָבוֹן); a pledge, i.e. part of the purchase-money or property given in advance as security for the rest. In the KJV it is rendered: earnest.
G729: From Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of the same as ῥαφίς; unsewed, i.e. of a single piece. In the KJV it is rendered: without seam.
G730: Or arsen probably from αἴρω; male (as stronger for lifting). In the KJV it is rendered: male, man.
G731: From Α (as a negative particle) and the same as ῥητῶς; unsaid, i.e. (by implication) inexpressible. In the KJV it is rendered: unspeakable.
G732: From Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ῥώννυμι; infirm. In the KJV it is rendered: sick (folk, -ly).
G733: From ἄῤῥην and κοίτη; a sodomite. In the KJV it is rendered: abuser of (that defile) self with mankind.
G734: Contracted from a compound of Ἄρτεμις and δῶρον; gift of Artemis; Artemas (or Artemidorus), a Christian. In the KJV it is rendered: Artemas.
G735: Probably from the same as ἀρτέμων; prompt; Artemis, the name of a Grecian goddess borrowed by the Asiatics for one of their deities. In the KJV it is rendered: Diana.
G736: From a derivative of ἄρτι; properly, something ready (or else more remotely from αἴρω (compare ἄρτος); something hung up), i.e. (specially) the topsail (rather foresail or jib) of a vessel. In the KJV it is rendered: mainsail.
G737: Adverb from a derivative of αἴρω (compare ἄρτος) through the idea of suspension; just now. In the KJV it is rendered: this day (hour), hence(-forth), here(-after), hither(-to), (even) now, (this) present.
G738: From ἄρτι and γεννητός; just born, i.e. (figuratively) a young convert. In the KJV it is rendered: new born.
G739: From ἄρτι; fresh, i.e. (by implication) complete. In the KJV it is rendered: perfect.
G740: From αἴρω; bread (as raised) or a loaf. In the KJV it is rendered: (shew-)bread, loaf.
G741: From a presumed derivative of αἴρω; to prepare, i.e. spice (with stimulating condiments). In the KJV it is rendered: season.
G742: Of Hebrew origin (אַרְפַּכְשַׁד); Arphaxad, a post-diluvian patriarch. In the KJV it is rendered: Arphaxad.
G743: From ἄρχω and ἄγγελος; a chief angel. In the KJV it is rendered: archangel.
G744: From ἀρχή; original or primeval. In the KJV it is rendered: (them of) old (time).
G745: From ἄρχω and Λαοδικεύς; people-ruling; Archelaus, a Jewish king. In the KJV it is rendered: Archelaus.
G746: From ἄρχομαι; (properly abstract) a commencement, or (concretely) chief (in various applications of order, time, place, or rank). In the KJV it is rendered: beginning, corner, (at the, the) first (estate), magistrate, power, principality, principle, rule.
G747: From ἀρχή and ἄγω; a chief leader. In the KJV it is rendered: author, captain, prince.
G748: From ἀρχή and a derivative of ἱερός; high-priestly. In the KJV it is rendered: of the high-priest.
G749: From ἀρχή and ἱερεύς; the high-priest (literally, of the Jews, typically, Christ); by extension a chief priest. In the KJV it is rendered: chief (high) priest, chief of the priests.
G750: From ἀρχή and ποιμήν; a head shepherd. In the KJV it is rendered: chief shepherd.
G751: From ἀρχή and ἵππος; horse-ruler; Archippus, a Christian. In the KJV it is rendered: Archippus.
G752: From ἀρχή and συναγωγή; director of the synagogue services. In the KJV it is rendered: (chief) ruler of the synagogue.
G753: From ἀρχή and τέκτων; a chief constructor, i.e. "architect". In the KJV it is rendered: masterbuilder.
G754: From ἀρχή and τελώνης; a principle tax-gatherer. In the KJV it is rendered: chief among the publicans.
G755: From ἀρχή and a compound of τρεῖς and κλίνω (a dinner-bed, because composed of three couches); director of the entertainment. In the KJV it is rendered: governor (ruler) of the feast.
G756: Middle voice of ἄρχω (through the implication, of precedence); to commence (in order of time). In the KJV it is rendered: (rehearse from the) begin(-ning).
G757: A primary verb; to be first (in political rank or power). In the KJV it is rendered: reign (rule) over.
G758: Present participle of ἄρχω; a first (in rank or power). In the KJV it is rendered: chief (ruler), magistrate, prince, ruler.
G759: From αἴρω (in the sense of sending off scent); an aromatic. In the KJV it is rendered: (sweet) spice.
G760: Of Hebrew origin (אָסָא); Asa, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Asa.
G761: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of σαλεύω; unshaken, i.e. (by implication) immovable (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: which cannot be moved, unmovable.
G762: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of σβέννυμι; not extinguished, i.e. (by implication) perpetual. In the KJV it is rendered: not to be quenched, unquenchable.
G763: From ἀσεβής; impiety, i.e. (by implication) wickedness. In the KJV it is rendered: ungodly(-liness).
G764: From ἀσεβής; to be (by implied act) impious or wicked. In the KJV it is rendered: commit (live, that after should live) ungodly.
G765: From Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of σέβομαι; irreverent, i.e. (by extension) impious or wicked. In the KJV it is rendered: ungodly (man).
G766: From a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed selges (of uncertain derivation, but apparently meaning continent); licentiousness (sometimes including other vices). In the KJV it is rendered: filthy, lasciviousness, wantonness.
G767: From Α (as a negative particle) and the base of σημαίνω; unmarked, i.e. (figuratively) ignoble. In the KJV it is rendered: mean.
G768: Of Hebrew origin (אָשֵׁר); Aser (i.e. Asher), an Israelite tribe. In the KJV it is rendered: Aser.
G769: From ἀσθενής; feebleness (of mind or body); by implication, malady; morally, frailty. In the KJV it is rendered: disease, infirmity, sickness, weakness.
G770: From ἀσθενής; to be feeble (in any sense). In the KJV it is rendered: be diseased, impotent folk (man), (be) sick, (be, be made) weak.
G771: From ἀσθενέω; a scruple of conscience. In the KJV it is rendered: infirmity.
G772: From Α (as a negative particle) and the base of σθενόω; strengthless (in various applications, literal, figurative and moral). In the KJV it is rendered: more feeble, impotent, sick, without strength, weak(-er, -ness, thing).
G773: Of uncertain derivation; Asia, i.e. Asia Minor, or (usually) only its western shore. In the KJV it is rendered: Asia.
G774: From Ἀσία; an Asian (i.e. Asiatic) or an inhabitant of Asia. In the KJV it is rendered: of Asia.
G775: From Ἀσία and ἀρχή; an Asiarch or president of the public festivities in a city of Asia Minor. In the KJV it is rendered: chief of Asia.
G776: From ἄσιτος; fasting (the state). In the KJV it is rendered: abstinence.
G777: From Α (as a negative particle) and σῖτος; without (taking) food. In the KJV it is rendered: fasting.
G778: Probably from the same as σκεῦος; to elaborate, i.e. (figuratively) train (by implication, strive). In the KJV it is rendered: exercise.
G779: From the same as ἀσκέω; a leathern (or skin) bag used as a bottle. In the KJV it is rendered: bottle.
G780: Adverb from a derivative of the base of ἡδονή; with pleasure. In the KJV it is rendered: gladly.
G781: From Α (as a negative particle) and σοφός; unwise. In the KJV it is rendered: fool.
G782: From Α (as a particle of union) and a presumed form of σπάω; to enfold in the arms, i.e. (by implication) to salute, (figuratively) to welcome. In the KJV it is rendered: embrace, greet, salute, take leave.
G783: From ἀσπάζομαι; a greeting (in person or by letter). In the KJV it is rendered: greeting, salutation.
G784: From Α (as a negative particle) and σπιλόω; unblemished (physically or morally). In the KJV it is rendered: without spot, unspotted.
G785: Of uncertain derivation; a buckler (or round shield); used of a serpent (as coiling itself), probably the "asp". In the KJV it is rendered: asp.
G786: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of σπένδω; literally, without libation (which usually accompanied a treaty), i.e. (by implication) truceless. In the KJV it is rendered: implacable, truce-breaker.
G787: Of Latin origin; an assarius or as, a Roman coin. In the KJV it is rendered: farthing.
G788: Neuter comparative of the base of ἐγγύς; more nearly, i.e. very near. In the KJV it is rendered: close.
G789: Probably of foreign origin; Assus, a city of Asia MInor. In the KJV it is rendered: Assos.
G790: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of ἵστημι; to be non-stationary, i.e. (figuratively) homeless. In the KJV it is rendered: have no certain dwelling-place.
G791: From astu (a city); urbane, i.e. (by implication) handsome. In the KJV it is rendered: fair.
G792: Probably from the base of στρώννυμι; a star (as strown over the sky), literally or figuratively. In the KJV it is rendered: star.
G793: From Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of στηρίζω; unfixed, i.e. (figuratively) vacillating. In the KJV it is rendered: unstable.
G794: From Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of stergo (to cherish affectionately); hard-hearted towards kindred. In the KJV it is rendered: without natural affection.
G795: From a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and stoichos (an aim); to miss the mark, i.e. (figuratively) deviate from truth. In the KJV it is rendered: err, swerve.
G796: From ἀστράπτω; lightning; by analogy, glare. In the KJV it is rendered: lightning, bright shining.
G797: Probably from ἀστήρ; to flash as lightning. In the KJV it is rendered: lighten, shine.
G798: Neuter from ἀστήρ; properly, a constellation; put for a single star (natural or artificial). In the KJV it is rendered: star.
G799: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of συγκρίνω; incomparable; Asyncritus, a Christian. In the KJV it is rendered: Asyncritos.
G800: From Α (as a negative particle) and σύμφωνος; inharmonious (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: agree not.
G801: From Α (as a negative particle) and συνετός; unintelligent; by implication, wicked. In the KJV it is rendered: foolish, without understanding.
G802: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of συντίθεμαι; properly, not agreed, i.e. treacherous to compacts. In the KJV it is rendered: covenant-breaker.
G803: From ἀσφαλής; security (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: certainty, safety.
G804: From Α (as a negative particle) and sphallo (to "fail"); secure (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: certain(-ty), safe, sure.
G805: From ἀσφαλής; to render secure. In the KJV it is rendered: make fast (sure).
G806: Adverb from ἀσφαλής; securely (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: assuredly, safely.
G807: From ἀσχήμων; to be (i.e. act) unbecoming. In the KJV it is rendered: behave self uncomely (unseemly).
G808: From ἀσχήμων; an indecency; by implication, the pudenda. In the KJV it is rendered: shame, that which is unseemly.
G809: From Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἔχω (in the sense of its congener σχῆμα); properly, shapeless, i.e. (figuratively) inelegant. In the KJV it is rendered: uncomely.
G810: From a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of σώζω; properly, unsavedness, i.e. (by implication) profligacy. In the KJV it is rendered: excess, riot.
G811: Adverb from the same as ἀσωτία; dissolutely. In the KJV it is rendered: riotous.
G812: From ἄτακτος; to be (i.e. act) irregular. In the KJV it is rendered: behave self disorderly.
G813: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of τάσσω; unarranged, i.e. (by implication) insubordinate (religiously). In the KJV it is rendered: unruly.
G814: Adverb from ἄτακτος, irregularly (morally). In the KJV it is rendered: disorderly.
G815: From Α (as a negative particle) and τέκνον; childless. In the KJV it is rendered: childless, without children.
G816: From a compound of Α (as a particle of union) and teino (to stretch); to gaze intently. In the KJV it is rendered: behold earnestly (stedfastly), fasten (eyes), look (earnestly, stedfastly, up stedfastly), set eyes.
G817: A particle probably akin to ἄνευ; aloof, i.e. apart from (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: in the absence of, without.
G818: From ἄτιμος; to render infamous, i.e. (by implication) contemn or maltreat. In the KJV it is rendered: despise, dishonour, suffer shame, entreat shamefully.
G819: From ἄτιμος; infamy, i.e. (subjectively) comparative indignity, (objectively) disgrace. In the KJV it is rendered: dishonour, reproach, shame, vile.
G820: From Α (as a negative particle) and τιμή; (negatively) unhonoured or (positively) dishonoured. In the KJV it is rendered: despised, without honour, less honourable (comparative degree).
G821: From ἄτιμος; used like ἀτιμάζω, to maltreat. In the KJV it is rendered: handle shamefully.
G822: From the same as ἀήρ; mist. In the KJV it is rendered: vapour.
G823: From Α (as a negative particle) and the base of τομώτερος; uncut, i.e. (by implication) indivisible (an "atom" of time). In the KJV it is rendered: moment.
G824: From Α (as a negative particle) and τόπος; out of place, i.e. (figuratively) improper, injurious, wicked. In the KJV it is rendered: amiss, harm, unreasonable.
G825: From Attalos (a king of Pergamus); Attaleia, a place in Pamphylia. In the KJV it is rendered: Attalia.
G826: From αὐγή; to beam forth (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: shine.
G827: Of uncertain derivation; a ray of light, i.e. (by implication) radiance, dawn. In the KJV it is rendered: break of day.
G828: From Latin ("august"); Augustus, a title of the Roman emperor. In the KJV it is rendered: Augustus.
G829: From αὐτός and the base of ἡδονή; self-pleasing, i.e. arrogant. In the KJV it is rendered: self-willed.
G830: From αὐτός and the same as αἱρετίζω; self-chosen, i.e. (by implication) voluntary. In the KJV it is rendered: of own accord, willing of self.
G831: From a compound of αὐτός and an obsolete hentes (a worker); to act of oneself, i.e. (figuratively) dominate. In the KJV it is rendered: usurp authority over.
G832: From αὐλός; to play the flute. In the KJV it is rendered: pipe.
G833: From the same as ἀήρ; a yard (as open to the wind); by implication, a mansion. In the KJV it is rendered: court, (sheep-)fold, hall, palace.
G834: From αὐλέω; a flute-player. In the KJV it is rendered: minstrel, piper.
G835: Middle voice from αὐλή; to pass the night (properly, in the open air). In the KJV it is rendered: abide, lodge.
G836: From the same as ἀήρ; a flute (as blown). In the KJV it is rendered: pipe.
G837: A prolonged form of a primary verb; to grow ("wax"), i.e. enlarge (literal or figurative, active or passive). In the KJV it is rendered: grow (up), (give the) increase.
G838: From αὐξάνω; growth. In the KJV it is rendered: increase.
G839: From a derivative of the same as ἀήρ (meaning a breeze, i.e. the morning air); properly, fresh, i.e. (adverb with ellipsis of ἡμέρα) to-morrow. In the KJV it is rendered: (to-)morrow, next day.
G840: From a (presumed) derivative of the same as ἀήρ (meaning blown); rough (properly as a gale), i.e. (figuratively) severe. In the KJV it is rendered: austere.
G841: From αὐτάρκης; self-satisfaction, i.e. (abstractly) contentedness, or (concretely) a competence. In the KJV it is rendered: contentment, sufficiency.
G842: From αὐτός and ἀρκέω; self-complacent, i.e. contented. In the KJV it is rendered: content.
G843: From αὐτός and a derivative or κατακρίνω; self-condemned. In the KJV it is rendered: condemned of self.
G844: From αὐτός and the same as μάτην; self-moved ("automatic"), i.e. spontaneous. In the KJV it is rendered: of own accord, of self.
G845: From αὐτός and ὀπτάνομαι; self-seeing, i.e. an eye-witness. In the KJV it is rendered: eye-witness.
G846: From the particle au (perhaps akin to the base of ἀήρ through the idea of a baffling wind) (backward); the reflexive pronoun self, used (alone or in the comparative ἑαυτοῦ) of the third person, and (with the proper personal pronoun) of the other persons. In the KJV it is rendered: her, it(-self), one, the other, (mine) own, said, (self-), the) same, ((him-, my-, thy-)self, (your-)selves, she, that, their(-s), them(-selves), there(-at, - by, -in, -into, -of, -on, -with), they, (these) things, this (man), those, together, very, which.
G847: Genitive (i.e. possessive) of αὐτός, used as an adverb of location; properly, belonging to the same spot, i.e. in this (or that) place. In the KJV it is rendered: (t-)here.
G848: Contracted for ἑαυτοῦ; self (in some oblique case or reflexively, relation). In the KJV it is rendered: her (own), (of) him(-self), his (own), of it, thee, their (own), them(-selves), they.
G849: From αὐτός and χείρ; self-handed, i.e. doing personally. In the KJV it is rendered: with … own hands.
G850: From auchmos (probably from a base akin to that of ἀήρ) (dust, as dried by wind); properly, dirty, i.e. (by implication) obscure. In the KJV it is rendered: dark.
G851: From ἀπό and αἱρέομαι; to remove (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: cut (smite) off, take away.
G852: From Α (as a negative particle) and φαίνω; non-apparent). In the KJV it is rendered: that is not manifest.
G853: From ἀφανής; to render unapparent, i.e. (actively) consume (becloud), or (passively) disappear (be destroyed). In the KJV it is rendered: corrupt, disfigure, perish, vanish away.
G854: From ἀφανίζω; disappearance, i.e. (figuratively) abrogation. In the KJV it is rendered: vanish away.
G855: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of φαίνω; non-manifested, i.e. invisible. In the KJV it is rendered: vanished out of sight.
G856: From a compound of ἀπό and the base of ἑδραῖος; a place of sitting apart, i.e. a privy. In the KJV it is rendered: draught.
G857: From a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and φείδομαι; unsparingness, i.e. austerity (asceticism). In the KJV it is rendered: neglecting.
G858: From a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and phellos (in the sense of a stone as stubbing the foot); smoothness, i.e. (figuratively) simplicity. In the KJV it is rendered: singleness.
G859: From ἀφίημι; freedom; (figuratively) pardon. In the KJV it is rendered: deliverance, forgiveness, liberty, remission.
G860: From ἅπτομαι; probably a ligament (as fastening). In the KJV it is rendered: joint.
G861: From ἄφθαρτος; incorruptibility; genitive, unending existence; (figuratively) genuineness. In the KJV it is rendered: immortality, incorruption, sincerity.
G862: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of φθείρω; undecaying (in essence or continuance). In the KJV it is rendered: not (in-, un-)corruptible, immortal.
G863: From ἀπό and hiemi (to send; an intensive form of eimi, to go); to send forth, in various applications (as follow). In the KJV it is rendered: cry, forgive, forsake, lay aside, leave, let (alone, be, go, have), omit, put (send) away, remit, suffer, yield up.
G864: From ἀπό and the base of ἱκανός; to go (i.e. spread) forth (by rumor). In the KJV it is rendered: come abroad.
G865: From Α (as a negative particle) and φιλάγαθος; hostile to virtue. In the KJV it is rendered: despiser of those that are good.
G866: From Α (as a negative particle) and φιλάργυρος; unavaricious. In the KJV it is rendered: without covetousness, not greedy of filthy lucre.
G867: From ἀφικνέομαι; properly, arrival, i.e. (by implication) departure. In the KJV it is rendered: departing.
G868: From ἀπό and ἵστημι; to remove, i.e. (actively) instigate to revolt; usually (reflexively) to desist, desert, etc. In the KJV it is rendered: depart, draw (fall) away, refrain, withdraw self.
G869: Adverb from ἀφανής (contraction); unawares, i.e. unexpectedly. In the KJV it is rendered: suddenly.
G870: Adverb from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and φόβος; fearlessly. In the KJV it is rendered: without fear.
G871: From ἀπό and ὁμοιόω; to assimilate closely. In the KJV it is rendered: make like.
G872: From ἀπό and ὁράω; to consider attentively. In the KJV it is rendered: look.
G873: From ἀπό and ὁρίζω; to set off by boundary, i.e. (figuratively) limit, exclude, appoint, etc. In the KJV it is rendered: divide, separate, sever.
G874: From a compound of ἀπό and ὁρμάω; a starting-point, i.e. (figuratively) an opportunity. In the KJV it is rendered: occasion.
G875: From ἀφρός; to froth at the mouth (in epilepsy). In the KJV it is rendered: foam.
G876: Apparently a primary word; froth, i.e. slaver. In the KJV it is rendered: foaming.
G877: From ἄφρων; senselessness, i.e. (euphemistically) egotism; (morally) recklessness. In the KJV it is rendered: folly, foolishly(-ness).
G878: From Α (as a negative particle) and φρήν; properly, mindless, i.e. stupid, (by implication) ignorant, (specially) egotistic, (practically) rash, or (morally) unbelieving. In the KJV it is rendered: fool(-ish), unwise.
G879: From a compound of ἀπό and ὕπνος; properly, to become awake, i.e. (by implication) to drop (off) in slumber. In the KJV it is rendered: fall asleep.
G880: From Α (as a negative particle) and φωνή; voiceless, i.e. mute (by nature or choice); figuratively, unmeaning. In the KJV it is rendered: dumb, without signification.
G881: Of Hebrew origin (אָחָז); Achaz, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Achaz.
G882: Of uncertain derivation; Achaia (i.e. Greece), a country of Europe. In the KJV it is rendered: Achaia.
G883: From Ἀχαΐα; an Achaian; Achaicus, a Christian. In the KJV it is rendered: Achaicus.
G884: From Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of χαρίζομαι; thankless, i.e. ungrateful. In the KJV it is rendered: unthankful.
G885: Probably of Hebrew origin (compare יוֹקִים); Achim, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Achim.
G886: From Α (as a negative particle) and χειροποίητος; unmanufactured, i.e. inartificial. In the KJV it is rendered: made without (not made with) hands.
G887: Of uncertain derivation; dimness of sight, i.e. (probably) a cataract. In the KJV it is rendered: mist.
G888: From Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of χρή (compare χρεία); useless, i.e. (euphemistically) unmeritorious. In the KJV it is rendered: unprofitable.
G889: From ἀχρεῖος; to render useless, i.e. spoil. In the KJV it is rendered: become unprofitable.
G890: From Α (as a negative particle) and χρηστός; inefficient, i.e. (by implication) detrimental. In the KJV it is rendered: unprofitable.
G891: Or achris akh'-rece; akin to ἄκρον (through the idea of a terminus); (of time) until or (of place) up to. In the KJV it is rendered: as far as, for, in(-to), till, (even, un-)to, until, while.
G892: Perhaps remotely from cheo (to shed forth); chaff (as diffusive). In the KJV it is rendered: chaff.
G893: From Α (as a negative particle) and ψεῦδος; veracious. In the KJV it is rendered: that cannot lie.
G894: Of uncertain derivation; wormwood (as a type of bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) calamity). In the KJV it is rendered: wormwood.
G895: From Α (as a negative particle) and ψυχή; lifeless, i.e. inanimate (mechanical). In the KJV it is rendered: without life.
G896: Of Hebrew origin (בַּ֫עַל); Baal, a Phœnician deity (used as a symbol of idolatry). In the KJV it is rendered: Baal.
G897: Of Hebrew origin (בָּבֶל); Babylon, the capitol of Chaldæa (literally or figuratively (as a type of tyranny)). In the KJV it is rendered: Babylon.
G898: From the same as βάθος; a step, i.e. (figuratively) grade (of dignity). In the KJV it is rendered: degree.
G899: From the same as βαθύς; profundity, i.e. (by implication) extent; (figuratively) mystery. In the KJV it is rendered: deep(-ness, things), depth.
G900: From βαθύς; to deepen. In the KJV it is rendered: deep.
G901: From the base of βάσις; profound (as going down), literally or figuratively. In the KJV it is rendered: deep, very early.
G902: A diminutive of a derivative probably of the base of βάσις; a palm twig (as going out far). In the KJV it is rendered: branch.
G903: Of Hebrew origin (בִּלְעָם); Balaam, a Mesopotamian (symbolic of a false teacher). In the KJV it is rendered: Balaam.
G904: Of Hebrew origin (בָּלָק); Balak, a Moabite. In the KJV it is rendered: Balac.
G905: Probably remotely from βάλλω (as a depository); a pouch (for money). In the KJV it is rendered: bag, purse.
G906: A primary verb; to throw (in various applications, more or less violent or intense). In the KJV it is rendered: arise, cast (out), X dung, lay, lie, pour, put (up), send, strike, throw (down), thrust.
G907: From a derivative of βάπτω; to immerse, submerge; to make whelmed (i.e. fully wet); used only (in the New Testament) of ceremonial ablution, especially (technically) of the ordinance of Christian baptism. In the KJV it is rendered: Baptist, baptize, wash.
G908: From βαπτίζω; baptism (technically or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: baptism.
G909: From βαπτίζω; ablution (ceremonial or Christian). In the KJV it is rendered: baptism, washing.
G910: From βαπτίζω; a baptizer, as an epithet of Christ's forerunner. In the KJV it is rendered: Baptist.
G911: A primary verb; to whelm, i.e. cover wholly with a fluid; in the New Testament only in a qualified or special sense, i.e. (literally) to moisten (a part of one's person), or (by implication) to stain (as with dye). In the KJV it is rendered: dip.
G912: Of Chaldee origin (גָּאוֹן and אֲבַגְתָא); son of Abba; Bar-abbas, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Barabbas.
G913: Of Hebrew origin (בָּרָק); Barak, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Barak.
G914: Of Hebrew origin (בֶּרֶכְיָה); Barachias (i.e. Berechijah), an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Barachias.
G915: Of uncertain derivation; a foreigner (i.e. non-Greek). In the KJV it is rendered: barbarian(-rous).
G916: From βαρύς; to weigh down (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: burden, charge, heavy, press.
G917: Adverb from βαρύς; heavily (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: dull.
