G1102: By variation for a derivative from knapto (to tease cloth); a cloth-dresser. In the KJV it is rendered: fuller.
G1103: From the same as γενέσια; legitimate (of birth), i.e. genuine. In the KJV it is rendered: own, sincerity, true.
G1104: Adverb from γνήσιος; genuinely, i.e. really. In the KJV it is rendered: naturally.
G1105: Akin to νέφος; gloom (as of a storm). In the KJV it is rendered: blackness.
G1106: From γινώσκω; cognition, i.e. (subjectively) opinion, or (objectively) resolve (counsel, consent, etc.). In the KJV it is rendered: advice, + agree, judgment, mind, purpose, will.
G1107: From a derivative of γινώσκω; to make known; subjectively, to know. In the KJV it is rendered: certify, declare, make known, give to understand, do to wit, wot.
G1108: From γινώσκω; knowing (the act), i.e. (by implication) knowledge. In the KJV it is rendered: knowledge, science.
G1109: From γινώσκω; a knower. In the KJV it is rendered: expert.
G1110: From γινώσκω; well-known. In the KJV it is rendered: acquaintance, (which may be) known, notable.
G1111: Of uncertain derivation; to grumble. In the KJV it is rendered: murmur.
G1112: From γογγύζω; a grumbling. In the KJV it is rendered: grudging, murmuring.
G1113: From γογγύζω; a grumbler. In the KJV it is rendered: murmurer.
G1114: From goao (to wail); properly, a wizard (as muttering spells), i.e. (by implication) an imposter. In the KJV it is rendered: seducer.
G1115: Of Chaldee origin (compare גֻּלְגֹּ֫לֶת); the skull; Golgotha, a knoll near Jerusalem. In the KJV it is rendered: Golgotha.
G1116: Of Hebrew origin (עֲמֹרָה); Gomorrha (i.e. Amorah), a place near the Dead Sea. In the KJV it is rendered: Gomorrha.
G1117: From γέμω; a load (as filling), i.e. (specially) a cargo, or (by extension) wares. In the KJV it is rendered: burden, merchandise.
G1118: From the base of γίνομαι; a parent. In the KJV it is rendered: parent.
G1119: Of uncertain affinity; the "knee". In the KJV it is rendered: knee(X -l).
G1120: From a compound of γόνυ and the alternate of πίπτω; to fall on the knee. In the KJV it is rendered: bow the knee, kneel down.
G1121: From γράφω; a writing, i.e. a letter, note, epistle, book, etc.; plural learning. In the KJV it is rendered: bill, learning, letter, scripture, writing, written.
G1122: From γράμμα. a writer, i.e. (professionally) scribe or secretary. In the KJV it is rendered: scribe, town-clerk.
G1123: From γράφω; inscribed (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: written.
G1124: From γράφω; a document, i.e. holy Writ (or its contents or a statement in it). In the KJV it is rendered: scripture.
G1125: A primary verb; to "grave", especially to write; figuratively, to describe. In the KJV it is rendered: describe, write(-ing, -ten).
G1126: From graus (an old woman) and εἶδος; crone-like, i.e. silly. In the KJV it is rendered: old wives'.
G1127: From ἐγείρω; to keep awake, i.e. watch (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: be vigilant, wake, (be) watch(-ful).
G1128: From γυμνός; to practise naked (in the games), i.e. train (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: exercise.
G1129: From γυμνάζω; training, i.e. (figuratively) asceticism. In the KJV it is rendered: exercise.
G1130: From a derivative of γυμνός; to strip, i.e. (reflexively) go poorly clad. In the KJV it is rendered: be naked.
G1131: Of uncertain affinity; nude (absolute or relative, literal or figurative). In the KJV it is rendered: naked.
G1132: From γυμνός; nudity (absolute or comparative). In the KJV it is rendered: nakedness.
G1133: A diminutive from γυνή; a little (i.e. foolish) woman. In the KJV it is rendered: silly woman.
G1134: From γυνή; feminine. In the KJV it is rendered: wife.
G1135: Probably from the base of γίνομαι; a woman; specially, a wife. In the KJV it is rendered: wife, woman.
G1136: Of Hebrew origin (גּוֹג); Gog, a symbolic name for some future Antichrist. In the KJV it is rendered: Gog.
G1137: Probably akin to γόνυ; an angle. In the KJV it is rendered: corner, quarter.
G1138: Of Hebrew origin (דָּוִיד); Dabid (i.e. David), the Israelite king. In the KJV it is rendered: David.
G1139: Middle voice from δαίμων; to be exercised by a dæmon. In the KJV it is rendered: have a (be vexed with, be possessed with) devil(-s).
G1140: Neuter of a derivative of δαίμων; a dæmonic being; by extension a deity. In the KJV it is rendered: devil, god.
G1141: From δαιμόνιον and δαίμων; dæmon-like. In the KJV it is rendered: devilish.
G1142: From daio (to distribute fortunes); a dæmon or supernatural spirit (of a bad nature). In the KJV it is rendered: devil.
G1143: A prolonged form of a primary root; to bite, i.e. (figuratively) thwart. In the KJV it is rendered: bite.
G1144: Or dakruon of uncertain affinity; a tear. In the KJV it is rendered: tear.
G1145: From δάκρυ; to shed tears. In the KJV it is rendered: weep.
G1146: From δάκτυλος; a finger-ring. In the KJV it is rendered: ring.
G1147: Probably from δέκα; a finger. In the KJV it is rendered: finger.
G1148: Probably of Chaldee origin; Dalmanutha, a place in Palestine. In the KJV it is rendered: Dalmanutha.
G1149: Probably of foreign derivation; Dalmatia, a region of Europe. In the KJV it is rendered: Dalmatia.
G1150: A variation of an obsolete primary of the same meaning; to tame. In the KJV it is rendered: tame.
G1151: Probably from the base of δαμάζω; a heifer (as tame). In the KJV it is rendered: heifer.
G1152: Probably from the base of δαμάζω; perhaps gentle; Damaris, an Athenian woman. In the KJV it is rendered: Damaris.
G1153: From Δαμασκός; a Damascene or inhabitant of Damascus. In the KJV it is rendered: Damascene.
G1154: Of Hebrew origin (NONE); Damascus, a city of Syria. In the KJV it is rendered: Damascus.
G1155: From δάνειον; to loan on interest; reflexively, to borrow. In the KJV it is rendered: borrow, lend.
G1156: From danos (a gift); probably akin to the base of δίδωμι; a loan. In the KJV it is rendered: debt.
G1157: From δανείζω; a lender. In the KJV it is rendered: creditor.
G1158: Of Hebrew origin (דָּנִיֵּאל); Daniel, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Daniel.
G1159: From δαπάνη; to expend, i.e. (in a good sense) to incur cost, or (in a bad one) to waste. In the KJV it is rendered: be at charges, consume, spend.
G1160: From dapto (to devour); expense (as consuming). In the KJV it is rendered: cost.
G1161: A primary particle (adversative or continuative); but, and, etc. In the KJV it is rendered: also, and, but, moreover, now (often unexpressed in English).
G1162: From δέομαι; a petition. In the KJV it is rendered: prayer, request, supplication.
G1163: 3rd person singular active present of δέω; also deon deh-on'; neuter active participle of the same; both used impersonally; it is (was, etc.) necessary (as binding). In the KJV it is rendered: behoved, be meet, must (needs), (be) need(-ful), ought, should.
G1164: From the base of δεικνύω; a specimen (as shown). In the KJV it is rendered: example.
G1165: From δεῖγμα; to exhibit. In the KJV it is rendered: make a shew.
G1166: A prolonged form of an obsolete primary of the same meaning; to show (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: shew.
G1167: From δειλός; timidity. In the KJV it is rendered: fear.
G1168: From δειλία; to be timid. In the KJV it is rendered: be afraid.
G1169: From deos (dread); timid, i.e. (by implication) faithless. In the KJV it is rendered: fearful.
G1170: Probably from the same as δεινῶς (through the idea of forgetting the name as fearful, i.e. strange); so and so (when the person is not specified). In the KJV it is rendered: such a man.
G1171: Adverb from a derivative of the same as δειλός; terribly, i.e. excessively. In the KJV it is rendered: grievously, vehemently.
G1172: From δεῖπνον; to dine, i.e. take the principle (or evening) meal. In the KJV it is rendered: sup (X -er).
G1173: From the same as δαπάνη; dinner, i.e. the chief meal (usually in the evening). In the KJV it is rendered: feast, supper.
G1174: The compound of a derivative of the base of δειλός and δαίμων; more religious than others. In the KJV it is rendered: too superstitious.
G1175: From the same as δεισιδαιμονέστερος; religion. In the KJV it is rendered: superstition.
G1176: A primary number; ten. In the KJV it is rendered: (eight-)een, ten.
G1177: From δέκα and δύο; two and ten, i.e. twelve. In the KJV it is rendered: twelve.
G1178: From δέκα and πέντε; ten and five, i.e. fifteen. In the KJV it is rendered: fifteen.
G1179: From δέκα and πόλις; the ten-city region; the Decapolis, a district in Syria. In the KJV it is rendered: Decapolis.
G1180: From δέκα and τέσσαρες; ten and four, i.e. fourteen. In the KJV it is rendered: fourteen.
G1181: Feminine of δέκατος; a tenth, i.e. as a percentage or (technically) tithe. In the KJV it is rendered: tenth (part), tithe.
G1182: Ordinal from δέκα; tenth. In the KJV it is rendered: tenth.
G1183: From δεκάτη; to tithe, i.e. to give or take a tenth. In the KJV it is rendered: pay (receive) tithes.
G1184: From δέχομαι; approved; (figuratively) propitious. In the KJV it is rendered: accepted(-table).
G1185: From the base of δόλος; to entrap, i.e. (figuratively) delude. In the KJV it is rendered: allure, beguile, entice.
G1186: Probably from drus (an oak); a tree. In the KJV it is rendered: tree.
G1187: From δεξιός and λαμβάνω; a guardsman (as if taking the right) or light-armed soldier. In the KJV it is rendered: spearman.
G1188: From δέχομαι; the right side or (feminine) hand (as that which usually takes). In the KJV it is rendered: right (hand, side).
G1189: Middle voice of δέω; to beg (as binding oneself), i.e. petition. In the KJV it is rendered: beseech, pray (to), make request.
G1190: From Δέρβη; a Derbæan or inhabitant of Derbe. In the KJV it is rendered: of Derbe.
G1191: Of foreign origin; Derbe, a place in Asia Minor. In the KJV it is rendered: Derbe.
G1192: From δέρω; a hide. In the KJV it is rendered: skin.
G1193: From δέρμα; made of hide. In the KJV it is rendered: leathern, of a skin.
G1194: A primary verb; properly, to flay, i.e. (by implication) to scourge, or (by analogy) to thrash. In the KJV it is rendered: beat, smite.
G1195: From a (presumed) derivative of δεσμέω; to be a binder (captor), i.e. to enchain (a prisoner), to tie on (a load). In the KJV it is rendered: bind.
G1196: From δεσμόν; to tie, i.e. shackle. In the KJV it is rendered: bind.
G1197: From δεσμέω; a bundle. In the KJV it is rendered: bundle.
G1198: From δεσμόν; a captive (as bound). In the KJV it is rendered: in bonds, prisoner.
G1199: Or desmos neuter and masculine respectively from δέω; a band, i.e. ligament (of the body) or shackle (of a prisoner); figuratively, an impediment or disability. In the KJV it is rendered: band, bond, chain, string.
G1200: From δεσμόν and φύλαξ; a jailer (as guarding the prisoners). In the KJV it is rendered: jailor, keeper of the prison.
G1201: From a derivative of δεσμόν (equivalent to δεσμέω); a place of bondage, i.e. a dungeon. In the KJV it is rendered: prison.
G1202: From the same as δεσμωτήριον; (passively) a captive. In the KJV it is rendered: prisoner.
G1203: Perhaps from δέω and posis (a husband); an absolute ruler ("despot"). In the KJV it is rendered: Lord, master.
G1204: Of uncertain affinity; here; used also imperative hither!; and of time, hitherto. In the KJV it is rendered: come (hither), hither(-to).
G1205: From δεῦρο and an imperative form of eimi (to go); come hither!. In the KJV it is rendered: come, X follow.
G1206: From δεύτερος; secondary, i.e. (specially) on the second day. In the KJV it is rendered: next day.
G1207: From δεύτερος and πρῶτος; second-first, i.e. (specially) a designation of the Sabbath immediately after the Paschal week (being the second after Passover day, and the first of the seven Sabbaths intervening before Pentecost). In the KJV it is rendered: second … after the first.
G1208: As the comparative of δύο; (ordinal) second (in time, place, or rank; also adverb). In the KJV it is rendered: afterward, again, second(-arily, time).
G1209: Middle voice of a primary verb; to receive (in various applications, literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: accept, receive, take.
G1210: A primary verb; to bind (in various applications, literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: bind, be in bonds, knit, tie, wind.
G1211: Probably akin to δέ; a particle of emphasis or explicitness; now, then, etc. In the KJV it is rendered: also, and, doubtless, now, therefore.
G1212: Of uncertain derivation; clear. In the KJV it is rendered: + bewray, certain, evident, manifest.
G1213: From δῆλος; to make plain (by words). In the KJV it is rendered: declare, shew, signify.
G1214: Probably for Δημήτριος; Demas, a Christian. In the KJV it is rendered: Demas.
G1215: From a compound of δῆμος and ἀγορά; to be a people-gatherer, i.e. to address a public assembly. In the KJV it is rendered: make an oration.
G1216: From Demeter (Ceres); Demetrius, the name of an Ephesian and of a Christian. In the KJV it is rendered: Demetrius.
G1217: From δῆμος and ἔργον; a worker for the people, i.e. mechanic (spoken of the Creator). In the KJV it is rendered: maker.
G1218: From δέω; the public (as bound together socially). In the KJV it is rendered: people.
G1219: From δῆμος; public; (feminine singular dative case as adverb) in public. In the KJV it is rendered: common, openly, publickly.
G1220: Of Latin origin; a denarius (or ten asses). In the KJV it is rendered: pence, penny(-worth).
G1221: From δή and ποτέ; a particle of generalization; indeed, at any time. In the KJV it is rendered: (what-)soever.
G1222: From δή and πού; a particle of asseveration; indeed doubtless. In the KJV it is rendered: verily.
G1223: A primary preposition denoting the channel of an act; through (in very wide applications, local, causal, or occasional). In the KJV it is rendered: after, always, among, at, to avoid, because of (that), briefly, by, for (cause) … fore, from, in, by occasion of, of, by reason of, for sake, that, thereby, therefore, X though, through(-out), to, wherefore, with (-in).
G1224: From διά and the base of βάσις; to cross. In the KJV it is rendered: come over, pass (through).
G1225: From διά and βάλλω; (figuratively) to traduce. In the KJV it is rendered: accuse.
G1226: Middle voice of a compound of διά and βεβαιόω; to confirm thoroughly (by words), i.e. asseverate. In the KJV it is rendered: affirm constantly.
G1227: From διά and βλέπω; to look through, i.e. recover full vision. In the KJV it is rendered: see clearly.
G1228: From διαβάλλω; a traducer; specially, Satan (compare שָׂטָן). In the KJV it is rendered: false accuser, devil, slanderer.
G1229: From διά and the base of ἄγγελος; to herald thoroughly. In the KJV it is rendered: declare, preach, signify.
G1230: From διά and γίνομαι; to elapse meanwhile. In the KJV it is rendered: X after, be past, be spent.
G1231: From διά and γινώσκω; to know thoroughly, i.e. ascertain exactly. In the KJV it is rendered: (would) enquire, know the uttermost.
G1232: From γραπτός and γνωρίζω; to tell abroad. In the KJV it is rendered: make known.
G1233: From διαγινώσκω; (magisterial) examination ("diagnosis"). In the KJV it is rendered: hearing.
G1234: From διά and γογγύζω; to complain throughout a crowd. In the KJV it is rendered: murmur.
G1235: From διά and γρηγορεύω; to waken thoroughly. In the KJV it is rendered: be awake.
G1236: From διά and ἄγω; to pass time or life. In the KJV it is rendered: lead life, living.
G1237: From διά and δέχομαι; to receive in turn, i.e. (figuratively) succeed to. In the KJV it is rendered: come after.
G1238: From a compound of διά and δέω; a "diadem" (as bound about the head). In the KJV it is rendered: crown.
G1239: From διά and δίδωμι; to give throughout a crowd, i.e. deal out; also to deliver over (as to a successor). In the KJV it is rendered: (make) distribute(-ion), divide, give.
G1240: From διαδέχομαι; a successor in office. In the KJV it is rendered: room.
G1241: From διά and ζώννυμι; to gird tightly. In the KJV it is rendered: gird.
G1242: From διατίθεμαι; properly, a disposition, i.e. (specially) a contract (especially a devisory will). In the KJV it is rendered: covenant, testament.
G1243: From διαιρέω; a distinction or (concretely) variety. In the KJV it is rendered: difference, diversity.
G1244: From διά and αἱρέομαι; to separate, i.e. distribute. In the KJV it is rendered: divide.
G1245: From διά and καθαρίζω; to cleanse perfectly, i.e. (specially) winnow. In the KJV it is rendered: thoroughly purge.
G1246: Middle voice from διά and a compound of κατά and ἐλέγχω; to prove downright, i.e. confute. In the KJV it is rendered: convince.
G1247: From διάκονος; to be an attendant, i.e. wait upon (menially or as a host, friend, or (figuratively) teacher); technically, to act as a Christian deacon. In the KJV it is rendered: (ad-)minister (unto), serve, use the office of a deacon.
G1248: From διάκονος; attendance (as a servant, etc.); figuratively (eleemosynary) aid, (official) service (especially of the Christian teacher, or technically of the diaconate). In the KJV it is rendered: (ad-)minister(-ing, -tration, -try), office, relief, service(-ing).
G1249: Probably from an obsolete diako (to run on errands; compare διώκω); an attendant, i.e. (genitive case) a waiter (at table or in other menial duties); specially, a Christian teacher and pastor (technically, a deacon or deaconess). In the KJV it is rendered: deacon, minister, servant.
G1250: From δίς and ἑκατόν; two hundred. In the KJV it is rendered: two hundred.
G1251: Middle voice from διά and ἀκούω; to hear throughout, i.e. patiently listen (to a prisoner's plea). In the KJV it is rendered: hear.
G1252: From διά and κρίνω; to separate thoroughly, i.e. (literally and reflexively) to withdraw from, or (by implication) oppose; figuratively, to discriminate (by implication, decide), or (reflexively) hesitate. In the KJV it is rendered: contend, make (to) differ(-ence), discern, doubt, judge, be partial, stagger, waver.
G1253: From διακρίνω; judicial estimation. In the KJV it is rendered: discern(-ing), disputation.
G1254: From διά and κωλύω; to hinder altogether, i.e. utterly prohibit. In the KJV it is rendered: forbid.
G1255: From διά and λαλέω; to talk throughout a company, i.e. converse or (genitive case) publish. In the KJV it is rendered: commune, noise abroad.
G1256: Middle voice from διά and λέγω; to say thoroughly, i.e. discuss (in argument or exhortation). In the KJV it is rendered: dispute, preach (unto), reason (with), speak.
G1257: From διά and λείπω; to leave off in the middle, i.e. intermit. In the KJV it is rendered: cease.
G1258: From διαλέγομαι; a (mode of) discourse, i.e. "dialect". In the KJV it is rendered: language, tongue.
G1259: From διά and ἀλλάσσω; to change thoroughly, i.e. (mentally) to conciliate. In the KJV it is rendered: reconcile.
G1260: From διά and λογίζομαι; to reckon thoroughly, i.e. (genitive case) to deliberate (by reflection or discussion). In the KJV it is rendered: cast in mind, consider, dispute, muse, reason, think.
G1261: From διαλογίζομαι; discussion, i.e. (internal) consideration (by implication, purpose), or (external) debate. In the KJV it is rendered: dispute, doubtful(-ing), imagination, reasoning, thought.
G1262: From διά and λύω; to dissolve utterly. In the KJV it is rendered: scatter.
G1263: From διά and μαρτυρέω; to attest or protest earnestly, or (by implication) hortatively. In the KJV it is rendered: charge, testify (unto), witness.
G1264: From διά and μάχομαι; to fight fiercely (in altercation). In the KJV it is rendered: strive.
G1265: From διά and μένω; to stay constantly (in being or relation). In the KJV it is rendered: continue, remain.
G1266: From διά and μερίζω; to partition thoroughly (literally in distribution, figuratively in dissension). In the KJV it is rendered: cloven, divide, part.
G1267: From διαμερίζω; disunion (of opinion and conduct). In the KJV it is rendered: division.
G1268: From διά and the base of νόμος; to distribute, i.e. (of information) to disseminate. In the KJV it is rendered: spread.
G1269: From διά and νεύω; to nod (or express by signs) across an intervening space. In the KJV it is rendered: beckon.
G1270: From a compound of διά and νοιέω; something thought through, i.e. a sentiment. In the KJV it is rendered: thought.
G1271: From διά and νοῦς; deep thought, properly, the faculty (mind or its disposition), by implication, its exercise. In the KJV it is rendered: imagination, mind, understanding.
G1272: From διά and ἀνοίγω; to open thoroughly, literally (as a first-born) or figuratively (to expound). In the KJV it is rendered: open.
G1273: From διά and a derivative of νύξ; to sit up the whole night. In the KJV it is rendered: continue all night.
G1274: From διά and anuo (to effect); to accomplish thoroughly. In the KJV it is rendered: finish.
G1275: From διά and the genitive case of πᾶς; through all time, i.e. (adverbially) constantly. In the KJV it is rendered: alway(-s), continually.
G1276: From διά and a derivative of the base of πέραν; to cross entirely. In the KJV it is rendered: go over, pass (over), sail over.
G1277: From διά and πλέω; to sail through. In the KJV it is rendered: sail over.
G1278: From διά and a derivative of πόνος; to toil through, i.e. (passively) be worried. In the KJV it is rendered: be grieved.
G1279: From διά and πορεύομαι; to travel through. In the KJV it is rendered: go through, journey in, pass by.
G1280: From διά and ἀπορέω; to be thoroughly nonplussed. In the KJV it is rendered: (be in) doubt, be (much) perplexed.
G1281: From διά and πραγματεύομαι; to thoroughly occupy oneself, i.e. (transitively and by implication) to earn in business. In the KJV it is rendered: gain by trading.
G1282: From διά and the base of πρίζω; to saw asunder, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate. In the KJV it is rendered: cut (to the heart).
G1283: From διά and ἁρπάζω; to seize asunder, i.e. plunder. In the KJV it is rendered: spoil.
G1284: From διά and ῥήγνυμι; to tear asunder. In the KJV it is rendered: break, rend.
G1285: From διά and saphes (clear); to clear thoroughly, i.e. (figuratively) declare. In the KJV it is rendered: tell unto.
G1286: From διά and σείω; to shake thoroughly, i.e. (figuratively) to intimidate. In the KJV it is rendered: do violence to.
G1287: From διά and σκορπίζω; to dissipate, i.e. (genitive case) to rout or separate; specially, to winnow; figuratively, to squander. In the KJV it is rendered: disperse, scatter (abroad), strew, waste.
G1288: From διά and σπάω; to draw apart, i.e. sever or dismember. In the KJV it is rendered: pluck asunder, pull in pieces.
G1289: From διά and σπείρω; to sow throughout, i.e. (figuratively) distribute in foreign lands. In the KJV it is rendered: scatter abroad.
G1290: From διασπείρω; dispersion, i.e. (specially and concretely) the (converted) Israelite resident in Gentile countries. In the KJV it is rendered: (which are) scattered (abroad).
G1291: Middle voice from διά and στέλλω; to set (oneself) apart (figuratively, distinguish), i.e. (by implication) to enjoin. In the KJV it is rendered: charge, that which was (give) commanded(-ment).
G1292: From διΐστημι; an interval. In the KJV it is rendered: space.
G1293: From διαστέλλομαι; a variation. In the KJV it is rendered: difference, distinction.
G1294: From διά and στρέφω; to distort, i.e. (figuratively) misinterpret, or (morally) corrupt. In the KJV it is rendered: perverse(-rt), turn away.
G1295: From διά and σώζω; to save thoroughly, i.e. (by implication or analogy) to cure, preserve, rescue, etc. In the KJV it is rendered: bring safe, escape (safe), heal, make perfectly whole, save.
G1296: From διατάσσω; arrangement, i.e. institution. In the KJV it is rendered: instrumentality.
G1297: From διατάσσω; an arrangement, i.e. (authoritative) edict. In the KJV it is rendered: commandment.
G1298: From διά and ταράσσω; to disturb wholly, i.e. agitate (with alarm). In the KJV it is rendered: trouble.
G1299: From διά and τάσσω; to arrange thoroughly, i.e. (specially) institute, prescribe, etc. In the KJV it is rendered: appoint, command, give, (set in) order, ordain.
G1300: From διά and τελέω; to accomplish thoroughly, i.e. (subjectively) to persist. In the KJV it is rendered: continue.
G1301: From διά and τηρέω; to watch thoroughly, i.e. (positively and transitively) to observe strictly, or (negatively and reflexively) to avoid wholly. In the KJV it is rendered: keep.
G1302: From διά and τίς; through what cause ?, i.e. why?. In the KJV it is rendered: wherefore, why.
G1303: Middle voice from διά and τίθημι; to put apart, i.e. (figuratively) dispose (by assignment, compact, or bequest). In the KJV it is rendered: appoint, make, testator.
G1304: From διά and the base of τρίβος; to wear through (time), i.e. remain. In the KJV it is rendered: abide, be, continue, tarry.
G1305: From a compound of διά and τρέφω; nourishment. In the KJV it is rendered: food.
G1306: From διά and αὐγάζω; to glimmer through, i.e. break (as day). In the KJV it is rendered: dawn.
G1307: From διά and φαίνω; appearing through, i.e. "diaphanous". In the KJV it is rendered: transparent.
G1308: From διά and φέρω; to bear through, i.e. (literally) transport; usually to bear apart, i.e. (objectively) to toss about (figuratively, report); subjectively, to "differ", or (by implication) surpass. In the KJV it is rendered: be better, carry, differ from, drive up and down, be (more) excellent, make matter, publish, be of more value.
G1309: From διά and φεύγω; to flee through, i.e. escape. In the KJV it is rendered: escape.
G1310: From διά and a derivative of φήμη; to report thoroughly, i.e. divulgate. In the KJV it is rendered: blaze abroad, commonly report, spread abroad, fame.
G1311: From διαβάλλω and φθείρω; to rot thoroughly, i.e. (by implication) to ruin (passively, decay utterly, figuratively, pervert). In the KJV it is rendered: corrupt, destroy, perish.
G1312: From διαφθείρω; decay. In the KJV it is rendered: corruption.
G1313: From διαφέρω; varying; also surpassing. In the KJV it is rendered: differing, divers, more excellent.
G1314: From διά and φυλάσσω; to guard thoroughly, i.e. protect. In the KJV it is rendered: keep.
G1315: From διά and a derivative of χείρ; to handle thoroughly, i.e. lay violent hands upon. In the KJV it is rendered: kill, slay.
G1316: From διά and the middle voice of χωρίζω; to remove (oneself) wholly, i.e. retire. In the KJV it is rendered: depart.
G1317: From διδακτός; instructive ("didactic"). In the KJV it is rendered: apt to teach.
G1318: From διδάσκω; (subjectively) instructed, or (objectively) communicated by teaching. In the KJV it is rendered: taught, which … teacheth.
G1319: From διδάσκαλος; instruction (the function or the information). In the KJV it is rendered: doctrine, learning, teaching.
G1320: From διδάσκω; an instructor (genitive case or specially). In the KJV it is rendered: doctor, master, teacher.
G1321: A prolonged (causative) form of a primary verb dao (to learn); to teach (in the same broad application). In the KJV it is rendered: teach.
G1322: From διδάσκω; instruction (the act or the matter). In the KJV it is rendered: doctrine, hath been taught.
G1323: From δίς and δραχμή; a double drachma (didrachm). In the KJV it is rendered: tribute.
G1324: Prolongation from δίς; double, i.e. twin; Didymus, a Christian. In the KJV it is rendered: Didymus.
G1325: A prolonged form of a primary verb (which is used as an alternative in most of the tenses); to give (used in a very wide application, properly, or by implication, literally or figuratively; greatly modified by the connection). In the KJV it is rendered: adventure, bestow, bring forth, commit, deliver (up), give, grant, hinder, make, minister, number, offer, have power, put, receive, set, shew, smite (+ with the hand), strike (+ with the palm of the hand), suffer, take, utter, yield.
G1326: From διά and ἐγείρω; to wake fully; i.e. arouse (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: arise, awake, raise, stir up.
G1327: From διά and ἔξοδος; an outlet through, i.e. probably an open square (from which roads diverge). In the KJV it is rendered: highway.
G1328: From διερμηνεύω; an explainer. In the KJV it is rendered: interpreter.
G1329: From διά and ἑρμηνεύω; to explain thoroughly, by implication, to translate. In the KJV it is rendered: expound, interpret(-ation).
G1330: From διά and ἔρχομαι; to traverse (literally). In the KJV it is rendered: come, depart, go (about, abroad, everywhere, over, through, throughout), pass (by, over, through, throughout), pierce through, travel, walk through.
G1331: From διά and ἐρωτάω; to question throughout, i.e. ascertain by interrogation. In the KJV it is rendered: make enquiry for.
G1332: From δίς and ἔτος; of two years (in age). In the KJV it is rendered: two years old.
G1333: From διετής; a space of two years (biennium). In the KJV it is rendered: two years.
G1334: From διά and ἡγέομαι; to relate fully. In the KJV it is rendered: declare, shew, tell.
G1335: From διηγέομαι; a recital. In the KJV it is rendered: declaration.
G1336: Neuter of a compound of διά and a derivative of an alternate of φέρω; carried through, i.e. (adverbially with εἰς and ὁ prefixed) perpetually. In the KJV it is rendered: + continually, for ever.
G1337: From δίς and θάλασσα; having two seas, i.e. a sound with a double outlet. In the KJV it is rendered: where two seas meet.
G1338: From διά and the base of ἱκανός; to reach through, i.e. penetrate. In the KJV it is rendered: pierce.
G1339: From διά and ἵστημι; to stand apart, i.e. (reflexively) to remove, intervene. In the KJV it is rendered: go further, be parted, after the space of.
G1340: From διά and a derivative of ἰσχυρός; to stout it through, i.e. asservate. In the KJV it is rendered: confidently (constantly) affirm.
G1341: From δίκαιος and κρίσις; a just sentence. In the KJV it is rendered: righteous judgment.
G1342: From δίκη; equitable (in character or act); by implication, innocent, holy (absolutely or relatively). In the KJV it is rendered: just, meet, right(-eous).
G1343: From δίκαιος; equity (of character or act); specially (Christian) justification. In the KJV it is rendered: righteousness.
G1344: From δίκαιος; to render (i.e. show or regard as) just or innocent. In the KJV it is rendered: free, justify(-ier), be righteous.
G1345: From δικαιόω; an equitable deed; by implication, a statute or decision. In the KJV it is rendered: judgment, justification, ordinance, righteousness.
G1346: Adverb from δίκαιος; equitably. In the KJV it is rendered: justly, (to) righteously(-ness).
G1347: From δικαιόω; aquittal (for Christ's sake). In the KJV it is rendered: justification.
G1348: From a derivative of δίκη; a judger. In the KJV it is rendered: judge.
G1349: Probably from δεικνύω; right (as self-evident), i.e. justice (the principle, a decision, or its execution). In the KJV it is rendered: judgment, punish, vengeance.
G1350: Probably from a primary verb diko (to cast); a seine (for fishing). In the KJV it is rendered: net.
G1351: From δίς and λόγος; equivocal, i.e. telling a different story. In the KJV it is rendered: double-tongued.
G1352: From διά and ὅς; through which thing, i.e. consequently. In the KJV it is rendered: for which cause, therefore, wherefore.
G1353: From διά and ὁδεύω; to travel through. In the KJV it is rendered: go throughout, pass through.
G1354: From Dionusos (Bacchus); reveller; Dionysius, an Athenian. In the KJV it is rendered: Dionysius.
G1355: From διό and περ; on which very account. In the KJV it is rendered: wherefore.
G1356: From the alternate of Ζεύς and the alternate of πίπτω; sky-fallen (i.e. an aerolite). In the KJV it is rendered: which fell down from Jupiter.
G1357: From a compound of διά and a derivative of ὀρθός, meaning to straighten thoroughly; rectification, i.e. (specially) the Messianic restauration. In the KJV it is rendered: reformation.
G1358: From διά and ὀρύσσω; to penetrate burglariously. In the KJV it is rendered: break through (up).
G1359: From the alternate of Ζεύς and a form of the base of κοράσιον; sons of Jupiter, i.e. the twins Dioscuri. In the KJV it is rendered: Castor and Pollux.
G1360: From διά and ὅτι; on the very account that, or inasmuch as. In the KJV it is rendered: because (that), for, therefore.
G1361: From the alternate of Ζεύς and τρέφω; Jove-nourished; Diotrephes, an opponent of Christianity. In the KJV it is rendered: Diotrephes.
G1362: From δίς and (probably) the base of πλείων; two-fold. In the KJV it is rendered: double, two-fold more.
G1363: From διπλοῦς; to render two-fold. In the KJV it is rendered: double.
G1364: Adverb from δύο; twice. In the KJV it is rendered: again, twice.
G1365: From δίς; properly, to duplicate, i.e. (mentally) to waver (in opinion). In the KJV it is rendered: doubt.
G1366: From δίς and στόμα; double-edged. In the KJV it is rendered: with two edges, two-edged.
G1367: From δίς and χίλιοι; two thousand. In the KJV it is rendered: two thousand.
G1368: From διά and hulizo hoo-lid'-zo (to filter); to strain out. In the KJV it is rendered: strain at (probably by misprint).
G1369: From a derivative of δίς; to make apart, i.e. sunder (figuratively, alienate). In the KJV it is rendered: set at variance.
G1370: From a derivative of δίς and στάσις; disunion, i.e. (figuratively) dissension. In the KJV it is rendered: division, sedition.
G1371: From a compound of a derivative of δίς and a derivative of temno (to cut); to bisect, i.e. (by extension) to flog severely. In the KJV it is rendered: cut asunder (in sunder).
G1372: From a variation of δίψος; to thirst for (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: (be, be a-)thirst(-y).
G1373: Of uncertain affinity; thirst. In the KJV it is rendered: thirst.
G1374: From δίς and ψυχή; two-spirited, i.e. vacillating (in opinion or purpose). In the KJV it is rendered: double minded.
G1375: From διώκω; persecution. In the KJV it is rendered: persecution.
G1376: From διώκω; a persecutor. In the KJV it is rendered: persecutor.
G1377: A prolonged (and causative) form of a primary verb dio (to flee; compare the base of δειλός and διάκονος); to pursue (literally or figuratively); by implication, to persecute. In the KJV it is rendered: ensue, follow (after), given to, (suffer) persecute(-ion), press forward.
G1378: From the base of δοκέω; a law (civil, ceremonial or ecclesiastical). In the KJV it is rendered: decree, ordinance.
G1379: From δόγμα; to prescribe by statute, i.e. (reflexively) to submit to, ceremonially rule. In the KJV it is rendered: be subject to ordinances.
G1380: A prolonged form of a primary verb, doko dok'-o (used only in an alternate in certain tenses; compare the base of δεικνύω) of the same meaning; to think; by implication, to seem (truthfully or uncertainly). In the KJV it is rendered: be accounted, (of own) please(-ure), be of reputation, seem (good), suppose, think, trow.
G1381: From δόκιμος; to test (literally or figuratively); by implication, to approve. In the KJV it is rendered: allow, discern, examine, X like, (ap-)prove, try.
G1382: From the same as δόκιμος; test (abstractly or concretely); by implication, trustiness. In the KJV it is rendered: experience(-riment), proof, trial.
G1383: Neuter of a presumed derivative of δοκιμή; a testing; by implication, trustworthiness. In the KJV it is rendered: trial, trying.
G1384: From δοκέω; properly, acceptable (current after assayal), i.e. approved. In the KJV it is rendered: approved, tried.
G1385: From δέχομαι (through the idea of holding up); a stick of timber. In the KJV it is rendered: beam.
G1386: From δόλος; guileful. In the KJV it is rendered: deceitful.
G1387: From δόλιος; to be guileful. In the KJV it is rendered: use deceit.
G1388: From an obsolete primary verb, dello (probably meaning to decoy; compare δελεάζω); a trick (bait), i.e. (figuratively) wile. In the KJV it is rendered: craft, deceit, guile, subtilty.
G1389: From δόλος; to ensnare, i.e. (figuratively) adulterate. In the KJV it is rendered: handle deceitfully.
G1390: From the base of δίδωμι; a present. In the KJV it is rendered: gift.
G1391: From the base of δοκέω; glory (as very apparent), in a wide application (literal or figurative, objective or subjective). In the KJV it is rendered: dignity, glory(-ious), honour, praise, worship.
G1392: From δόξα; to render (or esteem) glorious (in a wide application). In the KJV it is rendered: (make) glorify(-ious), full of (have) glory, honour, magnify.
G1393: Gazelle; Dorcas, a Christian woman. In the KJV it is rendered: Dorcas.
G1394: From the base of δίδωμι; a giving; by implication, (concretely) a gift. In the KJV it is rendered: gift, giving.
G1395: From the base of δίδωμι; a giver. In the KJV it is rendered: giver.
G1396: From a presumed compound of δοῦλος and ἄγω; to be a slave-driver, i.e. to enslave (figuratively, subdue). In the KJV it is rendered: bring into subjection.
G1397: From δουλεύω; slavery (ceremonially or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: bondage.
G1398: From δοῦλος; to be a slave to (literal or figurative, involuntary or voluntary). In the KJV it is rendered: be in bondage, (do) serve(-ice).
G1399: Feminine of δοῦλος; a female slave (involuntarily or voluntarily). In the KJV it is rendered: handmaid(-en).
G1400: Neuter of δοῦλος; subservient. In the KJV it is rendered: servant.
G1401: From δέω; a slave (literal or figurative, involuntary or voluntary; frequently, therefore in a qualified sense of subjection or subserviency). In the KJV it is rendered: bond(-man), servant.
G1402: From δοῦλος; to enslave (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: bring into (be under) bondage, X given, become (make) servant.
G1403: From δέχομαι; a reception, i.e. convivial entertainment. In the KJV it is rendered: feast.
G1404: Probably from an alternate form of derkomai (to look); a fabulous kind of serpent (perhaps as supposed to fascinate). In the KJV it is rendered: dragon.
G1405: Perhaps akin to the base of δράκων (through the idea of capturing); to grasp, i.e. (figuratively) entrap. In the KJV it is rendered: take.
G1406: From δράσσομαι; a drachma or (silver) coin (as handled). In the KJV it is rendered: piece (of silver).
G1407: From drepo (to pluck); a gathering hook (especially for harvesting). In the KJV it is rendered: sickle.
G1408: From the alternate of τρέχω; a race, i.e. (figuratively) career. In the KJV it is rendered: course.
G1409: A feminine diminutive of Drusus (a Roman name); Drusilla, a member of the Herodian family. In the KJV it is rendered: Drusilla.
G1410: Of uncertain affinity; to be able or possible. In the KJV it is rendered: be able, can (do, + -not), could, may, might, be possible, be of power.
G1411: From δύναμαι; force (literally or figuratively); specially, miraculous power (usually by implication, a miracle itself). In the KJV it is rendered: ability, abundance, meaning, might(-ily, -y, -y deed), (worker of) miracle(-s), power, strength, violence, mighty (wonderful) work.
G1412: From δύναμις; to enable. In the KJV it is rendered: strengthen.
G1413: From δύναμαι; a ruler or officer. In the KJV it is rendered: of great authority, mighty, potentate.
G1414: From δυνατός; to be efficient (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: be mighty.
G1415: From δύναμαι; powerful or capable (literally or figuratively); neuter possible. In the KJV it is rendered: able, could, (that is) mighty (man), possible, power, strong.
G1416: Or dumi prolonged forms of an obsolete primary duo (to sink) to go "down". In the KJV it is rendered: set.
G1417: A primary numeral; "two". In the KJV it is rendered: both, twain, two.
G1418: A primary inseparable particle of uncertain derivation; used only in composition as a prefix; hard, i.e. with difficulty. In the KJV it is rendered: + hard, + grievous, etc.
G1419: From δυσ- and a derivative of βαστάζω; oppressive. In the KJV it is rendered: grievous to be borne.
G1420: From δυσ- and a comparative of ἐντός (meaning a bowel); a "dysentery". In the KJV it is rendered: bloody flux.
G1421: From δυσ- and a presumed derivative of ἑρμηνεύω; difficult of explanation. In the KJV it is rendered: hard to be uttered.
G1422: From δυσ- and kolon (food); properly, fastidious about eating (peevish), i.e. (genitive case) impracticable. In the KJV it is rendered: hard.
G1423: Adverb from δύσκολος; impracticably. In the KJV it is rendered: hardly.
G1424: From δύνω; the sun-set, i.e. (by implication) the western region. In the KJV it is rendered: west.
G1425: From δυσ- and a derivative of νοιέω; difficult of perception. In the KJV it is rendered: hard to be understood.
G1426: From a compound of δυσ- and φήμη; defamation. In the KJV it is rendered: evil report.
G1427: From δύο and δέκα; two and ten, i.e. a dozen. In the KJV it is rendered: twelve.
G1428: From δώδεκα; twelfth. In the KJV it is rendered: twelfth.
G1429: From δώδεκα and φυλή; the commonwealth of Israel. In the KJV it is rendered: twelve tribes.
G1430: From demo (to build); properly, an edifice, i.e. (specially) a roof. In the KJV it is rendered: housetop.
G1431: From δῶρον; a gratuity. In the KJV it is rendered: gift.
G1432: Accusative case of δωρεά as adverb; gratuitously (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: without a cause, freely, for naught, in vain.
G1433: Middle voice from δῶρον; to bestow gratuitously. In the KJV it is rendered: give.
G1434: From δωρέομαι; a bestowment. In the KJV it is rendered: gift.
G1435: A present; specially, a sacrifice. In the KJV it is rendered: gift, offering.
G1436: Apparent imperative of ἐάω; properly, let it be, i.e. (as interjection) aha!. In the KJV it is rendered: let alone.
G1437: From εἰ and ἄν; a conditional particle; in case that, provided, etc.; often used in connection with other particles to denote indefiniteness or uncertainty. In the KJV it is rendered: before, but, except, (and) if, (if) so, (what-, whither-)soever, though, when (-soever), whether (or), to whom, (who-)so(-ever).
G1438: From a reflexive pronoun otherwise obsolete and the genitive case (dative case or accusative case) of αὐτός; him- (her-, it-, them-, also (in conjunction with the personal pronoun of the other persons) my-, thy-, our-, your-) self (selves), etc. In the KJV it is rendered: alone, her (own, -self), (he) himself, his (own), itself, one (to) another, our (thine) own(-selves), + that she had, their (own, own selves), (of) them(-selves), they, thyself, you, your (own, own conceits, own selves, -selves).
G1439: Of uncertain affinity; to let be, i.e. permit or leave alone. In the KJV it is rendered: commit, leave, let (alone), suffer.
G1440: From ἕβδομος and a modified form of δέκα; seventy. In the KJV it is rendered: seventy, three score and ten.
G1441: Multiple adverb from ἑβδομήκοντα; seventy times. In the KJV it is rendered: seventy times.
G1442: Ordinal from ἑπτά; seventh. In the KJV it is rendered: seventh.
G1443: Of Hebrew origin (עֵ֫בֶר); Eber, a patriarch. In the KJV it is rendered: Eber.
G1444: From Ἐβέρ; Hebraic or the Jewish language. In the KJV it is rendered: Hebrew.
G1445: From Ἐβέρ; a Hebræan (i.e. Hebrew) or Jew. In the KJV it is rendered: Hebrew.
G1446: From Ἐβέρ; the Hebraistic (Hebrew) or Jewish (Chaldee) language. In the KJV it is rendered: Hebrew.
G1447: Adverb from Ἑβραΐς; Hebraistically or in the Jewish (Chaldee) language. In the KJV it is rendered: in (the) Hebrew (tongue).
G1448: From ἐγγύς; to make near, i.e. (reflexively) approach. In the KJV it is rendered: approach, be at hand, come (draw) near, be (come, draw) nigh.
G1449: From ἐν and γράφω; to "engrave", i.e. inscribe. In the KJV it is rendered: write (in).
G1450: From ἐν and guion (a limb); pledged (as if articulated by a member), i.e. a bondsman. In the KJV it is rendered: surety.
G1451: From a primary verb agcho (to squeeze or throttle; akin to the base of ἀγκάλη); near (literally or figuratively, of place or time). In the KJV it is rendered: from, at hand, near, nigh (at hand, unto), ready.
G1452: Neuter of the comparative of ἐγγύς; nearer. In the KJV it is rendered: nearer.
G1453: Probably akin to the base of ἀγορά (through the idea of collecting one's faculties); to waken (transitively or intransitively), i.e. rouse (literally, from sleep, from sitting or lying, from disease, from death; or figuratively, from obscurity, inactivity, ruins, nonexistence). In the KJV it is rendered: awake, lift (up), raise (again, up), rear up, (a-)rise (again, up), stand, take up.
G1454: From ἐγείρω; a resurgence (from death). In the KJV it is rendered: resurrection.
G1455: From ἐν and a derivative of καθίημι; subinduced, i.e. surreptitiously suborned as a lier-in-wait. In the KJV it is rendered: spy.
G1456: Neuter plural of a presumed compound from ἐν and καινός; innovatives, i.e. (specially) renewal (of religious services after the Antiochian interruption). In the KJV it is rendered: dedication.
G1457: From ἐγκαίνια; to renew, i.e. inaugurate. In the KJV it is rendered: consecrate, dedicate.
G1458: From ἐν and καλέω; to call in (as a debt or demand), i.e. bring to account (charge, criminate, etc.). In the KJV it is rendered: accuse, call in question, implead, lay to the charge.
G1459: From ἐν and καταλείπω; to leave behind in some place, i.e. (in a good sense) let remain over, or (in a bad sense) to desert. In the KJV it is rendered: forsake, leave.
G1460: From ἐν and κατοικέω; to settle down in a place, i.e. reside. In the KJV it is rendered: dwell among.
G1461: From ἐν and a derivative of κέντρον; to prick in, i.e. ingraft. In the KJV it is rendered: graff in(-to).
G1462: From ἐγκαλέω; an accusation, i.e. offence alleged. In the KJV it is rendered: crime laid against, laid to charge.
G1463: Middle voice from ἐν and komboo (to gird); to engirdle oneself (for labor), i.e. figuratively (the apron as being a badge of servitude) to wear (in token of mutual deference). In the KJV it is rendered: be clothed with.

G1831: From ἐκ and ἔρχομαι; to issue (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: come (forth, out), depart (out of), escape, get out, go (abroad, away, forth, out, thence), proceed (forth), spread abroad.
G1832: Third person singular present indicative of a compound of ἐκ and εἰμί; so also exon ex-on' neuter present participle of the same (with or without some form of εἰμί expressed); impersonally, it is right (through the figurative idea of being out in public). In the KJV it is rendered: be lawful, let, X may(-est).
G1833: From ἐκ and etazo (to examine); to test thoroughly (by questions), i.e. ascertain or interrogate. In the KJV it is rendered: ask, enquire, search.
G1834: From ἐκ and ἡγέομαι; to consider out (aloud), i.e. rehearse, unfold. In the KJV it is rendered: declare, tell.
G1835: The tenth multiple of ἕξ; sixty. In the KJV it is rendered: sixty(-fold), threescore.
G1836: From ἔχω (in the sense of taking hold of, i.e. adjoining); successive. In the KJV it is rendered: after, following, X morrow, next.
G1837: Middle voice from ἐκ and ἠχέω; to "echo" forth, i.e. resound (be generally reported). In the KJV it is rendered: sound forth.
G1838: From ἔχω; habit, i.e. (by implication) practice. In the KJV it is rendered: use.
G1839: From ἐκ and ἵστημι; to put (stand) out of wits, i.e. astound, or (reflexively) become astounded, insane. In the KJV it is rendered: amaze, be (make) astonished, be beside self (selves), bewitch, wonder.
G1840: From ἐκ and ἰσχύω; to have full strength, i.e. be entirely competent. In the KJV it is rendered: be able.
G1841: From ἐκ and ὁδός; an exit, i.e. (figuratively) death. In the KJV it is rendered: decease, departing.
G1842: From ἐκ and ὀλοθρεύω; to extirpate. In the KJV it is rendered: destroy.
G1843: From ἐκ and ὁμολογέω; to acknowledge or (by implication, of assent) agree fully. In the KJV it is rendered: confess, profess, promise.
G1844: From ἐκ and ὁρκίζω; to exact an oath, i.e. conjure. In the KJV it is rendered: adjure.
G1845: From ἐξορκίζω; one that binds by an oath (or spell), i.e. (by implication) an "exorcist" (conjurer). In the KJV it is rendered: exorcist.
G1846: From ἐκ and ὀρύσσω; to dig out, i.e. (by extension) to extract (an eye), remove (roofing). In the KJV it is rendered: break up, pluck out.
G1847: From ἐκ and a derivative of the neuter of οὐδείς; to make utterly nothing of, i.e. despise. In the KJV it is rendered: set at nought.
G1848: A variation of ἐξουδενόω and meaning the same. In the KJV it is rendered: contemptible, despise, least esteemed, set at nought.
G1849: From ἔξεστι (in the sense of ability); privilege, i.e. (subjectively) force, capacity, competency, freedom, or (objectively) mastery (concretely, magistrate, superhuman, potentate, token of control), delegated influence. In the KJV it is rendered: authority, jurisdiction, liberty, power, right, strength.
G1850: From ἐξουσία; to control. In the KJV it is rendered: exercise authority upon, bring under the (have) power of.
G1851: From a compound of ἐκ and ἔχω (meaning to stand out); prominence (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: principal.
G1852: From ἔξυπνος; to waken. In the KJV it is rendered: awake out of sleep.
G1853: From ἐκ and ὕπνος; awake. In the KJV it is rendered: X out of sleep.
G1854: Adverb from ἐκ; out(-side, of doors), literally or figuratively. In the KJV it is rendered: away, forth, (with-)out (of, -ward), strange.
G1855: From ἔξω; external(-ly). In the KJV it is rendered: out(-side, -ward, - wardly), (from) without.
G1856: Or exotho from ἐκ and otheo (to push); to expel; by implication, to propel. In the KJV it is rendered: drive out, thrust in.
G1857: Comparative of ἔξω; exterior. In the KJV it is rendered: outer.
G1858: From ἑορτή; to observe a festival. In the KJV it is rendered: keep the feast.
G1859: Of uncertain affinity; a festival. In the KJV it is rendered: feast, holyday.
G1860: From ἐπαγγέλλω; an announcement (for information, assent or pledge; especially a divine assurance of good). In the KJV it is rendered: message, promise.
G1861: From ἐπί and the base of ἄγγελος; to announce upon (reflexively), i.e. (by implication) to engage to do something, to assert something respecting oneself. In the KJV it is rendered: profess, (make) promise.
G1862: From ἐπαγγέλλω; a self-committal (by assurance of conferring some good). In the KJV it is rendered: promise.
G1863: From ἐπί and ἄγω; to superinduce, i.e. inflict (an evil), charge (a crime). In the KJV it is rendered: bring upon.
G1864: From ἐπί and ἀγωνίζομαι; to struggle for. In the KJV it is rendered: earnestly contend for.
G1865: From ἐπί and athroizo (to assemble); to accumulate. In the KJV it is rendered: gather thick together.
G1866: From ἐπαινέω; praised; Epænetus, a Christian. In the KJV it is rendered: Epenetus.
G1867: From ἐπί and αἰνέω; to applaud. In the KJV it is rendered: commend, laud, praise.
G1868: From ἐπί and the base of αἰνέω; laudation; concretely, a commendable thing. In the KJV it is rendered: praise.
G1869: From ἐπί and αἴρω; to raise up (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: exalt self, poise (lift, take) up.
G1870: From ἐπί and αἰσχύνομαι; to feel shame for something. In the KJV it is rendered: be ashamed.
G1871: From ἐπί and αἰτέω; to ask for. In the KJV it is rendered: beg.
G1872: From ἐπί and ἀκολουθέω; to accompany. In the KJV it is rendered: follow (after).
G1873: From ἐπί and ἀκούω; to hearken (favorably) to. In the KJV it is rendered: hear.
G1874: From ἐπί and the base of ἀκροατής; to listen (intently) to. In the KJV it is rendered: hear.
G1875: From ἐπί and ἄν; a particle of indefinite contemporaneousness; whenever, as soon as. In the KJV it is rendered: when.
G1876: Neuter of a presumed compound of ἐπί and ἀνάγκη; (adverbially) on necessity, i.e. necessarily. In the KJV it is rendered: necessary.
G1877: From ἐπί and ἀνάγω; to lead up on, i.e. (technical) to put out (to sea); (intransitively) to return. In the KJV it is rendered: launch (thrust) out, return.
G1878: From ἐπί and ἀναμιμνήσκω; to remind of. In the KJV it is rendered: put in mind.
G1879: Middle voice from ἐπί and ἀναπαύω; to settle on; literally (remain) or figuratively (rely). In the KJV it is rendered: rest in (upon).
G1880: From ἐπί and ἀνέρχομαι; to come up on, i.e. return. In the KJV it is rendered: come again, return.
G1881: Middle voice from ἐπί and ἀνίστημι; to stand up on, i.e. (figuratively) to attack. In the KJV it is rendered: rise up against.
G1882: From a compound of ἐπί and ἀνορθόω; a straightening up again, i.e. (figuratively) rectification (reformation). In the KJV it is rendered: correction.
G1883: From ἐπί and ἄνω; up above, i.e. over or on (of place, amount, rank, etc.). In the KJV it is rendered: above, more than, (up-)on, over.
G1884: From ἐπί and ἀρκέω; to avail for, i.e. help. In the KJV it is rendered: relieve.
G1885: From a compound of ἐπί and ἄρχω (meaning a governor of a district, "eparch"); a special region of government, i.e. a Roman præfecture. In the KJV it is rendered: province.
G1886: From ἐπί and an equivalent of αὐλή; a hut over the head, i.e. a dwelling. In the KJV it is rendered: habitation.
G1887: From ἐπί and αὔριον; occurring on the succeeding day, i.e. (ἡμέρα being implied) to-morrow. In the KJV it is rendered: day following, morrow, next day (after).
G1888: From ἐπί and αὐτός and (the dative case singular of) a derivative of phor (a thief); in theft itself, i.e. (by analogy) in actual crime. In the KJV it is rendered: in the very act.
G1889: Contracted from Ἐπαφρόδιτος; Epaphras, a Christian. In the KJV it is rendered: Epaphras.
G1890: From ἐπί and ἀφρίζω; to foam upon, i.e. (figuratively) to exhibit (a vile passion). In the KJV it is rendered: foam out.
G1891: From ἐπί (in the sense of devoted to) and Aphrodite (Venus); Epaphroditus, a Christian. In the KJV it is rendered: Epaphroditus.
G1892: From ἐπί and ἐγείρω; to rouse upon, i.e. (figuratively) to excite against. In the KJV it is rendered: raise, stir up.
G1893: From ἐπί and εἰ; thereupon, i.e. since (of time or cause). In the KJV it is rendered: because, else, for that (then, -asmuch as), otherwise, seeing that, since, when.
G1894: From ἐπεί and δή; since now, i.e. (of time) when, or (of cause) whereas. In the KJV it is rendered: after that, because, for (that, -asmuch as), seeing, since.
G1895: From ἐπειδή and περ; since indeed (of cause). In the KJV it is rendered: forasmuch.
G1896: And other moods and persons of the same tense; from ἐπί and εἴδω; to regard (favorably or otherwise). In the KJV it is rendered: behold, look upon.
G1897: From ἐπεί and περ; since indeed (of cause). In the KJV it is rendered: seeing.
G1898: From a compound of ἐπί and εἰσάγω; a superintroduction. In the KJV it is rendered: bringing in.
G1899: From ἐπί and εἶτα; thereafter. In the KJV it is rendered: after that(-ward), then.
G1900: From ἐπί and (the accusative case plural neuter of) ἐκεῖνος; upon those parts of, i.e. on the further side of. In the KJV it is rendered: beyond.
G1901: Middle voice from ἐπί and ἐκτείνω; to stretch (oneself) forward upon. In the KJV it is rendered: reach forth.
G1902: Middle voice from ἐπί and ἐνδύω; to invest upon oneself. In the KJV it is rendered: be clothed upon.
G1903: From ἐπενδύομαι; a wrapper, i.e. outer garment. In the KJV it is rendered: fisher's coat.
G1904: From ἐπί and ἔρχομαι; to supervene, i.e. arrive, occur, impend, attack, (figuratively) influence. In the KJV it is rendered: come (in, upon).
G1905: From ἐπί and ἐρωτάω; to ask for, i.e. inquire, seek. In the KJV it is rendered: ask (after, questions), demand, desire, question.
G1906: From ἐπερωτάω; an inquiry. In the KJV it is rendered: answer.
G1907: From ἐπί and ἔχω; to hold upon, i.e. (by implication) to retain; (by extension) to detain; (with implication, of νοῦς) to pay attention to. In the KJV it is rendered: give (take) heed unto, hold forth, mark, stay.
G1908: From a comparative of ἐπί and (probably) areia (threats); to insult, slander. In the KJV it is rendered: use despitefully, falsely accuse.
G1909: A primary preposition; properly, meaning superimposition (of time, place, order, etc.), as a relation of distribution (with the genitive case), i.e. over, upon, etc.; of rest (with the dative case) at, on, etc.; of direction (with the accusative case) towards, upon, etc. In the KJV it is rendered: about (the times), above, after, against, among, as long as (touching), at, beside, X have charge of, (be-, (where-))fore, in (a place, as much as, the time of, -to), (because) of, (up-)on (behalf of), over, (by, for) the space of, through(-out), (un-)to(-ward), with.
G1910: From ἐπί and the base of βάσις; to walk upon, i.e. mount, ascend, embark, arrive. In the KJV it is rendered: come (into), enter into, go abroad, sit upon, take ship.
G1911: From ἐπί and βάλλω; to throw upon (literal or figurative, transitive or reflexive; usually with more or less force); specially (with ἑαυτοῦ implied) to reflect; impersonally, to belong to. In the KJV it is rendered: beat into, cast (up-)on, fall, lay (on), put (unto), stretch forth, think on.
G1912: From ἐπί and βαρέω; to be heavy upon, i.e. (pecuniarily) to be expensive to; figuratively, to be severe towards. In the KJV it is rendered: be chargeable to, overcharge.
G1913: From ἐπί and a reduplicated derivative of the base of βάσις (compare ἀναβιβάζω); to cause to mount (an animal). In the KJV it is rendered: set on.
G1914: From ἐπί and βλέπω; to gaze at (with favor, pity or partiality). In the KJV it is rendered: look upon, regard, have respect to.
G1915: From ἐπιβάλλω; a patch. In the KJV it is rendered: piece.
G1916: From ἐπί and βοάω; to exclaim against. In the KJV it is rendered: cry.
G1917: From a presumed compound of ἐπί and βούλομαι; a plan against someone, i.e. a plot. In the KJV it is rendered: laying (lying) in wait.
G1918: From ἐπί and a derivative of γάμος; to form affinity with, i.e. (specially) in a levirate way. In the KJV it is rendered: marry.
G1919: From ἐπί and γῆ; worldly (physically or morally). In the KJV it is rendered: earthly, in earth, terrestrial.
G1920: From ἐπί and γίνομαι; to arrive upon, i.e. spring up (as a wind). In the KJV it is rendered: blow.
G1921: From ἐπί and γινώσκω; to know upon some mark, i.e. recognize; by implication, to become fully acquainted with, to acknowledge. In the KJV it is rendered: (ac-, have, take)know(-ledge, well), perceive.
G1922: From ἐπιγινώσκω; recognition, i.e. (by implication) full discernment, acknowledgement. In the KJV it is rendered: (ac-)knowledge(-ing, - ment).
G1923: From ἐπιγράφω; an inscription. In the KJV it is rendered: superscription.
G1924: From ἐπί and γράφω; to inscribe (physically or mentally). In the KJV it is rendered: inscription, write in (over, thereon).
G1925: From ἐπί and δεικνύω; to exhibit (physically or mentally). In the KJV it is rendered: shew.
G1926: From ἐπί and δέχομαι; to admit (as a guest or (figuratively) teacher). In the KJV it is rendered: receive.
G1927: From a compound of ἐπί and δῆμος; to make oneself at home, i.e. (by extension) to reside (in a foreign country). In the KJV it is rendered: (be) dwelling (which were) there, stranger.
G1928: Middle voice from ἐπί and διατάσσω; to appoint besides, i.e. supplement (as a codicil). In the KJV it is rendered: add to.
G1929: From ἐπί and δίδωμι; to give over (by hand or surrender). In the KJV it is rendered: deliver unto, give, let (+ (her drive)), offer.
G1930: From ἐπί and a derivative of ὀρθός; to straighten further, i.e. (figuratively) arrange additionally. In the KJV it is rendered: set in order.
G1931: From ἐπί and δύνω; to set fully (as the sun). In the KJV it is rendered: go down.
G1932: From ἐπιεικής; suitableness, i.e. (by implication) equity, mildness. In the KJV it is rendered: clemency, gentleness.
G1933: From ἐπί and εἴκω; appropriate, i.e. (by implication) mild. In the KJV it is rendered: gentle, moderation, patient.
G1934: From ἐπί and ζητέω; to search (inquire) for; intensively, to demand, to crave. In the KJV it is rendered: desire, enquire, seek (after, for).
G1935: From ἐπί and θάνατος; doomed to death. In the KJV it is rendered: appointed to death.
G1936: From ἐπιτίθημι; an imposition (of hands officially). In the KJV it is rendered: laying (putting) on.
G1937: From ἐπί and θυμός; to set the heart upon, i.e. long for (rightfully or otherwise). In the KJV it is rendered: covet, desire, would fain, lust (after).
G1938: From ἐπιθυμέω; a craver. In the KJV it is rendered: + lust after.
G1939: From ἐπιθυμέω; a longing (especially for what is forbidden). In the KJV it is rendered: concupiscence, desire, lust (after).
G1940: From ἐπί and καθίζω; to seat upon. In the KJV it is rendered: set on.
G1941: Middle voice from ἐπί and καλέω; to entitle; by implication, to invoke (for aid, worship, testimony, decision, etc.). In the KJV it is rendered: appeal (unto), call (on, upon), surname.
G1942: From ἐπικαλύπτω; a covering, i.e. (figuratively) pretext. In the KJV it is rendered: cloke.
G1943: From ἐπί and καλύπτω; to conceal, i.e. (figuratively) forgive. In the KJV it is rendered: cover.
G1944: From ἐπί and a derivative of καταράομαι; imprecated, i.e. execrable. In the KJV it is rendered: accursed.
G1945: From ἐπί and κεῖμαι; to rest upon (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: impose, be instant, (be) laid (there-, up-)on, (when) lay (on), lie (on), press upon.
G1946: From Epikouros (compare ἐπικουρία) (a noted philosopher); an Epicurean or follower of Epicurus. In the KJV it is rendered: Epicurean.
G1947: From a compound of ἐπί and a (prolonged) form of the base of κοράσιον (in the sense of servant); assistance. In the KJV it is rendered: help.
G1948: From ἐπί and κρίνω; to adjudge. In the KJV it is rendered: give sentence.
G1949: Middle voice from ἐπί and λαμβάνω; to seize (for help, injury, attainment, or any other purpose; literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: catch, lay hold (up-)on, take (by, hold of, on).
G1950: Middle voice from ἐπί and λανθάνω; to lose out of mind; by implication, to neglect. In the KJV it is rendered: (be) forget(-ful of).
G1951: Middle voice from ἐπί and λέγω; to surname, select. In the KJV it is rendered: call, choose.
G1952: From ἐπί and λείπω; to leave upon, i.e. (figuratively) to be insufficient for. In the KJV it is rendered: fail.
G1953: From a derivative of ἐπιλανθάνομαι; negligence. In the KJV it is rendered: X forgetful.
G1954: From ἐπί and λοιποί; left over, i.e. remaining. In the KJV it is rendered: rest.
G1955: From ἐπιλύω; explanation, i.e. application. In the KJV it is rendered: interpretation.
G1956: From ἐπί and λύω; to solve further, i.e. (figuratively) to explain, decide. In the KJV it is rendered: determine, expound.
G1957: From ἐπί and μαρτυρέω; to attest further, i.e. corroborate. In the KJV it is rendered: testify.
G1958: From ἐπιμελέομαι; carefulness, i.e. kind attention (hospitality). In the KJV it is rendered: + refresh self.
G1959: Middle voice from ἐπί and the same as μέλω; to care for (physically or otherwise). In the KJV it is rendered: take care of.
G1960: Adverb from a derivative of ἐπιμελέομαι; carefully. In the KJV it is rendered: diligently.
G1961: From ἐπί and μένω; to stay over, i.e. remain (figuratively, persevere). In the KJV it is rendered: abide (in), continue (in), tarry.
G1962: From ἐπί and νεύω; to nod at, i.e. (by implication) to assent. In the KJV it is rendered: consent.
G1963: From ἐπί and νοῦς; attention of the mind, i.e. (by implication) purpose. In the KJV it is rendered: thought.
G1964: From ἐπίορκος; to commit perjury. In the KJV it is rendered: forswear self.
G1965: From ἐπί and ὅρκος; on oath, i.e. (falsely) a forswearer. In the KJV it is rendered: perjured person.
G1966: Feminine singular participle of a comparative of ἐπί and eimi (to go); supervening, i.e. (ἡμέρα or νύξ being expressed or implied) the ensuing day or night. In the KJV it is rendered: following, next.
G1967: Perhaps from the same as ἐπιοῦσα; tomorrow's; but more probably from ἐπί and a derivative of the present participle feminine of εἰμί; for subsistence, i.e. needful. In the KJV it is rendered: daily.
G1968: From ἐπί and πίπτω; to embrace (with affection) or seize (with more or less violence; literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: fall into (on, upon) lie on, press upon.
G1969: From ἐπί and πλήσσω; to chastise, i.e. (with words) to upbraid. In the KJV it is rendered: rebuke.
G1970: From ἐπί and πνίγω; to throttle upon, i.e. (figuratively) overgrow. In the KJV it is rendered: choke.
G1971: From ἐπί and potheo (to yearn); to dote upon, i.e. intensely crave possession (lawfully or wrongfully). In the KJV it is rendered: (earnestly) desire (greatly), (greatly) long (after), lust.
G1972: From ἐπιποθέω; a longing for. In the KJV it is rendered: earnest (vehement) desire.
G1973: From ἐπί and a derivative of the latter part of ἐπιποθέω; yearned upon, i.e. greatly loved. In the KJV it is rendered: longed for.
G1974: From ἐπιποθέω; intense longing. In the KJV it is rendered: great desire.
G1975: From ἐπί and πορεύομαι; to journey further, i.e. travel on (reach). In the KJV it is rendered: come.
G1976: From ἐπί and the base of ῥαφίς; to stitch upon, i.e. fasten with the needle. In the KJV it is rendered: sew on.
G1977: From ἐπί and ῥίπτω; to throw upon (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: cast upon.
G1978: From ἐπί and some form of the base of σημαίνω; remarkable, i.e. (figuratively) eminent. In the KJV it is rendered: notable, of note.
G1979: From a compound of ἐπί and a derivative of σῖτος; a provisioning, i.e. (concretely) food. In the KJV it is rendered: victuals.
G1980: Middle voice from ἐπί and the base of σκοπός; to inspect, i.e. (by implication) to select; by extension, to go to see, relieve. In the KJV it is rendered: look out, visit.
G1981: From ἐπί and σκηνόω; to tent upon, i.e. (figuratively) abide with. In the KJV it is rendered: rest upon.
G1982: From ἐπί and a derivative of σκιά; to cast a shade upon, i.e. (by analogy) to envelop in a haze of brilliancy; figuratively, to invest with preternatural influence. In the KJV it is rendered: overshadow.
G1983: From ἐπί and σκοπέω; to oversee; by implication, to beware. In the KJV it is rendered: look diligently, take the oversight.
G1984: From ἐπισκέπτομαι; inspection (for relief); by implication, superintendence; specially, the Christian "episcopate". In the KJV it is rendered: the office of a "bishop", bishoprick, visitation.
G1985: From ἐπί and σκοπός (in the sense of ἐπισκοπέω); a superintendent, i.e. Christian officer in genitive case charge of a (or the) church (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: bishop, overseer.
G1986: From ἐπί and σπάω; to draw over, i.e. (with ἀκροβυστία implied) efface the mark of circumcision (by recovering with the foreskin). In the KJV it is rendered: become uncircumcised.
G1987: Apparently a middle voice of ἐφίστημι (with νοῦς implied); to put the mind upon, i.e. comprehend, or be acquainted with. In the KJV it is rendered: know, understand.
G1988: From ἐπί and a presumed derivative of ἵστημι; an appointee over, i.e. commander (teacher). In the KJV it is rendered: master.
G1989: From ἐπί and στέλλω; to enjoin (by writing), i.e. (genitive case) to communicate by letter (for any purpose). In the KJV it is rendered: write (a letter, unto).
G1990: From ἐπίσταμαι; intelligent. In the KJV it is rendered: endued with knowledge.
G1991: From ἐπί and στηρίζω; to support further, i.e. reestablish. In the KJV it is rendered: confirm, strengthen.
G1992: From ἐπιστέλλω; a written message. In the KJV it is rendered: "epistle," letter.
G1993: From ἐπί and στόμα; to put something over the mouth, i.e. (figuratively) to silence. In the KJV it is rendered: stop mouths.
G1994: From ἐπί and στρέφω; to revert (literally, figuratively or morally). In the KJV it is rendered: come (go) again, convert, (re-)turn (about, again).
G1995: From ἐπιστρέφω; reversion, i.e. morally, revolution. In the KJV it is rendered: conversion.
G1996: From ἐπί and συνάγω; to collect upon the same place. In the KJV it is rendered: gather (together).
G1997: From ἐπισυνάγω; a complete collection; especially a Christian meeting (for worship). In the KJV it is rendered: assembling (gathering) together.
G1998: From ἐπί and συντρέχω; to hasten together upon one place (or a particular occasion). In the KJV it is rendered: come running together.
G1999: From the middle voice of a compound of ἐπί and συνιστάω; a conspiracy, i.e. concourse (riotous or friendly). In the KJV it is rendered: that which cometh upon, + raising up.
G2000: From a compound of ἐπί and sphallo (to trip); figuratively, insecure. In the KJV it is rendered: dangerous.
G2001: From ἐπί and ἰσχύω; to avail further, i.e. (figuratively) insist stoutly. In the KJV it is rendered: be the more fierce.
G2002: From ἐπί and σωρεύω; to accumulate further, i.e. (figuratively) seek additionally. In the KJV it is rendered: heap.
G2003: From ἐπιτάσσω; an injunction or decree; by implication, authoritativeness. In the KJV it is rendered: authority, commandment.
G2004: From ἐπί and τάσσω; to arrange upon, i.e. order. In the KJV it is rendered: charge, command, injoin.
G2005: From ἐπί and τελέω; to fulfill further (or completely), i.e. execute; by implication, to terminate, undergo. In the KJV it is rendered: accomplish, do, finish, (make) (perfect), perform(X -ance).
G2006: From epitedes (enough); serviceable, i.e. (by implication) requisite. In the KJV it is rendered: things which are needful.
G2007: From ἐπί and τίθημι; to impose (in a friendly or hostile sense). In the KJV it is rendered: add unto, lade, lay upon, put (up) on, set on (up), + surname, X wound.
G2008: From ἐπί and τιμάω; to tax upon, i.e. censure or admonish; by implication, forbid. In the KJV it is rendered: (straitly) charge, rebuke.
G2009: From a compound of ἐπί and τιμή; properly, esteem, i.e. citizenship; used (in the sense of ἐπιτιμάω) of a penalty. In the KJV it is rendered: punishment.
G2010: From ἐπί and the base of τροπή; to turn over (transfer), i.e. allow. In the KJV it is rendered: give leave (liberty, license), let, permit, suffer.
G2011: From ἐπιτρέπω; permission, i.e. (by implication) full power. In the KJV it is rendered: commission.
G2012: From ἐπί and τρόπος (in the sense of ἐπιτροπή); a commissioner, i.e. domestic manager, guardian. In the KJV it is rendered: steward, tutor.
G2013: From ἐπί and τυγχάνω; to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) to attain. In the KJV it is rendered: obtain.
G2014: From ἐπί and φαίνω; to shine upon, i.e. become (literally) visible or (figuratively) known. In the KJV it is rendered: appear, give light.
G2015: From ἐπιφανής; a manifestation, i.e. (specially) the advent of Christ (past or future). In the KJV it is rendered: appearing, brightness.
G2016: From ἐπιφαίνω; conspicuous, i.e. (figuratively) memorable. In the KJV it is rendered: notable.
G2017: A form of ἐπιφαίνω; to illuminate (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: give light.
G2018: From ἐπί and φέρω; to bear upon (or further), i.e. adduce (personally or judicially (accuse, inflict)), superinduce. In the KJV it is rendered: add, bring (against), take.
G2019: From ἐπί and φωνέω; to call at something, i.e. exclaim. In the KJV it is rendered: cry (against), give a shout.
G2020: A form of ἐπιφαύω; to begin to grow light. In the KJV it is rendered: begin to dawn, X draw on.
G2021: From ἐπί and χείρ; to put the hand upon, i.e. undertake. In the KJV it is rendered: go about, take in hand (upon).
G2022: From ἐπί and cheo (to pour); --to pour upon. In the KJV it is rendered: pour in.
G2023: From ἐπί and χορηγέω; to furnish besides, i.e. fully supply, (figuratively) aid or contribute. In the KJV it is rendered: add, minister (nourishment, unto).
G2024: From ἐπιχορηγέω; contribution. In the KJV it is rendered: supply.
G2025: From ἐπί and χρίω; to smear over. In the KJV it is rendered: anoint.
G2026: From ἐπί and οἰκοδομέω; to build upon, i.e. (figuratively) to rear up. In the KJV it is rendered: build thereon (thereupon, on, upon).
G2027: From ἐπί and okello (to urge); to drive upon the shore, i.e. to beach a vessel. In the KJV it is rendered: run aground.
G2028: From ἐπί and ὀνομάζω; to name further, i.e. denominate. In the KJV it is rendered: call.
G2029: From ἐπί and a derivative of ὀπτάνομαι; to inspect, i.e. watch. In the KJV it is rendered: behold.
G2030: From ἐπί and a presumed derivative of ὀπτάνομαι; a looker-on. In the KJV it is rendered: eye-witness.
G2031: From ἔπω; a word. In the KJV it is rendered: X say.
G2032: From ἐπί and οὐρανός; above the sky. In the KJV it is rendered: celestial, (in) heaven(-ly), high.
G2033: A primary number; seven. In the KJV it is rendered: seven.
G2034: Adverb from ἑπτά; seven times. In the KJV it is rendered: seven times.
G2035: From ἑπτάκις and χίλιοι; seven times a thousand. In the KJV it is rendered: seven thousand.
G2036: A primary verb (used only in the definite past tense, the others being borrowed from ἐρέω, ῥέω, and φημί); to speak or say (by word or writing). In the KJV it is rendered: answer, bid, bring word, call, command, grant, say (on), speak, tell.
G2037: From erao (to love); beloved; Erastus, a Christian. In the KJV it is rendered: Erastus.
G2038: Middle voice from ἔργον; to toil (as a task, occupation, etc.), (by implication) effect, be engaged in or with, etc. In the KJV it is rendered: commit, do, labor for, minister about, trade (by), work.
G2039: From ἐργάτης; occupation; by implication, profit, pains. In the KJV it is rendered: craft, diligence, gain, work.
G2040: From ἔργον; a toiler; figuratively, a teacher. In the KJV it is rendered: labourer, worker(-men).
G2041: From a primary (but obsolete) ergo (to work); toil (as an effort or occupation); by implication, an act. In the KJV it is rendered: deed, doing, labour, work.
G2042: From a presumed prolonged form of ἔρις; to stimulate (especially to anger). In the KJV it is rendered: provoke.
G2043: Of obscure affinity; to prop, i.e. (reflexively) get fast. In the KJV it is rendered: stick fast.
G2044: Of uncertain affinity; to belch, i.e. (figuratively) to speak out. In the KJV it is rendered: utter.
G2045: Apparently from ἐρέω (through the idea of inquiry); to seek, i.e. (figuratively) to investigate. In the KJV it is rendered: search.
G2046: Probably a fuller form of ῥέω; an alternate for ἔπω in certain tenses; to utter, i.e. speak or say. In the KJV it is rendered: call, say, speak (of), tell.
G2047: From ἔρημος; solitude (concretely). In the KJV it is rendered: desert, wilderness.
G2048: Of uncertain affinity; lonesome, i.e. (by implication) waste (usually as a noun, χώρα being implied). In the KJV it is rendered: desert, desolate, solitary, wilderness.
G2049: From ἔρημος; to lay waste (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: (bring to, make) desolate(-ion), come to nought.
G2050: From ἐρημόω; despoliation. In the KJV it is rendered: desolation.
G2051: From ἔρις; to wrangle. In the KJV it is rendered: strive.
G2052: Perhaps as the same as ἐρεθίζω; properly, intrigue, i.e. (by implication) faction. In the KJV it is rendered: contention(-ious), strife.
G2053: Of obscure affinity; wool. In the KJV it is rendered: wool.
G2054: Of uncertain affinity; a quarrel, i.e. (by implication) wrangling. In the KJV it is rendered: contention, debate, strife, variance.
G2055: From ἔριφος; a kidling, i.e. (genitive case) goat (symbolically, wicked person). In the KJV it is rendered: goat.
G2056: Perhaps from the same as ἔριον (through the idea of hairiness); a kid or (genitive case) goat. In the KJV it is rendered: goat, kid.
G2057: Probably from Ἑρμῆς; Hermas, a Christian. In the KJV it is rendered: Hermas.
G2058: From the same as ἑρμηνεύω; translation. In the KJV it is rendered: interpretation.
G2059: From a presumed derivative of Ἑρμῆς (as the god of language); to translate. In the KJV it is rendered: interpret.
G2060: Perhaps from ἐρέω; Hermes, the name of the messenger of the Greek deities; also of a Christian. In the KJV it is rendered: Hermes, Mercury.
G2061: From Ἑρμῆς and γίνομαι; born of Hermes; Hermogenes, an apostate Christian. In the KJV it is rendered: Hermogenes.
G2062: Neuter of a derivative of herpo (to creep); a reptile, i.e. (by Hebraism (compare רֶ֫מֶשׂ)) a small animal. In the KJV it is rendered: creeping thing, serpent.
G2063: Of uncertain affinity; red, i.e. (with θάλασσα) the Red Sea. In the KJV it is rendered: red.
G2064: Middle voice of a primary verb (used only in the present and imperfect tenses, the others being supplied by a kindred (middle voice) eleuthomai el-yoo'-thom-ahee, or (active) eltho el'-tho, which do not otherwise occur); to come or go (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: accompany, appear, bring, come, enter, fall out, go, grow, X light, X next, pass, resort, be set.
G2065: Apparently from ἐρέω (compare ἐρευνάω); to interrogate; by implication, to request. In the KJV it is rendered: ask, beseech, desire, intreat, pray.
G2066: From hennumi (to clothe); dress. In the KJV it is rendered: apparel, clothing, raiment, robe.
G2067: From a derivative of ἐσθής; clothing (concretely). In the KJV it is rendered: government.
G2068: Strengthened for a primary edo (to eat); used only in certain tenses, the rest being supplied by φάγω; to eat (usually literal). In the KJV it is rendered: devour, eat, live.
G2069: Of Hebrew origin (probably for אֶלְיְהוֹעֵינַי); Esli, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Esli.
G2070: First person plural indicative of εἰμί; we are. In the KJV it is rendered: are, be, have our being, X have hope, + (the gospel) was (preached unto) us.
G2071: Future of εἰμί; will be. In the KJV it is rendered: shall (should) be (have), (shall) come (to pass), X may have, X fall, what would follow, X live long, X sojourn.
G2072: From εἰς and a presumed derivative of ὀπτάνομαι; a mirror (for looking into). In the KJV it is rendered: glass.
G2073: Feminine of an adjective hesperos (evening); the eve (ὥρα being implied). In the KJV it is rendered: evening(-tide).
G2074: Of Hebrew origin (חֶצְרוֹן); Esrom (i.e. Chetsron), an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Esrom.
G2075: Second person plural present indicative of εἰμί; ye are. In the KJV it is rendered: be, have been, belong.
G2076: Third person singular present indicative of εἰμί; he (she or it) is; also (with neuter plural) they are. In the KJV it is rendered: are, be(-long), call, X can(-not), come, consisteth, X dure for a while, + follow, X have, (that) is (to say), make, meaneth, X must needs, + profit, + remaineth, + wrestle.
G2077: Second person singular present imperative of εἰμί; be thou; also estosan, third person of the same let them be. In the KJV it is rendered: be.
G2078: A superlative probably from ἔχω (in the sense of contiguity); farthest, final (of place or time). In the KJV it is rendered: ends of, last, latter end, lowest, uttermost.
G2079: Adverb from ἔσχατος; finally, i.e. (with ἔχω) at the extremity of life. In the KJV it is rendered: point of death.
G2080: From εἰς; inside (as preposition or adjective). In the KJV it is rendered: (with-)in(-ner, -to, -ward).
G2081: From ἔσω; from inside; also used as equivalent to ἔσω (inside). In the KJV it is rendered: inward(-ly), (from) within, without.
G2082: Comparative of ἔσω; interior. In the KJV it is rendered: inner, within.
G2083: From etes (a clansman); a comrade. In the KJV it is rendered: fellow, friend.
G2084: From ἕτερος and γλῶσσα; other- tongued, i.e. a foreigner. In the KJV it is rendered: man of other tongue.
G2085: From ἕτερος and διδάσκαλος; to instruct differently. In the KJV it is rendered: teach other doctrine(-wise).
