G2697: From κατέχω; a holding down, i.e. occupancy. In the KJV it is rendered: possession.
G2698: From κατά and τίθημι; to place down, i.e. deposit (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: do, lay, shew.
G2699: From a compound of κατά and temno (to cut); a cutting down (off), i.e. mutilation (ironically). In the KJV it is rendered: concision.
G2700: From κατά and a derivative of τόξον; to shoot down with an arrow or other missile. In the KJV it is rendered: thrust through.
G2701: From κατά and τρέχω; to run down, i.e. hasten from a tower. In the KJV it is rendered: run down.
G2702: From κατά and φέρω (including its alternate); to bear down, i.e. (figuratively) overcome (with drowsiness); specially, to cast a vote. In the KJV it is rendered: fall, give, sink down.
G2703: From κατά and φεύγω; to flee down (away). In the KJV it is rendered: flee.
G2704: From κατά and φθείρω; to spoil entirely, i.e. (literally) to destroy; or (figuratively) to deprave; --corrupt, utterly perish.
G2705: From κατά and φιλέω; to kiss earnestly. In the KJV it is rendered: kiss.
G2706: From κατά and φρονέω; to think against, i.e. disesteem. In the KJV it is rendered: despise.
G2707: From καταφρονέω; a contemner. In the KJV it is rendered: despiser.
G2708: From κατά and cheo (to pour); to pour down (out). In the KJV it is rendered: pour.
G2709: From κατά and chthon (the ground); subterranean, i.e. infernal (belonging to the world of departed spirits). In the KJV it is rendered: under the earth.
G2710: From κατά and χράομαι; to overuse, i.e. misuse. In the KJV it is rendered: abuse.
G2711: From κατά and ψύχω; to cool down (off), i.e. refresh. In the KJV it is rendered: cool.
G2712: From κατά (intensively) and εἴδωλον; utterly idolatrous. In the KJV it is rendered: wholly given to idolatry.
G2713: From κατά and ἔναντι; directly opposite. In the KJV it is rendered: before, over against.
G2714: From κατά and ἐνώπιον; directly in front of. In the KJV it is rendered: before (the presence of), in the sight of.
G2715: From κατά and ἐξουσιάζω; to have (wield) full privilege over. In the KJV it is rendered: exercise authority.
G2716: From κατά and ἐργάζομαι; to work fully, i.e. accomplish; by implication, to finish, fashion. In the KJV it is rendered: cause, to (deed), perform, work (out).
G2718: From κατά and ἔρχομαι (including its alternate); to come (or go) down (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: come (down), depart, descend, go down, land.
G2719: From κατά and ἐσθίω (including its alternate); to eat down, i.e. devour (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: devour.
G2720: From κατά and εὐθύνω; to straighten fully, i.e. (figuratively) direct. In the KJV it is rendered: guide, direct.
G2721: From κατά and ἐφίστημι; to stand over against, i.e. rush upon (assault). In the KJV it is rendered: make insurrection against.
G2722: From κατά and ἔχω; to hold down (fast), in various applications (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: have, hold (fast), keep (in memory), let, X make toward, possess, retain, seize on, stay, take, withhold.
G2723: From κατήγορος; to be a plaintiff, i.e. to charge with some offence. In the KJV it is rendered: accuse, object.
G2724: From κατήγορος; a complaint ("category"), i.e. criminal charge. In the KJV it is rendered: accusation (X -ed).
G2725: From κατά and ἀγορά; against one in the assembly, i.e. a complainant at law; specially, Satan. In the KJV it is rendered: accuser.
G2726: From a compound of κατά and perhaps a derivative of the base of φαίνω (meaning downcast in look); demureness, i.e. (by implication) sadness. In the KJV it is rendered: heaviness.
G2727: From κατά and ἦχος; to sound down into the ears, i.e. (by implication) to indoctrinate ("catechize") or (genitive case) to apprise of. In the KJV it is rendered: inform, instruct, teach.
G2728: From κατά and a derivative of ἰός; to rust down, i.e. corrode. In the KJV it is rendered: canker.
G2729: From κατά and ἰσχύω; to overpower. In the KJV it is rendered: prevail (against).
G2730: From κατά and οἰκέω; to house permanently, i.e. reside (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: dwell(-er), inhabitant(-ter).
G2731: From κατοικέω; residence (properly, the act; but by implication, concretely, the mansion). In the KJV it is rendered: dwelling.
G2732: From a derivative of κατοικέω; a dwelling-place. In the KJV it is rendered: habitation.
G2733: Residence (properly, the condition; but by implication, the abode itself). In the KJV it is rendered: habitation.
G2734: Middle voice from a compound of κατά and a derivative of ὀπτάνομαι (compare ἔσοπτρον); to mirror oneself, i.e. to see reflected (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: behold as in a glass.
G2735: From a compound of κατά and a derivative of ὀρθός (compare διόρθωσις); something made fully upright, i.e. (figuratively) rectification (specially, good public administration). In the KJV it is rendered: very worthy deed.
G2736: Also (compare) katotero (compare κατώτερος); adverb from κατά; downwards. In the KJV it is rendered: beneath, bottom, down, under.
G2737: Comparative from κάτω; inferior (locally, of Hades). In the KJV it is rendered: lower.
G2738: From καίω; properly, a burn (concretely), but used (abstractly) of a glow. In the KJV it is rendered: heat.
G2739: From καῦμα; to burn. In the KJV it is rendered: scorch.
G2740: From καίω; burning (the act). In the KJV it is rendered: be burned.
G2741: From καῦσις; to set on fire. In the KJV it is rendered: fervent heat.
G2742: From καυσόω; a glare. In the KJV it is rendered: (burning) heat.
G2743: From a derivative of καίω; to brand ("cauterize"), i.e. (by implication) to render unsensitive (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: sear with a hot iron.
G2744: From some (obsolete) base akin to that of aucheo (to boast) and εὔχομαι; to vaunt (in a good or a bad sense). In the KJV it is rendered: (make) boast, glory, joy, rejoice.
G2745: From καυχάομαι; a boast (properly, the object; by implication, the act) in a good or a bad sense. In the KJV it is rendered: boasting, (whereof) to glory (of), glorying, rejoice(-ing).
G2746: From καυχάομαι; boasting (properly, the act; by implication, the object), in a good or a bad sense. In the KJV it is rendered: boasting, whereof I may glory, glorying, rejoicing.
G2747: Probably from kegchros (millet); Cenchreæ, a port of Corinth. In the KJV it is rendered: Cencrea.
G2748: Of Hebrew origin (קִדְרוֹן); Cedron (i.e. Kidron), a brook near Jerusalem. In the KJV it is rendered: Cedron.
G2749: Middle voice of a primary verb; to lie outstretched (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: be (appointed, laid up, made, set), lay, lie.
G2750: Of uncertain affinity; a swathe, i.e. winding-sheet. In the KJV it is rendered: graveclothes.
G2751: A primary verb; to shear. In the KJV it is rendered: shear(-er).
G2752: From κελεύω; a cry of incitement. In the KJV it is rendered: shout.
G2753: From a primary kello (to urge on); "hail"; to incite by word, i.e. order. In the KJV it is rendered: bid, (at, give) command(-ment).
G2754: From κενόδοξος; empty glorying, i.e. self-conceit. In the KJV it is rendered: vain-glory.
G2755: From κενός and δόξα; vainly glorifying, i.e. self-conceited. In the KJV it is rendered: desirous of vain-glory.
G2756: Apparently a primary word; empty (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: empty, (in) vain.
G2757: From a presumed compound of κενός and φωνή; empty sounding, i.e. fruitless discussion. In the KJV it is rendered: vain.
G2758: From κενός; to make empty, i.e. (figuratively) to abase, neutralize, falsify. In the KJV it is rendered: make (of none effect, of no reputation, void), be in vain.
G2759: From kenteo (to prick); a point ("centre"), i.e. a sting (figuratively, poison) or goad (figuratively, divine impulse). In the KJV it is rendered: prick, sting.
G2760: Of Latin origin; a centurion, i.e. captain of one hundred soldiers. In the KJV it is rendered: centurion.
G2761: Adverb from κενός; vainly, i.e. to no purpose. In the KJV it is rendered: in vain.
G2762: Feminine of a presumed derivative of the base of κέρας; something horn-like, i.e. (specially) the apex of a Hebrew letter (figuratively, the least particle). In the KJV it is rendered: tittle.
G2763: From κέραμος; a potter. In the KJV it is rendered: potter.
G2764: From κέραμος; made of clay, i.e. earthen. In the KJV it is rendered: of a potter.
G2765: Neuter of a presumed derivative of κέραμος; an earthenware vessel, i.e. jar. In the KJV it is rendered: pitcher.
G2766: Probably from the base of κεράννυμι (through the idea of mixing clay and water); earthenware, i.e. a tile (by analogy, a thin roof or awning). In the KJV it is rendered: tiling.
G2767: Prolonged form of a more primary kerao ker-ah'-o (which is used in certain tenses); to mingle, i.e. (by implication) to pour out (for drinking). In the KJV it is rendered: fill, pour out.
G2768: From a primary kar (the hair of the head); a horn (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: horn.
G2769: Neuter of a presumed derivative of κέρας; something horned, i.e. (specially) the pod of the carob-tree. In the KJV it is rendered: husk.
G2770: From κέρδος; to gain (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: (get) gain, win.
G2771: Of uncertain affinity; gain (pecuniary or genitive case). In the KJV it is rendered: gain, lucre.
G2772: From κείρω; a clipping (bit), i.e. (specially) a coin. In the KJV it is rendered: money.
G2773: From a derivative of κέρμα; a handler of coins, i.e. money-broker. In the KJV it is rendered: changer of money.
G2774: Neuter of a derivative of κεφαλή; a principal thing, i.e. main point; specially, an amount (of money). In the KJV it is rendered: sum.
G2775: From the same as κεφάλαιον; (specially) to strike on the head. In the KJV it is rendered: wound in the head.
G2776: From the primary kapto (in the sense of seizing); the head (as the part most readily taken hold of), literally or figuratively. In the KJV it is rendered: head.
G2777: From κεφαλή; properly, a knob, i.e. (by implication) a roll (by extension from the end of a stick on which the manuscript was rolled). In the KJV it is rendered: volume.
G2778: Of Latin origin; properly, an enrollment ("census"), i.e. (by implication) a tax. In the KJV it is rendered: tribute.
G2779: Of uncertain affinity; a garden. In the KJV it is rendered: garden.
G2780: From κῆπος and ouros (a warden); a garden-keeper, i.e. gardener. In the KJV it is rendered: gardener.
G2781: Diminutive from keos (wax); a cell for honey, i.e. (collectively) the comb. In the KJV it is rendered: (honey-)comb.
G2782: From κηρύσσω; a proclamation (especially of the gospel; by implication, the gospel itself). In the KJV it is rendered: preaching.
G2783: From κηρύσσω; a herald, i.e. of divine truth (especially of the gospel). In the KJV it is rendered: preacher.
G2784: Of uncertain affinity; to herald (as a public crier), especially divine truth (the gospel). In the KJV it is rendered: preacher(-er), proclaim, publish.
G2785: Probably from the base of χάσμα; a huge fish (as gaping for prey). In the KJV it is rendered: whale.
G2786: Of Chaldee origin (compare כֵּפִים); the Rock; Cephas (i.e. Kepha), a surname of Peter. In the KJV it is rendered: Cephas.
G2787: Of uncertain derivation; a box, i.e. the sacred ark and that of Noah. In the KJV it is rendered: ark.
G2788: Of uncertain affinity; a lyre. In the KJV it is rendered: harp.
G2789: From κιθάρα; to play on a lyre. In the KJV it is rendered: harp.
G2790: From κιθάρα and a derivative of the same as ᾠδή; a lyre-singer(-player), i.e. harpist. In the KJV it is rendered: harper.
G2791: Probably of foreign origin; Cilicia, a region of Asia Minor. In the KJV it is rendered: Cilicia.
G2792: Of foreign origin (compare קִנָּמוֹן); cinnamon. In the KJV it is rendered: cinnamon.
G2793: From κίνδυνος; to undergo peril. In the KJV it is rendered: be in danger, be (stand) in jeopardy.
G2794: Of uncertain derivation; danger. In the KJV it is rendered: peril.
G2795: From kio (poetic for eimi, to go); to stir (transitively), literally or figuratively. In the KJV it is rendered: (re-)move(-r), way.
G2796: From κινέω; a stirring. In the KJV it is rendered: moving.
G2797: Of Hebrew origin (קִישׁ); Cis (i.e. Kish), an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Cis.
G2798: From κλάω; a twig or bough (as if broken off). In the KJV it is rendered: branch.
G2799: Of uncertain affinity; to sob, i.e. wail aloud (whereas δακρύω is rather to cry silently). In the KJV it is rendered: bewail, weep.
G2800: From κλάω; fracture (the act). In the KJV it is rendered: breaking.
G2801: From κλάω; a piece (bit). In the KJV it is rendered: broken, fragment.
G2802: Of uncertain derivation; Claude, an island near Crete. In the KJV it is rendered: Clauda.
G2803: Feminine of Κλαύδιος; Claudia, a Christian woman. In the KJV it is rendered: Claudia.
G2804: Of Latin origin; Claudius, the name of two Romans. In the KJV it is rendered: Claudius.
G2805: From κλαίω; lamentation. In the KJV it is rendered: wailing, weeping, X wept.
G2806: A primary verb; to break (specially, of bread). In the KJV it is rendered: break.
G2807: From κλείω; a key (as shutting a lock), literally or figuratively. In the KJV it is rendered: key.
G2808: A primary verb; to close (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: shut (up).
G2809: From κλέπτω; stealing (properly, the thing stolen, but used of the act). In the KJV it is rendered: theft.
G2810: Probably contracted from Kleopatros (compound of κλέος and πατήρ); Cleopas, a Christian. In the KJV it is rendered: Cleopas.
G2811: From a shorter form of καλέω; renown (as if being called). In the KJV it is rendered: glory.
G2812: From κλέπτω; a stealer (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: thief.
G2813: A primary verb; to filch. In the KJV it is rendered: steal.
G2814: From κλάω; a limb or shoot (as if broken off). In the KJV it is rendered: branch.
G2815: Of Latin origin; merciful; Clemes (i.e. Clemens), a Christian. In the KJV it is rendered: Clement.
G2816: From κληρονόμος; to be an heir to (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: be heir, (obtain by) inherit(-ance).
G2817: From κληρονόμος; heirship, i.e. (concretely) a patrimony or (genitive case) a possession. In the KJV it is rendered: inheritance.
G2818: From κλῆρος and the base of νόμος (in its original sense of partitioning, i.e. (reflexively) getting by apportionment); a sharer by lot, i.e. inheritor (literally or figuratively); by implication, a possessor. In the KJV it is rendered: heir.
G2819: Probably from κλάω (through the idea of using bits of wood, etc., for the purpose; a die (for drawing chances); by implication, a portion (as if so secured); by extension, an acquisition (especially a patrimony, figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: heritage, inheritance, lot, part.
G2820: From κλῆρος; to allot, i.e. (figuratively) to assign (a privilege). In the KJV it is rendered: obtain an inheritance.
G2821: From a shorter form of καλέω; an invitation (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: calling.
G2822: From the same as κλῆσις; invited, i.e. appointed, or (specially), a saint. In the KJV it is rendered: called.
G2823: Of uncertain derivation; an earthen pot used for baking in. In the KJV it is rendered: oven.
G2824: From κλίνω; a slope, i.e. (specially) a "clime" or tract of country. In the KJV it is rendered: part, region.
G2825: From κλίνω; a couch (for sleep, sickness, sitting or eating). In the KJV it is rendered: bed, table.
G2826: Neuter of a presumed derivative of κλίνη; a pallet or little couch. In the KJV it is rendered: bed.
G2827: A primary verb; to slant or slope, i.e. incline or recline (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: bow (down), be far spent, lay, turn to flight, wear away.
G2828: From a derivative of κλίνω; properly, reclination, i.e. (concretely and specially), a party at a meal. In the KJV it is rendered: company.
G2829: From κλέπτω; stealing. In the KJV it is rendered: theft.
G2830: From kluzo (to billow or dash over); a surge of the sea (literally or figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: raging, wave.
G2831: Middle voice from κλύδων; to surge, i.e. (figuratively) to fluctuate. In the KJV it is rendered: toss to and fro.
G2832: Of Chaldee origin (corresponding to אַחְאָב); Clopas, an Israelite. In the KJV it is rendered: Cleophas.
G2833: From a primary knao (to scrape); to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to tickle. In the KJV it is rendered: X itching.
G2834: Probably of foreign origin; Cnidus, a place in Asia Minor. In the KJV it is rendered: Cnidus.
G2835: Of Latin origin; a quadrans, i.e. the fourth part of an as. In the KJV it is rendered: farthing.
G2836: From koilos ("hollow"); a cavity, i.e. (especially) the abdomen; by implication, the matrix; figuratively, the heart. In the KJV it is rendered: belly, womb.
G2837: From κεῖμαι; to put to sleep, i.e. (passively or reflexively) to slumber; figuratively, to decease. In the KJV it is rendered: (be a-, fall a-, fall on) sleep, be dead.
G2838: From κοιμάω; sleeping, i.e. (by implication) repose. In the KJV it is rendered: taking of rest.
G2839: Probably from σύν; common, i.e. (literally) shared by all or several, or (ceremonially) profane. In the KJV it is rendered: common, defiled, unclean, unholy.
G2840: From κοινός; to make (or consider) profane (ceremonially). In the KJV it is rendered: call common, defile, pollute, unclean.
G2841: From κοινωνός; to share with others (objectively or subjectively). In the KJV it is rendered: communicate, distribute, be partaker.
G2842: From κοινωνός; partnership, i.e. (literally) participation, or (social) intercourse, or (pecuniary) benefaction. In the KJV it is rendered: (to) communicate(-ation), communion, (contri-)distribution, fellowship.
G2843: From κοινωνός; communicative, i.e. (pecuniarily) liberal. In the KJV it is rendered: willing to communicate.
G2844: From κοινός; a sharer, i.e. associate. In the KJV it is rendered: companion, X fellowship, partaker, partner.
G2845: From κεῖμαι; a couch; by extension, cohabitation; by implication, the male sperm. In the KJV it is rendered: bed, chambering, X conceive.
G2846: From κοίτη; a bedroom. In the KJV it is rendered: + chamberlain.
G2847: From κόκκος (from the kernel-shape of the insect); crimson-colored. In the KJV it is rendered: scarlet (colour, coloured).
G2848: Apparently a primary word; a kernel of seed. In the KJV it is rendered: corn, grain.
G2849: From kolos (dwarf); properly, to curtail, i.e. (figuratively) to chastise (or reserve for infliction). In the KJV it is rendered: punish.
G2850: From a derivative of kolax (a fawner); flattery. In the KJV it is rendered: X flattering.
G2851: From κολάζω; penal infliction. In the KJV it is rendered: punishment, torment.
G2852: From a derivative of the base of κολάζω; to rap with the fist. In the KJV it is rendered: buffet.
G2853: From kolla ("glue"); to glue, i.e. (passively or reflexively) to stick (figuratively). In the KJV it is rendered: cleave, join (self), keep company.
G2854: Neuter of a presumed derivative of kollura (a cake; prob akin to the base of κολλάω); properly, a poultice (as made of or in the form of crackers), i.e. (by analogy) a plaster. In the KJV it is rendered: eyesalve.
G2855: From a presumed derivative of kollubos (a small coin; probably akin to κολλούριον); a coin-dealer. In the KJV it is rendered: (money-)changer.
G2856: From a derivative of the base of κολάζω; to dock, i.e. (figuratively) abridge. In the KJV it is rendered: shorten.
G2857: Apparently feminine plural of kolossos ("colossal"); Colossæ, a place in Asia Minor. In the KJV it is rendered: Colosse.
G2858: From Κολοσσαί; a Colossæan, (i.e. inhabitant of Colossæ. In the KJV it is rendered: Colossian.
G2859: Apparently a primary word; the bosom; by analogy, a bay. In the KJV it is rendered: bosom, creek.
G2860: From kolumbos (a diver); to plunge into water. In the KJV it is rendered: swim.
G2861: From κολυμβάω; a diving-place, i.e. pond for bathing (or swimming). In the KJV it is rendered: pool.
G2862: Of Latin origin; a Roman "colony" for veterans. In the KJV it is rendered: colony.
G2863: From κόμη; to wear tresses of hair. In the KJV it is rendered: have long hair.
G2864: Apparently from the same as κομίζω; the hair of the head (locks, as ornamental, and thus differing from θρίξ; which properly denotes merely the scalp). In the KJV it is rendered: hair.
G2865: From a primary komeo (to tend, i.e. take care of); properly, to provide for, i.e. (by implication) to carry off (as if from harm; genitive case obtain). In the KJV it is rendered: bring, receive.
G2866: Neuter comparative of a derivative of the base of κομίζω (meaning, properly, well dressed, i.e. nice); figuratively, convalescent. In the KJV it is rendered: + began to amend.
G2867: From konia (dust; by analogy, lime); to whitewash. In the KJV it is rendered: whiten.
G2868: From the base of κονιάω and ornumi (to "rouse"); pulverulence (as blown about). In the KJV it is rendered: dust.
G2869: From κόπος; to tire, i.e. (figuratively) to relax. In the KJV it is rendered: cease.
G2870: From κόπτω; mourning (properly, by beating the breast). In the KJV it is rendered: lamentation.
G2871: From κόπτω; cutting, i.e. carnage. In the KJV it is rendered: slaughter.
G2872: From a derivative of κόπος; to feel fatigue; by implication, to work hard. In the KJV it is rendered: (bestow) labour, toil, be wearied.
G2873: From κόπτω; a cut, i.e. (by analogy) toil (as reducing the strength), literally or figuratively; by implication, pains. In the KJV it is rendered: labour, + trouble, weariness.
G2874: From kopros (ordure; perhaps akin to κόπτω); manure. In the KJV it is rendered: dung(-hill).
G2875: A primary verb; to "chop"; specially, to beat the breast in grief. In the KJV it is rendered: cut down, lament, mourn, (be-)wail.
G2876: Perhaps from κορέννυμι; a crow (from its voracity). In the KJV it is rendered: raven.
G2877: Neuter of a presumed derivative of kore (a maiden); a (little) girl. In the KJV it is rendered: damsel, maid.

G2957: Of uncertain derivation; Cyrene, a region of Africa. In the KJV it is rendered: Cyrene.
G2958: Of Latin origin; Cyrenius (i.e. Quirinus), a Roman. In the KJV it is rendered: Cyrenius.

G3161: Of Hebrew origin (מַתִּתְיָה); Mattathias (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite and a Christian. In the KJV it is rendered: Mattathias.
